text.title: 联络中断
text.objectives: 在魔导师平台的主教拉雷索尔希望你能找到血精灵间谍塔雷斯。
text.description: 我们在魔导师平台安插了一个联络人，为我们收集了一段时间的情报，但现在我们与他失去了联系。$b$b他的情报对我们的任务极为关键。

english.title: Severed Communications
english.objectives: Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace wants you to find Tyrith, a blood elf spy.
english.description: We've had a contact embedded in Magisters' Terrace gathering intelligence for us for some time now, but we've lost contact with him.$b$bThe information he was collecting is vital to our mission.

text.title: 大难不死
text.objectives: 卡雷苟斯希望你击败魔导师平台的凯尔萨斯。你必须带着凯尔萨斯的徽记向魔导师平台的拉雷索尔复命。
text.description: 正如你所见，燃烧军团贼心不死，仍然想利用太阳井的能量来实现他们的邪恶目的。$b$b凯尔萨斯已经从失败的阴影中走了出来，带领他们卷土重来。你必须阻止他。
text.giverWindow: 这是最后的时刻。

english.title: Hard to Kill
english.objectives: Kalecgos has asked you to defeat Kael'thas in Magisters' Terrace. You are to take Kael's head and report back to Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
english.description: As you've now witnessed, the Legion forces work tirelessly, manipulating the Sunwell's power to achieve their malevolent ends.$b$bKael'thas has risen from the ashes of defeat and once more leads them in their efforts. He must be stopped.
english.giverWindow: This is his final hour.

text.title: 激进思维
text.objectives: 魔导师平台的主教拉雷索尔要你杀死维萨鲁斯，获取它的精华。
text.description: 我们输不起这场战争。我想让我们的哨卫变得更加强大，这样这些英勇善战的男女就不会轻易牺牲了。$B$B军团掌握着一个强大的元素生物。它的精华正是我们所需要的东西。

english.title: A Radical Notion
english.objectives: Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace wants you to kill Vexallus and obtain its essence.
english.description: We cannot afford to lose this war. I'd like to empower our sentries so that brave men and women don't have to die.$B$BThe Legion has gotten a hold of a powerful elemental being. Its essence could be just what we need.

text.title: 扭曲的盟友
text.objectives: 魔导师平台的主教拉雷索尔要你杀死塞林·火心和女祭司德莉希亚。
text.description: 燃烧军团和凯尔萨斯的势力逐渐合流了。这令我十分担忧。$B$B从我们收集的情报来看，塞林·火心和女祭司德莉希亚正紧密协作，想将两股势力整合起来。你必须阻止她们。

english.title: Twisted Associations
english.objectives: Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace wants you to kill Selin Fireheart and Priestess Delrissa.
english.description: The Legion and Kael'thas' forces are becoming increasingly intertwined. This concerns me very deeply.$B$BFrom what we can gather Selin Fireheart and Priestess Delrissa work closely together to unite the two armies. You need to stop them.

text.title: 再踏征程
text.objectives: 暗影猎手塔金想要你和地狱火城墙破碎大厅内的石头守卫斯托克顿谈一谈。
text.description: 我始终在默默聆听，$C。我乃酋长之耳。$B$B我军在地狱火城墙的战备状态我也早有耳闻。现在是时候挺进邪兽人的老巢破碎大厅了。$B$B去和石头守卫斯托克顿取得联络，他负责指挥那里的行动。
text.completion: Keep your head down, or it's likely to end up on the wrong end of an arrow.

english.title: Advancing the Campaign
english.objectives: Shadow Hunter Ty'jin has asked you to speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: I mostly listen, $c. I listen so that the Warchief doesn't have to.$B$BI've heard of the status of our campaign against the Hellfire Citadel. It is time to take the Shattered Halls, seat of power for the fel orcs.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton, he's in charge there.
english.completion: Keep your head down, or it's likely to end up on the wrong end of an arrow.

text.title: 再踏征程
text.objectives: 远征军指挥官达纳斯·托尔贝恩要求你和地狱火城墙破碎大厅内的高级斥候卡德维克谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候给邪兽人最后一击了。$B$B高级斥候卡德维克正在地狱火城墙的破碎大厅里等着你。抓紧时间，邪兽人可能随时进犯荣耀堡！

english.title: Advancing the Campaign
english.objectives: Force Commander Danath Trollbane has asked you to speak with Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: The time has come to lay the final blow against the fel orcs.$B$BAdvance Scout Chadwick awaits your presence inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel. Make haste, their forces could strike against Honor Hold at any moment!

starters.name: 远征军指挥官达纳斯·托尔贝恩

text.title: 深入迷雾
text.objectives: 和地狱咆哮之拳的纳兹戈林将军谈一谈。
text.description: <纳兹戈林狠狠地吸了一口海风。>$b$b你闻到了吗，$n？这是家乡的味道，是我辈抛洒热血、誓死捍卫的土地。$b$b你听……听到了吗？这是平静安详的声音——家是我们的避风港，也是敌人不敢踏足的地方。$b$b记住这些吧，很快你将再也无法体验到这种感受了，前面有一场恶仗等着我们去打。$b$b现在快去安顿好，我们就要开船了！

english.title: Into the Mists
english.objectives: Speak to General Nazgrim on Hellscream's Fist.
english.description: <Nazgrim fills his lungs with sea air.>$b$bYou smell that, $n? It's the smell of our home, the lands our kind have bled and died to preserve.$b$bAnd listen... you hear that? It's the sound of peace and safety - a haven we've carved, where our enemies fear to tread.$b$bRemember these things. You won't experience them again anytime soon. We have ourselves a war to win.$b$bNow go get settled, we're shovin' off!

text.title: 我要红色木槿！
text.objectives: 收集5朵红色木槿，交给幽暗沼泽的塔苏。
text.description: 对我们来说，红色木槿的用途非常广泛。$B$B但它只生长在幽暗沼泽中，许多沼泽居民都很喜欢这种植物。$B$B如果你能帮我带些红色木槿回来，我会非常感谢的。
text.progress: Were you able to gather any hibiscus?
text.completion: These will do nicely, but we can always use more.  Perhaps you will find yourself in the Underbog again soon?

english.title: Bring Me A Shrubbery!
english.objectives: Collect 5 Sanguine Hibiscus and return them to T'shu in the Underbog.
english.description: My people use sanguine hibiscus for a number of purposes.$B$BIt grows naturally only in the Underbog, and many of the bog's denizens have taken a liking to it.$B$BIf you could bring me some, I would be very grateful.
english.progress: Were you able to gather any hibiscus?
english.completion: These will do nicely, but we can always use more.  Perhaps you will find yourself in the Underbog again soon?

text.title: 我还要红色木槿！
text.progress: We can still use more sanguine hibiscus. We're always struggling to find more.$B$BBring them to me in bunches of five and I will be most grateful.

english.title: Bring Me Another Shrubbery!
english.progress: We can still use more sanguine hibiscus. We're always struggling to find more.$B$BBring them to me in bunches of five and I will be most grateful.

text.title: The General's Edge
text.objectives: Bring Nazgrim's axe to General Nazgrim.
text.description: As you gradually gather your senses and begin to take in your surroundings, this object stands out amongst the strewn wreckage.$b$bIt occurs to you that this is the first time you've seen Nazgrim's axe outside of his tight grasp. Somehow, this fact makes your predicament even more unsettling...$b$bYou know that dead or alive, the General would want his weapon back in his possession.

english.title: The General's Edge
english.objectives: Bring Nazgrim's axe to General Nazgrim.
english.description: As you gradually gather your senses and begin to take in your surroundings, this object stands out amongst the strewn wreckage.$b$bIt occurs to you that this is the first time you've seen Nazgrim's axe outside of his tight grasp. Somehow, this fact makes your predicament even more unsettling...$b$bYou know that dead or alive, the General would want his weapon back in his possession.

text.title: 重组！
text.objectives: 从蜜露林地营救出匿踪大师琪麟、利维特·急刹、夏琪亚和格罗克中士。
text.description: 他们竟然有座空军基地！上次我低估了那个联盟上尉，失去了好多战友……$b$b一定还有少数几个生还者在炮艇坠毁时挺了过来，每一个有手有脚的战士对我们来说都至关重要。$b$b到下面的林子里尽可能多地找到生还者，我会亲自调查炮艇残骸。把所有人都召集到附近的村子里，我们要反击。

english.title: Regroup!
english.objectives: Rescue Shademaster Kiryn, Rivett Clutchpop, Shokia, and Sergeant Gorrok from Honeydew Glade.
english.description: They have an airbase! I have underestimated this Alliance Captain for the last time. So many good warriors lost...$b$bThere must have been a few survivors who were able to bail during the crash. We need every able-bodied fighter we can get.$b$bFind as many survivors as you can in the forest below, and I will investigate the wreckage itself. Rally everyone together at the nearby village for a counter-attack.

text.title: My Stars!
text.objectives: Collect 100 of Kiryn's Throwing Stars from Devious Wood Sprites.
text.description: A number of Kiryn's articles have been scattered around the area by wood sprites, but this one stands out as important to you.$b$bThe bag once hung from her waist, loaded with throwing stars. Without them, her arsenal will be considerably diminished.$b$bIf you were to retrieve the weapons from the pests that inhabit this region, it could only help your cause.

english.title: My Stars!
english.objectives: Collect 100 of Kiryn's Throwing Stars from Devious Wood Sprites.
english.description: A number of Kiryn's articles have been scattered around the area by wood sprites, but this one stands out as important to you.$b$bThe bag once hung from her waist, loaded with throwing stars. Without them, her arsenal will be considerably diminished.$b$bIf you were to retrieve the weapons from the pests that inhabit this region, it could only help your cause.

text.title: Barrel of Monkies
text.objectives: Sally Fizzlefury wants you to kill 5 drunken monkies.
text.description: These monkeymen are driving me insane!  I was just trying to get some insight into panderan brewing tactics and these hozu things keep drinking the brews before I can properly chemical test them.  Can you please go take a few of them out as a lesson to the others?  I'll make it worth your while.
text.completed: Report your success to Sally Fizzlefury at the farm in Shen-zin Su.

english.title: Barrel of Monkies
english.objectives: Sally Fizzlefury wants you to kill 5 drunken monkies.
english.description: These monkeymen are driving me insane!  I was just trying to get some insight into panderan brewing tactics and these hozu things keep drinking the brews before I can properly chemical test them.  Can you please go take a few of them out as a lesson to the others?  I'll make it worth your while.
english.completed: Report your success to Sally Fizzlefury at the farm in Shen-zin Su.

text.title: The Witch in the Woods
text.objectives: Find An Windfur on the road north of the Jade Witch Hut.
text.description: Oh please $r!  Can you help me?$b$bSome of the village children were playing in the woods and haven't come back. Could you please keep an eye out for them if you are going out there?$b$bI told those village rascals to leave that old widow up in the woods alone. My guess is they are probably harassing her. They think she is a witch.
text.completed: Find An Windfur.

english.title: The Witch in the Woods
english.objectives: Find An Windfur on the road north of the Jade Witch Hut.
english.description: Oh please $r!  Can you help me?$b$bSome of the village children were playing in the woods and haven't come back. Could you please keep an eye out for them if you are going out there?$b$bI told those village rascals to leave that old widow up in the woods alone. My guess is they are probably harassing her. They think she is a witch.
english.completed: Find An Windfur.

text.title: 胆比猢狲大
text.objectives: 营救6个受惊吓的熊猫人儿童。
text.description: 我知道林子里有个巫婆，但是没人相信我。她把我朋友阿信变成了青玉！$b$b我们都非常害怕，想要往回逃，但她放了大青玉怪来咬我们。为了躲避，很多伙伴都爬上了树。$b$b你能帮忙救救我的伙伴吗？
text.completion: Oh thank you so much for helping find my friends.  I still don't see Shin though...

english.title: The Double Hozen Dare
english.objectives: Rescue 6 Scared Pandaren cubs.
english.description: There is a witch in the woods but no one believes me. She turned my friend Shin into jade!$b$bWe were all so scared we tried to run back but she sicced her big jade monsters on us. A bunch of my friends tried to get away by climbing trees.$b$bCan you help me save my friends?
english.completion: Oh thank you so much for helping find my friends.  I still don't see Shin though...

text.title: 教训小猫！
text.objectives: 消灭8个青玉守护者。
text.description: 我曾试图跟林子里的一只青玉虎搏斗，但它们太恐怖了。它们盯着你看，你就会变成一尊青玉雕像！$b$b真的！陈的姐姐有一个朋友叫尼，尼从凯的妈妈那里听说过这件事。$b$b我真希望能像你一样勇敢。你能教我怎样才能打败那些青玉虎吗？
text.completion: Wow! You were awesome! You were like *bam* and they were like *aaaaa* and then they were smashed!

english.title: Down Kitty!
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Jade Guardians.
english.description: I tried to fight one of the jade tigers in the woods but they were too scary. They stare at you and you turn to a jade statue!$b$bHonest truth! Chen's sister's friend Ni heard it from Kai's mom.$b$bI want to be brave like you though. Can you show me how to beat up those jade tigers?
english.completion: Wow! You were awesome! You were like *bam* and they were like *aaaaa* and then they were smashed!

text.title: The Double Hozu Dare
text.objectives: Inspect 7 Lifelike Jade Statues south of the Jade Witch Hut.
text.description: Shin is still missing!$b$bI never... I mean the other kids never should have double hozu dared him to knock on the witch's door. $b$bWe saw a bunch of jade statues south of the Jade Witch's hut. $b$bCan you come with me and see if any of them are Shin?
text.completed: Speak with An Windfur.

english.title: The Double Hozu Dare
english.objectives: Inspect 7 Lifelike Jade Statues south of the Jade Witch Hut.
english.description: Shin is still missing!$b$bI never... I mean the other kids never should have double hozu dared him to knock on the witch's door. $b$bWe saw a bunch of jade statues south of the Jade Witch's hut. $b$bCan you come with me and see if any of them are Shin?
english.completed: Speak with An Windfur.

text.title: A Lesson in Bravery
text.objectives: Defeat 8 Leafy Tricksters south of the Jade Witch Hut.
text.description: Can you help teach me to be brave like you?$b$bWhen we played our prank on the witch we made a bunch of Leafy Tricksters angry.  I think the witch did something to them.$b$bCan you show me how you stand up to them?

english.title: A Lesson in Bravery
english.objectives: Defeat 8 Leafy Tricksters south of the Jade Witch Hut.
english.description: Can you help teach me to be brave like you?$b$bWhen we played our prank on the witch we made a bunch of Leafy Tricksters angry.  I think the witch did something to them.$b$bCan you show me how you stand up to them?

text.title: 青玉巫婆
text.objectives: 击败青玉巫婆。
text.description: 阿信一定还在青玉巫婆手里。$b$b我……我做不到！我不想见到那个巫婆。你能不能去和她谈一谈，看看阿信是不是还在她手里？$b$b你是个成年人，我想她不会把你变成玉雕的。
text.completion: Hurray! Thank you so much! Shin is saved and you beat up the old witch! And the best part is our parents were never told what we were up to. Hurray!$b$bIt looks like everybody who came back are trying to get rid of whatever jade they had. Toya's been collecting it for some reason and said you should go chat with him.
text.giverWindow: 她之所以被叫做“青玉巫婆”，是因为她院子里那些活灵活现的青玉雕像。

english.title: The Jade Witch
english.objectives: Defeat the Jade Witch.
english.description: The Jade Witch must still have Shin.$b$bI... I can't do it! I don't want to see the witch. Can you please go talk to her and see if she has Shin?$b$bYou're an adult, I don't think she would try to turn you into jade.
english.completion: Hurray! Thank you so much! Shin is saved and you beat up the old witch! And the best part is our parents were never told what we were up to. Hurray!$b$bIt looks like everybody who came back are trying to get rid of whatever jade they had. Toya's been collecting it for some reason and said you should go chat with him.
english.giverWindow: Known to locals as "The Jade Witch" due to the lifelike jade statues she keeps in her yard.

text.title: 军情七处报告：居高临下
text.objectives: 听苏利报告。
text.description: 耶！我们找到安玻了，她还活着，毫发无伤地活着。但好消息到此结束了。$b$b看看我们能不能沿着利尔的线索走下去……
text.completion: So, now you know why ol' Rell's all beat up.$b$b<You detect a change in Sully's facial expression, and he quickly turns away. Is he... crying?>

english.title: SI:7 Report: Fire From the Sky
english.objectives: Listen to Sully's report.
english.description: Yeah, we found Amber, she's alive, and all that. That's about where the good news stops though.$b$bLet's see if I can pick up where ol' Rell left off...
english.completion: So, now you know why ol' Rell's all beat up.$b$b<You detect a change in Sully's facial expression, and he quickly turns away. Is he... crying?>

text.title: 军情七处报告：敌对土著
text.objectives: 听小卢报告。
text.description: 我……我可以告诉你后来发生什么了！我们继续往北，走进了森林……
text.completion: Luckily, we all made it out alive.$b$bWell... all of us except for Socks...

english.title: SI:7 Report: Hostile Natives
english.objectives: Listen to Little Lu's report.
english.description: I... I can tell you what happened next! We continued north, into the forest...
english.completion: Luckily, we all made it out alive.$b$bWell... all of us except for Socks...

objectiveDetails.description: 检查栩栩如生的青玉雕像

text.title: 军情七处报告：不留俘虏
text.objectives: 听取安玻·吉尔妮的报告。
text.description: 我们最后去了西边，来到一个很大的猢狲村落。我们在山里，他们看不见的地方建了个小营地……
text.completion: So there you have it. We didn't find the White Pawn, but we came back with intel that could be of even greater importance to the Alliance.$b$bThe Horde have allied with the hozen, and are arming them as we speak. They and their monkey army now outnumber us thirty to one.

english.title: SI:7 Report: Take No Prisoners
english.objectives: Listen to Amber Kearnen's report.
english.description: The final leg of our journey took us west, to a large hozen village. We set up a small camp in the mountains, outside of their line of sight...
english.completion: So there you have it. We didn't find the White Pawn, but we came back with intel that could be of even greater importance to the Alliance.$b$bThe Horde have allied with the hozen, and are arming them as we speak. They and their monkey army now outnumber us thirty to one.

objectiveDetails.description: 带着苏利穿过猢狲营地

text.title: 销毁证据
text.objectives: 在蓝玉号船骸的沉船附近安放4个土制炸药。土制炸药之间的间隔不得少于10码。
text.description: 我必须请你再为我做件事，$N。$B$B我们不能把船上的私人物品留下让其他人发现。我们必须摧毁它。$B$B我用你找来的碎片组装了一些土制炸药。$B$B把这些炸药放到船上的任何位置，不过要注意的是别把它们放的太近。$B$B它们可能……呃……有一点不好控制，所以你必须分散摆放以免它们提前爆炸。
text.completed: Return to Nodd Codejack at Sapphire's End in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Explosive Evidence
english.objectives: Plant 4 Makeshift Dynamite near the sunken ship at Sapphire's End. Makeshift Dynamite must be placed at least 10 yards apart.
english.description: I must ask you to do one more thing for me, $n.$B$BThe personal effects on this ship cannot be left for others to find. We'll have to destroy it.$B$BI cobbled together some Makeshift Dynamite from the scraps you brought me.$B$BPlace the dynamite anywhere on the ship, but take care not to put them too close together.$B$BThey might be...uh...a little unwieldy, so you should spread them out in case of premature detonation.
english.completed: Return to Nodd Codejack at Sapphire's End in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 斥候报告：敌对土著
text.objectives: 听里克报告。
text.description: 我想我知道你想问什么：“格罗克中士到底发生什么事了？”别担心，不用担心。他绝对还活着。没有死。$b$b<里克不安地踱着步。>$b$b好吧，我们认为他应该还活着，但也可能死了。$b$b<里克看着你的眼睛，想确定你是否明白他的意思。>$b$b哎！我来告诉你到底发生什么了吧。

english.title: Scouting Report: Hostile Natives
english.objectives: Listen to Riko's report.
english.description: I bet I know your first question: "What the ook happened to Sergeant Gorrok?" Don't worry, don't worry. He's totally alive. Not dead or anything.$b$b<Riko shuffles uncomfortably.>$b$bWell, we THINK he's alive, but he ALSO might be very, very dead.$b$b<Riko looks into your eyes for approval.>$b$bFine! Let me tell you exactly what happened.

objectiveDetails.description: 查看栩栩如生的青玉雕像

text.title: 斥候报告：步入正轨
text.objectives: 听琪麟报告。
text.description: 里克的话大部分是真的。$b$b我们不敢去找格罗克——因为部落在这儿的人数太少了。我们已经无法承受更大的损失了，说实话，我们完全不知道那个寡妇究竟有多厉害。$b$b让我接着从猢狲那里说起……

english.title: Scouting Report: On the Right Track
english.objectives: Listen to Kiryn's report.
english.description: MOST of what Riko said is true.$b$bWe didn't dare pursue Gorrok - the Horde's numbers here are far too few. Our forces can only sustain so many losses, and frankly, we don't know how powerful that witch really is.$b$bLet me pick up where the hozen left off...

objectiveDetails.description: 搜索神龙之心的生命迹象

text.title: What Goes Down, Must Come Up!
text.objectives: Use the Goblin Drone Dispenser near the Exposed Root to recover supplies.$b$bNOTE: Each use will require one Cliff Glider Tail.
text.description: Rivett left behind what looks to be an important piece of equipment. Along its shaft you are able to make out the words: Goblin Drone Dispenser.$b$bWith a simple calibration, the device is set to deliver drones to Nazgrim's basecamp.$b$bEasy enough....$b$bThere's just one problem. The only supply crates worth transporting have fallen to the cliff ledge below the crash impact.$b$bAs you ponder the issue, you see the long, coiled tail of a Cliff Glider fly by the corner of your eye...

text.title: 军情七处报告：丛林迷失
text.objectives: 听利尔报告。
text.description: <利尔重重地咳嗽了几声才开口说话。>$b$b拜托了，$n。你得听听我们的遭遇。$b$b所有来这儿的联盟都该听听我们的遭遇。时间不多了。
text.completion: ...and that's <cough> how we found...$b$b<Rell's speech devolves into heavy coughing. The corner of his mouth produces a trickle of blood.>

english.title: SI:7 Report: Lost in the Woods
english.objectives: Listen to Rell's report.
english.description: <Rell coughs heavily before speaking.>$b$bPlease, $n. You need to hear what we've been through.$b$bThe whole damned Alliance needs to hear what we've been through. There may not be much time left.
english.completion: ...and that's <cough> how we found...$b$b<Rell's speech devolves into heavy coughing. The corner of his mouth produces a trickle of blood.>

text.title: 怪物
text.objectives: 收集每块古代雕像碎片的草图。
text.description: 显而易见，这座雕像和周围的废墟都源自上古时代。毫无疑问，这片大陆有着悠久的历史，不可能是在大灾变中新形成的。$b$b多年来附近的海域早已被探索过许多次，却从未发现大陆的踪影，只有一望无际的海水。$b$b如果你能绘出这些雕像碎片的草图，也许就能解开这片大陆的起源之谜。

english.title: Monstrosity
english.objectives: Collect sketches of each piece of the ancient statue.
english.description: It's plain to see that this statue and the surrounding ruins are of ancient origin. Clearly, this land has a deep history, which means it could not have been born of the cataclysm.$b$bAnd yet these waters have been explored for ages now, with no record of anything here but open sea.$b$bPerhaps if you were to sketch the pieces of this broken statue, you might shed light on the continent's origins.

text.title: Some "Pupil of Nature"
text.objectives: Investigate the Woods of the Lost, northeast of the Greenstone Quarry.
text.description: Wood sprites are not prone to wandering, so I'm surprised they ventured down as far as the mason's quarter. Something must be forcing them out of their natural habitat.$B$BThese particular sprites are native to the Woods of the Lost, just north of here. I'd go myself, but I've heard those woods are haunted.$B$BSo yeah, that's out.$B$BI guess we'll never know.$B$B<Weng coughs.>$B$BOrrrr... A big brave adventurer like YOU could go check it out! What do you say?

What do you say?

text.title: 林精的困境
text.objectives: 在失落林地摧毁10个缚岩毁灭者，并找出它们的源头。
text.description: <那些活着的雕像在林间肆虐。$B$B目前看来，它们似乎还满足于把林精撕成碎片。但如果让它们继续这样下去，恐怕熊猫人要担心的就不止是丢几块玉石那么简单了。>
text.completion: <Each statue shatters with a blood-curtling wail as spirits burst free.$B$BThe statues are not merely animate: they are possessed.>

english.title: The Sprites' Plight
english.objectives: Slay 10 Stonebound Destroyer the Woods of the Lost and discover their source.
english.description: <Living statues rampage through the woods.$B$BFor now, they seem content in pummeling the forest sprites into splinters, but if they continue any further the pandaren will have more than just missing jade to worry about.>
english.completion: <Each statue shatters with a blood-curtling wail as spirits burst free.$B$BThe statues are not merely animate: they are possessed.>

text.title: Breadcrumb Into Ruins
text.objectives: Head into the Ruins of Gan Shi, northwest of the [JADE MINES].
text.description: The spirits released from these statues are being pulled--rather violently--toward the coastal ruins up ahead.$B$BIt seems unlikely that they'll be allowed to rest...

english.title: Breadcrumb Into Ruins
english.objectives: Head into the Ruins of Gan Shi, northwest of the [JADE MINES].
english.description: The spirits released from these statues are being pulled--rather violently--toward the coastal ruins up ahead.$B$BIt seems unlikely that they'll be allowed to rest...

text.title: 打破循环
text.objectives: 在十雷台击败8个山泽缚灵者。
text.description: <魔古咒术师从冥间召来了不幸的灵魂，将他们强行封入雕像中。$B$B看来仅仅破坏雕像还不足以打破这种循环。>
text.completion: <The spirits may yet find peace.>

english.title: Break the Cycle
english.objectives: Kill 8 Shan'ze Spiritbinders in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: <Mogu conjurers call forth hapless spirits from beyond, forcing them into statues.$B$BIt seems that destroying the statues alone will not be enough to break the cycle.>
english.completion: <The spirits may yet find peace.>

text.title: 灵俑破灭
text.objectives: 在十雷台踢碎6个无魂毁灭者。
text.description: <一具魔古雕像的破碎残骸。从姿态来看，这个雕像还未激活就被打碎了。$B$B虽然不知道魔古族使用了什么黑暗魔法，但这种邪术似乎能使这些雕像变得更加坚硬。所以你最好在这些雕像还没有被封进灵魂前先摧毁他们。$B$B一记经典的正踢应该就能搞定。>

english.title: Simulacrumble
english.objectives: Kick 6 Vacant Destroyers in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: <The shattered remains of an ancient mogu statue. This one looks like it never animated before it was broken.$B$BWhatever dark magic the mogu are employing here, it seems to make the brittle statues significantly tougher. Better to destroy them while they are still vacant.$B$BA good old-fashioned kick should do the job.>

text.title: 迫切的恳求
text.objectives: 夺回裴智的法杖，并打断十雷台中心区域魔古族的仪式。
text.description: <尖啸声折磨着你的神经。在这可怕的噪声之下，有一丝微弱得几乎听不到的声音，仿佛来自遥远的地方。>$B$B请……帮帮我……废墟的中心地带……仪式……召唤……$B$B……不该来这……$B$B我的法杖……在祭坛……拿到它。请快一点。
text.giverWindow: 去祭坛取回我的法杖，并用古代灵魂来为其充能！

english.title: An Urgent Plea
english.objectives: Recover the Staff of Pei-Zhi and interrupt the mogu ritual in the center of the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: <Your mind is racked with a howl. Beneath it, a wispy voice is barely audible, as if from far away.>$B$BPlease... help... heart of the ruins... a ritual... conjuring...$B$B...should not be here...$B$BMy staff... on the altar... take it. Please hurry.
english.giverWindow: Take my staff from the altar and charge it with Ancient Spirits!

text.title: 灵魂的容器
text.objectives: 在十雷台从山泽灵爪刺客身上收集8个灵魂瓶。
text.description: 灵爪刺客是魔古暗杀祭司中的一个分支。在魔古帝国的鼎盛时期，他们是帝国军队中最精锐、最可怕的力量。$B$B他们每个人都掌握着致命的力量，能够抽取敌人的灵魂并将其封入玉瓶中。这些灵魂最后都会被送到缚灵者手中。$B$B如果你在废墟中遭遇灵爪刺客，记住：他们腰带上挂着的是罄竹难书的罪孽。$B$B让他们为自己的罪行付出代价，把那些瓶子带来给我。

english.title: Vessels of the Spirit
english.objectives: Recover 8 Spirit Bottles from Shan'ze Spiritclaws in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: The Spiritclaws are a sect of mogu assassin-priests who, at the height of the mogu empire, were the most elite and most feared of the emperor's troops.$B$BAll have mastered a deathblow which ensnares the spirit of the enemy, trapping it in a jade bottle for delivery to a Spiritbinder.$B$BIf you encounter any Spiritclaws further ahead in the ruins, take note: their belts hang with a cursed weight.$B$BRelieve them of their burden and bring the bottles back to me.

text.title: 仪式神器
text.objectives: 在十雷台找到缺口的祭祀陶碗、刺鼻的仪式蜡烛和玉琮，并把它们交给裴智。
text.description: 这里囚禁着无数灵魂……我能感觉到，他们无所不在。就连这些高墙都是禁锢逝者的囚笼。$B$B$n，我们不能就这么破坏这里的巫术——这么做只会释放出无数暴怒的灵魂，让他们肆虐大地。他们需要一盏明灯，来指引他们的方向。$B$B在你的帮助下，我能创造出一座接天桥：一座连接现世与彼岸的桥梁。我需要一个碗、一支蜡烛和一块玉琮来举行仪式。你可以在废墟里找到它们。

english.title: Ritual Artifacts
english.objectives: Bring Pei-Zhi a Chipped Ritual Bowl, a Pungent Ritual Candle, and a Jade Cong from the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: So many spirits held in captivity here... I can feel them everywhere. Even the walls are a cage for the long-dead.$B$B$n, we cannot simply break the sorcery over this place - doing so would release countless agonized souls to wander the earth. They will need a beacon, something to guide them.$B$BWith your help, I can create a tan-chao: a bridge from this world to the heavens. For this ritual, I'll need a bowl, a candle, and a jade cong. You should be able to find them all within the ruins.

text.title: 倔强的死者
text.objectives: 在十雷台用裴智的法杖吸收10个倔强的祖先灵魂。
text.description: 魔古族进行这种大规模唤灵仪式也不是毫无副作用的。有些被召唤而来的灵魂因太过狂野而难以驯服。通常，这样的灵魂会被拘禁起来，直到他们绝望屈服。$B$B我怀疑这附近就有魔古族的拘灵场所，很可能就由灵爪刺客看守着。$B$B请再次拿上我的法杖，用它来收集这些倔强的灵魂。你不需要和他们战斗——只要拿出法杖，他们就会被吸进去。

english.title: The Wayward Dead
english.objectives: Use the Staff of Pei-Zhi to absorb 10 Wayward Ancestors in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: The process of mass conjuring, as the mogu are doing here, is not without byproduct. Some spirits arrive too distraught or unruly to be harnessed, so they are confined and left to wander until their desperation leaves them more malleable.$B$BI suspect the mogu have such a holding area somewhere nearby, likely guarded by spiritclaws.$B$BPlease, take my staff again and use it to collect these wayward spirits. You needn't fight them - present the staff and they should be drawn in.

text.title: 重归自然
text.objectives: 在观海听涛林打碎灵魂瓶，释放出8只野兽之魂。
text.description: 恐怕我还得请你帮个忙，$n。$B$B你取回的灵魂瓶中所装的灵魂，既不属于魔古先祖，也不属于刚杀死的敌人，而是野兽的灵魂。看来灵爪刺客曾尝试着通过猎杀野兽来给灵俑充能。$B$B不幸的是，这让我们的任务更复杂了，因为野兽是无法通过接天桥的。$B$B把这些瓶子带到西边的观海听涛林并打碎它们，让那些野兽的灵魂重归自然。有些被怒火所蒙蔽的灵魂可能会攻击你，你得制服它们。

english.title: Back to Nature
english.objectives: Throw Spirit Bottles on the ground in Tideview Thicket to release 8 Beast Spirits.
english.description: I'm afraid I have another favor to ask, $n.$B$BThe bottles you recovered contain neither the spirits of mogu ancestors nor recently slain foes; they contain spirits of beasts. It seems the spiritclaws have resorted to poaching in an effort to fuel their simulacra.$B$BThis complicates our task, for I cannot take the beasts with me through the bridge.$B$BTake the bottles west to Tideview Thicket and smash them to return the spirits to nature. Some may be blind with rage and will need to be subdued.

text.title: 沟通天地
text.objectives: 保护十雷台的裴智直到仪式完成。
text.description: 我们已经准备好打开接天桥，引导这些灵魂安息。$B$B如果可以的话，我想请你再帮一个忙。魔古族一定会察觉到仪式的进行，并拼命来阻止仪式。我只需要一点点时间，通道一旦打开，汹涌而来的灵魂洪流就无人可挡了。$B$B如果你愿意再帮我一次，就请陪伴我前往仪式地点吧。

english.title: To Bridge Earth and Sky
english.objectives: Protect Pei-Zhi during his ritual at the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: We are ready to open the tan-chao and guide all of these spirits back to peace.$B$BIf I may, I would have your assistance once more. The mogu will surely sense the ritual taking place and will do everything in their power to halt it. I need only a few moments without interference, and once the path is open it will surge too greatly to be closed.$B$BIf you are willing to help one more time, please accompany me to the ritual site.

objectiveDetails.description: 在裴智进行仪式时保护他

text.title: 裴智归来
text.objectives: 前往十雷台的唤魂者之座击败单忌同，并救出裴智。
text.description: <先祖之魂源源不断地涌进裴智的接天桥，并重获自由。$B$B接天桥北面的废墟中有一座残存的大厅，那里的天空充斥着邪恶的能量。单忌同已经开始动手了。>

english.title: Pei-Back
english.objectives: Confront Shan Jitong and rescue Pei-Zhi at the Seat of the Spirit Waker in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
english.description: <Ancestral spirits stream into the tan-chao, Pei-Zhi's bridge to freedom.$B$BOne final chamber lingers in the ruins, just north of the tan-chao. The air above crackles with foul energy. Shan Jitong is already at work.>

text.title: 寒酸的供品
text.objectives: 在观海听涛林收集10株潮雾菇。
text.description: 仪式差不多准备好了，我们现在只缺一样东西：一份供品。$B$B别紧张，我没说要血祭，只是弄些食物而已。$B$B西北面的观海听涛林肯定长着不少蘑菇，很合适用来做供品。请你带些回来吧。

english.title: A Humble Offering
english.objectives: Gather 10 Tidemist Caps from Tideview Thicket.
english.description: I'm almost ready for the ritual, there's just one more thing we need: An offering.$B$BRelax, I don't mean a sacrifice. Just a bit of food.$B$BThere are sure to be mushrooms growing in Tideview Thicket to the northwest that are suitable for this. Please bring some.

text.title: 蛤蟆酱
text.objectives: 在纯净之池的顶层，从8个冒泡的蛤蟆卵身上取得蛤蟆卵。
text.description: 你听说了我们眼下的危机了吗？$B$B一群蛤蟆占领了那儿，并且还在疯狂繁殖着！这给养殖莲花的农夫带来了极大的困扰。$B$B刚巧，我能用黏呼呼的蛤蟆卵制作“蛤蟆酱”，这里的孩子们可喜欢了，完全留不出存货。$B$B如果你要去水池那儿，最好帮大伙一个忙，呃……就是弄些蛤蟆卵来，$B$B放到这瓶子里。帮帮我吧。$B$B你只要寻找有气泡的地方，然后用力挖就行了！
text.completion: Now when the kids ask: "Do you have Bottletoads?" I can say YES!

english.title: Bottletoads
english.objectives: Scoop toad eggs from 8 Gurgling Toadspawn on the top level of the Pools of Purity.
english.description: Have you heard about the crisis we're having at the pools?$B$BToads have moved in and are spawning like crazy! It's become a real problem for the lotus farmers.$B$BCoincidentally, I make a jam out of gelatinous toadspawn. I call it "Bottletoads" and it's a big hit with the kids around here. Can't keep any in stock.$B$BIf you're heading to the pools, you'd be doing everyone a favor by uh... liberating some of those toad eggs.$B$BInto this bottle. For me.$B$BJust look for bubbles and scoop right in!
english.completion: Now when the kids ask: "Do you have Bottletoads?" I can say YES!

text.title: 猜猜谁回来了
text.objectives: 将科罗什的背壳带给新希菲拉的颜。
text.description: <这只龙龟巨大的龟壳坚若磐石，上面布满了尖锐的脊突。当地有一人肯定能够使它物尽其用。>

english.title: Guess Whose Back
english.objectives: Bring Krosh's Back to Yan in New Cifera.
english.description: <This dragon turtle's massive shell is rock-hard and covered in sharp ridges. One of the locals could almost certainly make use of it.>

text.title: 恐钉
text.objectives: 杀死恐钉，获得吊尾钥匙。
text.description: 但愿你能胜任下一个任务，因为我们的性命就全指望它了。$B$B只有一把钥匙能打开我们的锁链。不幸的是，钥匙被挂在猢狲的宠物老虎恐钉的脖子上。$B$B它们把它养在北边的巨大坑洞里。取得钥匙的唯一方法就是杀掉这只野兽。
text.completion: Yes, with this key I will be able to free our chains.$B$BYou have delivered us from this vile place.
text.giverWindow: 那只巨兽看管着钥匙。

english.title: Kung Din
english.objectives: Obtain the Slingtail Key by slaying Kung Din.
english.description: I hope you are capable of this next task, for our lives depend on it.$B$BThere is only one key that will unlock our chains. Unfortunately, the key hangs around the neck of the hozen's pet tiger, Kung Din.$B$BThey keep the tiger in the great pit to the north. The only way to retrieve the key will be to kill the beast.
english.completion: Yes, with this key I will be able to free our chains.$B$BYou have delivered us from this vile place.
english.giverWindow: The great beast holds the key.

text.title: 真正的斗士
text.objectives: 和暗月马戏团的科戈尔·碎颅谈一谈。
text.description: 要成为一名格斗大师，肯定还需要些别的东西...$B$B也许经营暗月死斗场的科戈尔·碎颅会给你答案。
text.completed: 去暗月马戏团的暗月死斗场找到科戈尔·碎颅。

english.title: Pit Fighter
english.objectives: Speak with Korgol Crushskull at the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: There must be more to being a master pit fighter than this...$B$BPerhaps Korgol Crushskull who runs the Darkmoon Deathmatch at the Faire will know.
english.completed: Report to Korgol Crushskull at the Darkmoon Deathmatch at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 传家宝
text.objectives: 从月水庄死去的珠鳍村民身上收集8个珠鳍遗宝。
text.description: 最近我们在月水庄输掉了一场和猢狲的激烈战斗。$B$B虽然我们竭尽全力撤走了大多数人，但仍有许多人不幸遇难。$B$B我们甚至都没有逝者的遗物来寄托哀思。$B$B如果有人能去并从尸体上取回遗物，我们就能让逝者的灵魂安息，不再驻留。$B$B如果你能出手相助的话，这对我们来说意味着很多，$n。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. You do not know how much this means to the families of the lost.

english.title: Family Heirlooms
english.objectives: Collect 8 Pearlfin Heirlooms from dead Pearlfin Villagers in Moonwater Retreat.
english.description: We recently lost a fierce battle against the hozen at Moonwater Retreat.$B$BWe evacuated as many of our people as we could, but still, there were many we could not save.$B$BWe have no tokens of our lost over which to send our prayers.$B$BIf someone could go and retrieve heirlooms from the dead bodies, we could properly lay them to rest, and move on.$B$BIt would mean so much to us if you could do this, $n.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You do not know how much this means to the families of the lost.

text.title: 擒贼先擒王
text.objectives: 防御者墨尔顿要求你取得掠夺者因格瓦尔的徽记。
text.description: 维库人作战时无畏无惧，似乎他们在战斗中只求一死。他们数量庞大，个个骁勇善战，显然我们没有什么胜算。$B$B然而有一个名叫因格瓦尔的维库人备受他们尊崇。如果能够将他击败，维库人的士气必将遭到重大的打击。
text.progress: Good to see you're well, $n.$b$bWe've had about as many casualties as we can handle.
text.completion: Outstanding!$b$bThis could be the turn of luck we've all been hoping for.
text.giverWindow: 乌特加德城堡的领主。

english.title: Stealing Their Thunder
english.objectives: Defender Mordun has asked you to acquire the head of Ingvar the Plunderer.
english.description: The vrykul are fearless in a fight. Seems they actually yearn fer a death in battle. With their numbers and that ferocity, we're doomed - plain and simple.$b$bThere's one they esteem though, goes by the name of Ingvar. Bring him down and you'll deal a mighty blow to their spirit.
english.progress: Good to see you're well, $n.$b$bWe've had about as many casualties as we can handle.
english.completion: Outstanding!$b$bThis could be the turn of luck we've all been hoping for.
english.giverWindow: Lord of Utgarde Keep.

text.title: 收缴武器
text.objectives: 防御者墨尔顿要求你偷取5把维库武器。
text.description: 相信我，$g小伙子:小姑娘;，维库人的武器那真是太贱了！拿得稳，砍得狠，简直要人命。$b$b我需要你在它们取了我们性命之前偷点回来！
text.progress: You pinch a load a' them vrykul axes?
text.completion: <Mordun whistles.>$b$bWill ya just look at 'em? Incredible.$b$bI half expected these neanderthals to be swingin' around clubs and throwin' rock.$b$bNo such luck...

english.title: Disarmament
english.objectives: Defender Mordun wants you to steal 5 Vrykul Weapons.
english.description: Take it from me, $g lad:lass;, them vrykul weapons be downright nasty! Deceptively well-balanced, wickedly sharp - just plain deadly.$b$bI need you to pilfer some o' them weapons before they're used on us!
english.progress: You pinch a load a' them vrykul axes?
english.completion: <Mordun whistles.>$b$bWill ya just look at 'em? Incredible.$b$bI half expected these neanderthals to be swingin' around clubs and throwin' rock.$b$bNo such luck...

text.title: 视力衰弱
text.objectives: 从猢狲震地者手里夺回金祖恩的物品。$b$b如果找不到金祖恩，就去旋风高地和他谈一谈。
text.description: 我本可以把他们都杀光，朋友。$b$b把他们一个个爆头，等他们走近了我就装死。他们每次都会中计——几乎每次……$b$b最后他们当中有一个杂种变聪明了。拆穿了我的伪装。他们把我弄晕之后，抢走了我的眼镜片当飞盘玩。$b$b他们抢走了我的宝贝，然后留我在这里等死，这群该死的野蛮人……$b$b帮帮我，朋友。让我死也死得有尊严。

english.title: Cryin' My Eyes Out
english.objectives: Collect Zin'Jun's belongings from the Hozen Groundpounders.$b$bIf you lose Zin'Jun, speak to him at the Ascent of Swirling Winds.
english.description: I coulda taken out da whole lot of 'em, mon.$b$bShot 'em one by one, den played dead when dey be gettin' close. Fell for it every time, dey did - well almost every time...$b$bOne of 'em finally got wise. Called my bluff. Before I knew it, dey was usin' my eyes as marbles.$b$bRan off with my goods an' left me here ta die, da savages...$b$bHelp me, mon. Lemme die wit my dignity intact.

text.title: A Good Start
text.objectives: Kill 4 Hozen Mudflingers, 4 Hozen Skullthumpers, and 3 Hozen Fishcatchers.
text.description: Regardless of our predicament, our orders stand. We are to learn the lay of this land and prepare it for Hellscream's fleet.$b$bBut first, we must deal with these savages!$b$bYou see these corpses I've stacked up around the camp? I want mountains of them!$b$bWe are the Horde!$b$bThese vermin have not learned to fear us yet, but we will fix that soon enough...

english.title: A Good Start
english.objectives: Kill 4 Hozen Mudflingers, 4 Hozen Skullthumpers, and 3 Hozen Fishcatchers.
english.description: Regardless of our predicament, our orders stand. We are to learn the lay of this land and prepare it for Hellscream's fleet.$b$bBut first, we must deal with these savages!$b$bYou see these corpses I've stacked up around the camp? I want mountains of them!$b$bWe are the Horde!$b$bThese vermin have not learned to fear us yet, but we will fix that soon enough...

text.title: Fish Fry
text.objectives: Collect 12 Mature Carp from Hozu Fishcatchers
text.description: Fortune favors the bold!$b$bYour calculated aggressive actions have yielded unexpected rewards. If you can slay these fishcatchers after a successful haul, you'll inherit their slippery spoils.$b$bThinning out the enemy while feeding your allies - the picture of efficiency!

english.title: Fish Fry
english.objectives: Collect 12 Mature Carp from Hozu Fishcatchers
english.description: Fortune favors the bold!$b$bYour calculated aggressive actions have yielded unexpected rewards. If you can slay these fishcatchers after a successful haul, you'll inherit their slippery spoils.$b$bThinning out the enemy while feeding your allies - the picture of efficiency!

text.title: 丢失的槌子
text.objectives: 去祁翰酒坊找回大箩暂休槌。
text.description: $n，我想到了！真的很简单。让我们搞点大动静出来，看他还醒不醒。$B$B快看，那边有一面锣！看来人们过去就是用这面锣来叫醒他的。我们只要找一把称手的槌子，再把锣敲得震天响就行了。$B$B村长说槌子就放在西南面河边的祁翰酒坊里，离这不远。你能帮我去拿一下吗？我得先跟村民们打个招呼。

english.title: Missing Mallet
english.objectives: Recover the Dai-Lo Recess Mallet at the Ki-Han Brewery.
english.description: $n, I've got it! It's simple really. Let's make a ruckus so loud that there's no way he can sleep through it.$B$BWhy look at that, a conveniently placed gong! Makes me think this may just be how they've awoken him in the past. We just need the matching mallet to get it ringing as loud as possible.$B$BThe village leader tells me the mallet is over at the Ki-Han Brewery on the river, to the southwest. It's not far. Mind picking it up for me while I give the village some fair warning?

text.title: 小无赖
text.objectives: 杀死10只兔妖。
text.description: 我得再想想怎么叫醒这个顽固的小家伙，但岛上还有别的麻烦。南边的兔妖们正在糟蹋我们的粮食！这些长得像兔子一样的小偷和强盗！$B$B这群小无赖！$B$B我们杀得还没它们生得快！不过，我对此有一个完美的解决办法，那就是再杀快点儿！$n，只要有你在，这不是什么问题。

english.title: Rascals
english.objectives: Kill 10 Virmen.
english.description: I'll keep trying to find ways to wake this stubborn little guy up, but there is no shortage of trouble on the island it seems. The crops to the south are infested with virmen, rabbit-like thieves and pillagers.$B$BRascals!$B$BThey breed faster than we can kill them! I have the perfect solution for such a situation: kill them faster! With you here, $n, that shouldn't be a problem.

text.title: 还能吃！
text.objectives: 找回3个被连根拔起的芜菁、3根被偷的胡萝卜和3个遭窃的南瓜。
text.description: 农场中的兔妖把我们的粮食一卷而光，但这些混蛋把吃不下的也全带走了。它们肯定把最喜欢的食物藏到什么地方去了。$B$B你能先去把那些被连根拔起的庄稼弄回来吗？全岛的人都得靠我养活，每一棵蔬菜都是很宝贵的。

english.title: Still Good!
english.objectives: Recover 3 Uprooted Turnips, 3 Stolen Carrots, and 3 Pilfered Pumpkins.
english.description: The virmen to the south have been running off with all of our crops, but they're taking more than they can eat. They must be stockpiling them somewhere - the ones they like anyway.$B$BWill you go out and recover any of the uprooted crops you can find? I've got an island's worth of people to feed, and every single vegetable makes a difference.

text.title: 比木头更硬
text.objectives: 收集12块废弃的木板。
text.description: 给我从祁翰酒坊附近的建筑那里收集些木板回来。$B$B你还没意识到我的力量有多强大，所以我要露两手给你瞧瞧。

english.title: Stronger Than Wood
english.objectives: Gather 12 Discarded Wood Planks.
english.description: Gather me wood planks from construction near the Ki-Han Brewery.$B$BYou do not yet know the extent of my strength, so I shall display it to you.

text.title: 锣声震天
text.objectives: 敲锣。
text.description: 你准备好了吗，$n？我觉得我们应该找点东西把耳朵捂住，但是现在好像有点来不及了。记住，在接下来的几个小时里萦绕在你耳边的震天锣声是胜利的锣声！$B$B这份荣誉就全归你了，$n。准备好了就敲响这面锣吧！

english.title: Raucous Rousing
english.objectives: Ring the gong.
english.description: You ready for this, $n? I'm thinking maybe we should have looked for something to cover our ears, but it's a bit late for that now. Just remember that the intense ringing you'll be hearing for the next few hours is the ringing sound of victory!$B$BThe honor's all yours, $n. Ring the gong whenever you're ready!

text.title: Wugou, the Spirit of Earth
text.objectives: Slap the ox.
text.description: $n! Well, the plus side is that finding Wugou was easy enough. Waking him... not so much. I think he's going to wake quite sore from all the pushing and hitting I've done trying to rouse him.$B$BAre you a deep sleeper at all, $n? What wakes you up in the morning?$B$BRolling out of bed always seems to do it for me, so I figure let's just go for that! I tied off some ropes to the ox cart. We send it running and give him a good roll, and we should be good! Care to give the ox a good slap to get it going?
text.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in the Dai-Lo Farmstead.

english.title: Wugou, the Spirit of Earth
english.objectives: Slap the ox.
english.description: $n! Well, the plus side is that finding Wugou was easy enough. Waking him... not so much. I think he's going to wake quite sore from all the pushing and hitting I've done trying to rouse him.$B$BAre you a deep sleeper at all, $n? What wakes you up in the morning?$B$BRolling out of bed always seems to do it for me, so I figure let's just go for that! I tied off some ropes to the ox cart. We send it running and give him a good roll, and we should be good! Care to give the ox a good slap to get it going?
english.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in the Dai-Lo Farmstead.

text.title: 别泼脸！
text.objectives: 请涓流帮忙唤醒上古土灵无垢。
text.description: 好吧，$n。我一直在想，如果敲锣都不管用的话，我们下一步该怎么办。然后我突然就想到了！要是我的话，来盆水泼脸上屡试不爽。这招对那个土疙瘩一样的家伙来说，肯定事半功倍！$B$B去问问上古水灵涓流，看他肯不肯帮我们一把？他应该在瀑布旁的池子里嬉戏，就在树的另一边。

english.title: Not In the Face!
english.objectives: Request Shu's help in waking Wugou, the spirit of earth.
english.description: Alright $n, I was thinking about what we'd try next if the whole gong thing didn't work, and it came to me just like that! Water in the face always worked on me. It's got to be twice as effective for someone so dry and earthy!$B$BMind going over and asking Shu, the spirit of water, if he'll help us out?  He should be playing in the pool next to the waterfall, just on the other side of that tree.

text.title: 神真子的灵魂和躯体
text.objectives: 将上古水灵涓流和上古土灵无垢带回五晨寺。路边的牛车可以带你过去。
text.description: 很好，我们大功告成了。不是吗，$n？现在我们已成功唤醒了这两位，而且他们对你也很友好，我们只需把他们带回五晨寺就行了。$B$B你先上路，我要去道个别，之后很快会追上你。

english.title: The Spirit and Body of Shen-zin Su
english.objectives: Bring Shu and Wugou, the spirits of water and earth, to the Temple of Five Dawns.  A cart is waiting near the road to take you there.
english.description: Well, that wraps it up here, doesn't it $n?  Now that we've got these two roused and all friendly towards you, we just need to get them back to the Temple of Five Dawns.$B$BYou go ahead. I'm going to say my goodbyes, then I'll follow you up shortly.

text.title: 晨息村
text.objectives: 与季·火掌在晨息村会面。
text.description: 第四个，也是最后一个元素之灵，是上古风灵大风。当他不在天上游荡时，我们可以去西边的笑风山找他。我派艾莎和季一起去帮你找他。$B$B等你准备好了，我就会召唤旋风，把你送到寺庙顶层。然后，越过桥往西边走，去晨息村找季。

english.title: Morning Breeze Village
english.objectives: Meet with Ji Firepaw in Morning Breeze Village.
english.description: The fourth and final spirit is Dafeng, the spirit of air. When he is not in the skies, he can be found on the Ridge of Laughing Winds to the west. I've sent both Aysa and Ji to help you find him.$B$BWhen you are ready, I will summon winds to carry you to the top of the temple. From there, cross the bridges to the west and find Ji in Morning Breeze Village.

text.title: 作案工具
text.objectives: 找回 8 支沾了颜料的毛笔。
text.description: 猢狲偷了我们的毛笔，在我们的智慧卷轴上乱涂他们自己所谓的“智慧”。如果你愿意帮忙，就去阻止他们，并且拿回我们的毛笔，别让他们继续为害。

english.title: Tools of the Enemy
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 Paint Soaked Brushes.
english.description: The hozen have stolen our brushes and are painting over our scrolls of wisdom with their own wisdoms, if you can call them that. If you're here to help, stop them and bring our brushes back before they can do more harm.

text.title: 重写智慧
text.objectives: 烧毁5个破损的智慧卷轴。
text.description: $n，我们必须帮助邵白长老。没什么能比这更值得做的事情了。$B$B来这儿的路上，你肯定注意到南面洞穴里悬挂的智慧卷轴。很多卷轴都被猢狲涂花了，而且不幸的是，它们都无法复原了。我们对这些卷轴的处理方法很简单：烧掉。这样就能彻底除去猢狲的鬼画符。$B$B不用担心邵白长老。大家会齐心协力帮助他尽快重写智慧，这点我可以保证。

english.title: Rewritten Wisdoms
english.objectives: Burn 5 Defaced Scroll of Wisdom.
english.description: $n, we must help Elder Shaopai. There are few more deserving of our kindness.$B$BOn the way here, you surely noticed the scrolls of wisdom hanging in the grotto to the south. The hozen have defiled many of them, and sadly, they are not recoverable. We will deal with the problem directly - burn the defiled scrolls. Wipe the hozen writings away entirely.$B$BDo not worry for Elder Shaopai. The people shall come together and help him rewrite the wisdoms in time. I shall see to that.

text.title: 以直报怨
text.objectives: 在狒狒村击败20个猢狲。
text.description: 好吧，$n，这是我们第二次不得不对付可恶的猢狲了。我想是时候用火金之道来解决这个问题了。是可忍孰不可忍，我们要直捣黄龙。$B$B我们去北边的狒狒村，好好教训这些臭熏熏的捣乱分子。我一直期待着和你再次并肩作战，$n。
text.completion: Invigorating! A good fight always makes me feel better!

english.title: The Direct Solution
english.objectives: Kill 20 hozen in Fe-Feng Village.
english.description: Alright $n, this is the second time we've had to deal with ravaging hozen. I think it's time we take care of this problem the Huojin way. No more patience. No more mediation. We go to the source.$B$BWe're going into the hozen village to the north and we're punishing those smelly troublemakers. I've been looking forward to a chance to fight by your side again, $n.
english.completion: Invigorating! A good fight always makes me feel better!

text.title: 不作恶
text.objectives: 杀死狒狒村的猢狲酋长鲁克鲁克。
text.description: $n，你要知道，火金之道并不在于暴力。该出手时，我们绝不犹豫；但是不该出手时，我们也绝不冲动。俗话说，擒贼先擒王。$B$B这些猢狲之所以屡屡攻击我们的家园，都是由一个头目唆使的。如果我们除掉了鲁克鲁克，那么不需要全歼所有猢狲就能阻止他们的攻击了。$B$B我知道你不是火金派的一员，但是你会助我完成使命的，对吗，$n？
text.progress: Following the Huojin discipline often means making the hard decisions. This is one of those moments.
text.completion: $n, I think you've got a bit of Huojin in you. Stick with me and I'll bring you around, I think.

english.title: Do No Evil
english.objectives: Kill Ruk-ruk, the Fe-Feng Chief.
english.description: $n, I need you to understand that the way of the Huojin is not the way of violence. When fighting is needed, we will not hesitate, but when fighting is not needed, neither do we instigate. However, the direct solution is often cutting the head off the snake, as they say.$B$BThe hozen have a leader instigating these attacks. If we remove Ruk-Ruk, we won't have to wipe the hozen out entirely.$B$BI know you are not of the Huojin, but are you with me in what must be done, $n?
english.progress: Following the Huojin discipline often means making the hard decisions. This is one of those moments.
english.completion: $n, I think you've got a bit of Huojin in you. Stick with me and I'll bring you around, I think.

text.title: 警告猴子
text.objectives: 找回8捆被偷的焰火。
text.description: 这些猴子在袭击村子时总喜欢顺手牵羊。如果只是偷些余粮，我们倒也无所谓了，但是想到那些猴子偷了焰火...我不禁有点担心。再说了，谁知道我们什么时候就会用到这些焰火呢？$B$B帮我从猢狲的村子里找回被偷的焰火好吗，$n？
text.progress: I'm somewhat impressed they hadn't set their village on fire with these things.
text.completion: $n, I'm thinking we should celebrate with these later. What do you think?

english.title: Monkey Advisory Warning
english.objectives: Recover 8 Stolen Firework Bundles.
english.description: The monkeys have been stealing from the village during their attacks. We should be fine without some of the extra food stores, but the idea of monkeys with fireworks... I'm a little bit concerned. Not to mention, who knows when some fireworks will come in handy?$B$BHelp me recover the stolen fireworks from their village, $n?
english.progress: I'm somewhat impressed they hadn't set their village on fire with these things.
english.completion: $n, I'm thinking we should celebrate with these later. What do you think?

text.title: 比骨头更硬
text.objectives: 把玉虎立柱带给晨息村的乔乔·铁眉。
text.description: 这根巨大的玉虎立柱和猢狲的建筑风格有点不协调。$B$B它看起来非常坚硬，非常牢固。$B$B你很清楚应该把它交给谁。
text.completion: GOOD! A true challenge. Let us put this pillar to the test!

english.title: Stronger Than Bone
english.objectives: Bring the Jade Tiger Pillar to Jojo Ironbrow in Morning Breeze Village.
english.description: This giant jade tiger pillar doesn't seem to fit in amidst the hozen buildings.$B$BWhat it does seem is very hard. Very solid.$B$BYou know just the person to bring this to.
english.completion: GOOD! A true challenge. Let us put this pillar to the test!

text.title: 比石头更硬
text.objectives: 收集12个废弃的石块。
text.description: 给我从南边的笑风山弄些石块回来。$B$B你已经两次见证了我的实力，但我从你的眼神中还能看到疑虑。你等着瞧吧。

english.title: Stronger Than Stone
english.objectives: Gather 12 Abandoned Stone Blocks.
english.description: Gather me stone blocks from the Ridge of Laughing Winds to the south.$B$BYou have seen my strength twice, yet I still spy doubt within your eyes. It will not last.

text.title: 平衡之念
text.objectives: 从绳索上走过，与晨息湖上的艾莎·云歌谈谈。
text.description: 从我们到了以后，艾莎就一直在湖上冥想，她的全部心思都集中在大风上。我不知道她想从中发现什么，但是她很聪明，而且尚喜师父已经放心地将这个任务交给她了。$B$B你得从码头末端伸出的绳索上走过，才能找到她。这对你的平衡能力是一个考验，但我认为你完全可以做到，$n。
text.completion: I'm impressed. Most students that are even capable of reaching this spot do so soaking wet.

english.title: Balanced Perspective
english.objectives: Cross the ropes and speak to Aysa Cloudsinger on Morning Breeze Lake.
english.description: Aysa has been meditating on the lake since we've arrived, all her thoughts focused on Dafeng. I don't know what she hopes to discover out there, but she's no fool, and Master Shang Xi has entrusted this task with her.$B$BYou will need to cross the ropes leading from the end of the dock to reach her. It shall test your balance, but I think you're up to the task, $n.
english.completion: I'm impressed. Most students that are even capable of reaching this spot do so soaking wet.

text.title: 上古风灵大风
text.objectives: 和风语厅的上古风灵大风谈一谈。
text.description: 只要你耐心聆听，就能从风中找到答案。$B$B上古风灵大风被玛瑙蟠螭炤壬吓坏了，离开了天空。他就躲藏在高地南面的风语厅里。$B$B快去找他，我跟季会在那里和你碰头。
text.completion: Dafeng looks frightened as you approach, but settles a bit at the sound of your voice.

english.title: Dafeng, the Spirit of Air
english.objectives: Speak to Dafeng, the spirit of air, in the Chamber of Whispers.
english.description: If you listen long enough, the wind will carry the answer to you.$B$BDafeng, the spirit of air, has been scared from the skies by Zhao-Ren, the Onyx Serpent. He hides within the Chamber of Whispers, at the south side of the plateau.$B$BGo to him. Ji and I will join you there.
english.completion: Dafeng looks frightened as you approach, but settles a bit at the sound of your voice.

text.title: 天空之战
text.objectives: 使用季的焰火驱退蟠螭身上的邪恶能量，并净化玛瑙蟠螭炤壬。
text.description: 上古风灵大风受到了玛瑙蟠螭——炤壬的惊吓。我们得帮他直面恐惧，或是由我们代劳。$B$B当我告诉季关于玛瑙蟠螭的事后，他说他有办法对付，并已在风语厅外面开始做准备了。季虽然性情鲁莽，但我不能不说，他的满腔热情和坚定信念让我很是羡慕。$B$B让我们出去挑战玛瑙蟠螭吧。
text.completion: You have helped Dafeng, the spirit of air, find his courage! The final spirit has been restored.

english.title: Battle for the Skies
english.objectives: Defeat Zhao-Ren, the Onyx Serpent with the aid of Ji's fireworks.
english.description: Dafeng, the spirit of air, is terrified by Zhao-Ren, the Onyx Serpent. We must help him face that fear, or face it for him ourselves.$B$BWhen I told Ji of the serpent, he said he had an idea and would begin preparations outside of the chamber. Despite his rash nature, I must admit, I envy his passion and conviction.$B$BLet us go outside and confront the Onyx Serpent.
english.completion: You have helped Dafeng, the spirit of air, find his courage! The final spirit has been restored.

text.title: 传承的价值
text.objectives: 击败长者的卫士
text.description: 四元素之灵会帮助你与大地交谈并揭示其困境。不过首先，我还有一件小事要托付给你。$B$B跟我来，我的学生，陪我这个老熊猫人到西边的林地去。
text.completion: I do not have the strength of body or will that I once did. I'm glad there are noble pandaren like you to fight on for our people. You've come far, $n.

english.title: Worthy of Passing
english.objectives: Defeat the Guardian of the Elders.
english.description: The four elemental spirits will help you speak with the land and uncover its plight, but first, I have one small task to ask of you.$B$BJoin me, my pupil. Accompany this old pandaren to the western grove.
english.completion: I do not have the strength of body or will that I once did. I'm glad there are noble pandaren like you to fight on for our people. You've come far, $n.

text.title: 不受欢迎的生灵
text.objectives: 击败8只棘枝恶灵。
text.description: 你在晨之谷已经见过了林精，但是这片林地的林精是一个不同的种族。他们更加残酷，更加危险。$B$B如果你能驱逐这些林精，元素之灵会感激你的。
text.completion: The spirits thank you, $c.

english.title: Unwelcome Nature
english.objectives: Kill 8 Thornbranch Scamps.
english.description: You faced forest sprites in the Dawning Valley, but the forest sprites in this grove are a different breed. Crueler and more dangerous.$B$BIf you would clear some of these sprites out, the spirits would thank you.
english.completion: The spirits thank you, $c.

text.title: 积跬步，致千里
text.objectives: 找到8个坤牌仪式符咒。
text.description: 我累了，$n。我得休息一下。$B$B我们要举行一个仪式，但是这需要林地里的一些符咒。在林地里随便走走，你就会看到树上挂满了符咒。$B$B年轻人，如果可以的话，你能在我坐下恢复体力的时候帮我去收集一些符咒回来吗？
text.progress: Rest feels good. The burdens of life have become a great weight after so many years.
text.completion: You come through, as you always have. You are truly one of my greatest students. I think you will be something the likes of which the world has never seen.

english.title: Small, But Significant
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 Kun-Pai Ritual Charms.
english.description: I am tired, $n. I must rest.$B$BWe have a ritual to perform, but we require some of the charms from this grove. If you wander the grove, you should see them all over hanging from the trees. $B$BIf it does not offend one as young as you, will you permit me to sit and recover my strength while you gather these charms?
english.progress: Rest feels good. The burdens of life have become a great weight after so many years.
english.completion: You come through, as you always have. You are truly one of my greatest students. I think you will be something the likes of which the world has never seen.

text.title: 智慧传承
text.objectives: 聆听尚喜师父的话。
text.description: 你即将独自一人踏上旅程。但请先驻足片刻，听听一位老人的话吧。有了我的知识作为基础，你或许就能取得超越我的成就。
text.completion: I know, $n... I know. Such is the way of things.

english.title: Passing Wisdom
english.objectives: Listen to Master Shang Xi.
english.description: This journey shall soon be yours to undertake without me. Stay for a few moments and listen to an old man's words. Let my knowledge serve as a foundation for yours, that you might be greater than I ever was.
english.completion: I know, $n... I know. Such is the way of things.

text.title: 神真子的苦难
text.objectives: 登上热气球和神真子交谈。
text.description: 现在不是悲伤的时候。气球已经准备好了，神真子在等着你。$B$B我们将是数百年来第一批和神真子对话的熊猫人。这真是莫大的荣耀。
text.completion: You have undergone a great honor, $c. Have you come back wiser for it?

english.title: The Suffering of Shen-zin Su
english.objectives: Board the Hot Air Balloon and Speak to Shen-zin Su.
english.description: Now is not the time to grieve. The balloon is ready, and Shen-zin Su awaits.$B$BWe shall be the first pandaren to speak to Shen-zin Su in hundreds of years. It is a great honor.
english.completion: You have undergone a great honor, $c. Have you come back wiser for it?

objectiveDetails.description: 找到神真子的痛苦之源

text.title: 通往卓越
text.objectives: 打开通往悲雾林的大门。
text.description: 为神真子拔除这根肉中刺的任务就交给你们了。你们要彼此信任，不要心存芥蒂。$B$B在悲雾林生活着一位孤独的隐士。向他的棚屋进发吧。他对于隐藏在树丛中的黑暗非常了解。
text.completion: Evil is rising from the seas and filling the forest. It's not just tigers anymore... something far more sinister lurks in the shadows, waiting to take any pandaren unwise enough to stray out alone.$B$BYou are not safe here.

english.title: Bidden to Greatness
english.objectives: Open the gates to Pei-Wu Forest.
english.description: It is up to all of you to remove the thorn from the side of Shen-zin Su. Do not let your differences come between you. Trust in each other.$B$BWithin the Pei-Wu Forest is a lone hermit. Head directly to his hut. He knows intimately of the dark things that now lurk in the trees.
english.completion: Evil is rising from the seas and filling the forest. It's not just tigers anymore... something far more sinister lurks in the shadows, waiting to take any pandaren unwise enough to stray out alone.$B$BYou are not safe here.

text.title: 海中的邪恶
text.objectives: 杀死8只黑暗骇魔或黑暗恐魔。
text.description: 我不知道这在森林中肆虐的邪恶生物是什么，$c，不过我知道怎么对付它。我想你也一样。
text.completion: You make me proud, $n. You make all of us proud.

english.title: Evil from the Seas
english.objectives: Kill 8 Darkened Horrors or Darkened Terrors.
english.description: I do not know what this evil is that is infesting the forest, $n, but I know exactly how to deal with it. So do you, I think.
english.completion: You make me proud, $n. You make all of us proud.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死黑暗骇魔或黑暗恐魔

text.title: 一个都不能少
text.objectives: 拯救3名受伤的船员。
text.description: 你的朋友已经尽她所能来拯救我的船员。对此我深表感谢。$B$B但我们要应对的状况仍然超出了我们能力：扑灭飞船残骸上的火、解救船员、击退邪恶的海洋生物、还要防止囚犯脱逃。我们实在是应付不过来了。$B$B我还有一些船员留在了船上，我需要在残骸崩塌前将他们疏散。我知道这要求有点过分，不过你能帮帮我吗？
text.completion: I have no idea who you people are, but fate surely smiled on us this day. Many more would be dead if not for the help of you and your friends. I am in your debt.

english.title: None Left Behind
english.objectives: Rescue 3 Injured Sailors.
english.description: Your friend has been doing everything she can to save my crew. I'm deeply appreciative.$B$BWe're still dealing with more than we can handle here: quenching the fires on the wreckage, getting my people out, fighting off these evil sea creatures, and trying to prevent the prisoners from escaping. We're simply in over our heads.$B$BI still have men on the ship that we need to get clear before the wreckage collapses on them. I know this is asking a lot, but can you help?
english.completion: I have no idea who you people are, but fate surely smiled on us this day. Many more would be dead if not for the help of you and your friends. I am in your debt.

text.title: 储备竹竿
text.objectives: 收集10根折断的竹竿。
text.description: 我们的人营养不良，伤病缠身，筋疲力尽，但他们是部落。每个人都会战斗到死。作为新盟友，当时机到来时，我们会站在你们一边。但如果能有几把武器，我们就会更加强大。$B$B我正在让大家收集竹竿来制作长矛。如果你能贡献一份力量，将给我们带来很大的帮助。
text.progress: The Horde does not back down from a fight.
text.completion: These are excellent! We'll have them crafted into weapons in no time.

english.title: Stocking Stalks
english.objectives: Gather 10 Broken Bamboo Stalks.
english.description: My men are malnourished, injured, and exhausted, but they are Horde. Every one will fight to their dying breath. As our new ally, we will stand by you when the time comes, but we would stand stronger with weapons.$B$BI have my men out gathering bamboo stalks to fashion into spears. If you can spare the effort, we could use the extra pair of capable hands.
english.progress: The Horde does not back down from a fight.
english.completion: These are excellent! We'll have them crafted into weapons in no time.

text.title: 紧急消息
text.objectives: 去寻天号船骸见德罗娜·莱因哈特。
text.description: 我肯定艾莎不会喜欢这个计划，但这是我们唯一能做的。你能帮我把这个坏消息告诉她吗，$n？她需要知道我们所做的事，以确保每个人的安全。
text.completion: Your friend is out fighting to save my crew. Fiercely I might add. I'm afraid your message may have to wait.

english.title: Urgent News
english.objectives: Speak to Delora Lionheart at the Wreck of the Skyseeker.
english.description: I'm sure Aysa won't love this plan, but it's the only plan we've got. Would you mind being the bearer of bad news for me, $n? She needs to know what we're doing so she can get everyone to safety.
english.completion: Your friend is out fighting to save my crew. Fiercely I might add. I'm afraid your message may have to wait.

text.title: 医疗物资
text.objectives: 找回8只医疗物资箱。
text.description: 我们需要医疗物资来救助伤患，但我们的补给箱在失事时都散落在现场了。如果你能找到一些补给箱，我会非常感激。
text.progress: Did you find the boxes I spoke of?
text.completion: These will do perfectly. I'll get my medics to work immediately.$B$BThank you.

english.title: Medical Supplies
english.objectives: Recover 8 Crates of Medical Supplies.
english.description: We need supplies to tend to our wounded, but the supply crates containing them were scattered in the crash. If you can bring back any crates you find, I would be very grateful.
english.progress: Did you find the boxes I spoke of?
english.completion: These will do perfectly. I'll get my medics to work immediately.$B$BThank you.

text.title: 远古的邪恶
text.objectives: 击败弗德拉卡，深海梦魇。
text.description: $n，我正在找你呢！$B$B刚才有个逃出来的水手看到艾莎还在飞船的残骸那里，对抗着一些巨大的怪兽。她可能需要你的援助，快去帮她，快！
text.completion: <Aysa is clearly exhausted from the fight.>$B$BYour skills in battle... are unquestionable... $c.$B$B<Aysa catches her breath for a moment.>$B$BDid you save the escaped prisoners?  ...Where is Ji? Is he okay?

english.title: An Ancient Evil
english.objectives: Defeat the Vordraka, the Deep Sea Nightmare.
english.description: $n, I was looking for you!$B$BOne of the escaping sailors just spotted Aysa in the wreckage of the ship, facing some enormous beast. She might need your help - you should go to her, quickly!
english.completion: <Aysa is clearly exhausted from the fight.>$B$BYour skills in battle... are unquestionable... $c.$B$B<Aysa catches her breath for a moment.>$B$BDid you save the escaped prisoners?  ...Where is Ji? Is he okay?

text.title: 治疗神真子
text.objectives: 营救并保护治疗者，直至神真子的伤口愈合。
text.description: 这比我想象中的还要可怕，但我们还可以应付。我们得把治疗者聚集起来，让这个伤口愈合。我们得治愈神真子。$B$B快去把你能找到的所有治疗者都叫来！营救他们、保护他们……用尽一切办法把他们带到这儿来，治愈这个伤口。$B$B一定要不惜任何代价保证治疗者的安全。
text.progress: We need to get the healers to the wound and keep them safe!
text.completion: You are a sight to see when under pressure, $n! We wouldn't have stood a chance without you.$B$BI think it's working. The flow of blood is slowing. I knew it would work!

english.title: The Healing of Shen-zin Su
english.objectives: Rescue and defend healers until Shen-zin Su's wound is healed.
english.description: This is more horrific than I imagined, but we can handle this. We need to gather the healers and close the wound. We need to save Shen-zin Su.$B$BFind any healers you can! Rescue them, relieve them - whatever you need to do to get them over here healing the wound.$B$BKeep the healers safe at all costs!
english.progress: We need to get the healers to the wound and keep them safe!
english.completion: You are a sight to see when under pressure, $n! We wouldn't have stood a chance without you.$B$BI think it's working. The flow of blood is slowing. I knew it would work!

text.title: 新的盟友
text.objectives: 返回五晨寺。寻天号船骸旁的牛车可以带你过去。
text.description: $n，我只是做了应该做的事，而且我们的计划也成功了。如果不采取行动，事情可能会变得更糟。我只希望艾莎能够明白这一点。$B$B以后有的是时间来反省，但现在我们必须返回五晨寺。我们要让大家知道神真子已经得救了，还要决定这些新盟友的命运。
text.completion: It is good to see you again, $n. You've done all that I've asked of you and more... you have saved Shen-zin Su.$B$BYou make an old master proud.

english.title: New Allies
english.objectives: Return to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the Wreck of the Skyseeker to take you there.
english.description: $n, I did what had to be done. And the plan worked. Things could have been much worse had we not acted. I only wish Aysa could understand that.$B$BThere will be plenty of time for reflection, but for now, we need to return to the Temple of Five Dawns. We need to let them know that Shen-zin Su has been saved, and we need to sort out the fates of these new allies.
english.completion: It is good to see you again, $n. You've done all that I've asked of you and more... you have saved Shen-zin Su.$B$BYou make an old master proud.

text.title: 证明你的价值
text.objectives: 在巨龙之魂的团队副本内，前往永恒之眼，从缚风者哈格拉身上偷一枚地火操纵者的解码环。
text.description: 你好，$n！你的绰号——嗯，没错——“金手指”，在军团中可是十分有名呢。$B$B我们正需要你的技术来完成一件大事。但首先得确定你就是我们需要的那个人，然后我才能告诉你详情。$B$B随着战斗的进行，你会进入永恒之眼，我要你帮我从缚风者哈格拉身上偷一枚地火操纵者的解码环。你能完成这个任务吗？

english.title: Proving Your Worth
english.objectives: Pickpocket a cryptomancer's decoder ring from Hagara the Stormbinder at the Eye of Eternity within the Dragon Soul raid encounter.
english.description: Hello, $n! You've earned a reputation among the flight as having - shall we say - 'nimble fingers.'$B$BWe need someone of your skills for a matter of utmost delicacy. Before I reveal more, we need to know you're the right $gman:woman; for the job.$B$BWhen the course of battle takes you to the Eye of Eternity, I need you to pickpocket Hagara the Stormbinder to retrieve a cryptomancer's decoder ring. Are you up to the task?

text.title: 隐藏的信息
text.objectives: 为你的地火操纵者的解码环充能，然后用它来破解科拉丝塔萨的烧焦的密码。
text.description: 驻守在暮光高地朱红庇护所内的科拉丝塔萨截获了一段极为重要的密电。我会让她说明整个情况，但我们需要你的帮助才能破解这段代码！$B$B带上你的解码环去找主城的虚灵魔术师，他应该知道如何为它充能。快去找科拉丝塔萨要这份密电，然后用解码环帮她解码。快点！时间不多了……

english.title: A Hidden Message
english.objectives: Charge your Cryptomancer's Decoder Ring and use it to decode the Corastrasza's Singed Cipher.
english.description: Corastrasza, currently stationed at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands, has intercepted a coded message of grave importance. I'll let her explain the full situation, but we need your expertise to unravel the cipher!$B$BTake your decoder ring to an ethereal thaumaturge in your capital city - he should know how to charge it. Acquire the encoded cipher from Corastrasza and use the ring to decode it for her. Hurry! Time is ticking...

text.title: 巫妖王之耳
text.objectives: 乌特加德城堡内的防御者墨尔顿要求你杀死凯雷塞斯王子。
text.description: 凯雷塞斯王子在嚎风峡湾充当巫妖王的耳目。$B$B我一点都不喜欢这个家伙！$B$B给他点苦头尝尝，你会让整个世界都为之叫好。
text.progress: It is good to see you again, $N.
text.completion: I bet the pale whelp felt that!$B$BThat's one more step towards yer judgment day, Arthas!

english.title: Ears of the Lich King
english.objectives: Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep wants you to slay Prince Keleseth.
english.description: Prince Keleseth acts as Arthas' eyes and ears in the Fjord.$B$BI don't like that one bit!$B$BGo and give him a round o' pain. You'll be doing the world a favor by doing so.
english.progress: It is good to see you again, $N.
english.completion: I bet the pale whelp felt that!$B$BThat's one more step towards yer judgment day, Arthas!

text.title: 血债血偿
text.objectives: 击败空克。
text.description: 我本来都准备好躺着等死了，伙计。$b$b可现在，这些杂碎！$b$b呼呼跟我在一起很久了。噢，那些美好的回忆……$b$b伙计，如果我不先为我的呼呼报仇，我死后就没脸去见他。$b$b这帮流氓的头儿叫空克。我们要把他找出来，然后宰了他——替呼呼报仇！

english.title: Seein' Red
english.objectives: Kill Konk.
english.description: I was just about ta curl up an' die, mon.$b$bNow, dis!$b$bSnuff an' me go way back. Oh, da memories...$b$bNo way I can face Snuff in da afterlife without avengin' his death first, mon!$b$bDese hooligans be led by one named Konk. We gotta sniff him out an' den snuff him out - for Snuff!

text.title: Tracking Event: Found Mishka at Plane

english.title: Tracking Event: Found Mishka at Plane

text.title: 游荡者
text.objectives: 在战斗中打败云游的斗士。
text.description: [ph]找到云游的斗士并发出挑战。
text.completed: 和云游的斗士谈一谈。

english.title: The Wanderer
english.objectives: Defeat the Roaming Brawler in a fight.
english.description: [ph] Find and challenge the Roaming Brawler to a fight.
english.completed: Speakk to the Roaming Brawler.

text.title: 叛君之死
text.objectives: 艾卓-尼鲁布内的复国者阿扎克委派你击败阿努巴拉克。带着阿努巴拉克的破损甲壳向阿扎克复命。
text.description: 背叛者的国王阿努巴拉克深居于曾经显赫一时的艾卓-尼鲁布王国。$b$b他扭曲并玷污了我们曾经的家园，把它变成了如今这个邪恶堕落的地方。他率领着一众亡灵蛛魔军队，立誓效忠巫妖王。$b$b去终结他的统治吧。
text.progress: Is it done, $c? Has the traitor king finally met his end?
text.completion: <A fierce glow emanantes from all of Azak's eyes as he stares at the husk.>$b$bIt is DONE!$b$bYour name shall be recorded in the extensive history of our people, $r!
text.giverWindow: 背叛者的国王

english.title: Death to the Traitor King
english.objectives: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub has tasked you with defeating Anub'arak. You are to return to A'zak with Anub'arak's Broken Husk.
english.description: Anub'arak, the traitor king, makes his home in the once proud Kingdom of Azjol-Nerub.$b$bHe has twisted and perverted our homeland into the wretched squalor it is today. He rules over an army of undead nerubians who have pledged themselves to serving the Lich King.$b$bBring an end to his reign.
english.progress: Is it done, $c? Has the traitor king finally met his end?
english.completion: <A fierce glow emanantes from all of Azak's eyes as he stares at the husk.>$b$bIt is DONE!$b$bYour name shall be recorded in the extensive history of our people, $r!
english.giverWindow: The Traitor King

text.title: 别忘了蛛卵！
text.objectives: 艾卓-尼鲁布内的复国者阿扎克要求你摧毁6个天灾蛛魔之卵。
text.description: 艾卓-尼鲁布里面布满了天灾蛛魔细心呵护的卵，它们很快就会孵化，为蛛魔军队提供新鲜血液，使得他们能够继续杀戮，不断壮大。$b$b这些蛛卵都被污秽的魔法污染了，我们的任务就是摧毁它们。
text.completion: Do not worry, $r.$B$BThe eggs they found were but a fraction of our hidden stores within Azjol-Nerub.$B$BOur mighty kingdom shall be reborn.

english.title: Don't Forget the Eggs!
english.objectives: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub wants you to destroy 6 Nerubian Scourge Eggs.
english.description: Throughout Azjol-Nerub, the scourged nerubians carefully nurture eggs that will soon hatch, providing them nerubian young to slaughter and raise.$b$bThe eggs have been tainted with foul magics. Our only recourse is to dispose of them.
english.completion: Do not worry, $r.$B$BThe eggs they found were but a fraction of our hidden stores within Azjol-Nerub.$B$BOur mighty kingdom shall be reborn.

text.title: Efficient Excavations
text.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
text.description: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to most efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in massive excavation projects.$b$bAfter a quick skim of the material, it becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bA map on the back cover indicates that the author has a bunker in the southwest region of Uldum.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.
text.giverWindow: You can only assume that the picture on the cover is of the self-absorbed author.

english.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: The Faceless Ones
text.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him in Ahn'Kahet.
text.description: In my peoples' struggle against the forces of the undead, they dug deeper as they lost ground. In desperation, they dug too deep.$b$bWe inadvertently exposed a tendril of the old god's will, which was made manifest in the creatures known only as the Faceless.$b$bIn the end, we could not fight on two fronts against such powerful enemies. Our misfortune cost us the war against the undead, and ultimately, our home.$b$bEnter Ahn'kahet, $c, and cleanse our former home of these Faceless atrocities.
text.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

english.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him in Ahn'Kahet.
