english.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

text.title: 守门人的护符
text.objectives: 艾卓-尼鲁布里的复国者阿扎克要求你从看门者克里克希尔那里夺回守门人的护符。
text.description: 艾卓-尼鲁布大门的看守者克里克希尔并非是一个叛徒。$B$B他在蜘蛛之战中守卫我们的家园，不敌天灾军团的入侵而殒命。$B$B以他的身份推测，通向隐秘帝国的钥匙应该就在他手里。我希望你能把钥匙夺回来，让它回到艾卓-尼鲁布人民的手中。
text.progress: Has Krik'thir's spirit been released from the curse of undeath? What of the talisman?
text.completion: Just as I suspected.$B$BMost of the empire has remained closed off since Krik'thir's final stand. Perhaps my people have already secured the depths and merely await release? Perhaps the faceless ones fester behind closed doors.$B$BOnly time will tell. The exposed upper reaches of Azjol-Nerub must first be cleansed of Arthas' taint.

english.title: The Gatewatcher's Talisman
english.objectives: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub wants you to retrieve the Gatewatcher's Talisman from Krik'thir the Gatewatcher.
english.description: Krik'thir, guardian of the gates to Azjol-Nerub, was not a traitor.$B$BHe fell in the War of the Spider defending our home from the Scourge.$B$BAs per his station, he was in possession of the key to the hidden empire. I'd like you to retrieve it so it may be returned to its people.
english.progress: Has Krik'thir's spirit been released from the curse of undeath? What of the talisman?
english.completion: Just as I suspected.$B$BMost of the empire has remained closed off since Krik'thir's final stand. Perhaps my people have already secured the depths and merely await release? Perhaps the faceless ones fester behind closed doors.$B$BOnly time will tell. The exposed upper reaches of Azjol-Nerub must first be cleansed of Arthas' taint.

text.title: Save the Cuddlies
text.objectives: Lasso 5 Drunk Red Pandas in Fox Grove and bring them to Apprentice Ji Alerage.
text.description: The Fox Grove has become a dangerous place for the local red pandas. $b$bSadly due to my actions helping that crazy Brewmaster Shadowpour, the foxes of the grove have developed an inebriation bite.  The result is the little red pandas keep getting drunk until they can no longer defend themselves.  $b$bPlease!  Can you help me?$b$bIf you round up some of them I have an aroma about this fire that will help sober them up.  That should keep them safe for at least a short while.
text.completed: Speak with Apprentice Ji Alerage.

english.title: Save the Cuddlies
english.objectives: Lasso 5 Drunk Red Pandas in Fox Grove and bring them to Apprentice Ji Alerage.
english.description: The Fox Grove has become a dangerous place for the local red pandas. $b$bSadly due to my actions helping that crazy Brewmaster Shadowpour, the foxes of the grove have developed an inebriation bite.  The result is the little red pandas keep getting drunk until they can no longer defend themselves.  $b$bPlease!  Can you help me?$b$bIf you round up some of them I have an aroma about this fire that will help sober them up.  That should keep them safe for at least a short while.
english.completed: Speak with Apprentice Ji Alerage.

text.title: Lethal Hangovers
text.objectives: Kill 8 intoxicated foxes in the Fox Grove.
text.description: I told him not to do it!  But "no one stands in the way of Brewmaster Shadowpour".$b$BMy master went and contaminated the local water supply trying to "add flavor" to the water. The toxins trickled down here to the Fox Grove where the brew has an irreversible effect on the foxes. $b$BIt warps their minds and sends them into a frenzy.  Now they are a permanent danger to any travelers and local wildlife.$b$BCan you help me cull some of their numbers please?
text.completed: Speak with Apprentice Ji Alerage.

english.title: Lethal Hangovers
english.objectives: Kill 8 intoxicated foxes in the Fox Grove.
english.description: I told him not to do it!  But "no one stands in the way of Brewmaster Shadowpour".$b$BMy master went and contaminated the local water supply trying to "add flavor" to the water. The toxins trickled down here to the Fox Grove where the brew has an irreversible effect on the foxes. $b$BIt warps their minds and sends them into a frenzy.  Now they are a permanent danger to any travelers and local wildlife.$b$BCan you help me cull some of their numbers please?
english.completed: Speak with Apprentice Ji Alerage.

text.title: 法医学
text.objectives: 收集8份黏稠的叶绿素。
text.description: 这些家伙无处不在——而且充满了敌意！我们得赶在更多的联盟出现之前解决掉他们。$b$b这具尸体真是惨不忍睹，不过我依然可以通过解剖得出一些结论。$b$b只要对化学试剂进行科学合理的调配，我一定能制造出一种专门针对这种生物的强效毒药。实际上，我只需对我现有的毒药略作改良。$b$b帮我去水边找些黏稠的叶绿素。任何半灵性植物身上应该都有我要的东西。

english.title: Forensic Science
english.objectives: Collect 8 Viscous Chlorophyll.
english.description: These creatures are everywhere - and very hostile! We'll need to deal with them before any more Alliance show up.$b$bThis one's taken quite a beating, but I've still made some determinations about its anatomy.$b$bWith the proper reagents, I'll be able to fashion a poison that should be quite effective against this species. In fact, I'll just need to modify a bit of the poison I have with me.$b$bGo and find me some viscous chlorophyll down by the water. Any semi-sentient flora should do.

text.title: Into the Nexus
text.objectives: Archmage Berinand has asked you to speak with Warmage Kaitlyn in the Nexus.
text.description: I sent Warmage Kaitlyn into the Nexus to investigate the chaos that is Malygos' domain, but she hasn't reported back in days.$B$BWould you mind going there and lending her aid? I'm certain she could use help if she hasn't been eaten by dragons.

english.title: Into the Nexus
english.objectives: Archmage Berinand has asked you to speak with Warmage Kaitlyn in the Nexus.
english.description: I sent Warmage Kaitlyn into the Nexus to investigate the chaos that is Malygos' domain, but she hasn't reported back in days.$B$BWould you mind going there and lending her aid? I'm certain she could use help if she hasn't been eaten by dragons.

text.title: 差那么一点……就打中我了！
text.objectives: 在静寂瀑布找到丢失的补给箱。
text.description: 听着，$g老兄:宝贝;。$b$b我从炮艇上派出了几架补给回收器，它们不是失踪就是坠毁了，几乎全军覆没。$b$b其中一架嗡嗡地飞过营地，然后坠毁在瀑布那里了。$b$b你能不能去把那个箱子里的东西带回来给我？$b$b我们的回收器都派出去了，不过我的火箭靴也许能帮把手……帮把脚，看情况吧。$b$b嗨！太叫人伤心了……

english.title: Missed Me By... That Much!
english.objectives: Find the missing supply crate at Serenity Falls.
english.description: Listen, $gpal:toots;.$b$bI sent out a coupla supply drones from the gunship, and they've all been lost or crashed. Almost all, that is.$b$bOne of 'em buzzed right through the camp here and crashed out by them waterfalls.$b$bHow 'bout you see what you can do about bringin' the contents of that crate back here, hmm?$b$bWe're all outta drones, but my rocket boots might get come in handy... or footy, as the case may be.$b$bHah! I just kill me...

text.title: 事态
text.objectives: 走访金乌祭坛和玉蟾祭坛并击败乌克门头领。
text.description: 这些该死的土著！才杀了一个，又冒出来两个……$b$b不过一切照旧，$n。不管我们的人手多么紧张，局势多么险恶，命令就是命令。$b$b我还有很多计划要制定，很多问题要解决。$b$b我命令你去那边了解一下局势。要是找不到有价值的情报，就别回来见我。$b$b还有，路上顺便让那个唧唧歪歪的蠢货永远闭上嘴！$b$b解散！

english.title: Lay of the Land
english.objectives: Visit the Shrine of the Sun, the Shrine of the Moon, and Kill Dook Ookem.
english.description: Curse these furry pests! Kill one, and two more rise in its place...$b$bNothing has changed, $n. Orders are orders, no matter how few of us stand and regardless of the odds.$b$bI have plans to make and problems to solve.$b$bI want you to get out there and learn the lay of the land. Don't return until you have something useful to report.$b$bAnd silence that yammering fool while you're out there!$b$bDismissed!

text.title: 斥候报告：敌人的朋友
text.objectives: 听里克报告。
text.description: 我们找的可不只是联盟，你懂的。我们也在找那些长着尖鼻子，闪闪发光的锦鱼人！$b$b好吧，我们很快找到了他们……

english.title: Scouting Report: The Friend of My Enemy
english.objectives: Listen to Riko's report.
english.description: We weren't only looking for Alliance, you know. We were also looking for those snooked-up, tik-flikklin' jinyu!$b$bWell, we found 'em all right...

text.title: 斥候报告：锦鱼得水
text.objectives: 听取夏琪亚的报告。
text.description: 我们的头儿被变成了玉雕，猢狲向导开溜了，还有一个战俘在拖后腿。在这种情况下，琪麟和我只能做一件事了：$b$b那就是冲进敌人领地并向他们复仇。$b$b想知道事情的经过吗？

english.title: Scouting Report: Like Jinyu in a Barrel
english.objectives: Listen to Shokia's report.
english.description: With our leader turned to jade, our hozen guide disappeared, and a prisoner of war in tow, there was only one thing that Kiryn and I could do:$b$bMarch into our enemy's territory and deliver some vengeance.$b$bWant to know how it went?

objectiveDetails.description: 护送匿踪大师琪麟穿过营地

text.title: 师生义绝
text.objectives: 安卡赫特的先知伊克塞特要求你去刺杀先知纳多克斯。
text.description: 我曾将先知纳多克斯视为我的导师。$B$B可自从我亲眼看到他残忍地杀害了我的朋友和家人，变成恶魔的仆人之后，一切都彻底改变了。$B$B请你进入地底深渊找到他，并让他为自己的罪行付出代价，$r。
text.completion: With Nadox gone, I hope to take his place as a leader of my people.$B$BThe Empire of Azjol-Nerub is destined for greatness, $r...

english.title: Pupil No More
english.objectives: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet has tasked you with the assassination of Elder Nadox.
english.description: I once called Elder Nadox my teacher.$B$BThat changed forever when I was forced to watch him mercilessly slaughter my friends and family as a servant of the damned.$B$BFind him within the depths and make him pay for his crimes, $r.
english.completion: With Nadox gone, I hope to take his place as a leader of my people.$B$BThe Empire of Azjol-Nerub is destined for greatness, $r...

text.title: 夺回安卡赫特
text.objectives: 安卡赫特的先知伊克塞特要求你杀死3个塔达拉姆之眼，1个碾骨者以及塔达拉姆王子。
text.description: 塔达拉姆王子和他的天灾大军沿用了我们过去的卫所，以抵御来自严寒深渊的原住民。$B$B去把那些卫所端掉，杀死那里的天灾守卫。我的部队会配合原住民干掉那些残兵的。
text.completion: Excellent.$B$B<You heard a series of clicking sounds.>$B$BNow to vanquish our other foe.
text.giverWindow: 我们决不能失败。
text.turninWindow: 我需要再请你帮我一个忙。

english.title: Reclaiming Ahn'Kahet
english.objectives: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet wants you to kill 3 Eyes of Taldaram, a Bonegrinder, and Prince Taldaram.
english.description: Prince Taldaram and his army of Scourge use the same wards we once used to hide our empire to keep themselves safe from the native denizens of the icy depths.$B$BDeactivate the wards and slaughter the Scourge guarding them. My forces will help the natives slaughter the rest.
english.completion: Excellent.$B$B<You heard a series of clicking sounds.>$B$BNow to vanquish our other foe.
english.giverWindow: Failure will not be tolerated.
english.turninWindow: I must ask one more favor of you.

text.title: 酸雨
text.objectives: 利用回收的旋翼机，击败25个猢狲裂肠者和25个猢狲刺剑手。
text.description: 自从你走了之后，越来越多的猢狲开始逼近我们的营地。看来他们正在为一次大规模的攻势集结兵力！$b$b如果还想看到明天的太阳，我们就必须采取一些极端措施。$b$b给，拿上这些涂了毒的飞镖，想办法削减他们的数量。

english.title: Acid Rain
english.objectives: Using the Recovered Gyrocopter, kill 25 Hozen Gutrippers and 25 Hozen Nibstabbers.
english.description: Since you've been gone, more and more of these creatures are approaching our camp. They appear to be amassing for a major assault!$b$bWe're going to have to take some drastic measures if we hope to see tomorrow.$b$bHere, take my poisoned throwing stars and figure out a way to thin out their numbers.

text.title: 爵德不怕天灾
text.objectives: 达克萨隆要塞里的库塞尔要求你杀死暴龙之王爵德，并且带回它的牙齿。
text.description: 有一个疲于奔命的达卡莱巨魔告诉我，那只巨大的暴龙之王爵德对天灾的瘟疫完全免疫。$B$B如果你能够找到暴龙之王并且把它的一颗牙齿弄下来给我的话，也许我可以把它制成一把武器。
text.completion: <Kurzel's eyes open wide.>$B$BWow! That's enormous!

english.title: What the Scourge Dred
english.objectives: Kurzel inside Drak'Tharon Keep wants you to slay King Dred and bring her his tooth.
english.description: One of the fleeing Drakkari trolls told me of a great raptor king, Dred, that was immune to the plague.$B$BIf you could find King Dred and bring me one of his teeth, perhaps I could fashion it into a weapon.
english.completion: <Kurzel's eyes open wide.>$B$BWow! That's enormous!

text.title: 谨慎行事
text.objectives: 罗宁要求你前往达拉然的紫罗兰监狱然后和辛克莱尔中尉谈一谈。
text.description: 听我说，$r。$B$B紫罗兰监狱最近发生了一起事变，这引起了我的注意。似乎蓝龙军团正准备对达拉然发动一次全面的进攻！$B$B我要你立即前往监狱，去找辛克莱尔中尉。她会告诉你整个事件的细节。$B$B还有，你要尽可能谨慎地处理这件事。不到万不得已的情况下，我并不想让这件事引起达拉然居民的恐慌。我说得够清楚了吧？$B$B好了，现在就出发吧！
text.completion: Not a moment too soon.$b$bAre you prepared to defend Dalaran, $c?

english.title: Discretion is Key
english.objectives: Rhonin wants you to go to the Violet Hold in Dalaran and speak with Lieutenant Sinclari.
english.description: Listen to me, $r.$b$bIt's just been brought to my attention that there's been an incident at the Violet Hold. It would appear that the blues are launching a full scale invasion of Dalaran!$b$bI need you to get to the prison and speak with Lieutenant Sinclari at once. She'll give you the details.$b$bThat is not all. I need this handled with utmost discretion. We mustn't alarm the citizens of Dalaran if it can possibly be avoided. Do I make myself clear?$b$bVery well. Now, go!
english.completion: Not a moment too soon.$b$bAre you prepared to defend Dalaran, $c?

text.title: 全面遏制
text.objectives: 紫罗兰监狱内的辛克莱尔中尉要求你阻止蓝龙军团的入侵。当你杀死塞安妮苟萨之后再和她谈谈。
text.description: 我的部队现在举步维艰，而玛利苟斯派出的进攻者却前赴后继。$B$B我担心这仍然不是最危险的时刻。$B$B你必须坚持到他们的首领塞安妮苟萨亲自参战。只有她的死亡才能遏制住攻势，拯救达拉然。$B$B你准备好了以后就告诉我。
text.completion: Thank you, hero!$B$BDalaran is safe for another day because of your bravery.

english.title: Containment
english.objectives: Lieutenant Sinclari in the Violet Hold wants you to put an end to the blue dragon invasion force. You are to speak to her again once Cyanigosa is slain.
english.description: My forces are in absolute shambles, and Malygos' assailants just keep coming.$B$BI fear that the worst has yet to come.$B$BYou must engage them until their leader, Cyanigosa, comes. Only her death will stop the invasion and save Dalaran.$B$BSpeak to me again when you are ready.
english.completion: Thank you, hero!$B$BDalaran is safe for another day because of your bravery.

text.title: DEPRECATED: Terror on the High Seas
text.objectives: Speak to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in the throne room of Stormwind Keep.
text.description: Word has reached Stormwind of terrible crimes committed against ships carrying Alliance citizens. The Horde stands accused of stopping Alliance ships, boarding them, mistreating passengers, and stealing cargo.$B$BHeroes of the Alliance, your help is needed to determine the truth of these allegations! Seek out Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth at Stormwind Keep if you would answer the call.

english.title: DEPRECATED: Terror on the High Seas
english.objectives: Speak to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in the throne room of Stormwind Keep.
english.description: Word has reached Stormwind of terrible crimes committed against ships carrying Alliance citizens. The Horde stands accused of stopping Alliance ships, boarding them, mistreating passengers, and stealing cargo.$B$BHeroes of the Alliance, your help is needed to determine the truth of these allegations! Seek out Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth at Stormwind Keep if you would answer the call.

text.title: DEPRECATED: Gathering Evidence
text.objectives: Visit Stormwind Harbor and speak with Sentinel Eloria, Lumian Starwhisper, Nayeth Frostmoon, and Finelar Mistwalker.
text.description: A ship called the Bravery routinely ferries passengers and cargo from Stormwind port to Rut'theran Village, right outside Darnassus.$B$BWell, the ship has just returned with distressing news. Both passengers and crew say that Horde vessels stopped and boarded the Bravery in the waters off Teldrassil, mistreated those on board, and stole some of the cargo before turning the ship around.$B$BWe have to find out what happened, $n. Would you go to Stormwind Harbor and listen to the stories of the passengers?
text.completed: Speak with Thandiel Whitemoon at the Stormwind Harbor.

english.title: DEPRECATED: Gathering Evidence
english.objectives: Visit Stormwind Harbor and speak with Sentinel Eloria, Lumian Starwhisper, Nayeth Frostmoon, and Finelar Mistwalker.
english.description: A ship called the Bravery routinely ferries passengers and cargo from Stormwind port to Rut'theran Village, right outside Darnassus.$B$BWell, the ship has just returned with distressing news. Both passengers and crew say that Horde vessels stopped and boarded the Bravery in the waters off Teldrassil, mistreated those on board, and stole some of the cargo before turning the ship around.$B$BWe have to find out what happened, $n. Would you go to Stormwind Harbor and listen to the stories of the passengers?
english.completed: Speak with Thandiel Whitemoon at the Stormwind Harbor.

text.title: 战斗未竟
text.objectives: 哈克娅想要你和古达克内的托玛尔谈一谈。
text.description: 阿卡里先知确实已经无法再对这个世界造成什么威胁了，但我们仍有许多事情要做。$b$b更多的阿卡里之血被用来强化了另一个人，而他才是目前真正的威胁。$b$b行动要快，$n，前往古达克和托玛尔取得联系。他会告诉你下一步该做些什么。
text.completion: Lissen up, mon. Dere be dangerous work ta be done!

english.title: Unfinished Business
english.objectives: Har'koa wants you to speak with Tol'mar in Gundrak.
english.description: While it is true that the Prophet of Akali will trouble this world no more, there yet remains work to be done.$b$bThe greater part of Akali's blood has empowered another, and it is in him that the true danger lies.$b$bQuickly, $n, make your way to Gundrak and speak with Tol'mar. He will be able to direct you further in this cause.
english.completion: Lissen up, mon. Dere be dangerous work ta be done!

text.title: 迦尔达拉必须付出代价
text.objectives: 托玛尔要求你杀死古达克内的斯拉德兰，莫拉比和迦尔达拉。
text.description: 这是我见过的最可怕的事情了。伟大的阿卡里……在我面前被杀死了。真是太恐怖了……$b$b我原本只是负责侦查而已。但我实在是无法忍受了！迦尔达拉和他的手下必须得到惩罚！$b$b为阿卡里报仇，伙计。这是义不容辞的责任！
text.completion: Ya done it?! Dey be no more?$b$bHere ya go, mon. Take dis gift for bringin' justice to da frozen wastes.
text.giverWindow: 叛徒难逃一死！

english.title: Gal'darah Must Pay
english.objectives: Tol'mar wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
english.description: It musta been da most awful thing I ever seen. Da great Akali - slain right before my eyes. Horrible...$b$bMy job be to observe only. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay!$b$bAvenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.
english.completion: Ya done it?! Dey be no more?$b$bHere ya go, mon. Take dis gift for bringin' justice to da frozen wastes.
english.giverWindow: Da traitor deserves death!

text.title: 迦尔达拉必须付出代价
text.objectives: 记载者拜基妮要求你杀死古达克内的斯拉德兰，莫拉比和迦尔达拉。
text.description: 伟大的阿卡里被杀害了，$r。$b$b我毕生的责任是负责记录，而非战斗。但我已忍无可忍！迦尔达拉和他的手下必须得到惩罚！$b$b为阿卡里报仇，伙计。这是义不容辞的责任！
text.giverWindow: 对他不能心慈手软！

english.title: Gal'darah Must Pay
english.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
english.description: Da mighty Akali has been slain, $r.$b$bMy role in life be to record, not fight. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay!$b$bAvenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.
english.giverWindow: Show him no mercy!

text.title: 只是去看看
text.objectives: 图基尼希望你能去找古达克的拜基妮说话。
text.description: 从古达克一直传来可怕的声响。这种声音越来越大，而且出现得越来越频繁。$b$b我有个学徒还在古达克里做记载，她已经跟随我很久了。也许你能帮我去看看她怎么了？

english.title: Just Checkin'
english.objectives: To'kini wants you to speak to Bah'kini in Gundrak.
english.description: There have been fearsome sounds echoing from Gundrak. They have been increasing in volume and frequency of late.$b$bMy long-time student is currently recording events from inside Gundrak. Perhaps you could find the time to check in on her for me?

text.title: Sacred Scroll
text.objectives: Bring the Illegible Scroll to Lorewalker Cho.
text.description: The unfamiliar markings on this parchment have an elegance about them that Yoggtord and his gang don't seem capable of.$b$bYou suspect that, like everything else these Hozu possess, this is stolen merchandise.$b$bPerhaps the original owner of the scroll is still nearby...

english.title: Sacred Scroll
english.objectives: Bring the Illegible Scroll to Lorewalker Cho.
english.description: The unfamiliar markings on this parchment have an elegance about them that Yoggtord and his gang don't seem capable of.$b$bYou suspect that, like everything else these Hozu possess, this is stolen merchandise.$b$bPerhaps the original owner of the scroll is still nearby...

text.title: 独一无二
text.objectives: 记载者拜基妮要你从古达克弄一块达卡莱巨像的碎片回来。
text.description: 乍听之下，这个故事似乎有点老套——巨魔摧毁了他们本该膜拜的存在，获得了禁忌的力量。$b$b如果我听说的事都是真的，那么他们一定有一个特殊的魔像，一个前所未有的神秘造物！$b$b帮我弄一块魔像碎片来，我要研究一下。

english.title: One of a Kind
english.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini wants you to recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus in Gundrak.
english.description: At first glance, it be lookin' like da same old story here - trolls tappin' into forbidden powah by destroyin' da very beings dey should be worshippin'.$b$bIf what I learned be true, den dey have a special golem - one like nuthin' created before!$b$bBring me back a piece from dat golem ta study.

text.title: 独一无二
text.objectives: 托玛尔要你从古达克弄一块达卡莱巨像的碎片回来。
text.description: 要是达卡莱人肯老老实实地膜拜这些神灵，而不是摧毁了它们，这场悲剧本来是可以避免的。$b$b我听说他们有一个特别的魔像——里面灌注着禁忌的能量。$b$b给我弄一块魔像的碎片回来，这样我们就能从这里的兄弟姐妹们身上学到点东西了。
text.progress: You find da golem? I'm sure it's in there somewhere.
text.completion: Amazin'! Dis be like nothing I've ever seer before.$B$BGood work, mon.

english.title: One of a Kind
english.objectives: Tol'mar wants you to recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus in Gundrak.
english.description: Dis whole mess coulda been avoided if da Drakkari had worshipped da gods instead of destroyin' dem.$b$bI heard dat dey have a special golem - one imbued with forbidden powah.$b$bBring me back a piece from dat golem so we can learn from our bruddas and sistahs.
english.progress: You find da golem? I'm sure it's in there somewhere.
english.completion: Amazin'! Dis be like nothing I've ever seer before.$B$BGood work, mon.

text.title: 前车之鉴
text.objectives: 古达克的记载者拜基妮要你收集6块达卡莱历史石板。
text.description: 古达克看来已经完了。你也知道，这是事实。$b$b如果你有勇气的话，就去寻找历史石板吧，看看到底是什么令达卡莱帝国落得如此下场。$B$B或许有一天，我们能让它重现昔日的荣光。

english.title: For Posterity
english.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini in Gundrak wants you to collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
english.description: Gundrak looks doomed. You know dis to be true.$b$bIf you be havin' the courage, search for history tablets to see what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end.$B$BPerhaps one day we be bringin' dem back to der former glory.

text.title: Lay of the Land[TEMP]
text.objectives: Explore the region.
text.description: Grah!!$b$bFor every one of these muck-flingers we kill, another two spring from the woods to take its place. I wouldn't share this with the others, but it's clear that we won't last long here, $n.$b$bI must stay and defend what remains of our belongings. You scout out the region and seek a solution to our primate problem.$b$bGo now. Our hope goes with you...

english.title: Lay of the Land[TEMP]
english.objectives: Explore the region.
english.description: Grah!!$b$bFor every one of these muck-flingers we kill, another two spring from the woods to take its place. I wouldn't share this with the others, but it's clear that we won't last long here, $n.$b$bI must stay and defend what remains of our belongings. You scout out the region and seek a solution to our primate problem.$b$bGo now. Our hope goes with you...

text.title: Seeking Answers
text.objectives: Use the candles to meditate at the Cairn of Blood.
text.description: <Cho endures your stream of questions before speaking.>$b$bSo much to ponder, traveler...$b$bYou first must learn how to ask before your mind can discern the truth.$b$bI have completed my meditations for today, but my candles remain at the Cairn of Blood.$b$bGo there. Clear your mind. We will speak again when you are prepared to hear my words.

english.title: Seeking Answers
english.objectives: Use the candles to meditate at the Cairn of Blood.
english.description: <Cho endures your stream of questions before speaking.>$b$bSo much to ponder, traveler...$b$bYou first must learn how to ask before your mind can discern the truth.$b$bI have completed my meditations for today, but my candles remain at the Cairn of Blood.$b$bGo there. Clear your mind. We will speak again when you are prepared to hear my words.

text.title: Aunty Lin Windfur
text.objectives: Speak with Lin Windfur in Panda Town.
text.description: We will start heading back to town once everyone gets organized.  No way is anyone going to mess with me now!  I'll boot them in the head! I'm sure I won't be in trouble after this.$b$bThank you so much for your help. Can you tell Aunty Lin back in Panda Town that we are okay and on our way back?  She has tons of old cool stuff she might give you as a reward.
text.completed: Speak with Lin Windfur in Panda Town.

english.title: Aunty Lin Windfur
english.objectives: Speak with Lin Windfur in Panda Town.
english.description: We will start heading back to town once everyone gets organized.  No way is anyone going to mess with me now!  I'll boot them in the head! I'm sure I won't be in trouble after this.$b$bThank you so much for your help. Can you tell Aunty Lin back in Panda Town that we are okay and on our way back?  She has tons of old cool stuff she might give you as a reward.
english.completed: Speak with Lin Windfur in Panda Town.

text.title: 前车之鉴
text.objectives: 古达克的托玛尔要你收集6块达卡莱历史石板。
text.description: 如今，冰巨魔的土地笼罩于昔日荣光的阴影之中，辉煌不再。$b$b如果你够胆的话，就去寻找历史石板吧，看看到底是什么令达卡莱帝国落得如此下场。$B$B或许有一天，我们能将这片土地交还给新的冰霜巨魔族裔。
text.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
text.completion: We trolls been subject to da splittin' of empires for longer than some races been existin'.$B$BWe always regrow from da ruins.

english.title: For Posterity
english.objectives: Tol'mar in Gundrak wants you to collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
english.description: Da land of da ice trolls is a shadow of its former glory.$b$bIf you be havin' the courage, search for history tablets to see what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end.$B$BPerhaps one day we be givin' dis land back to a new line of frost trolls.
english.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
english.completion: We trolls been subject to da splittin' of empires for longer than some races been existin'.$B$BWe always regrow from da ruins.

text.title: To Catch a Thief
text.objectives: Infiltrate Ravenholdt Manor and locate the missing black dragon egg.
text.description: Just beyond this cave lies Ravenholdt Manor. You need to get inside without being seen!$B$B<Mostrasz places an enchantment on you.>$B$BThere - now I'll be able to keep an eye on you and communicate as you venture into the compound. Now sneak into that manor, locate the egg, and don't get caught...

english.title: To Catch a Thief
english.objectives: Infiltrate Ravenholdt Manor and locate the missing black dragon egg.
english.description: Just beyond this cave lies Ravenholdt Manor. You need to get inside without being seen!$B$B<Mostrasz places an enchantment on you.>$B$BThere - now I'll be able to keep an eye on you and communicate as you venture into the compound. Now sneak into that manor, locate the egg, and don't get caught...

text.title: 绝望的守望者
text.objectives: 岩石大厅的卡迪尔·斩铁要求你让悲伤圣女安息，并获得一滴悲伤水晶之泪。
text.description: 我很乐意为造物者以及他们的造物献出生命。$B$B可是，自从洛肯背叛之后，整个奥杜尔似乎都开始与世界为敌。尤其是悲伤圣女，她似乎已经彻底沉浸在自己全新的痛苦秩序里了。$B$B请让她安息，并将她的一滴泪水带回来给我。
text.progress: I wish there were another way, but it seems death is the maiden's only salvation now.
text.completion: <Kaldir stares into the crystal in silence for a moment.>$B$BNo being has ever felt such sincere sorrow as the Maiden of Grief has.$B$BLet us remember her spirit as we continue our efforts against Loken.

english.title: The Forlorn Watcher
english.objectives: Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone has asked you to put the Maiden of Grief to rest and to obtain a Crystal Tear of Grief.
english.description: I would gladly give my life for the Makers or their creations.$B$BHowever, since Loken's betrayal it seems all of Ulduar has turned on the world. One in particular, the Maiden of Grief, seems to reel in agony at her new orders.$B$BPlease lay her to rest and bring me one of her tears.
english.progress: I wish there were another way, but it seems death is the maiden's only salvation now.
english.completion: <Kaldir stares into the crystal in silence for a moment.>$B$BNo being has ever felt such sincere sorrow as the Maiden of Grief has.$B$BLet us remember her spirit as we continue our efforts against Loken.

text.title: 堕落的构造体
text.objectives: 岩石大厅的卡迪尔·斩铁要求你杀死3个黑暗符文巨人和克莱斯塔卢斯。
text.description: 铁矮人们正忙着雕刻巨型岩石构造体。我担心它们很快就变成铁矮人的强大武器。$B$B你必须去击败他们的监工克莱斯塔卢斯以及大厅中的黑暗符文巨人成品，否则就太迟了！
text.completion: Well done, $r.$B$BEvery weapon we can take away from Loken is a great boon to our own war effort.

english.title: Corrupt Constructs
english.objectives: Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone has asked you to kill 3 Dark Rune Giants and Krystallus.
english.description: The iron dwarves are busy at work carving out massive stone constructs that I fear will soon be used as powerful weapons.$B$BYou must defeat their overseer, Krystallus, and the dark rune giants already walking the halls before it is too late!
english.completion: Well done, $r.$B$BEvery weapon we can take away from Loken is a great boon to our own war effort.

text.title: 大赛冠军
text.objectives: 大领主提里奥·弗丁要求你完成冠军的试炼。
text.description: 随着这次大赛的举行，与巫妖王的决战离我们又近了一步。$B$B$n，拿出你的勇气与荣誉感，尽情地战斗吧。这里的每一个战士都是百里挑一的精英。$B$B我们要同心协力，阻止阿尔萨斯！
text.completion: I am honored to stand in the presence of such a fierce warrior.$B$BYou have brought honor to yourself and to your people, $n!
text.giverWindow: 我对你有信心。
text.turninWindow: 你令我对赢得这场战争的信心大增。

english.title: Champion of the Tournament
english.objectives: Highlord Tirion Fordring has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
english.description: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King.$B$B$n, fight with valor and honor. Every fighter here has gathered for the common good.$B$BTogether, we will stop Arthas!
english.completion: I am honored to stand in the presence of such a fierce warrior.$B$BYou have brought honor to yourself and to your people, $n!
english.giverWindow: I have faith in you.
english.turninWindow: You bring me great hope for the success of this campaign.

text.title: Champion of the King
text.objectives: King Varian Wrynn has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
text.description: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King.$B$B$N, you are to represent the Alliance in this grand arena.$B$BProve yourself against Azeroth's finest. Go forward with honor.
text.giverWindow: Prepare yourself.

english.title: Champion of the King
english.objectives: King Varian Wrynn has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
english.description: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King.$B$B$N, you are to represent the Alliance in this grand arena.$B$BProve yourself against Azeroth's finest. Go forward with honor.
english.giverWindow: Prepare yourself.

text.title: DEPRECATED: Claiming Kalimdor
text.objectives: Report to General Nazgrim at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
text.description: Victory shall soon be ours! Our forces have engaged the enemy all over Kalimdor.$B$BWarchief Garrosh Hellscream has commanded all able-bodied $rs to report for duty in support of our latest offensive.$B$BMake your way to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar and present yourself to General Nazgrim for immediate assignment! For the Horde!
text.completed: Report to General Nazgrim at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

english.objectives: Report to General Nazgrim at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Victory shall soon be ours! Our forces have engaged the enemy all over Kalimdor.$B$BWarchief Garrosh Hellscream has commanded all able-bodied $rs to report for duty in support of our latest offensive.$B$BMake your way to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar and present yourself to General Nazgrim for immediate assignment! For the Horde!
english.completed: Report to General Nazgrim at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

text.title: DEPRECATED: Where Are Those Ships?
text.objectives: Speak to Overseer Moxx at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale and kill 6 Night Elf Raiders on the ships outside the town.
text.description: With most of our fleet leading the attack on Theramore and engaging the enemy elsewhere, we're going to need more ships to complete our blockade of Kalimdor.$B$BThe warchief ordered the shipwrights at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale to work overtime to meet the demand, but none of the new craft have arrived yet.$B$BTravel there and put the question to their overseer. Tell them the warchief wants his ships!

english.title: DEPRECATED: Where Are Those Ships?
english.objectives: Speak to Overseer Moxx at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale and kill 6 Night Elf Raiders on the ships outside the town.
english.description: With most of our fleet leading the attack on Theramore and engaging the enemy elsewhere, we're going to need more ships to complete our blockade of Kalimdor.$B$BThe warchief ordered the shipwrights at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale to work overtime to meet the demand, but none of the new craft have arrived yet.$B$BTravel there and put the question to their overseer. Tell them the warchief wants his ships!

text.title: 决一死战
text.objectives: 闪电大厅的风暴先驱埃尔林要求你击败沃尔坎。
text.description: 我就跟你直说了吧，小$r。自从与托里姆决裂之后，我的族人们已经变了。$b$b沃尔坎把我们看做眼中钉，肉中刺。他跟我们之间，只有一方能活下来。我们只想要和平，可现在看来，战争已经是我们唯一的选择了。
text.completion: Volkhan shall haunt the dreams of my people no more.$b$bContinue your efforts, little $r. In time, I am certain my people will grow to forgive Thorim.

english.title: Diametrically Opposed
english.objectives: Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning wants you to defeat Volkhan.
english.description: I shall speak plainly to you, little $r. My people have not been the same since our ties with Thorim were severed.$b$bVolkhan will not rest until either he, or we, are no more. We only want peace, but it seems we have no choice but war.
english.completion: Volkhan shall haunt the dreams of my people no more.$b$bContinue your efforts, little $r. In time, I am certain my people will grow to forgive Thorim.

text.title: 不惜代价！
text.objectives: 闪电大厅的风暴先驱埃尔林要求你击败洛肯，然后将洛肯的信物带回来交给他。
text.description: 无论如何，洛肯一定得死。$b$b击败洛肯的光荣使命将由你背负。$b$b把他的信物带回来给我，我将永远感激你的义举。
text.progress: Has justice been brought to Loken?
text.completion: That vile worm is dead?$b$bYou have turned out to be a great boon to my people, little $r.$b$bPlease accept this gift in return for your loyal friendship.

english.title: Whatever it Takes!
english.objectives: Stormherald Eljrinn in the Halls of Lightning wants you to defeat Loken. You are then to return to Stormherald Eljrinn with Loken's Tongue.
english.description: One way or another, Loken shall fall.$b$bThe honor and glory of his defeat shall be yours.$b$bReturn to me with his lying tongue, and earn my unending gratitude.
english.progress: Has justice been brought to Loken?
english.completion: That vile worm is dead?$b$bYou have turned out to be a great boon to my people, little $r.$b$bPlease accept this gift in return for your loyal friendship.

text.title: 扫清道路
text.objectives: 闪电大厅的风暴先驱埃尔林要求你杀死3个雷铸医师，3个雷铸战术师以及比亚格里将军。
text.description: 洛肯的大军正在加紧备战。但他们永远不会想到，自己会首先遭到攻击。$B$B进攻的时机到了。趁他们还没有发动针对全艾泽拉斯生灵的战争，先去消灭比亚格里将军和他的大军吧！
text.completion: Though few outside of us shall ever know it, you have certainly saved the world on this day.

english.title: Clearing the Way
english.objectives: Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning wants you to kill 3 Stormforged Menders, 3 Stormforged Tacticians, and General Bjarngrim.
english.description: Loken's forces prepare for war. What they are not ready for is to be attacked themselves.$B$BNow is the moment to strike. Take out General Bjarngrim and his army, lest they mount an offensive on all life on Azeroth!
english.completion: Though few outside of us shall ever know it, you have certainly saved the world on this day.

text.title: 风暴先驱埃尔林
text.objectives: 约库姆国王要你进入闪电大厅，与风暴先驱埃尔林谈一谈。
text.description: 我已经派出一位密使前往闪电大厅对付洛肯。$B$B但考虑到洛肯的大军实力，他肯定需要帮助。请你竭尽全力帮助他，这样我们才能彻底阻止那个叛徒。

english.title: Stormherald Eljrrin
english.objectives: King Jokkum wants you to enter the Halls of Lightning and speak with Stormherald Eljrrin.
english.description: I have sent an emissary to the Halls of Lightning to take the battle to Loken.$B$BHe undoubtedly needs assistance, given the strength of Loken's armies. Lend him any aid you can so that we may finally stop the traitor.

text.title: 正本清源
text.objectives: 银色神官帕尔崔丝要你杀死席瓦拉·索格蕾。
text.description: 我们正在努力减轻天灾军团的战争机器给我们造成的损失。$B$B这里的维库人已经自愿加入了巫妖王的阵营，这已经妨害了我们的任务。$B$B我请求你，勇敢的战士，你必须在他们被带入永恒的黑暗之前，击败他们的精神领袖席瓦拉。
text.completion: Every soldier we deny to the Scourge is more than one life saved.$B$BThank you.
text.giverWindow: 她令我们的困境雪上加霜。

english.title: Working at the Source
english.objectives: Argent Confessor Paletress wants you to slay Svala Sorrowgrave.
english.description: We are hard at work ensuring that we minimize our losses to the Scourge war machine.$B$BThe vrykul here are undermining that mission by willingly joining the Lich King's ranks.$B$BPlease, brave champion, you must defeat their spiritual leader, Svala, before she leads her people into the eternal shadow!
english.completion: Every soldier we deny to the Scourge is more than one life saved.$B$BThank you.
english.giverWindow: She thrives on our pain.

starters.name: 银色神官帕尔崔丝的影像

enders.name: 银色神官帕尔崔丝的影像

text.title: 丝木林之路
text.objectives: 击败8只丝木追踪者。
text.description: 西边就是丝木林之路了。这条路已经被邪恶且暴戾的蜘蛛给占据了，整条路显得黑影憧憧。$b$b我本该亲自去对付这些恶棍的，但我得保护这家面馆，使其免于……呃……陷入困境或别的什么。$b$b去吧英雄，去征服这些野兽！如果你能活着回来，或许我会给你讲一些我的英雄往事。$b$b当然，我也会支付你报酬的。
text.completion: Such a noble hero. You remind me of a younger, less good looking version of myself.

english.title: The Silkwood Road
english.objectives: Defeat 8 Silkwood Stalkers.
english.description: West of here is the Silkwood Road. It has fallen into shadow as the spiders there have turned to a more evil and gluttonous path.$b$bI would face these villains myself but someone has to defend the noodle shop from... um... dangers and such.$b$bGo, hero, and conquer these beasts! Should you succeed perhaps I shall regale you with some of my epic tales of heroism.$b$bI'll also pay you.
english.completion: Such a noble hero. You remind me of a younger, less good looking version of myself.

text.title: 万千烦恼丝
text.objectives: 收集7卷生丝线。
text.description: 啊，欢迎你，旅行者。我需要你的帮助！$b$b塞拉·金酿在找丝线。我个人是讨厌丝线的，因为它总是会跟我的毛缠在一起。$b$b不过我真的很想让她高兴。$b$b你能不能从西边的丝木林帮我找些丝线回来？酬劳不是问题。
text.completion: Oh thank you so much! This is perfect!$b$bI hope it didn't stick to you like it stuck to me.$b$bI'm going to go find Syra and give this to her right away!

english.title: The Threads that Stick
english.objectives: Gather 7 Pristine Silk Strands.
english.description: Ah, welcome traveler. I have need of your services!$b$bSyra Goldendraft was looking for some silk. Personally I hate silk as it always gets stuck in my fur.$b$bI really want to impress her though.$b$bIf you bring me some silk from the Silkwood to the west of here I will gladly pay you for your help.
english.completion: Oh thank you so much! This is perfect!$b$bI hope it didn't stick to you like it stuck to me.$b$bI'm going to go find Syra and give this to her right away!

text.title: 聪明的阿西约
text.objectives: 找到聪明的阿西约。
text.description: 我不知道聪明的阿西约从哪里得到“聪明”这个称号的。所有的锦鱼人都很聪明，我看不出他比其他大多数锦鱼人聪明在哪里。$b$b实际上恰恰相反。$b$b至少他是个能干的战士。他在天禅院表现得很好，因此能够被选中参加我们的训练任务。$b$b如果你想帮助他寻找隐秘大师，可以沿着河谷的北侧边缘寻找他。
text.completion: Where have I seen you before?
text.completed: 去四风谷的新希菲拉找到聪明的阿西约。

english.title: Clever Ashyo
english.objectives: Find Clever Ashyo.
english.description: I'm not sure where Clever Ashyo got his "Clever" title from. All jinyu are clever, and I wouldn't say that he's any more clever than most of them.$b$bQuite the opposite, actually.$b$bAt least he's a capable fighter. He did well enough at Tian Monastery to be selected for our training mission.$b$bIf you want to help him look for the Hidden Master, you can find him along the Valley's northern border.
english.completion: Where have I seen you before?
english.completed: Find Clever Ashyo at New Cifera in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 林·柔掌
text.objectives: 找到林·柔掌
text.description: 林并没有意识到她自己有多大的天赋。所以她的功夫虽然不错，但意志薄弱。只要树立起信心，她或许能强过我们所有人。$b$b但愿在西行之旅中，她能找到信心。我们说话这会儿她可能已经启程去石犁村了。如果你要去山谷的另一侧，那就截住林并和她谈一谈。
text.completion: Oh, it's you!$b$bNo, I haven't found the Hidden Master yet. I probably wasted my time coming out here.$b$b<Sigh...>
text.completed: 去四风谷的石犁村找到林·柔掌。

english.title: Lin Tenderpaw
english.objectives: Find Lin Tenderpaw.
english.description: Lin is more talented than she thinks she is. Strong of fist but weak of spirit. With more confidence, she could be better than all of us.$b$bPerhaps she will find the surety she needs on her trip into the west. She's probably on her way to Stoneplow as we speak. Stop and speak to her, if you find yourself on that side of the Valley.
english.completion: Oh, it's you!$b$bNo, I haven't found the Hidden Master yet. I probably wasted my time coming out here.$b$b<Sigh...>
english.completed: Find Lin Tenderpaw at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 肯肯
text.objectives: 找到肯肯。
text.description: 嗯……猢狲肯肯。$b$b就个人而言，他在训练中的成长速度让我惊讶。他还算是有脑子的，这一点比他大部分的同类都要强。$b$b他说过他要去东边，不过你看我们已经在山谷里很靠东的一侧了，我想他应该离这不远。沿着朝南的路径，去卡桑琅丛林的朱家堡寻找他，看看他发现了什么。
text.completed: 去卡桑琅丛林的朱家堡找肯肯。

english.title: Ken-Ken
english.objectives: Find Ken-Ken.
english.description: So... Ken-Ken. The hozen.$b$bPersonally, I'm impressed he's progressed so far in his training. He's got a brain between his ears, which is more than can be said for most of his kind.$b$bHe said he was headed east, but, seeing as we're already on the far east side of the valley, I can't imagine he went too far from here. Look for him at Zhu's Watch, in Krasarang Wilds, down the path to the south. See what he's found.
english.completed: Find Ken-Ken at Zhu's Watch in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 康·棘杖
text.objectives: 找到康·棘杖。
text.description: 康的骄傲常常会让他自信过头，这也导致他总是身涉险境。他现在的处境一点也不乐观——他正朝着卡桑琅丛林的深处走去。$b$b我一般不会请求陌生人的帮助，不过……你能去找找他，确保他安然无恙吗？这样我才会放心一点，因为我知道有一位勇敢的$r正照顾着他。
text.completed: 在卡桑琅丛林的先遣营地找到康·棘杖。

english.title: Kang Bramblestaff
english.objectives: Find Kang Bramblestaff.
english.description: Kang's pride regularly becomes overconfidence, which often leads him down dangerous paths. His current path is as dangerous as any - he is headed deep into the Krasarang Wilds.$b$bI wouldn't normally ask a favor of a stranger, but... would you make sure that he is well? It would give me relief to know that a brave $r was looking out for him.
english.completed: Find Kang Bramblestaff at The Incursion in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 康·棘杖
text.objectives: 找到康·棘杖。
text.description: 康的骄傲常常会让他自信过头，这也导致他总是身涉险境。他现在的处境一点也不乐观——他正朝着卡桑琅丛林的深处走去。$b$b我一般不会请求陌生人的帮助，不过……你能去找找他，确保他安然无恙吗？这样我才会放心一点，因为我知道有一位勇敢的$r正照顾着他。
text.completed: 去卡桑琅丛林的雷霆裂口找康·棘杖。

english.title: Kang Bramblestaff
english.objectives: Find Kang Bramblestaff.
english.description: Kang's pride regularly becomes overconfidence, which often leads him down dangerous paths. His current path is as dangerous as any - he is headed deep into the Krasarang Wilds.$b$bI wouldn't normally ask a favor of a stranger, but... would you make sure that he is well? It would give me relief to know that a brave $r was looking out for him.
english.completed: Find Kang Bramblestaff at Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 缺乏常识
text.objectives: 挖出7件农具。
text.description: 兔妖——他们并不是只偷吃我们的食物。他们也在尝试建立自己的农场。问题是……嗯，他们似乎很愚蠢。$b$b你不信穆诺的话？昨晚，他们闯入了工具房……偷走了我们的农具。当我们醒来时，发现耙子和手推车被种在了地里。$b$b他们还给耙子和手推车浇了水。他们在试着种手推车！$b$b拜托了，你去那儿的时候，请把我们的工具挖出来。
text.completion: Thanks, friend. Now maybe a hozen can get some ookin' work done around here.

english.title: A Poor Grasp of the Basics
english.objectives: Unearth 7 pieces of farm equipment.
english.description: Virmen - they no just eat our food. They trying to start farms of their own. The problem is... well, they ookin' dumb.$b$bYou no believe Muno? Last night, they break into tool sheds... steal equipment. When we wake up, we find rakes and wheelbarrows planted in ground.$b$bThey was WATERING them. They was trying to GROW WHEELBARROWS.$b$bPlease, while you out there, unbury our stuff.
english.completion: Thanks, friend. Now maybe a hozen can get some ookin' work done around here.

text.title: Building a Better Hozen Trap
text.objectives: Collect 8 Slickies and 8 Intact Pottery Jars from Lake Kittitata.
text.description: One thing is now painfully clear. The Hozen love their 'slickies'.$b$bWhile deep in your meditative trance, scattered images and impressions came to your mind. Now fully awake, you struggle to make sense of the experience.$b$bThe beginnings of an absurd plan begin to take shape in your head. It might just be crazy enough to work...

english.title: Building a Better Hozen Trap
english.objectives: Collect 8 Slickies and 8 Intact Pottery Jars from Lake Kittitata.
english.description: One thing is now painfully clear. The Hozen love their 'slickies'.$b$bWhile deep in your meditative trance, scattered images and impressions came to your mind. Now fully awake, you struggle to make sense of the experience.$b$bThe beginnings of an absurd plan begin to take shape in your head. It might just be crazy enough to work...

text.title: 整个吞下
text.objectives: 从肿胀的鳄鱼体内释放5个猢狲，并从玉盘湖收集5条斑点鳟。
text.description: 现在，回到你的困境这个话题。$b$b我相信你可以帮助你的人民与我们猢狲建立关系，就像我的人民曾经做过的一样。$b$b我身后的小径会将你引领到一片水域，猢狲们原来从这里捕鱼填饱肚子。$b$b每年的这个时节，一些恐怖的野兽会占据这片水域，许多饥饿的猢狲都落入了它们口中。$b$b如果你能救出一些受害者并收集一些鱼，或许你在这里会更受欢迎。

english.title: Swallowed Whole
english.objectives: Free 5 hozen from the Engorged Crocolisks, and gather 5 Speckled Trout from Lake Kittitata.
english.description: Now, back to your dilemma.$b$bI believe you can help your people build relations with our hozen, as my people have.$b$bThe trail behind me will lead you to a body of water the hozen use to gather the fish that feeds them.$b$bAround this time every year, fearsome beasts call those waters home and many hungry hozen are lost to them.$b$bIf you were to rescue some of the victims and gather some fish, perhaps you will be regarded more favorably.

text.title: 理想的颜色
text.objectives: 收集8片刚凋落的花瓣。
text.description: 如你所见，这个林子里到处都是美丽的粉红色花瓣。花瓣落下不久，它们的色泽就会变暗消退。$b$B如果可以的话，你能帮我收集一些刚掉下来的新鲜花瓣吗？只有那些刚掉下来的花瓣里才有我需要的颜色。$b$B我能用来制作一种让人叹为观止的墨水。能帮帮我吗？
text.completion: Ah! You have a wonderful eye for color my friend.  These will make a superb pigment.

english.title: The Perfect Color
english.objectives: Gather 8 Freshly Fallen Petals.
english.description: As you have seen, this grove is abundant with beautiful pink petals.  As each petal ages, the tone deepens and fades.$b$BIf you would be so kind, I am in need of a few petals that have freshly fallen.  Only the ones that have just fallen will have precisely the right color I am after.$b$BFrom it I can forge an ink that will be breathtaking.  Can you help me?
english.completion: Ah! You have a wonderful eye for color my friend.  These will make a superb pigment.

text.title: 尾针翎笔
text.objectives: 从百木园黄蜂身上收集6根黄蜂尾针。
text.description: 要达到理想的出墨效果，我们必须有合适的工具。我以前用的已经彻底废掉了，它们的笔毛变得跟猢狲毛一样乱糟糟的。$b$b看到百木园里的黄蜂了吗？用它们的尾针制成的翎笔，每一排笔毛的硬度都很适中。$b$b能给我带些黄蜂尾针来吗？
text.completion: My thanks traveler. These will make a fine set of quills. Here is something for your trouble.

english.title: Quill of Stingers
english.objectives: Gather 6 Wasp Stingers from Orchard Wasps.
english.description: To achieve perfect paint strokes, one must have the right tools. My own have fallen into disrepair, their bristles becoming as unmanageable as hozu hair.$b$bHave you seen the wasps throughout the Arboretum? Their stingers can be fashioned into quills that provide just the right level of sharpness in each line.$b$bCould you gather some for me please?
english.completion: My thanks traveler. These will make a fine set of quills. Here is something for your trouble.

text.title: 审时度势
text.objectives: 和珠鳍村的长老卢山、珍珠守护者福锦、锐鳍教头和吽·提门度谈一谈。
text.description: 我一直在思考。$B$B我们补给中断，又远离家乡。$B$B尽管这些珠鳍锦鱼人对于我们的到来仍心存疑虑，但他们好像也没有敌意。$B$B如果我们能说服他们相信大家都是朋友，那两个种族的联盟势必产生不可估量的价值。$B$B$n，你得去跟村里的锦鱼人谈一谈。$B$B说服他们的首领不要惧怕我们，我们只为和平而来。
text.completion: It sounds like you made quite the good impression.$B$BWell done, $n!

english.title: The Pearlfin Situation
english.objectives: Speak to Elder Lusshan, Pearlkeeper Fujin, Instructor Sharpfin, and Ot-Temmdo at Pearlfin Village.
english.description: I've been thinking.$B$BWe are cut off from support and a long way from home.$B$BAlthough these Pearlfin jinyu mistrust our presence, they do not appear to be hostile.$B$BIf we could convince them that we are their friends, an alliance between our races could prove extremely valuable.$B$B$n, you must go speak to the jinyu around the village.$B$BConvince their leaders that we are not to be feared, and that we only wish for peace.
english.completion: It sounds like you made quite the good impression.$B$BWell done, $n!

objectiveDetails.description: 与珍珠守护者福锦交谈
与流水工匠吽·提门度交谈

text.title: Tracking Event: Spies Leave
text.objectives: See the scouts off, then speak to Big Lu.
text.description: It's time for Sully and I to leave. We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly.$B$BI'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly.$B$BI'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

text.title: 行军口粮
text.objectives: 收集6块乌龟腰肉。
text.description: 我们没时间等将军把伤养好了。$B$B我和苏利计划向北去搜寻安度因，但我们需要足够的行军补给。$B$B这片湖里水产丰富，并且我们已获准进行捕捞。$B$B去收集一些补给品，我和苏利会在这做最后的准备。
text.completion: This should be plenty, $n. Thanks.

english.title: Road Rations
english.objectives: Collect 6 Tortoise Flanks.
english.description: We do not have time to wait around for the Admiral to recover.$B$BSully and I are planning to search for Anduin to the north, but we'll need supplies for our journey.$B$BThe lake here is teeming with wildlife, which we have received permission to hunt.$B$BGo and gather some supplies while Sully and I finalize our preparations.
english.completion: This should be plenty, $n. Thanks.

text.title: Zen Healing
text.objectives: Collect 6 Zen Lotus.
text.description: Your friend Taylor is in critical shape. Unfortunately, his wounds are tainted by hozen poison, which is very difficult to cure.$B$BLuckily, through many generations of fighting the hozen, my people have developed medicines to treat such injuries.$B$BThe flowers growing on the surface of Glass Lake are needed to make the antidote.$B$B$n, go quickly and bring back some blooms. Your Admiral's life depends on it.
text.completed: Return to Mishka at Pearlfin Village in the Jade Forest.
