english.description: Your friend Taylor is in critical shape. Unfortunately, his wounds are tainted by hozen poison, which is very difficult to cure.$B$BLuckily, through many generations of fighting the hozen, my people have developed medicines to treat such injuries.$B$BThe flowers growing on the surface of Glass Lake are needed to make the antidote.$B$B$n, go quickly and bring back some blooms. Your Admiral's life depends on it.
english.completed: Return to Mishka at Pearlfin Village in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 长老的道具
text.objectives: 从吊尾粘爪猴身上收集水语者法杖、典礼长袍、玉冠和檀木念珠。
text.description: 天呐，天呐……绝不能让长老知道啊！$B$B我一定是在逃出来的时候把长老的祭祀道具落在村里了。$B$B但是……月水庄现在爬满了猢狲！$B$B我算哪门子的珍珠守护者啊，竟然这么粗心把东西搞丢了？$B$B<这位老锦鱼人双手掩面。>$B$B这位陌生人，你能好心帮我一回吗？
text.completion: You found them? Oh thank the spirits of water!$B$BYou have saved my tailfin, $n.

english.title: The Elder's Instruments
english.objectives: Collect the Waterspeaker's Staff, Ceremonial Robe, Jade Crown, and Rosewood Beads from Slingtail Stickypaws.
english.description: Oh dear, oh dear... The Elder mustn't find out!$B$BI must have left the Elder's ceremonial instruments behind during the escape.$B$BBut... Moonwater Retreat is crawling with hozen by now!$B$BWhat sort of Pearlkeeper am I, to have lost them so carelessly?$B$B<The old jinyu buries his face into his hands.>$B$BStranger, could you find it in your heart to help me?
english.completion: You found them? Oh thank the spirits of water!$B$BYou have saved my tailfin, $n.

text.title: 找到游学者
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的黄粱阁寻找游学者周卓。
text.description: 我听说你和你的人民正在拼命追寻安度因王子。$B$B我知道有个人或许能帮到你们，一个熊猫人游学者比任何人都要了解这片土地。我不敢担保你会受到哪种形式的接待，但他对你的好奇心几乎一定和你对他的好奇心一样强烈！$B$B这位游学者居住在西南方的森林里。告诉他是珠鳍族人派你来的。
text.completion: You look around the empty house.$B$BIt appears you are in the right place, but there is no sign of its inhabitant.

english.title: Seek Out the Lorewalker
english.objectives: Search for Lorewalker Cho at the Dreamer's Pavilion in the Jade Forest.
english.description: I see that you and your people are desperate to find your Prince Anduin.$B$BI know someone who may be able to help you, a pandaren Lorewalker who knows this land better than anyone. I cannot guarantee what kind of reception you will receive, but he will almost certainly be as curious about you as you are of him!$B$BThe Lorewalker lives in the forest to the southwest. Tell him that the Pearlfin have sent you.
english.completion: You look around the empty house.$B$BIt appears you are in the right place, but there is no sign of its inhabitant.

text.title: 借来的美酒
text.objectives: 品尝极品美酒。
text.description: 一股酒香从桌上的瓶子中飘散出来。$B$B尝一小口应该不会有事的，对吧？
text.completion: I heard your people had washed up on our shores, but I did not expect to find one washed up on my very doorstep! What brings you here, stranger?$b$b<You explain about your search for Prince Anduin, and describe the boy to the pandaren.>$b$bVery interesting! And so the Pearlfin sent you to me, did they?

english.title: Borrowed Brew
english.objectives: Taste the mouthwatering brew.
english.description: A delicious smell wafts out from the bottle on the table.$B$BA little taste couldn't hurt, right?
english.completion: I heard your people had washed up on our shores, but I did not expect to find one washed up on my very doorstep! What brings you here, stranger?$b$b<You explain about your search for Prince Anduin, and describe the boy to the pandaren.>$b$bVery interesting! And so the Pearlfin sent you to me, did they?

text.title: 集中精神
text.objectives: 前往翡翠林的黄粱阁，与游学者周卓一同在亭子中冥想。
text.description: 洄梦仙酒已经酿好了！这一次，当你喝下它时，必须在内心专注的状态下接受自己看到的影像。$b$b跟着我进入亭子，我们熊猫人非常珍视内心的平静，我会教你如何达到这种状态。$b$b内心的忧虑会给你带来诸多干扰，但请记住时刻保持专注！

english.title: Finding Your Center
english.objectives: Meditate with Lorewalker Cho at the pagoda at the Dreamer's Pavilion in the Jade Forest.
english.description: The dream brew is complete! This time, when you drink it, you must embrace the visions you see from a state of inner focus.$b$bFollow me to my pagoda, and I will teach you how to achieve the inner calm that we pandaren value so much.$b$bYour troubled mind will present you with many distractions, but just remember to stay centered!

text.title: 效力
text.objectives: 击败迷雾爬行者，直到迷雾恐魔出现，然后收集一颗迷雾恐魔之心。
text.description: 要酿造洄梦仙酒，我们需要各种原料。$B$B首先，为了提高仙酒的效力，我需要从一种可怕的生物——传说中的迷雾恐魔身上收集一种原料。$B$B据说这种生物只出现在迷雾最深之处。$B$B在这里的东北方，你会发现一些体型较小的迷雾爬行者在沼泽里游荡。杀死这些迷雾爬行者，直到迷雾恐魔出现，然后把它的心脏带给我。

english.title: Potency
english.objectives: Kill Mist Creepers until a Mist Horror appears, then collect a Mist Horror Heart.
english.description: To make the Dream Brew, we will need several ingredients.$B$BFirst, to improve its strength, I will need an ingredient from a fearsome creature, the legendary Mist Horror.$B$BIt is said that this creature only appears where the fog is deepest.$B$BNorth and east of here, you will find smaller Mist Creepers roaming the swamps. Kill these creatures until the Mist Horror appears, and then bring me its heart.

text.title: 醇度
text.objectives: 从泥沼鳄鱼身上收集5只生鲜鳄鱼眼。
text.description: 酒的醇度是一个重要但经常被忽视的要素。$B$B为了调配出完美的浓稠度，我需要一些东边泥沼鳄鱼身上的生鲜鳄鱼眼。$B$B要小心。那些生物异常凶猛。

english.title: Body
english.objectives: Collect 5 Pristine Crocolisk Eyes from Bog Crocolisks.
english.description: A brew's body is an important and often overlooked factor.$B$BTo create the perfect consistency, I will need pristine eyes from the Bog Crocolisks to the east.$B$BTake care. The creatures are quite vicious.

text.title: 色泽
text.objectives: 收集8个琥珀蝇翅膀。
text.description: 洄梦仙酒最重要的特色在于它彩虹般梦幻的颜色。$B$B去东边，你会找到一些烁光琥珀蝇。我需要用它们的翅膀来酿造出仙酒最终的荧光色彩。$B$B拿上这把匕首，用它来收集8个翅膀。

english.title: Hue
english.objectives: Collect 8 Amberfly Wings.
english.description: The most distinguishing feature of the Dream Brew is its iridescent, dream-like color.$B$BTo the east, you will find Glittering Amberflies. I will need their wings to create the final luminescent color of the brew.$B$BTake this knife and use it to collect 8 wings.

text.title: 水流之灵
text.objectives: 和长老卢山谈一谈，并见证水语仪式。
text.description: 我们与猢狲之间的战斗旷日持久，部族的未来也飘忽不定。$B$B这正是我们的水语者决定向流水祈求指引的原因。$B$B长老卢山正等着你。请将道具交给他们，也好让他们开始仪式。
text.completion: I saw the vision, $n. What do you think it means?$B$BI think it is clear that you play some part in it.

english.title: Spirits of the Water
english.objectives: Speak to Elder Lusshan and witness the waterspeaking ceremony.
english.description: Our war against the hozen rages without end, and the future of our tribe is uncertain.$B$BThis is why our waterspeaker has decided to seek wisdom from the waters.$B$BElder Lusshan is waiting. Please deliver the instruments so that they may begin.
english.completion: I saw the vision, $n. What do you think it means?$B$BI think it is clear that you play some part in it.

text.title: Trail of the White Pawn
text.objectives: Show the cloak to Admiral Taylor at Pearlfin Village in the Jade Forest.
text.description: Although the cloak is ragged and torn, there is no mistaking the fine tailoring and the King's royal crest.$B$BYou should show it to your Alliance commander.

english.title: Trail of the White Pawn
english.objectives: Show the cloak to Admiral Taylor at Pearlfin Village in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Although the cloak is ragged and torn, there is no mistaking the fine tailoring and the King's royal crest.$B$BYou should show it to your Alliance commander.

text.title: 圣水
text.objectives: 从悲伤之穴的四个圣水泉眼中收集治疗之水。
text.description: 我很感激你大老远地赶来救我，但是任伤得很重。$B$B这位年迈的熊猫人根本不用帮助我，但是他仍然冒着生命危险救下了我。$B$B他在开始发烧之前，曾提到在山下的洞穴里有一些治疗之水。$B$B这很危险，但我会不顾一切去帮助我的朋友。你能帮我把这种水取回来吗？

english.title: Sacred Waters
english.objectives: Collect healing waters from the four Sacred Bowls in the Den of Sorrow.
english.description: I appreciate you coming all this way to save me, but Ren is gravely injured.$B$BThe old pandaren had no reason to help me, yet still he risked his life to save my own.$B$BBefore the fever set in, he mentioned that there are healing waters in the cave just down the hill.$B$BIt is dangerous, but I will do anything to help my friend. Will you help me retrieve the waters?

text.title: 安息
text.objectives: 击败6个受折磨的灵魂。
text.description: 这些灵魂……这些穴居者……它们痛苦地嚎哭着……$B$B困在……人间……无法……转世。$B$B听着……它们的哭泣……我……快要疯了……$B$B请……去……让它们安息吧。

english.title: Rest in Peace
english.objectives: Kill 6 Tortured Spirits.
english.description: The spirits... the cavedwellers... they howl in agony... $B$BTrapped... in this world... cannot move... to the next.$B$BI... will go mad... listening... to their cries... $B$BPlease...go...put them to rest.

text.title: 古老的传说
text.objectives: 从悲伤之穴取回《溪山吟》。
text.description: 我的父亲为锦绣谷的考证奉献了一生。$B$B锦绣谷是个神秘的地方，自从一万两千年前发生熊猫人起义之后就被封闭了起来。我们对那个地方一无所知！$B$B我父亲根据一系列的线索找到了山下的洞穴，希望找到一首名为《溪山吟》的古老诗歌，但以他现在的身体状况已经没法做到了。那个地方被某些祖先的灵魂守护着。$B$B如果你要去那个地方，是否可以把诗歌带回来交给我呢？
text.giverWindow: 黑暗之息在此处徘徊。

english.title: An Ancient Legend
english.objectives: Retrieve the Song of the Vale from the Den of Sorrow.
english.description: My father has dedicated his life to studying the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.$B$BThe Vale is a mythical place, sealed after the Pandaren revolution twelve thousand years ago. We know so little about it!$B$BMy father followed a trail of clues to the cave down the hill, seeking a very old poem known as the Song of the Vale, but he is in no condition to retrieve it. It is guarded by some sort of ancestor spirit.$B$BIf you are heading that way anyway, would you mind bringing it back to him?
english.giverWindow: A dark presence lingers here.

text.title: 安度因的决择
text.objectives: 告诉安度因该回家了。
text.description: 你已经为王子的朋友们做了你所能做的一切。$B$B你完成了任务并找到了白卒——安度因王子。海军上将泰勒和其他军情七处的特工们会急于把那孩子保护起来。$B$B是时候回家了。

english.title: Anduin's Decision
english.objectives: Tell Anduin that it is time to return home.
english.description: You have done all you can for the Prince's friends.$B$BYou completed your mission and found the White Pawn - Prince Anduin. Admiral Taylor and the other SI:7 agents will be eager to have the boy safe in their custody.$B$BIt is time to return home.

text.title: Fighting the Flames
text.objectives: Put out 6 fires in Wayward Landing.
text.description: Those monkeys seem to be more savage than intelligent, but they're smart enough to know that fire is a powerful weapon.$B$BI don't need to explain that if those fires are left unchecked, they'll destroy everything we've built here.$B$BAll my men have their hands full, so you'll have to do it. Take this bucket of water and put out those flames!
text.completed: Return to Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Fighting the Flames
english.objectives: Put out 6 fires in Wayward Landing.
english.description: Those monkeys seem to be more savage than intelligent, but they're smart enough to know that fire is a powerful weapon.$B$BI don't need to explain that if those fires are left unchecked, they'll destroy everything we've built here.$B$BAll my men have their hands full, so you'll have to do it. Take this bucket of water and put out those flames!
english.completed: Return to Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 绝配
text.objectives: 和珠鳍侍水僧们谈一谈，用合适的装备武装他们。
text.description: 我和长老卢山都认为团结合作才是最好的出路。$B$B我们会与珠鳍部族分享我们先进的军事理论和武器装备。$B$B作为回报，他们将成为我们强大的盟友，支援我们与部落对抗。$B$B带上这箱武器装备。我要你在村子里四处转转，给锦鱼人们装备上适合他们技能的武器。
text.completion: Good. Let those Horde mongrels show their faces now!

english.title: A Perfect Match
english.objectives: Speak to Pearlfin Aqualytes and arm them with the proper equipment.
english.description: Elder Lusshan and I agree that the best path forward will be to work together.$B$BWe will share with the Pearlfin our superior military knowledge and weaponry.$B$BIn return, they will be a powerful ally should we again encounter the Horde.$B$BTake this crate of equipment and weapons. I need you to go around the village and equip the jinyu with weapons befitting their skills.
english.completion: Good. Let those Horde mongrels show their faces now!

text.title: 另有要事
text.objectives: 通过杀死24只翠竹旷野中的野生生物来训练珠鳍精兵。
text.description: 我建成了一支由精明强干的珠鳍学徒所组成的队伍，但他们缺少实战经验。$B$B把他们带到东北面的翠竹旷野，杀死任何你们能找到的野生动物。$B$B直到他们适应了战斗，再把他们带回来。
text.completion: Your trainees returned recently. I could hardly believe my eyes! They did not look like the same jinyu that you left with.$B$BExcellent work, $c. Couldn't have done better myself.

english.title: Bigger Fish to Fry
english.objectives: Train the Pearlfin Adepts by killing 24 wildlife in the Bamboo Wilds.
english.description: I've prepared a team of bright young Pearlfin trainees who need field experience.$B$BTake them northeast, into the Bamboo Wilds, and kill any wildlife that you find.$B$BDon't bring them back until they're fit for battle.
english.completion: Your trainees returned recently. I could hardly believe my eyes! They did not look like the same jinyu that you left with.$B$BExcellent work, $c. Couldn't have done better myself.

text.title: 烧死他们
text.objectives: 击败15只古鲁金援兵或吊尾新兵。
text.description: 高级斥候报告说吊尾围栏的猢狲已经得到了来自于他们北方的部落的增援。$B$B我们的作战部队已经在西北的山脊上集结完毕，他们就等你发号施令了。$B$B现在是时候让他们瞧瞧我们的厉害了，现在是时候彻底把他们击溃了。
text.completion: The waters were right about you, $n. Because of your efforts, this village has a future. We will not forget the lessons you've taught us, $c.

english.title: Let Them Burn
english.objectives: Kill 15 Grookin Reinforcements or Slingtail Recruits.
english.description: Advance scouts report that the hozen at the Slingtail Pits are amassing with reinforcements from their tribes to the north.$B$BOur forces are gathered for battle on the ridge to the northwest. They are just waiting for you.$B$BNow is the time to show them what we are made of. Now is the time to destroy them indefinitely.
english.completion: The waters were right about you, $n. Because of your efforts, this village has a future. We will not forget the lessons you've taught us, $c.

objectiveDetails.description: 古鲁金援兵或吊尾新兵

text.title: 群龙无首
text.objectives: 击败酋长咕克嘎克。
text.description: 尽管猢狲们表面上杂乱无章，其实他们乱中有序。他们的首领，酋长咕克嘎克，是个精明的策划者。$B$B他通常行踪不定，但是斥候们报告说有人看到他在西北方猢狲营地的大坑中。$B$B现在出击，别对他心慈手软，$n，否则他会以牙还牙。
text.completion: Without their leader, these hozen should once again settle into disarray.$B$BToday we rejoice in our victory! $n, you came to us a stranger, but you depart as a friend.$B$BFrom henceforth, you are the highest of the high - a valued friend and defender of the Pearlfin tribe.
text.giverWindow: 吊尾猢狲的首领。

english.title: Carp Diem
english.objectives: Kill Chief Gukgut.
english.description: Despite the hozen's apparent disarray, there is an order to their chaos. Their leader, Chief Gukgut, is the shrewd mastermind behind their attacks.$B$BHe is organizing their movements at the great pit at the hozen camp to the northwest.$B$BStrike now and show him no mercy, $n, for he will do the same.
english.completion: Without their leader, these hozen should once again settle into disarray.$B$BToday we rejoice in our victory! $n, you came to us a stranger, but you depart as a friend.$B$BFrom henceforth, you are the highest of the high - a valued friend and defender of the Pearlfin tribe.
english.giverWindow: The leader of the Slingtail hozen.

text.title: 陈和丽丽
text.objectives: 跟随陈·风暴烈酒去庞家农场。
text.description: 我和我侄女都是刚刚来到潘达利亚。或许你也一样。我们是来自迷踪岛的访客。老实说，我们也不知道自己要去哪里。$b$b前面的农场看起来是个歇歇脚并畅饮一杯的好地方。你觉得怎么样，丽丽？$b$b$R？你愿意和我们一同上路吗？
text.completion: Welcome, welcome, visitors! You've come to sample some of my son's turnips? Perhaps purchase a few pigs?$b$bPlease, make yourselves at home. I have plenty of room.

english.title: Chen and Li Li
english.objectives: Follow Chen Stormstout to Pang's Stead.
english.description: My niece and I are new to Pandaria. Probably like yourself. We're visitors from the Wandering Isle, and, to be honest, we have no idea where we're going.$b$bThat farm up ahead looks as fine a place as any to take off our shoes and enjoy a brew. What do you say, Li Li?$b$b$R? Would you like to share the road with us?
english.completion: Welcome, welcome, visitors! You've come to sample some of my son's turnips? Perhaps purchase a few pigs?$b$bPlease, make yourselves at home. I have plenty of room.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟随陈和丽丽去庞家农场

text.title: 剪不断理还乱
text.objectives: 先击败8只暴牙侦查者、暴牙强盗或暴牙捣蛋鬼，然后击败18只暴牙流氓。
text.description: 不好意思我这里乱成这样。兔妖——这些山下的类兔生物——不断向山上扩张地盘，都已经扩张到我们家族的农场了，我们的作物——顺便说下它们比别的作物更大、更美味——也因此而遭到了兔妖的肆虐。$b$b我不擅长战斗……但你行！你能帮我赶走一些兔妖吗？
text.completion: <Pang surveys the area around his farm.>$b$bWell, they're not ALL gone yet, but there's less of them. And they aren't holding their ears quite as high anymore.$b$bI'd guess that they're scared of you, $n.

english.title: A Seemingly Endless Nuisance
english.objectives: Slay 8 Snagtooth Spotters, Tool-Grabbers, or Troublemakers. Then slay 18 Snagtooth Pesterlings.
english.description: I apologize for the state of things around here. The virmen - those rabbity creatures, down the hill - have been pushing further and further into my family's farm, and our crops - which are normally bigger, and more delicious, by the way - have been suffering because of it.$b$bI'm no soldier... but you might be! Would you mind pushing some of these virmen off of our land?
english.completion: <Pang surveys the area around his farm.>$b$bWell, they're not ALL gone yet, but there's less of them. And they aren't holding their ears quite as high anymore.$b$bI'd guess that they're scared of you, $n.

text.title: 低产的芜菁
text.objectives: 找到昂·雷脚。
text.description: 十分感谢你的帮助，$n。如果你感兴趣的话，我想给你另一件任务。$b$b我的儿子，昂，在这座山下经营着一个小农场。他本该在今天早晨给我带来些水果和蔬菜的，但我一整天都没看到他。$b$b你能下山去那个小农场看看出了什么事吗？
text.completion: Wha-? Who the...? My father sent you?$b$bPshh... he can be so nosy sometimes. I have everything under control here.
text.completed: 去四风谷的雷脚农田找昂·雷脚。

english.title: Low Turnip Turnout
english.objectives: Find Ang Thunderfoot.
english.description: Your help here is appreciated, $n. I'd like to give you another job, if you're interested.$b$bMy son, Ang, runs the small farm just down this hill. He should have brought me some fruits and vegetables this morning, but I haven't seen him all day.$b$bWould you go down there and see what's going on?
english.completion: Wha-? Who the...? My father sent you?$b$bPshh... he can be so nosy sometimes. I have everything under control here.
english.completed: Find Ang Thunderfoot at the Thunderfoot Farm in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 鼠辈泛滥
text.objectives: 把6只胀鼓鼓的土拨鼠赶出雷脚农田，并填满6个土拨鼠地洞。
text.description: 今早，我出去看我爸爸驱赶兔妖。当我回来的时候，却发现农场里到处都是土拨鼠！$b$b我不想杀死它们，但是我们要把它们从农场赶出去。嘿，有了！我们可以把这些洞封上！$b$b用泥土把土拨鼠的洞给填平，这样它们就没法再钻到我们的农场里来了。
text.completion: Thank you, $gsir:ma'am;! Now I can get back to my chores.

english.title: Rampaging Rodents
english.objectives: Move 6 Plump Marmots off of Thunderfoot Farm, and fill in 6 Marmot Holes.
english.description: I went off this morning to watch my papa fight the virmen. When I came back, the farm was full of marmots!$b$bI don't want to kill them, but we need to get rid of them. Hey, I know! We can close the holes!$b$bFill in their holes with dirt, so they can't come out in our farm anymore.
english.completion: Thank you, $gsir:ma'am;! Now I can get back to my chores.

text.title: 近乎完美的作物
text.objectives: 将一筐新鲜的果蔬带给庞·雷脚。
text.description: 拿着，$n。我父亲会想要这个的。$b$b再次感谢你帮我驱逐了兔妖。
text.completion: Ho ho! Now that's what I like to see!

english.title: Practically Perfect Produce
english.objectives: Bring the Crate of Fresh Crops to Pang Thunderfoot.
english.description: Here, $n. My father will be wanting this.$b$bThank you, again, for helping with the virmen.
english.completion: Ho ho! Now that's what I like to see!

text.title: 热心的范妮小姐
text.objectives: 将昂的粉色大芜菁、昂的夏日西瓜和庞家特辣豆腐带给范妮小姐，并让她把食物交给梁。食物必须送达雷脚牧场。
text.description: 我会卖掉大多数蔬菜，但会留一些给我的家人。特别是我的侄子梁，他需要一些蔬菜喂猪。$b$b不幸的是，目前通往梁的农场的路上充斥着暴牙兔妖。我们得向范妮小姐求助。$b$b带一些我们收集的食物给范妮小姐，她就站在我家旁边。然后礼貌地问问她，能否把这些食物送往梁的牧场。
text.completion: I understand you're the one who sent the food down from uncle's farm. Thank you.$b$bMy pigs are picky eaters, but those turnips and watermelons are some of their favorites.

english.title: The Fabulous Miss Fanny
english.objectives: Bring Ang's Giant Pink Turnip, Ang's Summer Watermelon, and Pang's Extra-Spicy Tofu to Miss Fanny, and ask her to deliver them. The food must land on Thunderfoot Ranch.
english.description: Most of these vegetables will be sold, but I'd like to keep some for my family. Specifically, my nephew Liang needs some to feed to his pigs.$b$bUnfortunately, the pathway to Liang's farm is currently swarming with Snagtooth virmen. We're going to have to ask Miss Fanny to help us out.$b$bBring some of the food we've gathered to Miss Fanny, who stands next to my house. Then ask her - NICELY! - to send them down to Liang's ranch.
english.completion: I understand you're the one who sent the food down from uncle's farm. Thank you.$b$bMy pigs are picky eaters, but those turnips and watermelons are some of their favorites.

text.title: 爱吃的肉
text.objectives: 获取4块穆山兽肩肉排和80块乌龟肉碎片。
text.description: 我之前告诉过你，我的猪很挑食。它们需要吃肉长膘，但它们不喜欢羊肉，也不喜欢牦牛肉，并且，我也不打算喂它们猪肉。$b$b但它们爱吃穆山兽的肉，也喜欢吃乌龟肉。这两种生物在西边有很多。$b$b我的捕猎技能可是相当的差劲。你能帮帮我这个年轻的牧场主和我的猪吗？
text.completion: <Liang sorts through the meat.>$b$bYou're not just a $c, but you're a butcher, too? You've got an eye for quality pig food, neighbor.$b$b<Liang throws the meat into the muddy pit below.>

english.title: The Meat They'll Eat
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Mushan Shoulder Steaks and 80 Turtle Meat Scraps.
english.description: I told you earlier, my pigs are picky eaters. They need to eat meat to grow strong, but they don't like mutton, they don't like yak, and I'm not about to feed them any pig meat.$b$bThey do, however, eat meat off of the mushan beasts, and they're also quite partial to turtle. Both creatures can be found in abundance to the west.$b$bMy skills as a hunter are admittedly quite weak. Can you help out a young rancher and his pigs?
english.completion: <Liang sorts through the meat.>$b$bYou're not just a $c, but you're a butcher, too? You've got an eye for quality pig food, neighbor.$b$b<Liang throws the meat into the muddy pit below.>

text.title: 送回猪圈
text.objectives: 找到健健、灵灵和臭肥肥。
text.description: 我努力想看住这些猪，但它们有时还是会溜走。由于兔妖造成的一系列困扰，我可能稍稍放松了些警惕，一些猪就趁机逃跑了。$b$b能帮我找找它们吗？要我说，我会去西边的山下寻找的。
text.completion: There they are! Back into the sty with you three, now!$b$b<Liang looks up at you.>$b$bThank you, neighbor. I'm truly grateful for your assistance.

english.title: Back to the Sty
english.objectives: Find Jian, Ling, and Smelly.
english.description: I try to keep an eye on my stock, but every once in a while some of them sneak away. With all the confusion these virmen are causing, I may have let my guard down for a few moments, and some of my pigs escaped.$b$bCare to look for them? I'd start by looking down the hill, to the west.
english.completion: There they are! Back into the sty with you three, now!$b$b<Liang looks up at you.>$b$bThank you, neighbor. I'm truly grateful for your assistance.

text.title: 邻居的义务
text.objectives: 把游荡的羔羊带给放羊的弗二郎。
text.description: 看起来家畜有麻烦的人还不止我一个。弗二郎的这只羊这周已经是第三次跑到我的牧场了。我想他可能需要人手帮忙照看他的羊群。$b$b你应该去他那看看，我的邻居。并把这个可怜的小家伙还给弗二郎。
text.completion: You really shouldn't have brought the lamb back to me. He... he was safer in that pigsty than he is over here.

english.title: A Neighbor's Duty
english.objectives: Bring the Wayward Lamb to Francis the Shepherd Boy.
english.description: I'm not the only one having trouble with his stock, it seems. One of Francis' sheep has wandered over to my ranch, for the third time this week. I'm beginning to think he needs help tending to his flock.$b$bYou should check up on him, neighbor. And bring this poor little thing with you.
english.completion: You really shouldn't have brought the lamb back to me. He... he was safer in that pigsty than he is over here.

text.title: 利爪馋嘴
text.objectives: 击败5只行窃平原鹰和6只行窃恶狼。
text.description: 先是有老鹰飞了过来。你可能已经看到一些鹰在上空盘旋了。$b$b很快狼也跟着出现了。我想他们嗅出了我的懦弱。$b$b我远没有尚师傅想得那么英勇。如果我不去收拾收拾那些野兽，尚师傅会十分生气的。$b$b你……你可以帮帮我吗？$g先生:女士;？
text.completion: They... they're not stopping, but at least we fought back. Right?

english.title: Piercing Talons and Slavering Jaws
english.objectives: Kill 5 Thieving Plainshawks and 6 Thieving Wolves.
english.description: First the hawks came. You've probably seen some of them circling up above.$b$bThe wolves came shortly after. I think they smelled my weakness.$b$bI'm not nearly as brave as Master Shang thought I was. The master will be quite cross with me if I don't do something about these beasts.$b$bCan... can you help, $gsir:ma'am;?
english.completion: They... they're not stopping, but at least we fought back. Right?

text.title: 卢佩罗
text.objectives: 击败卢佩罗。
text.description: 我在想……如果我们杀了狼群首领，也许狼群会停止攻击。$b$b我们管它叫卢佩罗，它就在河岸对面一带游荡。$b$b<又一波攻击吸引了弗二郎的注意力。也许你得自己去解决卢佩罗了。>
text.completion: I know I should be the one fighting them off. Maybe I'm not cut out for shepherding after all.
text.giverWindow: 狼群的首领，羊羔吞食者。

english.title: Lupello
english.objectives: Slay Lupello.
english.description: I've been thinking... the wolves might stop attacking if we kill their pack leader.$b$bWe call him Lupello, and he patrols the opposite riverbank.$b$b<Francis' concentration is broken by another attack. Perhaps you should go deal with Lupello yourself.>
english.completion: I know I should be the one fighting them off. Maybe I'm not cut out for shepherding after all.
english.giverWindow: Leader of wolves, devourer of lambs.

text.title: 英勇的一课
text.objectives: 使用牧民的套索套住巨型白色平原鹰并打败它。
text.description: <尚师傅对牧童说道。>$b$b弗二郎，你应该拿出勇气来！你具备成为优秀牧羊人所需的全部品质，可唯独缺少直面恐惧的勇气！$b$b<他看向你。>$b$b你，陌生人。你帮助了我的家人。弗二郎就像我的亲儿子一样。$b$b给我的学徒展示一下什么是无惧无畏。使用这根绳子套住上空的巨型白色平原鹰并打败它。$b$b<尚师傅指向天空，看了弗二郎一眼便离开了。>
text.completion: Francis has taken longer than I expected to become an effective shepherd. We all go through these phases... my son Liang was weak once, too. As was I.$b$bBut he will learn. It is the Thunderfoot way.

english.title: A Lesson in Bravery
english.objectives: Use the Rancher's Lariat to lasso and defeat a Great White Plainshawk.
english.description: <Master Shang speaks to his shepherd boy.>$b$bFrancis, you need to show bravery! You have everything it takes to make a great shepherd, except the courage to face your fears!$b$b<He looks over to you.>$b$bYou, stranger. You helped the rest of my family. Francis is like a second son to me.$b$bShow my apprentice what it means to lack fear. Use this rope to lasso and defeat one of the great white hawks above us.$b$b<Shang points to the sky, looks at Francis, and leaves.>
english.completion: Francis has taken longer than I expected to become an effective shepherd. We all go through these phases... my son Liang was weak once, too. As was I.$b$bBut he will learn. It is the Thunderfoot way.

text.title: 英雄所喝略同
text.objectives: 护送陈·风暴烈酒和丽丽去西南边的酿酒厂。
text.description: 又碰面啦，$n。想想这应该是我们第四次巧遇了吧？$b$b瞧……我的酒桶马上就要见底啦。我听人提过西南边有家酿酒厂，那儿正是我们要去的地方。要不要入伙？
text.completion: If yer lookin' fer beer, you came to the right place, neighbor.$b$bJust, ah... excuse the mess. Had me a bit of a problem with virmen the last few days.

english.title: Great Minds Drink Alike
english.objectives: Escort Chen Stormstout and Li Li to the brewery in the southwest.
english.description: Hello again, $n. What is this, the fourth time we've run into one another already?$b$bSay... my keg is quickly becoming quite empty. I've heard mention of a brewery to the southwest, and that's where we're headed. Care to join us?
english.completion: If yer lookin' fer beer, you came to the right place, neighbor.$b$bJust, ah... excuse the mess. Had me a bit of a problem with virmen the last few days.

text.title: 长辈的许可
text.objectives: 挑战并打败金酿族长、风裘族长和棘杖族长。
text.description: 我的爱人罗想从族长那里获得娶我的许可。虽然他们已经离开了这个世界，但我们仍然希望能获得他们的祝福。$b$b问题是，他们都是灵魂，我们的礼物和贡品都不能打动他们。他们说，要想得到他们的祝福，必须让罗或一个英雄在一次战斗中击败他们。$b$b罗是个好男人，但不是个战士。$b$b你愿意做我们的英雄吗？
text.completion: They... they agreed?! Fantastic! Thank you so much! With their blessing we can be the happiest pandaren in all the land!$b$bPlease, take this. We meant it to be a tribute for the pandriarchs but they didn't seem interested.

english.title: Getting Permission
english.objectives: Challenge and defeat Pandriarch Goldendraft, Pandriarch Windfur, and Pandriarch Bramblestaff.
english.description: My love, Lo, tried to get permission to marry me from the pandriarchs. Though they have passed beyond, their favor would carry a lot of weight.$b$bThing is, they are spirits, and none of the gifts or tributes we brought impress them. To win their favor they claimed that either Lo or a champion must defeat them in single combat.$b$bLo is a good man, but not a fighter.$b$bWould you be our champion?
english.completion: They... they agreed?! Fantastic! Thank you so much! With their blessing we can be the happiest pandaren in all the land!$b$bPlease, take this. We meant it to be a tribute for the pandriarchs but they didn't seem interested.

text.title: 寻求智慧
text.objectives: 和风筝大师欧提南谈一谈，然后前往晨芳园。
text.description: 游学者周卓在你外出的时候来找过你。$B$B他说北方的晨芳园小镇急需你的援助，但他没有说明原因。$B$B和风筝大师欧提南谈一谈，他会很乐意送你一程的。

english.title: In Search of Wisdom
english.objectives: Speak to Kitemaster Ut-Nam and get a ride to Dawn's Blossom.
english.description: Lorewalker Cho came by and asked for you while you were gone.$B$BHe needs your assistance urgently in the town of Dawn's Blossom to the north. For what reason, he did not say.$B$BSpeak to Kitemaster Ut-Nam. He would be happy to send you there.

objectiveDetails.description: 与风筝大师欧提南交谈

text.title: The Dream Brew
text.objectives: Drink the Dream Brew at the Seer's Stone and find the White Pawn.
text.description: The Dream Brew is ready.$B$BDrink it at the Seer's Stone, just to the right of the red pagoda.$B$BSeek, and find.
text.completed: Speak to the White Pawn at the Den of Sorrow in the Jade Forest.

english.title: The Dream Brew
english.objectives: Drink the Dream Brew at the Seer's Stone and find the White Pawn.
english.description: The Dream Brew is ready.$B$BDrink it at the Seer's Stone, just to the right of the red pagoda.$B$BSeek, and find.
english.completed: Speak to the White Pawn at the Den of Sorrow in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 杀死柯山
text.objectives: 杀死猛虎林中的柯山。
text.description: 柯山是一个大坏蛋，$b$b杀死了我所有的儿子！伊克伊克、拿布拿布、埃特埃特和比提比提等等，我记不太清了。$b$b蠢蛋，你能帮帮猢狲吗？杀死柯山！$b$b那个坏蛋就在那边。$b$b<尼比尼比指了指东边。>

english.title: Kill Kher Shan
english.objectives: Kill Kher Shan in Tigers' Wood.
english.description: Kher Shan is one big dooker.$b$bGrooked all my sons! Ick Ick, Nab Nab, Eet Eet, Bitty Bitty, and the others I can't remember.$b$bWikket wanna help hozen? Go grook Kher Shan!$b$bThe dooker's over there.$b$b<Nibi Nibi points to the east.>

text.title: 竭尽所能
text.objectives: 前往皇帝的预言地，将挑选过的玉石交给游学者周卓。和晨芳园的托亚谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 好吧，我已经竭尽全力，只能找到这些了。$B$B周卓一定是要拿它们派上什么大用场！$B$B如果你准备好去见周卓，就告诉我一声——我已经为你备好了坐骑。
text.completion: I knew Toya would come through for me!$B$BHe can get anything, you know.

english.title: All We Can Spare
english.objectives: Deliver the Scavenged Jade to Lorewalker Cho at Emperor's Omen. Speak with Toya in Dawn's Blossom for a ride.
english.description: Alright, I called in every favor I could. Here's what we got.$B$BCho must be on to something big!$B$BLemme know when you're ready to go see him - I got a ride all prepared for ya.
english.completion: I knew Toya would come through for me!$B$BHe can get anything, you know.

text.title: 玉石灾星
text.objectives: 前往绿石采掘场，杀死12只绿石利齿蛛和6只绿石钻孔蛛。
text.description: 你见过页岩蜘蛛吗，$c？它们通常是无害的，到处乱爬，吞吃岩石，但是它们爱吃玉石，就像小孩爱吃糖果一样。矿工们都叫它们“利齿蛛”。$B$B几天前，我们不当心挖到一个巨大的页岩蜘蛛巢穴。它们疯狂的涌进矿洞，见什么咬什么——包括几个矿工。$B$B我要你进去把它们清理掉，这样我们才能拿出足够的玉石了。采掘场就在这里的正西方。
text.completion: Well I'll be... you actually did it!$B$BYou lookin' for a more permanent job, $gbuddy:sister;? I could use a bruiser like you around full-time!

english.title: Calamity Jade
english.objectives: Slay 12 Greenstone Nibblers and 6 Greenstone Gorgers at the Greenstone Quarry.
english.description: You ever seen a shale spider, $c? Usually harmless, just creepin' around eatin' rocks, but they got a taste for jade like cubs on candy. The boys call 'em "nibblers."$B$BA few days back, we tunneled into a huge nest of these critters. They spilled out into the mines and went crazy, chewed up damn near everything in sight - including some of the boys.$B$BYou get in there and clear 'em out, and we got plenty of jade to spare. The quarry is directly west of here.
english.completion: Well I'll be... you actually did it!$B$BYou lookin' for a more permanent job, $gbuddy:sister;? I could use a bruiser like you around full-time!

text.title: 孟的丈夫
text.objectives: 在绿石采掘场找到孟豪。
text.description: <这一次，工头降低了声音。>$B$B听着，这回可没那么简单了……我想请你再帮个忙。我那白痴丈夫——孟豪，是采石场的监工。我叫他别回去，那里太危险了。但他就像猢狲一样顽固，而且比他们更蠢。他说工友们需要他的“精神支持”。$B$B<孟冷笑道。>$B$B可我的精神支持呢？！如果那个蠢货死了，我该怎么办？！$B$B请……帮我留意他的行踪，告诉他让他回家。$B$B<她的眼睛湿润了，随后转过身去。>
text.completion: <Hao looks up at you, struggling to pull himself from the rubble.>$B$BNo, no. I got it. HNNGHHH!!$B$BOkay, maybe I don't got it.

english.title: Mann's Man
english.objectives: Locate Hao Mann at the Greenstone Quarry.
english.description: <For once, the foreman lowers her voice.>$B$BLook, this ain't easy... I got another favor to ask. My idiot husband, Hao, is a shift lead down at the quarry. I told him not to go back, that it was too dangerous, but he's as stubborn as a hozen and twice as stupid. Says the boys need him around for "moral support."$B$B<Mann sneers.>$B$BWhat about my moral support?! What am I gonna do if that idiot dies?!$B$BPlease... keep an eye out for him. Tell him to come home.$B$B<Her eyes soften before she turns away.>
english.completion: <Hao looks up at you, struggling to pull himself from the rubble.>$B$BNo, no. I got it. HNNGHHH!!$B$BOkay, maybe I don't got it.

text.title: 疯狂的石头
text.objectives: 到绿石工匠区，从调皮的林精身上取回15块玉石。
text.description: 我们整个玉石供应链都垮掉了。矿洞变得十分危险，我们的士气也前所未有的低落，而且——如果那些还不算最糟糕的话——绿石工匠区被一群林精占领了！$B$B连植物都来跟我作对！$B$B如果你真的急需玉石，可以沿着西南的路到工匠区去，自己从那些得意洋洋的筷子怪手里夺回玉石。
text.completion: Catch? They were playin' CATCH with my product?!$B$BI hope you showed those walkin' toothpicks a thing or two.$B$BYou know, maybe you ain't a $gcub:tart; after all. I've been lookin' for some muscle to help out with my problem at the quarry.$B$BAnd judgin' by the size of the Lorewalker's restoration project here, I think you'll need a lot more jade.

english.title: I Have No Jade And I Must Scream
english.objectives: Recover 15 Chunks of Jade from Puckish Sprites around the Greenstone Mason's Quarter.
english.description: Our whole jade supply line has fallen apart. The mines are a death trap, morale is historically low, and - as if that weren't bad enough - the mason's quarter has been overrun by wood sprites!$B$BNow even the plants are out to ruin me!$B$BYou need jade so badly, you can follow the road southwest to the mason's quarter and get it from those glorified chopsticks yourself.
english.completion: Catch? They were playin' CATCH with my product?!$B$BI hope you showed those walkin' toothpicks a thing or two.$B$BYou know, maybe you ain't a $gcub:tart; after all. I've been lookin' for some muscle to help out with my problem at the quarry.$B$BAnd judgin' by the size of the Lorewalker's restoration project here, I think you'll need a lot more jade.

text.title: 被困住了！
text.objectives: 在绿石采掘场解救8名绿石矿工。
text.description: <孟豪用尽全力想从碎石堆中爬出来。>$B$B啊啊啊！！$B$B让我猜猜，是我老婆让你来的吧？想想看，我的小宝贝该是多么焦急啊。哈哈！她总是为我着急。看——啊啊啊！！——这点小塌方——啊啊啊！！！——根本困不住我老豪。$B$B不过，有几个伙计还没脱困呢。如果你找到他们，请帮他们一把，好吗？我没事。$B$B真的。
text.completion: <Hao lets out a hearty laugh.>$B$BI seen 'em come runnin' out o' there like ol' Kher Shan himself were givin' chase.

english.title: Trapped!
english.objectives: Free 8 Greenstone Miners in the Greenstone Quarry.
english.description: <Hao struggles against the rubble with all his might.>$B$BHNNNGHHH!!$B$BLet me guess: my wife sent you? Imagine that, my delicate little snow lily all worried. Ha ha! She's always frettin' over me. Look--HNNGHH!!!--it'll take more than a little--HNNGGHHH!!--cave-in to keep ol' Hao down.$B$BSome o' the boys, on the other hand, are in trouble. Help 'em out if you find any, will ya? I'll be fine.$B$BReally.
english.completion: <Hao lets out a hearty laugh.>$B$BI seen 'em come runnin' out o' there like ol' Kher Shan himself were givin' chase.

text.title: 全归你了
text.objectives: 登上玉石矿车，与孟豪一起返回皇帝的预言地。
text.description: 好吧，这么说你需要玉石，是吧？我得说我们欠你的远不止几块玉石——采石场最不缺的就是玉石。多亏你的帮忙，我们应该很快就能恢复正常的生产了。$B$B我恐怕得回我老婆那儿去了，咱俩就带着这车宝贝直接去找她吧。$B$B我还没见过我的车拉不动的$r呢。你爬到车上去，跑腿的事就交给我老郝吧。
text.completion: You did it! You brought my honey-bear back!$B$BOh thank you, $p! Thank you!

english.title: What's Mined Is Yours
english.objectives: Board the jade cart and ride with Hao back to Emperor's Omen.
english.description: Aw'right, so you need jade, do ya? I'd say we owe you at least that - we got plenty in the quarry, and thanks to yer help we should be back on schedule in no time.$B$BI should probably get back to the wife, so let's you and me take this cart o' the good stuff straight to her.$B$BNow, I ain't never met no $r t'were too big for me to pull in a wagon. You climb on the back there and let ol' Hao do the legwork.
english.completion: You did it! You brought my honey-bear back!$B$BOh thank you, $p! Thank you!

text.title: 神龙之心
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的神龙之心和工头雷科谈一谈。
text.description: 你做得很好，孩子。幸亏有你，我们才能留出这么多玉石，我刚好知道有个人也许会需要这些玉石。$B$B我的朋友工头雷科正在神龙之心主持一项浩大的雕刻工程。$B$B把多出来的这批玉石带去给他吧，顺便告诉他老朋友孟向他问好。他一定热切盼望着你的到来呢。
text.completion: Am I seeing this right? A whole shipment of pure, high quality uncut jade?$B$BThank goodness. I knew Foreman Mann would come through for us.$B$BOh and you too. Thanks for bringing it by.

english.title: The Serpent's Heart
english.objectives: Speak to Foreman Raike at the Serpent's Heart in the Jade Forest.
english.description: You've done great here, kid. Thanks to you, we have quite a bit of extra jade, and I know just the someone who could use it.$B$BMy friend Foreman Raike is running the great statue project at the Serpent's Heart.$B$BBring a shipment of extra jade to him, and tell him his old friend Mann says hello. He'll be eagerly waiting your arrival.
english.completion: Am I seeing this right? A whole shipment of pure, high quality uncut jade?$B$BThank goodness. I knew Foreman Mann would come through for us.$B$BOh and you too. Thanks for bringing it by.

text.title: 青龙寺
text.objectives: 和青龙寺入口处的大贤者易风谈一谈。和风筝大师卓续谈一谈，乘坐风筝去青龙寺。
text.description: 你可帮了我们大忙了，旅行者。$B$B现在有足够的玉石来完成这尊雕像了。我们得向玉珑——也就是青龙，报告一下工程进度。$B$B你到了那儿之后，和青龙寺入口处的大贤者易风谈一谈。$B$B如果你想快点到那儿的话，就和风筝大师卓续谈一谈，我肯定他会助你一臂之力的。
text.completion: You bring news from the Serpent's Heart?$B$B<The Elder Sage patiently listens to your tale of what occurred at the Jade Mines and at the large jade statue.>$B$BThank you for coming all this way, stranger. However, I cannot allow you to speak to the Jade Serpent right now.$B$BThe ancient one is very busy, and as you can see, is not here at the moment.

english.title: The Temple of the Jade Serpent
english.objectives: Speak to Elder Sage Wind-Yi outside the entrance to the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Speak to Kitemaster Shoku for a kite ride to the temple.
english.description: You've done us a huge favor here, traveler.$B$BNow that we have enough jade to complete the statue, we should send word of our progress to Yu'Lon, the Jade Serpent.$B$BWhen you arrive, speak to Elder Sage Wind-Yi outside the entrance to the Temple of the Jade Serpent.$B$BIf you wish to speed your journey, speak to Kitemaster Shoku. I'm sure he can spare an extra kite for you.
english.completion: You bring news from the Serpent's Heart?$B$B<The Elder Sage patiently listens to your tale of what occurred at the Jade Mines and at the large jade statue.>$B$BThank you for coming all this way, stranger. However, I cannot allow you to speak to the Jade Serpent right now.$B$BThe ancient one is very busy, and as you can see, is not here at the moment.

text.title: 上等虫腿
text.objectives: 从猛虎林的虎萤身上收集30条虫子腿。
text.description: 你是猢狲真正的朋友吗，蠢蛋？我们来证实一下吧，好不好？$b$b古鲁金猴山的猢狲已经没有鱼饵了。虎萤的腿会在水中抽搐，是最好的鱼饵！$b$b泼泼讨厌被刺。蠢蛋去弄些鱼饵，然后带回古鲁金。

english.title: The Bees' Knees
english.objectives: Collect 30 Bug Legs from Tigerflies in Tigers' Wood.
english.description: You really hozen friend, wikket? Let's see, hmm?$b$bHozen at Grookin' Hill all outta slicky bait. Tigerflies' legs stay twitchy in water - make best bait!$b$bBo Bo sick from stings. Wikket get bait and take to Grookin.

text.title: 前往拉文霍德
text.objectives: 与朱红庇护所的莫奥斯塔兹谈一谈，然后与他一起飞往拉文霍德庄园。
text.description: 如果黑龙蛋在拉文霍德庄园里，那我们就不能冒险发动全面进攻了，以免误伤了它。我需要一个机灵的家伙潜入庄园，确认这一点。$B$B我说的就是你，$n。$B$B莫奥斯塔兹会帮助你潜入庄园的。到门外去跟他谈谈，然后你们就一起飞去拉文霍德吧。祝你好运！

english.title: To Ravenholdt
english.objectives: Speak to Mostrasz at the Vermillion Redoubt and fly to Ravenholdt Manor together.
english.description: If the egg is in Ravenholdt Manor, we can't risk torching it in an all-out assault. I'll need someone slippery to get in there and find out for sure.$B$BThat's you, $n.$B$BMostrasz will help you infiltrate the compound. Speak to him just outside and fly to Ravenholdt together. Good luck!

text.title: 唯命是从
text.objectives: 将联盟命令交给古鲁金的酋长卡哈卡哈。
text.description: 恩，看来你这个蠢蛋也没那么坏！$b$b其他光皮肤对猢狲一点也不好。$b$b猢狲从坏蠢蛋那里拿来了这个！$b$b所有蠢蛋战利品都归卡哈卡哈，这是酋长的命令！$b$b给你，蠢蛋，拿着它。卡哈卡哈想见见猢狲的新朋友。$b$b他的营地就在古鲁金猴山的南边。

english.title: Orders are Orders
english.objectives: Bring the Alliance Orders to Chief Kah Kah at Grookin.
english.description: Hmm, maybe wikket not so bad after all!$b$bOther baldskins not nice to hozen.$b$bHozen take this from bad wikkets!$b$bAll wikket loot goes to Kah Kah - Chief's orders!$b$bHere, wikket. You take it. Kah Kah will want to meet new hozen friend.$b$bHis camp south at Grookin Hill.

text.title: 即时通信
text.objectives: 在古鲁金猴山的酋长卡哈卡哈附近使用地狱咆哮之拳信号弹。
text.description: 欢迎你，光板儿。我，卡哈卡哈，是古鲁金猴山猢狲的酋长。$b$b乌克门头领想当酋长，但好光板儿把他干掉了，作为给哈卡哈卡的礼物。$b$b猢狲也有礼物给好光板儿。从大爆炸来的礼物。猢狲把他们藏起来了，光板儿找不到。

english.title: Instant Messaging
english.objectives: Use the Hellscream's Fist Signal Flare near Chief Kah Kah at Grookin Hill.
english.description: Welcome, wikket! Me Kah Kah - chief of Grookin Hill hozen.$b$bDook Ookem wanted to be chief, but good wikket grook him good - big gift to Kah Kah.$b$bHozen has gift for good wikket too. Gift come from great crash. Hozen keep it safe for wikket.

text.title: 愤怒的飞禽
text.objectives: 从顽猴旷野中的血爪鹰身上收集6把鸟肠。
text.description: 这些家伙喜欢鱼，是吧？好吧，那我们就把你挑起的事情做完然后让他们“爱上”我们？$b$b我还有一些从残骸那里拿回来的炸药，只需要一些诱饵把鱼给引过来。$b$b鸟肠再合适不过了——简直百试不爽！我看到城南有些鸟飞来飞去的。$b$b那么？你还在等什么呢？

english.title: Furious Fowl
english.objectives: Collect 6 Fistfuls of Bird Guts from Bloodtalons in Dookin' Grounds.
english.description: So these guys like fish, huh? Well how about we finish what you started and make them LOVE us?$b$bI've still got some explosive powder from the wreck, just need something to attract the fish.$b$bGuts is sure to do the trick - never fails. I saw some birds flyin' around south of town.$b$bWell? Whatcha waitin' for?

text.title: Friends and Foes
text.objectives: Kill 7 Riverstride Jinyu at the Slicky Stream.
text.description: These ookin' Jinyu grookin Kah Kah's nephews!$b$bWikket once kill many hozen. Now wikket kill many jinyu.

english.title: Friends and Foes
english.objectives: Kill 7 Riverstride Jinyu at the Slicky Stream.
english.description: These ookin' Jinyu grookin Kah Kah's nephews!$b$bWikket once kill many hozen. Now wikket kill many jinyu.

text.title: 炸鱼
text.objectives: 在浊水河岸使用鸟肠炸弹并收集5条炸上来的滑水鱼。
text.description: 嘿。我已经把你带来的鸟肠缠到我的炸药上了。$b$b我把它们叫做鸟肠炸弹，回头我得申请专利！$b$b既然你跟这些家伙做了朋友，那就由你来领这个人情吧，怎么样？$b$b你只需要点燃引线然后把它们丢到岸边的水里！

english.title: Boom Bait
english.objectives: Use the Gut Bombs at Murky Bank and collect 5 Exploded Slickies.
english.description: There. I've plastered your bird guts over my explosives.$b$bI call 'em Gut Bombs, patent pending.$b$bSince you made friends with these fellas, how about you do the honors?$b$bJust light the fuse and throw 'em down by the shoreline!

text.title: 夺回作物
text.objectives: 夺回5个被偷的芜菁和5个被偷的西瓜。
text.description: 好吧。并非一切都在我的掌控之中。我整个上午都在驱赶兔妖。我成功地把它们赶走了。但它们却抢走了我的一些作物。$b$b它们带着作物往南边的小河去了。我不知道它们拿走我的作物要做什么。但很有可能不是用来吃的。$b$b如果我父亲现在就要作物的话，我就得找人帮忙把那些作物夺回来了。你能帮帮我吗？
text.completion: Perfect.$b$b<Ang surveys the bruised turnips and the soggy watermelons.>$b$bWhat were they DOING down there!?

english.title: Taking a Crop
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Stolen Turnips and 5 Stolen Watermelons.
english.description: Alright, fine. I DON'T have everything under control here. I spent all morning fighting off virmen. I managed to clear them off of my property, but they got away with some of my crops.$b$bThey took them down to the river, to the south. I have no idea what they're doing with them, but it's probably not eating them.$b$bIf my father wants his delivery now, I'm going to need some help getting those crops back. Could you help me out?
english.completion: Perfect.$b$b<Ang surveys the bruised turnips and the soggy watermelons.>$b$bWhat were they DOING down there!?

text.title: 超越地平线
text.objectives: 和夏琪亚、格罗克中士、匿踪大师琪麟以及酋长卡哈卡哈谈一谈。
text.description: 我对你在这里所做的一切表示认可，$c。我在给酋长的报告中自然会提到你的功绩。$b$b但是现在可没时间休息！$b$b我们必须绘制这片土地的地图，并为部落入主此地做好准备。地图的事情我打算派一支斥候小队去处理。$b$b去找到他们，别让他们在那消极怠工。把任务传达给他们，并试着说服你的新朋友们为我们提供一名向导。$b$b你就和我呆在这里，我们有些准备工作要做。

english.title: Beyond the Horizon
english.objectives: Speak to Shokia, Sergeant Gorrok, Shademaster Kiryn, and Chief Kah Kah.
english.description: I recognize all you've managed to do here, $c. My report to the Warchief will include an account of your deeds.$b$bBut there's no time to rest!$b$bThis land must be charted and prepared for Horde settlement. I've already selected an away team to do just that.$b$bFind them before they grow comfortable here. Inform them of their mission, and try to convince your new friends to send along one of their own to serve as a guide.$b$bYou'll be staying here with me. We have preparations to make.

text.title: 鱼儿都是我们的！
text.objectives: 从浊水河岸收集4块钳嘴龟肉排。
text.description: 你觉得猢狲很疯吧，无毛怪？等猢狲没了滑水鱼吃，你才知道什么叫疯！$b$b滑水鱼不够猢狲和无毛怪吃的。$b$b钳嘴龟！猢狲讨厌该死的钳嘴龟。无毛怪，你去把钳嘴龟都吃掉！$b$b<埃克埃克指了指南边。>

english.title: Silly Wikket, Slickies are for Hozen
english.objectives: Collect 4 Snapper Steaks from the Murky Bank.
english.description: You think hozen crazy, wikket? Wait til you see hozen with no slickies!$b$bNot enough slickies for hozen and wikkets.$b$bSnappers! Hozen hate them ookin' snappers. Wikkets can eat all the snappers!$b$b<Eekle Eekle points to the south.>

text.title: 身边的游击队
text.objectives: 击败观景台附近的8个联盟渗透者。
text.description: 安度因·乌瑞恩王子。这就是敌人国王的儿子！命运再次垂青部落了，$n。$b$b但事情都有两面。我们最好不要天真地以为那个小崽子是独自一人。$b$b这座岛附近的联盟渣滓们一定会不遗余力地搜寻他们的娇气的小王子。$b$b你跟我一起对整个区域进行搜查，然后除掉所有可能来救他的人。

english.title: Guerrillas in our Midst
english.objectives: Kill 8 Alliance Infiltrators near the Scenic Overlook.
english.description: Prince Anduin Wrynn. The very son of our enemy's king! Fortune has smiled on the Horde once again, $n.$b$bBut there's another side of this coin. We'd be naive to think the child was left alone.$b$bAny Alliance scum within sight of this land must be searching desperately for their precious princeling.$b$bYou and I are going to scour the area and root out his would-be rescuers.

text.title: 擒兔先擒首
text.objectives: 击败“煎锅”艾尤、“刃爪”吉纳亚和疯跳。
text.description: 在打开酒桶之前，我们还有正经事要做。这些兔妖与迷踪岛上的兔妖没什么区别……这帮讨厌鬼不仅长得像，而且繁殖速度也跟兔子一样快。$b$b当然，我们可以看到一个杀一个，但这种没有意义的杀戮又能解决什么问题呢？我们不妨把它们的种兔揪出来，自然就能减慢它们的……繁殖速度了。
text.completion: <Chen nods.>$b$bGood work, $n. You're not bad in combat.$b$bWhat do you say we team up for the next part?

english.title: Leaders Among Breeders
english.objectives: Slay Aiyu the Skillet, Jinanya the Clawblade, and Frenzyhop.
english.description: Before any kegs are tapped, we have work to do. These virmen are no different than the virmen on the Wandering Isle... a nuisance that breeds as fast as the rabbits they resemble.$b$bSure, we could kill every last virmen we find, but what's the point in needless bloodshed? Let's just take out their alphas, and they'll slow down with their... reproduction.
english.completion: <Chen nods.>$b$bGood work, $n. You're not bad in combat.$b$bWhat do you say we team up for the next part?

text.title: 黄配红变橙色
text.objectives: 收集10株草甸金盏花和40瓶动物血液。
text.description: 陈叔说，我们要去帮泥盏摆平兔妖的问题。我赞成！我就喜欢折腾兔妖！$b$b计划是这样的：我们把一些芜菁刷成橙色，并使兔妖相信这是胡萝卜。$b$b最后的结果一定很搞笑。$b$b我去弄些芜菁。你去找些材料来配制橙色的食用色素。
text.completion: Whoah, whoah, WHOAH! You brought back BLOOD? I guess I should have looked around for a half second before I asked you to bring me something red.$b$bYeesh!$b$b<Li Li turns back to the ingredients, spends a moment crushing the flower petals, and then mixes in some of the blood.>$b$b<She begins to giggle.>

english.title: Yellow and Red Make Orange
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Meadow Marigolds and 40 Vials of Animal Blood.
english.description: Uncle Chen says we're going to help this guy out with his virmen problem. Fine by me! I LOVE messing with virmen.$b$bHere's the plan: we're going to paint some turnips orange, and then we'll try to convince the virmen that they're carrots.$b$bThis can only end in comedy.$b$bI'll gather turnips. You find something that we can use to make edible orange paint.
english.completion: Whoah, whoah, WHOAH! You brought back BLOOD? I guess I should have looked around for a half second before I asked you to bring me something red.$b$bYeesh!$b$b<Li Li turns back to the ingredients, spends a moment crushing the flower petals, and then mixes in some of the blood.>$b$b<She begins to giggle.>

text.title: 密径主母
text.objectives: 击败挛踵主母，地栗。
text.description: 先前我们已搞定了那几只种兔，现在轮到兔妖的主母了。$b$b兔妖选择伴侣时并不怎么讲究，但一窝兔妖还是会有一只主母作为主心骨的。主母通常是一窝兔妖中最魁梧、最卑鄙，也是最强壮的一只。$b$b不过，我倒是不介意和一只密径主母打一架练练手。要不我们一起并肩作战吧？
text.completion: That should take care of the virmen for a few weeks, at least. Enough time for Mudmug to get out a few good batches of beer, uninterrupted.$b$bAnd isn't that what's really important?
text.giverWindow: 不是说谁长得好看谁就能成为密径主母的。

english.title: The Warren-Mother
english.objectives: Defeat Chufa, the Twitchheel Warren-Mother.
english.description: We've dealt with the alpha males. Now, the alpha female.$b$bVirmen aren't terribly selective when it comes to breeding, but most broods will still have a dominant mother figure. She's usually bigger, meaner, and tougher than anyone else in the brood.$b$bYou know, I wouldn't mind testing my skills against a warren-mother. Mind if I fight alongside you?
english.completion: That should take care of the virmen for a few weeks, at least. Enough time for Mudmug to get out a few good batches of beer, uninterrupted.$b$bAnd isn't that what's really important?
english.giverWindow: You don't get to be a Warren-Mother by virtue of good looks.

text.title: 真假胡萝卜
text.objectives: 将刷成橙色的芜菁扔到12只挛踵囤积者面前。
text.description: 陈叔仍在盯着我呢，所以我一时半会没法开溜。我想只能由你替我把这些芜菁……我意思是，“胡萝卜”……送到扭曲密径去。$b$b这应该很简单。只要把这些“胡萝卜”扔到免妖面前，然后等着看它们发现这些其实是芜菁时的反应吧！
text.completion: Bah ha hah haaaa! I love messing with virmen.

english.title: Crouching Carrot, Hidden Turnip
english.objectives: Toss Orange-Colored Turnips in front of 12 Twitchheel Hoarders.
english.description: Uncle Chen's still got his eye on me, which means I won't be wandering off any time soon. I guess it's up to you to take these turnips... I mean, "carrots"... into the Twisted Warren and deliver them for me.$b$bIt should be pretty simple. Just toss the vegetables in front of virmen, then watch their reaction when they find out it's really a turnip!
english.completion: Bah ha hah haaaa! I love messing with virmen.

objectiveDetails.description: 用刷成橙色的芜菁来戏弄兔妖

text.title: 贼性难改
text.objectives: 从扭曲密径找回6袋被偷的啤酒花。
text.description: 你和那个姓陈的朋友都是好人呐，好心帮我解决了兔妖的问题。我通常不太喜欢求助于人，但毕竟过了这村儿就没这店儿了。$b$b你们去收拾兔妖的时候，能否帮我找几袋啤酒花吗？我非常确定是它们在昨晚偷走的。$b$b按照它们的习性，估计是拿去做枕头了。
text.completion: Aww, thank ya kindly, $gsir:ma'am;. You're a real $ggentleman:sweetheart;.

english.title: Thieves to the Core
english.objectives: Recover 6 Stolen Sacks of Hops from the Twisted Warren.
english.description: You and that Chen fellow are good people, helpin' out with the virmen like you are. I don't like to ask for favors, but I ain't gonna turn 'em away, either.$b$bWhile you're out there puttin' the hurt to those rabbit-men, you wouldn't mind keepin' an eye out for some bags o' hops, would ya? I'm pretty sure they lifted 'em last night.$b$bProbably usin' em for pillows, knowin' how they are.
english.completion: Aww, thank ya kindly, $gsir:ma'am;. You're a real $ggentleman:sweetheart;.

text.title: 遗产
text.objectives: 与陈、丽丽和泥盏喝一杯。
text.description: 我得说我们的努力已经得到回报了。我迫不及待想尝尝泥盏酿出的美酒了。
text.completion: I know Uncle Chen's coming back. I'm not worried.$b$bActually, this is probably my big chance to finally explore Pandaria! No fat uncle tying me down!
text.completed: 去四风谷的泥盏营地和丽丽谈一谈。

english.title: Legacy
english.objectives: Have a drink with Chen, Li Li, and Mudmug.
english.description: I'd say we've earned our reward. I can't wait to taste what Mudmug's been brewing.
english.completion: I know Uncle Chen's coming back. I'm not worried.$b$bActually, this is probably my big chance to finally explore Pandaria! No fat uncle tying me down!
english.completed: Speak with Li Li at Mudmug's Place in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 丽丽的假日
text.objectives: 带丽丽拜访丝纱工坊、新希菲拉和黄泽瀑布。
text.description: 陈叔嘱咐我说，他不在的时候不能打架……但这并不意味着我不能去探险。我终于能在潘达利亚随便逛逛，不必每四十七步一歇啦！$b$b你要跟我一起去吗？我打赌我们可以在附近找到各种好玩的地方。
text.completion: That was great! You and I should go exploring again sometime.$b$bAnd it looks like we finished before Uncle Chen got back, too. Perfect.

english.title: Li Li's Day Off
english.objectives: Bring Li Li to the Silken Fields, New Cifera, and Huangtze Falls.
english.description: Uncle Chen asked me not to get into any fights while he was away... but that doesn't mean I can't go exploring. Finally, a chance to look around Pandaria without stopping every forty-seven steps for another rest!$b$bYou want to come with me? I'll bet there's all kinds of cool places we can visit, not too far away from here.
english.completion: That was great! You and I should go exploring again sometime.$b$bAnd it looks like we finished before Uncle Chen got back, too. Perfect.

text.title: 泥水
text.objectives: 使用泥盏的瓶子收集泥水。
text.description: 你与其在外面四处乱晃，还不如来看看我整个的酿酒“流程”呢。老实说，也谈不上什么流程……我就是把所有材料混在一起，然后等着就行。$b$b你也许听说过——我喜欢用南边河岸上的泥水。你能把瓶子里装满泥水带回来吗？我要去采些啤酒花和大麦来做好准备。
text.completion: You done good, $n. You done good.

english.title: Muddy Water
english.objectives: Use Mudmug's Vial to gather muddy water.
english.description: While you're just hangin' around, I might as well get you involved in my whole beer-makin' "process". Ain't much of a process, really... I just mix all the stuff together and wait.$b$bYou probably heard - I like to use the muddy water from the riverbanks, to the south. Would you mind fillin' up this flask with that water and bringin' it back? I'll start gettin' the hops and barley all ready.
english.completion: You done good, $n. You done good.

text.title: 破碎的梦想
text.objectives: 和陈·风暴烈酒谈一谈并倾听他的故事。
text.description: 是啊，我找到了风暴烈酒酿造厂……虽然我并没有得到想像中的热情款待。$b$b<陈给自己倒了一大杯啤酒。>$b$b想听听我的故事吗？
text.completion: Maybe I wasn't meant to settle down anyhow.

english.title: Broken Dreams
english.objectives: Speak with Chen Stormstout and listen to his story.
english.description: Yes, I found the Stormstout Brewery... although I didn't exactly get the warm reception I expected.$b$b<Chen pours himself a mug of ale.>$b$bDo you want to hear the story?
english.completion: Maybe I wasn't meant to settle down anyhow.

text.title: 烧毁那座房子
text.objectives: 使用纳兹戈林的烈酒摧毁观景台上的联盟营地。
text.description: 瞧，$n！$b$b这些联盟狗在山脊上建了个营地。$b$b给，拿着我的烈酒。让我们放把冲天大火，让他们在暴风城哭泣吧！$b$b为了部落！

english.title: Burning Down the House
english.objectives: Use Nazgrim's Grog to destroy the Alliance Camp atop the Scenic Overlook.
english.description: Look, $n!$b$bThese Alliance dogs built a camp up on the ridge.$b$bHere, take my grog. Let's make a fire they can see from Stormwind!$b$bFor the Horde!

text.title: 炸弹才是王道！
text.objectives: 和古鲁金猴山东边的利维特谈一谈。用他的沼气弹来抵御锦鱼人的进攻。
text.description: 这是突发状况！$b$b看起来你捅了马蜂窝，杀了他们的鱼人朋友。$b$b他们把帐算到古鲁金猴山的头上，正准备发动反击！$b$b我本来还想多花点时间做深入的研究开发，但是看来我们不得不立刻在他们身上试验一下我们的沼气弹了！$b$b到要塞东边来找我，准备好投弹吧！

english.title: Boom Goes the Doonamite!
english.objectives: Speak to Rivett east of Grookin Hill. Use his Methane Grenades to fend off the Jinyu attack.
english.description: It's an emergency!$b$bLooks like you stirred up a hornet's nest killin' all them fish-folk.$b$bThey're conductin' a full-on counterattack on Grookin Hill!$b$bI was hopin' to get some R&D time, but we're gunna hafta put my methane-grenade theory to work right away!$b$bMeet me on the east side of the fort, and bring yer throwin' arm!

text.title: 绿色能源
text.objectives: 在顽猴旷野收集7个鲜绿树枝。
text.description: 绿色能量：沼气！$b$b我们要环保。清洁燃烧、高热效比、纯天然，而且等我们回家之后，那些德鲁伊也不会来找我麻烦了。$b$b好吧，其实是我的炸药用完了……$b$b所以，我需要你的帮助，$n。$b$b不，我不会让你干这些脏活，尤其不会在将军面前这样做。我会亲自去收集这些“沉积物”。$b$b你去收集些木材，我们来建个厕所，我必须为长远打算！

english.title: Green-ish Energy
english.objectives: Gather 7 Green Branches in the Dookin' Grounds.
english.description: One word: Methane!$b$bWe're going green. Clean burning, high availability, all natural, and will keep the druids off my back when we get back to our neck of the world.$b$bThat, and I ran out of blasting powder...$b$bSo, I need your help, $n.$b$bNo, no, I wouldn't ask you to do the dirty work - especially not in front of the general. I'll collect these 'deposits' myself.$b$bYou gather up some wood for an outhouse - I'm thinking long-term here!

text.title: Broken Earthen Figurine
text.objectives: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
text.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.
text.completed: Completion text.

english.objectives: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
english.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.
english.completed: Completion text.

text.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.
