english.objectives: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
english.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.
english.completed: Completion text.

text.title: 斥候归来
text.objectives: 去古鲁金猴山和夏琪亚谈一谈。
text.description: 嘿，你出去的时候我们的斥候回来了。拿着这个，他们找到一些联盟的小崽子。$b$b也许你应该去问问他们。
text.completed: 去古鲁金猴山和夏琪亚谈一谈。

english.title: The Scouts Return
english.objectives: Speak with Shokia in Grookin Hill.
english.description: Hey, while you were out our scouts came back. And get this, they found some Alliance kid.$b$bYou should probably go debrief them.
english.completed: Speak with Shokia in Grookin Hill.

text.title: 堵住虫群
text.objectives: 在石犁村击败14只伊克提克螳螂妖。
text.description: 我不是当地人，以前甚至从来没有来过这里。但连我都发现了不对劲的地方。$b$b那边的长城是为了阻止螳螂妖侵入熊猫人的领地而建的。可现在，螳螂妖派出的飞行斥候正越过长城，那高耸的城墙简直形同虚设！$b$b那些竹竿似的斥候之所以能猖狂到现在，肯定是因为与他们作战的是农夫而不是战士。在你这样的人面前，它们根本就是不堪一击的。
text.completion: Lin asked you to help us out? Rather presumptive of her.$b$bStill, we are short-manned. We won't turn down your help... or the girl's. You have our thanks, $c.

english.title: Stemming the Swarm
english.objectives: Slay 14 Ik'thik mantid in Stoneplow.
english.description: I'm not from here. I've never even BEEN here before today. But even I can tell you that something's wrong.$b$bThat wall over there was built to keep mantid off of pandaren lands.  Now, the mantid are sending their winged scouts over the top, as if the wall wasn't even there!$b$bThe only reason those spindly scouts aren't dying is because they're attacking farmers, not soldiers. They wouldn't stand a chance against someone like you.
english.completion: Lin asked you to help us out? Rather presumptive of her.$b$bStill, we are short-manned. We won't turn down your help... or the girl's. You have our thanks, $c.

text.title: 疏散命令
text.objectives: 疏散黑土一家、铲掌一家、绿耕一家和泥皮一家。
text.description: 有些农夫还在地里……有的已经太靠近倒塌的城墙，非常危险。我不希望有任何农夫去逞强。我们会收拾这伙螳螂妖的，之后农夫们就可以重回家园。$b$b我的影踪派门人正忙着保护这座城镇，无法组织农夫的疏散。想要证明自己是个有用的帮手吗？那就去将那些农夫转移到安全的地方吧。
text.completion: A few stubborn ranchers want to make my job harder?$b$b<The Watch Commander sighs.>$b$bFine. I will rob no pandaren of his right to defend his land.

english.title: Evacuation Orders
english.objectives: Evacuate the Blacksoil Family, the Spadepaw Family, the Greentill Family, and the Marlfur Family.
english.description: A few farmers remain in the fields... some perilously close to the crumbling wall. I don't want any farmers pretending to be heroes. We will take care of this mantid swarm, and then they can return to their homes.$b$bMy Shado-Pan are too busy defending this town to organize evacuations. You want to prove yourself useful? Get those farmers out of harm's way.
english.completion: A few stubborn ranchers want to make my job harder?$b$b<The Watch Commander sighs.>$b$bFine. I will rob no pandaren of his right to defend his land.

text.title: 隐秘大师
text.objectives: 去四风谷找断掌大师。
text.description: 从现在起，我们应该能应付石犁村的防御工作了。$b$b<影踪派指挥官向林·柔掌示意说。>$b$b林正在这里寻找一位她称之为“隐秘大师”的人。我想我知道她说的是谁，我给你提供条线索。$b$b向北走。
text.completion: You seek training?$b$b<The pandaren studies your physique for several seconds, without speaking.>$b$bAlright.

english.title: The Hidden Master
english.objectives: Find Master Bruised Paw in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: We should be able to handle the defense of Stoneplow from here on out.$b$b<The Watch Commander motions towards Lin Tenderpaw.>$b$bLin here is searching for someone she calls "The Hidden Master". I believe I know who she's talking about, and I have a clue for you.$b$bGo north.
english.completion: You seek training?$b$b<The pandaren studies your physique for several seconds, without speaking.>$b$bAlright.

text.title: 不屈之拳：竹之试炼
text.objectives: 和断掌大师谈一谈，然后成功击打一捆芦竹3次。
text.description: 我们将开始一个测验：竹之试炼。$b$b你的朋友林没有通过这个测验。$b$b跟我来，仔细听我给你讲。
text.completion: You show promise, $n. We will continue.$b$bIt is now time for your first round of training.

english.title: Unyielding Fists: Trial of Bamboo
english.objectives: Speak with Master Bruised Paw, then successfully strike the Stack of Bamboo Reeds 3 times.
english.description: We will start with a test: The Trial of Bamboo.$b$bYour friend Lin failed this test.$b$bFollow me, and listen carefully to my instructions.
english.completion: You show promise, $n. We will continue.$b$bIt is now time for your first round of training.

text.title: 迷雾重重
text.objectives: 击败12只迷雾化身。
text.description: 这片森林里的迷雾真是让人不堪其扰——我很乐意把它交给像你这样的徒弟。某种奇怪的生物就潜藏在树林的迷雾中，你必须随时将它们击退。$b$b想想怎么通过这一轮训练吧。
text.completion: You follow directions well, $n.

english.title: They Will Be Mist
english.objectives: Slay 12 Mist Incarnations.
english.description: The mist in this forest is a constant nuisance - one which I'm glad to hand off to trainees like you. Strange creatures lurk in the mist between these trees, and they must constantly be pushed back.$b$bConsider this part of your training.
english.completion: You follow directions well, $n.

text.title: 驱雾火盆
text.objectives: 点燃北部驱雾火盆、西部驱雾火盆和南部驱雾火盆。
text.description: 徒弟。$b$b我们四周有几个驱雾火盆，它们就藏在我家附近的丛林里。它们的驱雾效果很好，不过经常需要保养。$b$b你能在北面、西面和南面各找到一个。找到这些火盆并点燃它们。
text.completion: You honor your people, $n.

english.title: Fog Wards
english.objectives: Light the Northern Fog Ward, the Western Fog Ward, and the Southern Fog Ward.
english.description: Trainee.$b$bSeveral wards surround us, hidden in the woods near my home. They are quite effective at dispersing the mist, but they require constant upkeep.$b$bYou will find one to the north, one to the west, and one to the south. Find these wards and light them.
english.completion: You honor your people, $n.

text.title: 不屈之拳：木之试炼
text.objectives: 和断掌大师谈一谈，然后成功击打一堆木板4次。
text.description: 看来你的训练进展不错。跟我来，我们将尝试一下木之试炼。
text.completion: You have the gift of focus, $n. Not many of my students make it this far.$b$b<Master Bruised Paw glances over at Lin.>

english.title: Unyielding Fists: Trial of Wood
english.objectives: Speak with Master Bruised Paw, then successfully strike the Stack of Wooden Blocks 4 times.
english.description: You have progressed in your training, I think. Come with me, and we will attempt the Trial of Wood.
english.completion: You have the gift of focus, $n. Not many of my students make it this far.$b$b<Master Bruised Paw glances over at Lin.>

text.title: 鸟蛋的味道
text.objectives: 获得10个帝燕鸥蛋、4个渔翁白鹤蛋和1个犀角陆行鸟蛋。
text.description: 我能感到你的焦虑，但你还没有准备好。在进行终极考试前，你还得继续训练。至于你的任务……我要你去帮我掏些鸟蛋过来。$b$b对，就是鸟蛋。山顶上东面的沼泽地里栖息着许多鸟，一般情况下它们都很温顺。你应该很容易就能采到够我吃几个星期的鸟蛋。
text.completion: Now you know why I don't gather the eggs myself.$b$bShall we continue your training?

english.title: A Taste For Eggs
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Emperor Tern Eggs, 4 Whitefisher Crane Eggs, and 1 Hornbill Strider Egg.
english.description: I can sense your anxiety, but you are not ready yet. Your training must continue before you perform the final test. As for your task... I need you to fetch me some eggs.$b$bYes, eggs. The marshland atop the hills to the east is home to a number of birds, all of which are generally peaceful in nature. You should have no trouble gathering enough eggs to last me several weeks.
english.completion: Now you know why I don't gather the eggs myself.$b$bShall we continue your training?

text.title: 不屈之拳：石之试炼
text.objectives: 和断掌大师谈一谈，然后成功击打一堆石砖5次。
text.description: 自从来到这里之后，你进步神速啊，$n。通常我不会这么快让人尝试……但我觉得你能行。$b$b是时候尝试下石之试炼了。
text.completion: <Master Bruised Paw bows before you.>$b$bStone quivers and breaks beneath your fists. You have the power to move mountains, if you so desire.$b$bThere is nothing more I can teach you.

english.title: Unyielding Fists: Trial of Stone
english.objectives: Speak with Master Bruised Paw, then successfully strike the Stack of Stone Blocks 5 times.
english.description: You have accomplished much in the short time you have been here, $n. I would not normally offer this test so soon... but I feel that you're ready.$b$bIt is time you attempted the Trial of Stone.
english.completion: <Master Bruised Paw bows before you.>$b$bStone quivers and breaks beneath your fists. You have the power to move mountains, if you so desire.$b$bThere is nothing more I can teach you.

text.title: 训练和戒律
text.objectives: 去四风谷的石犁村向麦龙报告。
text.description: 我告诉过自己，如果我有幸成为隐秘大师的弟子，我一定要将大师的所有本领都学会。现在机会来了，$n，我不会让它轻易溜走的。$b$b但我担心石犁村还需要我们。我走得太早，都没来得及将那些螳螂妖斥候赶走。如果你能帮我联络到影踪派指挥官并确认下情况，我会安心很多的。$b$b还有，如果你碰到其他人，或许你该告诉他们隐秘大师的藏身之处……
text.completion: I'm glad to hear that Lin is well.$b$bOur defenses are holding, for now. The mantid continue to send their scouts over the wall, but they haven't gotten much farther than that.

english.title: Training and Discipline
english.objectives: Report to Loon Mai at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: I told myself that, if I ever made it here to the Hidden Master, I would learn everything I could from him. This is my chance, $n. I'm not going to let it slip away.$b$bStill, I fear that Stoneplow needs us. I left early, before we were able to push the mantid scouts back. I'd feel better if you would check in with the Watch Commander for me.$b$bOh, and if you run into the others, maybe you should tell them where the Hidden Master is...
english.completion: I'm glad to hear that Lin is well.$b$bOur defenses are holding, for now. The mantid continue to send their scouts over the wall, but they haven't gotten much farther than that.

text.title: 以柔掌之名，以柔掌之誉
text.objectives: 收集18片玉月叶。
text.description: 我本来想去告诉晓、康和其他人我找到了隐秘大师，但他把我扣下来了！他说我必须得通过那个竹子的考验才行。$b$b<林低声说：>顺便问一声，你那边情况怎么样？$b$b目前看来，我只能每天傻站在这里打石头了。我的指关节都快脱臼了！$b$b如果你能帮我弄点玉月叶，我就可以自己制些药膏，至少可以稍缓一下现在的痛楚。
text.completion: <Lin pauses for a moment to rub the leaves on her swollen paws.>$b$bThank you! I can prepare a proper ointment later, but this will do for now.

english.title: Tenderpaw By Name, Tender Paw By Reputation
english.objectives: Gather 18 Jademoon Leaves.
english.description: I'd like to go tell Xiao, Kang, and the others that I've found the hidden master, but now he won't let me leave! He says I have to pass that test of bamboo first.$b$b<Lin whispers:> How'd you do that, by the way?$b$bIt looks like, for the time being, I'm stuck here practicing my punches against this rock. And my knuckles are about to cave in.$b$bIf you could gather some jademoon leaves, I could prepare an ointment and at least numb some of this pain.
english.completion: <Lin pauses for a moment to rub the leaves on her swollen paws.>$b$bThank you! I can prepare a proper ointment later, but this will do for now.

text.title: 找到男孩
text.objectives: 和墨水大师魏谈一谈。
text.description: 看到我儿子罗了吗？他刚才还在这儿呢，我告诉过他我们今天就要走的。$b$b我想他肯定是跑去追求那个年轻女孩塞拉·金酿了。这正是我们需要离开的原因！$b$b我绝不能让我儿子跟金酿家的女儿私奔！$b$b我要搜遍这周围，找到他们俩。$b$b我一直觉得这两个家伙偷偷溜进了百木园。你能否去那儿帮我找找他们俩？
text.completion: You seek two lovers blind to the ambitions of their family names. They were here, seeking a way to hold to their path.$b$bSadly they did not find their answers among the trees or art.
text.completed: 去翡翠林的百木园和墨水大师魏谈一谈。

english.title: Find the Boy
english.objectives: Speak with Inkmaster Wei.
english.description: Have you seen my son, Lo? He was here a moment ago and I told him we were leaving today.$b$bI'm sure he's off trying to woo that young Syra Goldendraft. That is the very reason we need to leave!$b$bNo son of mine is going to run off with a Goldendraft!$b$bI'm going to search around here for them.$b$bI do keep catching those two sneaking off to the Arboretum. Any chance you could head out there and look for them?
english.completion: You seek two lovers blind to the ambitions of their family names. They were here, seeking a way to hold to their path.$b$bSadly they did not find their answers among the trees or art.
english.completed: Speak with Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 黎明神龛
text.objectives: 去黎明神龛寻找塞拉·金酿。
text.description: 你在找的“孩子”其实并不真的是小孩，他们是成年的熊猫人，虽然在他们的长辈眼里，他们永远都是孩子。他们两家的不和不能影响他们之间真挚的爱。$b$b塞拉和罗一直希望能摆脱双方家族不和带来的困境，你可以在黎明神龛找到他们。
text.completion: Oh stranger! Please tell me you can help us. They really hurt my Lo.
text.completed: 去翡翠林的黎明神龛和塞拉·金酿谈一谈。

english.title: Shrine of the Dawn
english.objectives: Search the Shrine of the Dawn for Syra Goldendraft.
english.description: The "children" you seek are not actually children but grown pandaren, despite what their elders might claim. Their love will not be held in check by the feuds of their families.$b$bYou will find both Syra and Lo at the Shrine of the Dawn, ever seeking an answer to their dilemma amongst the pandriarchs of old.
english.completion: Oh stranger! Please tell me you can help us. They really hurt my Lo.
english.completed: Speak with Syra Goldendraft at Shrine of the Dawn in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 占卜师的困境
text.objectives: 击败流水魔，找回贤者马里的法杖。
text.description: 既然你帮了矿区这么大的忙，那么能否帮我们解决庙里的一点小问题呢？$B$B贤者马里最近一直抱怨说他的寺庙总受到骚扰。$B$B水元素最近变得非常调皮，竟偷走了他的祭祀法杖。$B$B如果你能帮我解决这个问题，我将感激不尽，我甚至可以在青龙面前替你美言几句。$B$B沿着这条路，一直往北走就是了。
text.completion: I am but an old jinyu, and those pesky water sprites were impossible to catch. Thank you, $n, for returning my staff to me.

english.title: The Scryer's Dilemma
english.objectives: Kill Water Fiends to recover Wise Mari's Staff.
english.description: Since you were so helpful at the mines, would you be willing to help us with a small problem here at the temple?$B$BWise Mari has been complaining recently of a disturbance in his temple.$B$BThe water elementals have gotten quite playful recently, and made off with his ceremonial staff.$B$BIf you could help him, I would be most grateful. I may even put in a word with the Jade Serpent for you.$B$BJust follow the path to the north.
english.completion: I am but an old jinyu, and those pesky water sprites were impossible to catch. Thank you, $n, for returning my staff to me.

text.title: 藏书人的困境
text.objectives: 和寺庙藏书阁的游学者石步谈一谈。
text.description: 游学者石步掌管着整个寺庙的藏书阁。最近有些事情似乎在干扰他和他的工作。$B$B这里有上千卷的古书需要他誊抄，我可不能让他为任何事情分心。$B$B你能沿着这条路去南边的藏书阁，看看到底是什么在困扰着他吗？
text.completion: The Elder Sage Rain-Zhu sent you?$B$BVery well. You shall help me.

english.title: The Librarian's Quandary
english.objectives: Speak to Lorewalker Stonestep in the temple library.
english.description: Lorewalker Stonestep is in charge of the entire temple library. Lately, something has been troubling him and his work.$B$BWith thousands of ancient tomes to be transcribed, I can't afford to have him distracted.$B$BWould you follow the path south to the library and see what ails him?
english.completion: The Elder Sage Rain-Zhu sent you?$B$BVery well. You shall help me.

text.title: 骑士的羁绊
text.objectives: 找到4条顽皮的翔龙。
text.description: 看见训练场上的幼年翔龙了吗？$B$B这些小东西有些淘气，其中有些居然在训练前跑去玩耍了。$B$B如果女主人发现它们不在，肯定会生气的。$B$B帮我把他们找回来好吗？我不想让它们惹上麻烦。$B$B它们喜欢在开阔地玩耍，去庭院和尖塔附近找找看。
text.completion: You found them and brought them all back!$B$BThey've really taken a liking to you.$B$BThank you so much!

english.title: The Rider's Bind
english.objectives: Find 4 Playful Serpents.
english.description: Have you seen the young serpents in the training yard?$B$BThe littles ones tend to be mischievous, and some of them ran off to play before the training session.$B$BThe Mistress will get angry if she discovers they're missing.$B$BWould you go find them and bring them back to me? I don't want them to get into trouble.$B$BThey like to play out in the open, so look for them in courtyards and around the spires.
english.completion: You found them and brought them all back!$B$BThey've really taken a liking to you.$B$BThank you so much!

objectiveDetails.description: 找到顽皮的青色小翔龙
找到顽皮的赤红小翔龙
找到顽皮的翡翠小翔龙
找到顽皮的金色小翔龙

text.title: 青龙
text.objectives: 倾听青龙的讲述。
text.description: 你是来给青龙捎口信的，对吗？$B$B<小女孩抬着头好奇地看着你。>$B$B我想是时候让你跟她见个面了。
text.completion: Did you deliver your message?

english.title: The Jade Serpent
english.objectives: Listen to the Jade Serpent.
english.description: You came to deliver a message to the Jade Serpent, right?$B$B<The little girl tilts her head up at you inquisitively.>$B$BI guess it's time you met her.
english.completion: Did you deliver your message?

text.title: 飞蛾满屋
text.objectives: 杀死8只斑点飞蛾。
text.description: 飞蛾正在侵蚀藏书阁。飞蛾！$B$B任何称职的藏书人都知道飞蛾对纸张的威胁极大，仅次于书虫。$B$B事实证明，我的助手都是一群无可救药的胆小鬼，连虫子都怕。$B$B请你一定要帮我消灭些飞蛾！上千名熊猫人作家的心血之作都指望你来拯救了！
text.completion: Yes, yes, thank you! You've thinned out their numbers wonderfully.

english.title: Moth-Ridden
english.objectives: Kill 8 Dappled Moths.
english.description: Moths have infested the library. Moths!$B$BAny librarian worth his letters knows that moths are the most dangerous threat to paper, second only to bookworms.$B$BAs it turns out, my assistants are a useless bunch of insect-fearing cowards.$B$BPlease, you MUST help me get rid of the moths immediately! The works of a thousand pandaren storytellers depend on you!
english.completion: Yes, yes, thank you! You've thinned out their numbers wonderfully.

text.title: 历史书页
text.objectives: 搜遍整个藏书阁，找到被虫蛀的书，然后碾碎12只书虫。
text.description: 最糟糕的事情终于发生了，$r。$B$B我们这里长书虫了！$B$B形势非常非常严峻。我们必须立刻彻底消灭藏书阁中的书虫，绝对不能让它们扩散开来。$B$B我们必须碾碎这个大麻烦，碾碎它们！我要你检查藏书阁里被虫蛀的书籍，并碾碎你发现的所有书虫。
text.completion: Oh, wonderful! I am so relieved that we managed to avert disaster.$B$BNo no, don't get too close, please. You still have some squashed bug bits on your shoes.

english.title: Pages of History
english.objectives: Search through the library books for infestations, then squash 12 Bookworms.
english.description: The worst possible thing has happened, $r.$B$BWe. Have. Bookworms.$B$BThis is a critical situation. All bookworms in the library must be eradicated at once to prevent their spread.$B$BWe must squash this problem, literally! Please examine the infested books in the library and squash any bookworms that you find.
english.completion: Oh, wonderful! I am so relieved that we managed to avert disaster.$B$BNo no, don't get too close, please. You still have some squashed bug bits on your shoes.

text.title: 完好如初
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的青龙寺和大贤者朱雨谈一谈。
text.description: 你无法想象你帮了我们多大的忙，$n。$B$B如果失去了这些珍贵的卷轴，我都不知道该怎么办了。$B$B请回去转告大贤者朱雨，就说藏书阁现在恢复正常了。
text.completion: Lorewalker Stonestep is back to work?$B$BRemarkable. You were able to do what the last four priests I sent could not.$B$BI...I think my headache is disappearing.

english.title: Everything In Its Place
english.objectives: Speak to Elder Sage Rain-Zhu at the Temple of the Jade Serpent in Jade Forest.
english.description: You have helped us more than you can ever imagine, $n.$B$BI do not know what I would do if our precious scrolls were ever to be lost.$B$BPlease return to the Elder Sage Rain-Zhu and tell him that the library is in order.
english.completion: Lorewalker Stonestep is back to work?$B$BRemarkable. You were able to do what the last four priests I sent could not.$B$BI...I think my headache is disappearing.

text.title: 点亮天空
text.objectives: 点燃8个烟花。
text.description: 喜欢烟花吗，$G先生:女士;？$B$B我爱死它们了！很久以前，我们点燃烟花来吓走恶魔，但我就是单纯地喜欢它们，因为它们实在很漂亮！$B$B庙里应该还有一些旧的烟花发射器。$B$B你能为我点上几朵大烟花吗？我会非常高兴的！
text.completion: Yay! I saw the fireworks all the way from over here!$B$BThank you so much, $n.

english.title: Lighting Up the Sky
english.objectives: Set off 8 fireworks.
english.description: Do you like fireworks, $Gsir:miss;?$B$BI love them! In older times we would set them off to frighten away demons, but I just like them because they're pretty!$B$BI think there are still some old launchers lying around the temple.$B$BWould you go set off some big fireworks for me? It would make me so happy!
english.completion: Yay! I saw the fireworks all the way from over here!$B$BThank you so much, $n.

text.title: The Darkness Around Us
text.objectives: Kill 15 sha invaders.
text.description: Despite our best efforts, the sha broke the seals around the main temple.$B$BIf we cannot hold them back here, their darkness will spread to the rest of the Jade Forest.$B$BWe need your help immediately. Kill any sha creatures that you see. They should not be difficult to find.

english.title: The Darkness Around Us
english.objectives: Kill 15 sha invaders.
english.description: Despite our best efforts, the sha broke the seals around the main temple.$B$BIf we cannot hold them back here, their darkness will spread to the rest of the Jade Forest.$B$BWe need your help immediately. Kill any sha creatures that you see. They should not be difficult to find.

text.title: 新的视界
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的青龙寺，和庭院附近的大贤者朱雨谈一谈。
text.description: 请转告大贤者朱雨，我马上就开始我的工作。
text.completion: Wonderful! Knowing that the scryer has returned to his meditations has lifted a great burden from my shoulders.

english.title: A New Vision
english.objectives: Speak to Elder Sage Rain-Zhu near the courtyard in the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Please tell the Elder Sage Rain-Zhu that I will begin my work at once.
english.completion: Wonderful! Knowing that the scryer has returned to his meditations has lifted a great burden from my shoulders.

text.title: 晨芳园
text.objectives: 和晨芳园里的游学者周卓谈一谈。$b$b和古鲁金猴山的飞行管理员谈一谈出发的事。
text.description: 鲜血与雷鸣！我的斧子早就饥渴难耐了！$b$b在扫清这片土地上的所有联盟之前，我们是不会回奥格瑞玛的。$b$b如果有必要的话，我会亲自训练这些土著。无论如何，我们要在这片土地上做好部落驻扎的准备工作。$b$b同时，他们的酋长让我把这个转交给你：一张地图和一封写得龙飞凤舞的信。$b$b做你该做的事去，但是给我抓紧点。$b$b战争就要爆发了……

english.title: Dawn's Blossom
english.objectives: Speak with Lorewalker Cho in Dawn's Blossom.$b$bSpeak to the flightmaster in Grookin Hill for passage.
english.description: Blood and Thunder! My axe hungers!$b$bWe won't return to Orgrimmar until every last Alliance is purged from this land.$b$bI will train these natives myself, if I have to. One way or another, this land will be made ready for Horde settlement.$b$bIn the meantime, their chief gave me this to pass on to you - a map and a message in some fancy script.$b$bDo what you must, but be quick about it.$b$bWar is brewing...

text.title: 武装训练
text.objectives: 取得并装备一对徒弟的拳套。
text.description: 首先，你需要称手的武器。从下面的武器架上取得一副拳套，带过来，让我看看你是否知道怎么装备武器。

english.title: The Lesson of the Iron Bough
english.objectives: Retrieve and equip a pair of Trainee's Handwraps.
english.description: First, you will need a weapon suited to your talents. Retrieve a pair of fist weapons from one of the weapon racks below, bring them to me, and show me that you know how to equip them properly.

objectiveDetails.description: 拾取并装备徒弟的拳套
拾取并装备另一个徒弟的拳套

text.title: 找回谷物
text.objectives: 将8袋谷物带给种粮状元老凯。
text.description: 既然你要到南方去，能不能顺便帮我们找回那批被窃贼偷走的谷物？$b$b我们看见鸟群和林精们把我们最好的存粮整袋整袋地背走，逃到东面和南面的田地里去了。
text.completion: Why thank you very much stranger. This has not been a good day, but you certainly have helped us make it better.$b$bPlease, take this, you've earned it.

english.title: Grain Recovery
english.objectives: Bring 8 Sacks of Grain to Grainlord Kai.
english.description: Since you are heading south, can you try to recover some of the grain that these thieves made off with?$b$bWe saw birds and sprites running off with entire bags of our best bulk stock into the fields east and south of here.
english.completion: Why thank you very much stranger. This has not been a good day, but you certainly have helped us make it better.$b$bPlease, take this, you've earned it.

text.title: 玩个小把戏
text.objectives: 杀死8只狡猾的玉蜀黍窃贼。
text.description: 所以……我们采购了一大批廉价粮食。不过那些林精一直在打这批谷物的主意。$b$b我讨厌林精。尤其是它们那圆不溜瞅的小眼睛和一成不变的笑脸。$b$b我想静悄悄地把它们干掉。我能出钱请你秘密除掉一些偷粮贼吗？
text.completion: Thank you for your help stranger! Hopefully we can deal with the rest on our own from here.

english.title: Wee Little Shenanigans
english.objectives: Kill 8 Tricky Maizers.
english.description: So... we bought some cheap grains in bulk. It turned out the grain was infested with sprites.$b$bI HATE sprites. With their wee beady eyes and constant smiling.$b$bI would like to resolve this quietly. Can I buy your services to discreetly eliminate some of these grain thieves?
english.completion: Thank you for your help stranger! Hopefully we can deal with the rest on our own from here.

text.title: 斩草除根
text.objectives: 打败大麦蛮人科尔南。
text.description: 我要先声明，这件事绝对纯属意外。我所做的一切都是为了我们的事业！$b$b我怎么可能知道林精会随时入侵，或是其中一个家伙吃下了我新研制的“潘的离奇增长”。$b$b现在可好了，它们不仅有一个大块头的林精当首领，而且这个大块头脾气还很暴躁。$b$b如果我付你钱，你会干掉它吗？
text.completion: Now that that's over I have some ideas on how to make a new concoction. We'll see.$b$bThank you for your help. Here is your reward.
text.giverWindow: 当一个林精染指“潘的离奇增长”时会发生什么事呢。

english.title: Out of Sprite
english.objectives: Defeat Cornan the Barley Barbarian.
english.description: Just to be clear, what happened was an accident. What I did, I did for INDUSTRY!$b$bThere was no way I could have known that a sprite invasion would happen at any time, or that one of them would try to eat my new "Pan's Miracle Gro" formula.$b$bNow not only do they have a big sprite leading them, but he's one angry beast.$b$bIf I pay you, will you take him out?
english.completion: Now that that's over I have some ideas on how to make a new concoction. We'll see.$b$bThank you for your help. Here is your reward.
english.giverWindow: What happens when a forest sprite gets their hands on Pan's Miracle Gro formula.

text.title: 尝味
text.objectives: 品尝陈年谷物、轻质谷物、新鲜谷物和发芽的谷物。
text.description: 既然你来了，不如就帮我个忙吧。你瞧，我这辈子从来没沾过酒，让我来执行这个任务真是大错特错。$b$b你来把这里的每种谷物都尝一口吧，看看它们的甜度是否符合陈叔的要求。
text.completion: Huh. I guess none of that grain is going to work. Uncle Chen is pretty picky.$b$bMaybe the Grainlord knows where we can find something more... special.

english.title: Taste Test
english.objectives: Taste the Aged Grain, Light Grain, Fresh Grain, and Malted Grain.
english.description: As long as you're here, you might as well help me out. I'm feeling pretty darn unqualified for the task, seeing as I've never drank a drop of beer in my life.$b$bYou should try a little sample of each of their grains. Let's see if any of this stuff is sweet enough for Uncle Chen.
english.completion: Huh. I guess none of that grain is going to work. Uncle Chen is pretty picky.$b$bMaybe the Grainlord knows where we can find something more... special.

text.title: 寻找更好的大麦
text.objectives: 去风之崖的崖底找到发芽的岩洞大麦。
text.description: 还在找高甜度的谷物？我父亲曾提到过一种发芽的岩洞大麦，听起来蛮符合你们的要求。$b$b如果你们不怕危险的话，从这向南有个风之崖，在底部可以看到一个古老的山洞。$b$b那里还有一部我父亲搭建的老式升降装置，是他以前去丛林探险时留下的。$b$b山洞里面有一片跟我的家族一样古老的灌木丛。在那片灌木上，你可以采到一种甜得沁人心脾的谷物。$b$b不过你得小心它的守卫。
text.completion: Now THIS smells like the right stuff!

english.title: The Quest for Better Barley
english.objectives: Find the Malted Cave Barley at the base of the Winds' Edge.
english.description: Looking for sweet grain? My father once mentioned a malted cave barley that sounds about right.$b$bIf you are willing to brave the peril, there is an ancient cave at the base of the Winds' Edge south of here.$b$bThere is even an old lift my father made when he would travel into the jungle.$b$bIn the cave is a bush as old as my family. From that bush you can pluck a grain so sweet it will humble your senses.$b$bJust watch out for its guardians.
english.completion: Now THIS smells like the right stuff!

text.title: 陈的决意
text.objectives: 在半山与陈·风暴烈酒碰面。
text.description: 你知道吗？我根本不用这么沮丧。$b$b我要让高老伯看看，什么是真正的酿酒师。我要使用前所未有的原料，酿出他未曾品尝过的美酒。$b$b我陈·风暴烈酒，酿酒当世无双。
text.completion: Let's make some beer.
text.completed: 去四风谷的半山和陈·风暴烈酒碰面。

english.title: Chen's Resolution
english.objectives: Meet up with Chen Stormstout at Halfhill.
english.description: You know what? I don't have to take this.$b$bI'll show that Uncle Gao what it means to be a real brewer. I'll brew the best beer he's ever tasted, with ingredients I've never even used before.$b$bI'm Chen Stormstout, and I'm the best brewer alive.
english.completion: Let's make some beer.
english.completed: Meet up with Chen Stormstout at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 陈的口味
text.objectives: 去找陈·风暴烈酒。
text.description: 陈叔肯定会喜欢的。或者……他也有可能让我们再去找更甜的谷物。他就是这么让人无语。$b$b我们先把这些谷物带去半山给他吧。
text.completion: Ah! Now these are some beautifully malted grains. The two of you have a good eye and nose.
text.completed: 去四风谷的半山找陈·风暴烈酒。

english.title: The Chen Taste Test
english.objectives: Return to Chen Stormstout.
english.description: Uncle Chen is going to love this. Or... he might tell us to find something sweeter. He's kind of dumb like that.$b$bLet's get this grain back to him at Halfhill.
english.completion: Ah! Now these are some beautifully malted grains. The two of you have a good eye and nose.
english.completed: Return to Chen Stormstout at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 丽丽和谷物
text.objectives: 去四风谷的帝皇粮仓和丽丽谈一谈。
text.description: 我会让你加入我的酿酒计划，$n：我准备酿的酒叫作帝王纯酿。成功的话，这将是一种色泽黑褐，口感浓郁的烈酒。$b$b<陈皱起了眉头。>$b$b我刚刚意识到……我还没有把计划告诉过丽丽，她都不知道该带哪种谷物回来！$b$b你能去跟她说一声吗？我要她把她所能找到的甜度最高的麦芽谷物带回来。
text.completion: $n? What are you doing here?$b$bSo, Uncle Chen wants sweet malts? No problem! Let's get to the taste testing.
text.completed: 去四风谷的帝皇粮仓和丽丽谈一谈。

english.title: Li Li and the Grain
english.objectives: Speak with Li Li at the Imperial Granary in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: I'll let you in on my brewing plan, $n: I'm planning on making an Emperor Stout. Done right, it should be dark, roasty, and high in alcohol.$b$b<A frown appears on Chen's face.>$b$bI just realized... I never told my plans to Li Li. She'll have no idea what type of grain to bring back!$b$bCould you speak with her? I need her to bring back the sweetest malted grains she can find.
english.completion: $n? What are you doing here?$b$bSo, Uncle Chen wants sweet malts? No problem! Let's get to the taste testing.
english.completed: Speak with Li Li at the Imperial Granary in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 扛不动水
text.objectives: 和四风谷金扇泽的泥盏谈一谈。
text.description: 你能去看看泥盏的情况吗？他可能需要些帮助才能把水运回来。$b$b我敢肯定，如果有个像你这般魁梧、强壮的$c去帮他减轻负担，他会感激不尽的。
text.completion: $n! You here to help out? That's mighty swell of you.
text.completed: 和四风谷金扇泽的泥盏谈一谈。

english.title: Doesn't Hold Water
english.objectives: Speak with Mudmug at the Gilded Fan in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Would you mind checking in on Mudmug? He may need some assistance bringing that water back.$b$bI'm sure he'll appreciate the help of a big, strong $c like yourself to help him shoulder the load.
english.completion: $n! You here to help out? That's mighty swell of you.
english.completed: Speak with Mudmug at the Gilded Fan in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 园丁芳兰和洒水壶
text.objectives: 按园丁芳兰的吩咐给她的60颗蔬菜浇水。$b$b你可以骑在马上浇水。
text.description: 你想让我免费送你一些啤酒花？哼！这是今天第三次见到像你这样不懂事的$r来要食物的了！$b$b你想要食物？那就给我干活！$b$b<她将一把洒水壶推到你手中。>$b$b去给我的菜浇浇水，现在！
text.completion: Hmmph!$b$bNice farming.

english.title: Gardener Fran and the Watering Can
english.objectives: Listen to Gardener Fran's orders and water 60 of her vegetables.$b$bYou can water plants while mounted.
english.description: You want me to just GIVE you some hops? Pfshh! This is the third time today some little $r like you has come up to me asking for food!$b$bYou want food? Then you'd better work!$b$b<She shoves a watering can into your hand.>$b$bNow go water my plants!
english.completion: Hmmph!$b$bNice farming.

text.title: 寻找活水
text.objectives: 带泥盏去金扇泽的漩涡之池，帮他收集30捧沼泽活水。$b$b如果与泥盏走散了，你可以在金扇泽的大香蕉旁找到他。
text.description: 看那，$n：这里就是金扇泽。我听说过很多关于他们在这里找到活水的好消息，当然也有很多坏消息。$b$b天晓得陈需要什么样的水来酿酒，不如我们给他做一个水样拼盘吧？$b$b来嘛，说干就干。我们一起去舀些水上来。
text.completion: Lookee that, neighbor! That is quite the collection of water we got here. With magical water like this, I'm sure that Chen'll make a brew that really shines.$b$bOr possibly a brew that lands someone in the outhouse for a month. I guess we'll just have to wait and see.

english.title: The Great Water Hunt
english.objectives: Guide Mudmug to Swirling Pools within the Gilded Fan, and help him collect 30 pawfuls of Gladewater.$b$bIf you become separated from Mudmug, you can find him next to the giant banana in the Gilded Fan.
english.description: Look at it, $n: the Gilded Fan. I heared lots of good things about the water they got here. Lots of bad things, too.$b$bNo sayin' what kind of water Chen's gonna be needin', so what say we make him a little sampler platter?$b$bCome on, let's get movin'. We'll go scoop up some water together.
english.completion: Lookee that, neighbor! That is quite the collection of water we got here. With magical water like this, I'm sure that Chen'll make a brew that really shines.$b$bOr possibly a brew that lands someone in the outhouse for a month. I guess we'll just have to wait and see.

text.title: 除草大战
text.objectives: 从蓝盖的地里拔掉100颗杂草。$b$b你可以在骑乘状态下拔草。
text.description: 你想要啤酒花？我后面的草棚里还有很多。我很乐意分些给你们……不过，你得帮我到地里除草。$b$b现在，快去干吧！听明白了吗？
text.completion: You weed like a champion.

english.title: Weed War
english.objectives: Pull 100 weeds from Gai Lan's field.$b$bYou can pull weeds while mounted.
english.description: You want some hops? I've got plenty in the shed out back. I'll gladly share some with you... if you'll help me weed my field.$b$bNow "hop" to it! Get it?
english.completion: You weed like a champion.

text.title: 寻找啤酒花
text.objectives: 向园丁芳兰、蓝盖和邓·泥爪索要啤酒花。
text.description: 丽丽去找粮食了，泥盏会为我们解决水源，现在只需缺啤酒花和几只上等的木桶了。我去准备木桶……你去采集啤酒花吧。$b$b我不太了解当地的啤酒花品种，但我肯定附近的农夫会有一些酿酒用的好材料。去看看你能弄些什么东西回来。
text.completion: After talking with the farmers, it seems like they all will be willing to part with some hops... provided that you help them out some way in return.

english.title: Hop Hunting
english.objectives: Ask Gardener Fran, Gai Lan, and Den Mudclaw for hops.
english.description: With Li Li fetching grain, and Mudmug handling our water, all we need is hops, and some good wood barrels. I'll handle the barrels... but I need you to gather the hops.$b$bI don't know much about the hops from this land, but I'm sure the nearby farmers have something worth brewing with. Go see what you can rustle up.
english.completion: After talking with the farmers, it seems like they all will be willing to part with some hops... provided that you help them out some way in return.

text.title: 够了，真受够了
text.objectives: 获得100颗兔妖门牙。
text.description: 兔妖太喜欢咬东西了。$b$b它们咬坏了蒙蒙的胡萝卜。它们还咬坏了蒙蒙的南瓜。蒙蒙想要吓走它们，谁知到这些贪吃鬼反而咬了蒙蒙的尾巴和脚好几口。$b$b真是受够它们了。$b$b你打起架来比蒙蒙强多了。给我把它们那惹祸的门牙拔下来。到时候我看谁咬谁。
text.completion: So many teeth! Maybe Mung-Mung will glue them together to make a tiny rake.

english.title: Enough is Ookin' Enough
english.objectives: Obtain 100 Virmen Teeth.
english.description: Virmen, they bite too much.$b$bThey bite Mung-Mung's carrot. They bite Mung-Mung's pumpkin. Mung-Mung try to shoo them away, and the dookers bite Mung-Mung's tail and foot.$b$bEnough is ookin' enough.$b$bYou fight way better than Mung-Mung does. Bring back their bitey teeth. Then we see who does the biting.
english.completion: So many teeth! Maybe Mung-Mung will glue them together to make a tiny rake.

text.title: 风暴烈酒的啤酒花
text.objectives: 回半山找陈·风暴烈酒。
text.description: 三位农夫已将他们的啤酒花运到半山了。或许你该去和陈确认一下，确保他都收到了。
text.completion: Look at all these hops! This is quality stuff, too.$b$bWe're making headway, $n. Soon we'll have all the ingredients to finally start brewing.
text.completed: 回四风谷的半山找陈·风暴烈酒。

english.title: Stormstout's Hops
english.objectives: Return to Chen Stormstout in Halfhill.
english.description: All three farmers have delivered their hops to Halfhill. Perhaps you should check in with Chen to make sure that he received them.
english.completion: Look at all these hops! This is quality stuff, too.$b$bWe're making headway, $n. Soon we'll have all the ingredients to finally start brewing.
english.completed: Return to Chen Stormstout at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 农夫的女儿
text.objectives: 找到米娜·泥爪。
text.description: 勇敢的$c，你来的真是太及时了。我的女儿不见了！$b$b我怀疑是兔妖将她掳到它们臭气熏天的兔子窝里去了。我这把老骨头打不动了，手下的工人整个上午都在抵抗兔妖，也已经精疲力尽了。$b$b你能帮我找到她吗？
text.completion: No... no... get back... I don't want...$b$bWait, you're not a carrot. You're not a virmen either. You're here to save me?
text.completed: 去四风谷的弹尾密径找米娜·泥爪。

english.title: The Farmer's Daughter
english.objectives: Find Mina Mudclaw.
english.description: Brave $c, you could not have arrived at a better time. My daughter is missing!$b$bI've got a suspicion that the virmen took her down into that stinking little warren of theirs. I'm too old to fight virmen, and my farmhand is already exhausted from fighting them off all morning.$b$bCould you look for her?
english.completion: No... no... get back... I don't want...$b$bWait, you're not a carrot. You're not a virmen either. You're here to save me?
english.completed: Find Mina Mudclaw within the Springtail Warren in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 眼放橙光
text.objectives: 将米娜·泥爪带回她父亲身边。
text.description: 那些兔妖……它们逼着我做可怕又愚蠢的事情，全都和胡萝卜有关。我都说不清它们朝我扔了多少个胡萝卜。$b$b别再浪费时间了。带我离开这鬼地方！
text.completion: What's all this fuss about carrots? I don't get it.

english.title: Seeing Orange
english.objectives: Bring Mina Mudclaw back home to her father.
english.description: Those virmen... they make me do horrible, horrible, silly things. All involving carrots. I couldn't tell you how many carrots they threw at me.$b$bLet's not waste any more time. Get me out of here!
english.completion: What's all this fuss about carrots? I don't get it.

objectiveDetails.description: 将米娜·泥爪带回她父亲身边

text.title: 魔丝勒斯！
text.objectives: 引诱并打败魔丝勒斯。
text.description: 可敬的工匠老楚好像创造出一个新怪物，一个长着翅膀的魔丝死神。$b$b它叫魔丝勒斯。$b$b你已经见识过它的幼虫。现在请你帮助我们收拾这只怪物。$b$b一切拜托你了，$c。请你进入陷坑，使用诱饵，将那只怪物引出来。$b$b我们的灭蛾战士会从旁协助你，不过怪物吐出的魔丝恐怕会把我们的战士缠住，所以如果他们招架不住了，你可得去帮他们一下。
text.completion: We are pursuing perfection in our art and in ourselves. Along the way many mistakes will be made.$b$bI'm sure by tomorrow this field will be swimming with more mistakes. Still, we thank you for your help.
text.giverWindow: 最巨型的飞蛾。

english.title: Mothallus!
english.objectives: Bait and defeat Mothallus.
english.description: The esteemed Journeyman Chu would appear to have created a monster. It is silken death with wings.$b$bMothallus.$b$bYou have already faced its brood. Now we ask that you help us face the creature itself.$b$bPlease, $c, venture into the pit and rifle the bait. This will bring the beast to you.$b$bOur mothfighters will assist you as you need, though silk tends to stick to them more than most so you may need to help them, should they become overwhelmed.
english.completion: We are pursuing perfection in our art and in ourselves. Along the way many mistakes will be made.$b$bI'm sure by tomorrow this field will be swimming with more mistakes. Still, we thank you for your help.
english.giverWindow: The mightiest of moths.

text.title: 飞蛾叛乱
text.objectives: 杀死6只变异的魔丝蛾和8只小变异魔丝蛾。
text.description: 哦……太好了！一位$c！你能帮帮我吗？$b$b我在做提高蚕丝产量的实验时，不小心创造出一种邪恶的怪物。$b$b后果就是飞蛾大暴动了。你能使用自己的$c技巧去消灭一些变异飞蛾吗？
text.completion: It seems like there's not QUITE as many corrupted moths out there. At the very least, you've bought me some more time before I get in big, big trouble.

english.title: The Moth Rebellion
english.objectives: Kill 6 Mutated Silkmoths and 8 Tiny Mutated Silkmoths.
english.description: Oh... oh good! A $c! Could you help me?$b$bI created a strain of vile monsters during my experiments to improve silk output.$b$bThe result was a full-scale moth rebellion. Can you use your $ciness and destroy some of these mutants?
english.completion: It seems like there's not QUITE as many corrupted moths out there. At the very least, you've bought me some more time before I get in big, big trouble.

text.title: Behind the Masks
text.objectives: Collect 8 Masks of Doubt.
text.description: The sha may seem unstoppable, but this is not true.$B$BTheir masks seem to be the source of their power. When a sha and its mask are separated, the creature's essence is banished back to its own realm.$B$BBring me intact masks, for I wish to study them further. Do be careful. I'm sure the sha will not part with them easily.

english.title: Behind the Masks
english.objectives: Collect 8 Masks of Doubt.
english.description: The sha may seem unstoppable, but this is not true.$B$BTheir masks seem to be the source of their power. When a sha and its mask are separated, the creature's essence is banished back to its own realm.$B$BBring me intact masks, for I wish to study them further. Do be careful. I'm sure the sha will not part with them easily.

text.title: Saving the Sutras
text.objectives: Collect 6 Ancient Sutras.
text.description: My adepts had to abandon their studies when the sha invasion began.$B$BUnfortunately, they left their books scattered around the temple grounds. These priceless works of knowledge must be saved!$B$BThe sutras can be found near the Training Pit and the Adept's Ring to the northeast.

english.title: Saving the Sutras
english.objectives: Collect 6 Ancient Sutras.
english.description: My adepts had to abandon their studies when the sha invasion began.$B$BUnfortunately, they left their books scattered around the temple grounds. These priceless works of knowledge must be saved!$B$BThe sutras can be found near the Training Pit and the Adept's Ring to the northeast.

text.title: Arrows of Fortune
text.objectives: Collect 8 Defender's Arrows.
text.description: Our war supplies grow low, but especially needed are additional arrows.$B$BOur serpent riders are skilled marksmen, but they can do little without ammunition.$B$BWe need someone to brave the battlefields and retrieve any undamaged arrows to refill our stores.$B$BEvery arrow you retrieve will be used wisely.

english.title: Arrows of Fortune
english.objectives: Collect 8 Defender's Arrows.
english.description: Our war supplies grow low, but especially needed are additional arrows.$B$BOur serpent riders are skilled marksmen, but they can do little without ammunition.$B$BWe need someone to brave the battlefields and retrieve any undamaged arrows to refill our stores.$B$BEvery arrow you retrieve will be used wisely.

text.title: Hidden Power
text.objectives: Deliver Ancient Mantras to 6 Yu'lon Guardians or Yu'lon Adepts.
text.description: Our temple defenders have battled relentlessly for hours. No doubt they grow tired.$B$BI will give you mantras to deliver to our fighters.$B$BDo not be fooled by these pieces of paper. These ancient scriptures hold words of untold power.

english.title: Hidden Power
english.objectives: Deliver Ancient Mantras to 6 Yu'lon Guardians or Yu'lon Adepts.
english.description: Our temple defenders have battled relentlessly for hours. No doubt they grow tired.$B$BI will give you mantras to deliver to our fighters.$B$BDo not be fooled by these pieces of paper. These ancient scriptures hold words of untold power.

text.title: 疑之影
text.objectives: 击败疑之影。
text.description: 南面出现了一个煞魔的恐怖具象。$B$B它想要摧毁远古圣物——千语钟。$B$B自从建庙至今，这口钟从未响过，传说它是一件蕴含了远古力量的法器。$B$B我要你去击败这个恶魔！我们必须保护这件圣物！
text.giverWindow: 疑之煞的孽生先锋。

english.title: The Shadow of Doubt
english.objectives: Defeat the Shadow of Doubt.
english.description: A terrible manifestation of the sha has appeared to the south.$B$BIt is trying to destroy an ancient relic, the Bell of a Thousand Whispers.$B$BThis bell has never been rung in the temple's history, for it is rumored to be an ancient instrument of power.$B$BPlease go and defeat this demon where it stands! We must save this relic!
english.giverWindow: A lieutenant of the Sha of Doubt.

text.title: Flames of the Void
text.objectives: Fly your War Serpent near Pure Water Springs, then douse 6 Void Flames with the water carried in its mouth.
text.description: Do you see the violent black and white flames erupting all around the temple?$B$BThe greater our doubt, the stronger they rage. Unchecked, they will devour the entire temple.$B$BWe have but one hope.$B$BTake flight on one of our war serpents. Fly it near the pure springs of water, and then douse the fires with water from the pools.

english.title: Flames of the Void
english.objectives: Fly your War Serpent near Pure Water Springs, then douse 6 Void Flames with the water carried in its mouth.
english.description: Do you see the violent black and white flames erupting all around the temple?$B$BThe greater our doubt, the stronger they rage. Unchecked, they will devour the entire temple.$B$BWe have but one hope.$B$BTake flight on one of our war serpents. Fly it near the pure springs of water, and then douse the fires with water from the pools.

text.title: 随机应变
text.objectives: 击败6个加尔鲁什尔步兵和6个加尔鲁什尔设备养护工。
text.description: 随风潜入夜，做事细无声。这才是我们军情七处的风格。至少，原计划是这样的。$B$B利尔·夜风已经潜入了加尔鲁什尔前哨站，找寻安度因和泰勒的踪迹。但那里的动静越来越大，我们得支援他。$B$B干掉这些拦路的部落崽子，找到利尔·夜风！
text.completion: Great work! If you ever decide to give up your life of adventure, the SI:7 could use more talent like you...

english.title: No Plan Survives Contact with the Enemy
english.objectives: Kill 6 Garrosh'ar Grunts and 6 Garrosh'ar Gear-Greasers.
english.description: Quickly and quietly; that's how SI:7 prefers to operate. That was the plan, at least.$B$BRell Nightwind is already inside Garrosh'ar Point looking for signs of Anduin and Taylor, but it's getting hot in there and he needs support.$B$BFight yer way through these dogs and find Rell!
english.completion: Great work! If you ever decide to give up your life of adventure, the SI:7 could use more talent like you...

text.title: 消灭加图尔
text.objectives: 击败加图尔。
text.description: 好了，$g小伙子:小姑娘;。我们已经沉重打击了这支术士部队……现在是时候给他们致命一击了。$b$b加图尔回来了，就在那座古老的寺庙废墟里。给我弄死他，这样一来部落就失去了盘踞在潘达利亚的最后的力量了。
text.completion: Sha...$b$bFighting the Horde on a foreign shore is hard enough.

english.title: The Fall of Ga'trul
english.objectives: Slay Ga'trul.
english.description: Alright $glad:lass;. We've taken enough jabs at this warlock army... now it's time to cut off the head.$b$bGa'trul's back there, in that big ol' temple ruin. Give him a good what-for, and the Horde will have lost its last stake here in Pandaria.
english.completion: Sha...$b$bFighting the Horde on a foreign shore is hard enough.

text.title: 蚕丝从哪里来
text.objectives: 获得桑叶，喂给5只饥饿的蚕宝宝，拿到生丝。
text.description: 想不想做一天丝匠呢？$b$b首先，你需要新鲜的桑叶。你可以在西北方向的桑树林中找到新鲜桑叶。$b$b接下来，要用新鲜桑叶喂养西面料坑中饥饿的蚕宝宝。$b$b最后，你可以在我们农场南面的加工作坊中得到生丝。$b$b祝你玩的开心！
text.completion: Superb specimens. I will see to it they find their way to the right place. Please enjoy this free sample.

english.title: Where Silk Comes From
english.objectives: Obtain Mulberry Leaves, feed 5 Hungry Silkworms, and get Raw Silk.
english.description: Would you like to be a Silkmaster for a day?$b$bThe first thing you'll need are fresh mulberry leaves. You can find them in our grove of mulberry bushes to the northwest.$b$bNext you will need to feed them to a hungry silkworm in our feeding pit to the west.$b$bAnd finally you should get some raw silk from our processing hut on the south side of our farm.$b$bHave fun!
english.completion: Superb specimens. I will see to it they find their way to the right place. Please enjoy this free sample.

text.title: 帝王酒
text.objectives: 站在一旁，帮助陈·风暴烈酒酿酒。
text.description: 万事俱备，现在可以开始酿酒了。$b$b看仔细了，$n……你或许可以从中学到一两手。
text.completion: Thanks for waiting so long. You are as patient as you are brave.

english.title: The Emperor
english.objectives: Stand by and help Chen Stormstout with his brew.
english.description: We have everything we need. It's time to start brewing.$b$bPay attention, $n... you might learn a thing or two.
english.completion: Thanks for waiting so long. You are as patient as you are brave.

text.title: 敲门
text.objectives: 去风暴烈酒酿造厂的入口处和陈·风暴烈酒碰面。
text.description: 现在，向风暴烈酒酿造厂前进！现在正是我重整风暴烈酒家族的最佳时机……还有什么能比几杯美酒更让人能团结起来呢？$b$b你知道酿造厂在哪儿，对吧？沿着这条路一直向西走。你绝对找得到。当然，你也可以跟我们结伴同行——我们马上就动身。
text.completion: The door... it's boarded up?
text.completed: 去风暴烈酒酿造厂的入口处和陈·风暴烈酒碰面。

english.title: Knocking on the Door
english.objectives: Meet up with Chen Stormstout at the entrance of the Stormstout Brewery.
english.description: Now, onward to the Stormstout Brewery! It's high time that I was reunited with the rest of the Stormstouts... and what better way to reunite than over a few mugs of ale?$b$bYou know where the brewery is, right? Just follow this road to the west. You can't miss it. Of course, you're free to share the road with us - we'll be leaving any moment now.
english.completion: The door... it's boarded up?
english.completed: Meet up with Chen Stormstout at the entrance of the Stormstout Brewery.

text.title: 扫清道路
text.objectives: 击败10只酒臭猢狲或捣乱的兔妖
text.description: 你看到了吗？兔妖、猢狲和水精怪……从酿造厂的大门和窗户里像潮水一样涌出来！见鬼，里头出什么事了？！$b$b酿造厂还有一个入口，就在东边。我要赶过去看看到底怎么了。你留在这里，试试看能不能摆平这些怪物，没有什么比喝醉的猢狲更难缠的了。

english.title: Clear the Way
english.objectives: Slay 10 Ale-Addled Hozen or Mischievous Virmen.
english.description: Are you seeing this? Virmen, hozen, and water sprites... all pouring out of the brewery doors and windows! What the heck is going on in there!?$b$bThere is another entrance, on the eastern side of the brewery. I'm going to run over there and try to figure out what's going on. In the meantime, see if you can't get rid of these creatures. There's nothing worse than a drunken hozen.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死酒臭猢狲或捣乱的兔妖

text.title: 最奇妙的液体
text.objectives: 获得3个活水精华。
text.description: 我听过不少有关这座酿造厂的荒谬八卦。之前我还以为那都是假的……直到看见那只巨型猢狲。$b$b所以，这不禁让我想到，其他那些传言会不会也是真的？前几天我刚听到一条传闻，说是一些水精怪在酿造厂里面上窜下跳，还引起了骚乱之类的。它们的身体真的都是由水构成的。$b$b我觉得，如果用这样神奇的液体来酿酒，肯定能酿出一些绝世好酒。如果你找到了这些水精灵，能给我带一些来吗？

english.title: The Fanciest Water
english.objectives: Obtain 3 Spritewater Essences.
english.description: I've heard lots of cockamamie rumors about this here brewery. I thought they were all false... until I saw that giant hozen.$b$bSo, it got me thinkin', what if the other rumors are true? I heard this one rumor just the other day about some water sprites that run around inside the brewery, causin' a ruckus and whatnot. Their bodies are actually MADE OF WATER.$b$bI reckon a man could make some mighty fine beer with some fancy water like that. If you find any, could you bring me some?

text.title: 看那些木桶，伙计
text.objectives: 解救7个困在桶里的熊猫人。
text.description: 那只巨型猢狲太胡闹了！它把木桶扔得到处都是！$b$b看那些木桶，伙计！$b$b看起来，之前在酿造厂门口工作的熊猫人差不多都已经被他关在木桶里了。如果我是你，就会帮助他们逃出来。顺便让你那身过度发达的肌肉派点用处。$b$b我们到酿造厂的后门汇合，就在东边。不见不散！

english.title: Barrels, Man
english.objectives: Free 7 Barreled Pandaren.
english.description: I can't believe that giant hozen! He's just throwing barrels everywhere!$b$bBarrels, man!$b$bIt looks like he managed to get pretty much all the pandaren that were working out in front of the brewery. If I were you, I'd help some of them break out. Put some of those ridiculous muscles to use.$b$bWe're headed over to the brewery's rear entrance, to the east. Meet you there!

objectiveDetails.description: 解救困在桶里的熊猫人

text.title: 忍无可忍
text.objectives: 击败涡流、尤噶和碳酸黄酒元素。
text.description: 够了，$n。我受够了。$b$b如果没人站出来为这家酿造厂做点事，我们将永远地失去它。还有我们那悠久的家族历史——和藏酒——都会被糟蹋的。$b$b所以……我们打算从后门冲进去。你、丽丽、泥盏和我。$b$b一场恶战在所难免。$b$b准备好了就告诉我。

english.title: Cleaning House
english.objectives: Defeat Eddy, Jooga, and the Fizzy Yellow Alemental.
english.description: That's it, $n. I've had enough of this.$b$bIf somebody doesn't do SOMETHING to take care of this brewery, we'll lose it forever. And there's far too much family history - and beer - in there to risk wasting.$b$bSo... we're going to break in through the back door. You, Li Li, Mudmug, and me.$b$bIt's gonna be a brawl in there.$b$bLet me know when you're ready.

text.title: 朱家堡之殇
text.objectives: 与朱家堡的居民交谈，找出愿意和你说话的人。
text.description: 熊猫人总是用张开的双臂欢迎旅行者的到来——还有打开的酒桶！不过这镇里全都是怪人！$B$B每个人都在生闷气，他们根本不愿和肯肯交谈！$B$B你能在镇子里找到愿意和我们交谈的人吗？也许正常点的熊猫人都躲进屋子里去了？

english.title: What's Eating Zhu's Watch?
english.objectives: Speak with the inhabitants in Zhu's Watch and find someone willing to talk to you.
english.description: Pandaren always welcome travelers with open arms - and open kegs! But this town full of jerks!$B$BEveryone so busy sulking, they won't talk to Ken-Ken at all!$B$BCan you find someone in town who will talk to us? Maybe normal pandaren just hiding in the houses?

objectiveDetails.description: 与沮丧的朱家戒卫交谈

text.title: 找到易默
text.objectives: 前往朱家堡的东北方寻找易默·长眉。
text.description: 我的侄子易默一直都是个比较悲观的人。当这股绝望风潮席卷镇子的时候，对他的影响特别严重。之前，他就成天坐着，不吃不喝，只是盯着远方。$B$B现在，他又往东北方的悬崖去了，那里是雷鸟的巢穴和捕猎场。$B$B拜托了，$c，你能去找他回来吗？

english.title: Finding Yi-Mo
english.objectives: Look for Yi-Mo Longbrow somewhere northeast of Zhu's Watch.
english.description: My nephew, Yi-Mo, has always been sort of a downer. When this wave of despair hit the town, he took it harder than most. He sat around for days refusing to eat, just staring off into the horizon.$B$BNow he's wandered off toward the cliffs northeast of here, where the thunderbirds nest and hunt.$B$BPlease, $c, will you look for him?

text.title: 对症下药
text.objectives: 在朱家界收集4块蜂巢、4条滑溜的泥鱼和4块岩盐核心。
text.description: 好吧，肯肯相当肯定他知道熊猫人出什么事了​​！用老老猢狲疗法达到理想的效果。$B$B需要将蜂蜜、鱼油和盐混合。肯肯在城镇周围的树木中看到大量的蜂箱，干涸的池塘里一定有鱼。$B$B那么还需要盐……阿梅可能知道我们在哪里可以找到一些。

english.title: Materia Medica
english.objectives: Gather 4 Chunks of Honeycomb, 4 Slick Mudfish, and 4 Salty Cores from Zhu Province.
english.description: Alright, Ken-Ken pretty sure he knows what wrong with pandaren! Got old, old hozen remedy that do the trick.$B$BNeed to mix honey, fish oil, and salt. Ken-Ken saw lots of beehives in the trees around town, and there must be fish left in the dry ponds.$B$BThat just leave salt... Mei might know where we can find some.

text.title: 振作起来，易默
text.objectives: 将易默·长眉带回朱家堡。
text.description: 自从这场风暴开始肆虐，我就感到很……疲惫。$B$B那不是身体上的疲劳……不，那感觉就像我的灵魂精疲力尽、毫无价值，陷入了绝望。我猜这感觉，就像是你的女朋友因为某个肚子长得更圆的家伙而离开了你。可我又没有女朋友，我又能知道什么呢？$B$B我还能知道些什么呢？除了这些雷鸟，我对所有人都毫无价值，至少我能为它们提供一顿大餐。$B$B<易默深深地叹了一口气，继续凝视着天空。看起来他哪儿都不愿意去。>

english.title: Cheer Up, Yi-Mo
english.objectives: Bring Yi-Mo Longbrow back to Zhu's Watch.
english.description: Ever since this storm began, I've just been... tired.$B$BNot physically... no. It's like my very soul is exhausted. Worthless. Hopeless. I imagine it's what one feels when a mate leaves them for someone with a rounder belly, but I've never had a mate so how would I know?$B$BHow can I claim to know anything? I'm worthless to everyone but these thunderbirds. At least they'll have a good meal out of me.$B$B<Yi-Mo sighs deeply and continues staring off into the sky. It doesn't look like he's going anywhere.>

text.title: 保卫朱家界
text.objectives: 在朱家界里击败10个野鳞蜥蜴人或野鳞草药师。
text.description: 随着我们对朱家界的防守日益松懈，野外的蜥蜴人已经潜入了村子北面的洞穴。$B$B村里的大部分猎人都一蹶不振，所以那些蜥蜴人也开始在村子里大摇大摆好像在自己家一样，想拿什么就拿什么！$B$B我要让他们知道，朱家堡可不是好惹的。$B$B你愿意帮我传达这个信息吗？

english.title: Securing the Province
english.objectives: Kill 10 Wildscale Saurok or Wildscale Herbalists in Zhu Province.
english.description: With our grip on the province loosening, saurok from the wilds have already moved in to the cave just north of town.$B$BMost of our hunters are face-down in their own tears, so the saurok just walk in here like they own the place and grab whatever they want!$B$BI want to send a message that Zhu's Watch is not to be crossed.$B$BWill you be my messenger?

text.title: 边境
text.objectives: 沿着朱家界西南边界点燃朱的纪念之火、林的纪念之火和珀的纪念之火。
text.description: 篝火在吓退野兽方面，效果出人意料地好。火光能使它们不敢随意离开荒野。我们西南的边界上设有三处篝火，平时我们总让它们燃烧着。$B$B然而已经有些日子没人去照看火焰了，篝火一定已经熄灭了。没有了篝火，荒野生物重新占领这片我们守护了几百年的土地只是个时间问题。$B$B拜托你，去重新点燃篝火吧。它们是保证朱家界安全的关键，也是对建立朱家堡的先人们的纪念。

english.title: Borderlands
english.objectives: Light the Memorial Flame of Zhu, Memorial Flame of Rin, and Memorial Flame of Po along the southwest border of Zhu Province.
english.description: Bonfires are surprisingly effective at discouraging beasts from wandering out of the wilds. We have three along the border to the southwest which we normally keep lit at all times.$B$BNobody's been there for days, though, and the fires must be out by now. It's only a matter of time before the wilds creep back in and overtake the land we have kept safe for centuries.$B$BPlease, re-ignite the bonfires. They are critical in keeping the province safe, and they are memorials to the founders of our way of life.

text.title: 进入酒坊
text.objectives: 和风暴烈酒酿造厂里的陈·风暴烈酒谈一谈。
text.description: 我们得搞清楚酒厂里到底出了什么事，$n！$B$B我们可能已经清除了一些大害虫，但我敢肯定在它们跑出来的地方还有更多祸害。去找几个朋友，然后到里面来见我。

english.title: Into the Brewery
english.objectives: Speak to Chen Stormstout inside the Stormstout Brewery.
english.description: We need to find out what's going on inside that brewery, $n!$b$bWe may have cleared out some of the bigger pests, but I'm certain there's plenty more where they came from. Gather up a few of your friends, and meet me inside!

text.title: 寻找隐秘大师
text.objectives: 倾听晓和他同伴们的谈话。
text.description: 嘿，你好。你在寻找这片地方的主人吗？那就去见见楼梯上面的那位熊猫人吧。$b$b跟你一样，我也是访客。$b$b不好意思，我跟我朋友现在要商量点事情。我们稍后再聊。
text.completion: Were you listening in? Don't worry, I don't mind. You're welcome to search for the hidden master as well.$b$bThough, if you do find him, I'd appreciate if you came back here and told me where he was.
text.completed: 去四风谷的庞家农场和晓谈一谈。

english.title: The Search for the Hidden Master
english.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
english.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs.$b$bI'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I are trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.
english.completion: Were you listening in? Don't worry, I don't mind. You're welcome to search for the hidden master as well.$b$bThough, if you do find him, I'd appreciate if you came back here and told me where he was.
english.completed: Speak with Xiao at Pang's Stead in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: FLAG - Kung Fu Intro
text.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
text.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

english.title: FLAG - Kung Fu Intro
english.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
english.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

objectiveDetails.description: Listen to Xiao and his companions

text.title: 干嘛这么严肃？
text.objectives: 从朱家界收集18颗巨大的豹牙和1罐颜料。
text.description: 好的，所以那个不起作用。嗯……这个让肯肯很高兴！但熊猫人还在悲伤……$B$B我们尝试老猢狲的另一种疗法，这次，我们回到了甚至比奶奶那个时代还更早的时代，是非常古老的时候。猢狲有时候仍然这样做……主要在派对上。$B$B肯肯有木工活要做，你把牙齿给他！不是你的，大的那个，是像豹的那样的！$B$B噢，还要一些油漆！！阿梅可能知道在哪里。

english.title: Why So Serious?
english.objectives: Collect 18 Huge Panther Fangs and 1 Jar of Pigment from Zhu Province.
english.description: Okay, so that not work. Well... it cheer Ken-Ken up! But pandaren still sad...$B$BWe try another old hozen remedy - this time, we go back even further than gramma, way WAY back to ancient times. Hozen still do this sometimes... mostly at parties.$B$BKen-Ken got woodworking to do - you bring him teeth! Not yours; big ones, like a panther would have!$B$BOh, and some paint! Mei might know where to find.

text.title: 变相怪杰
text.objectives: 在朱家堡使用肯肯的面具，治愈8名沮丧的朱家戒卫。
text.description: 好吧……这真是出人意料！$B$B现在想想，肯肯总算记起猢狲们为什么要先使用面具了……$B$B根据传说，美猴王用面具治愈了因悲伤过度而无法治国的老熊猫人皇帝少昊。然后他们将面具与他的悲伤一起埋进了土里。$B$B我们应该对更多的熊猫人使用面具，但我们不会把悲伤留在地里，我们要踢爆它的屁股。$B$B我们动手吧，$n！

english.title: Apply Directly to the Forehead
english.objectives: Use Ken-Ken's Mask to cure 8 Despondent Wardens of Zhu in Zhu's Watch.
english.description: Well... THAT was unexpected!$B$BCome to think of it, now Ken-Ken remember why hozen use mask in the first place...$B$BA legend about the Monkey King says he used a mask to cure old pandaren emperor, Shaohao, when he was too sad to lead his people. Then they buried mask--with all his sadness--in the ground.$B$BWe should use the mask on more pandaren, but instead of putting sad away in ground, we gonna PUNCH ITS BUTT.$B$BLet's do this, $n!

text.title: 朱家堡的绝望
text.objectives: 在朱家堡驱除易默·长眉体内的惘之煞能量。
text.description: 嗯……那不是易默小子吗？$B$B<肯肯眯着眼透过越下越大的暴雨看去。>$B$B真是他！他站在井台边，看起来状况不太妙。$B$B肯肯有一种不好的预感……

english.title: Zhu's Despair
english.objectives: Exorcise the Sha of Despair energy from Yi-Mo Longbrow in Zhu's Watch.
english.description: Hmm... Is that Yi-Mo kid over there?$B$B<Ken-Ken squints against the increasing torrents of rain.>$B$BIt is! He's at the well, and he's not lookin' so good.$B$BKen-Ken got a bad feeling about this...

text.title: 潘达利亚之泪
text.objectives: 在朱家界杀死12只悲泣恐魔。
text.description: 这一切都是从我们的池塘开始的。有一天，池塘里的水突然都被吸入了地下。当池水干涸时，天上开始下起雨来。$B$B尽管暴雨倾泻如注，池塘却一点也没有注满的迹象。就好像大地本身干渴难耐，把水分都吸尽了一般。$B$B如今，池塘里滋生出了可怕的绝望煞魔，一种由从天而降的雨水和土地里蕴含的盐分构的元素生物：它们就是潘达利亚之泪。

english.title: Tears of Pandaria
english.objectives: Kill 12 Weeping Horrors in Zhu Province.
english.description: All of this started with our ponds. In a single day, all of the water retreated down into the earth. When there was no more water in the ponds, it began to fall from the sky.$B$BDespite endless torrents of rain, the ponds do not fill. It's as if the land itself thirsts and cannot be quenched.$B$BNow the ponds birth horrific manifestations of despair. Elementals made of water from the sky and salt from the earth; the tears of Pandaria.

text.title: 吉尔尼斯的密探
text.objectives: 在吉尔尼斯的吉尔尼斯城废墟附近找到扎佐·耀指。
text.description: 如果你想加入我的行动，追杀躲藏起来的黑龙，就得先杀死“信条”海勒姆来证明自己的能力。他正在吉尔尼斯组建部队。$B$B我们还未能渗透进他的守卫中，但我们派了一个人到那里去监视他。扎佐·耀指是一个非常机灵的奥术师，他就在吉尔尼斯主城的废墟外待命。$B$B去找到他，他会指点你找到目标的。
text.completed: 在吉尔尼斯的吉尔尼斯城废墟附近找到扎佐·耀指。

english.title: Our Man in Gilneas
english.objectives: Seek out Zazzo Twinklefingers near the ruins of Gilneas City in Gilneas.
english.description: If you wish to join my cause and slaughter the black dragons in hiding, prove yourself by taking down Hiram Creed. He's amassing an army in Gilneas.$B$BWe haven't been able to slip past his defenders, but we've got a man on the scene keeping an eye on him. Zazzo Twinklefingers, a very crafty arcane mage, is waiting for us to contact him just outside of the ruins of the Gilnean capital.$B$BFind him and he'll direct you to the target.
english.completed: Seek out Zazzo Twinklefingers near the ruins of Gilneas City in Gilneas.

text.title: 刺杀信条
text.objectives: 潜入吉尔尼斯城废墟，杀死躲藏在军事区中的“信条”海勒姆。
text.description: 城里的骚乱已经持续好几天了。“信条”海勒姆乔装成吉尔尼斯人，用自己的龙血感染了许多狼人。连被遗忘者都没办法把他揪出来。$B$B只有出色的刺客才能结束这场混乱！$B$B我身后这座桥的守卫相当松散。我要你悄悄闯过商业区，往南边走。你可以在军事区里找到这个“信条”。$B$B我会时刻关注你的，万一有什么麻烦，也好及时把你弄回来。$B$B……我敢说，你肯定会有麻烦的！

english.title: Assassinate Creed
english.objectives: Stealth into the ruins of Gilneas City and slay Hiram Creed within the military district.
english.description: The city has been in chaos for days now. Hiram Creed, disguised as a Gilnean, has infected the lot of those dogs with his own draconic blood. Even the Forsaken are having trouble routing him out.$B$BOnly a surgical assassination can end this!$B$BThe bridge behind me is relatively unguarded. Slip in through merchant's square and head south - you'll find Creed in the middle of the military district.$B$BI'll keep an eye on you and pull you out if there's any trouble.$B$B...There WILL be trouble!

text.title: 时光之末
text.objectives: 和时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。
text.description: 青铜守护巨龙诺兹多姆正需要部落勇士的协助。你也是少数受到他垂青的人之一。我还可以多告诉你一些内情。$b$b我的主人很少请求凡人的协助，但我相信一切都会随着时间而改变……包括时光守护者本人。$b$b他就在遥远的未来，在时光之末中等你。如果你愿意的话，我可以帮你抵达那里。
text.completed: 与时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。

english.title: The End Time
english.objectives: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.
english.description: Nozdormu, the bronze Aspect, has asked for help from the champions of the Horde. You are on his short list. I can share few other details.$b$bIt is uncharacteristic of my master to request the assistance of mortals, but I suppose that all things change with time... even the Aspect of Time himself.$b$bHe awaits you at the End Time, in the distant future. I can help you to travel there, if you so choose.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.

text.title: 时光之末
text.objectives: 和时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。
text.description: 青铜守护巨龙诺兹多姆正需要联盟勇士的协助。你也是少数受到他垂青的人之一。我还可以多告诉你一些内情。$b$b我的主人很少请求凡人的协助，但我相信一切都会随着时间而改变……包括时光守护者本人。$b$b他就在遥远的未来，在时光之末中等你。如果你愿意的话，我可以帮你抵达那里。
text.completed: 与时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。

english.title: The End Time
english.objectives: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.
english.description: Nozdormu, the bronze Aspect, has asked for help from the champions of the Alliance. You are on his short list. I can share few other details.$b$bIt is uncharacteristic of my master to request the assistance of mortals, but I suppose that all things change with time... even the Aspect of Time himself.$b$bHe awaits you at the End Time, in the distant future. I can help you to travel there, if you so choose.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.

text.title: 姆诺兹多
text.objectives: 杀死姆诺兹多。
text.description: 如果我们想要消灭死亡之翼，就需要借助巨龙之魂的力量。而要取得巨龙之魂，我就得把你带回一万年前的大分裂时代……但我现在无法通过那条时间流。$b$b阻止我们进入时间流的生物名叫姆诺兹多。为了实现我们消灭死亡之翼的计划，我们必须在这里，在这个扭曲的未来杀死它。$b$b而这就是我找你来的原因，$n。

english.title: Murozond
english.objectives: Slay Murozond.
english.description: If we are to destroy Deathwing, we will need the power of the Dragon Soul. To obtain the Dragon Soul, I would have to take you back to the Sundering, ten thousand years in the past... but that time passage is blocked to me.$b$bThe creature that blocks us from accessing this time passage is named Murozond. He must be slain, here, in this twisted future, before we can continue our plot to unmake Deathwing.$b$bThis is why you were brought here, $n.

text.title: 备份需要
text.objectives: 在时光之末中杀死两个残影，并使用艾鲁尔米的容器备份他们的信息。
text.description: 据我所知，你想要避免这个未来的发生。如果这是真的，那我们必须在这条时间流消失之前，把有关数据备份下来。$b$b我们认为，在这一未来中，最有趣、最珍贵的，就是那些徘徊在巨龙圣地中的强大“残影”。$b$b在你去消灭那些残影时，记得带上这个容器。它会保存这些残影的部分能量，然后存入青铜龙军团的档案库内。

english.title: Archival Purposes
english.objectives: Slay two of the Echoes within the End Time, then allow Alurmi's Vessel to archive their information.
english.description: From what I understand, you intend to avoid this future. If this is true, then we must archive data from this timestrand before it is lost to us.$b$bWe believe that the most interesting and valuable elements of this future are the powerful "echoes" that roam the dragonshrines.$b$bTake this vessel with you as you silence these echoes. A portion of their energies will be archived within the bronze dragonflight's depository.

text.title: 永恒之井
text.objectives: 与永恒之井中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。
text.description: 我们必须抢在永恒龙军团的余孽动手之前，尽快采取行动。时间宝贵。$b$b我会把你从遥远的未来带回遥远的过去……带回上古之战的时代。我们的目标就是巨龙之魂，一个拥有巨大力量的神器……它的力量足以毁灭死亡之翼，并终结它对当前世界的统治。
text.completed: 与永恒之井中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。

english.title: The Well of Eternity
english.objectives: Speak with Nozdormu at the Well of Eternity.
english.description: We must move quickly, before any remaining Infinite agents intervene. Time is precious.$b$bI will now take you from your distant future into your distant past... the War of the Ancients. Our goal is the Dragon Soul, an artifact of immense power... enough power to break Deathwing, and end his reign over your present.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the Well of Eternity.

text.title: 无穷无尽
text.objectives: 关闭三座恶魔传送门，然后杀死佩罗萨恩。
text.description: 在我们和巨龙之魂中间，还挡着整整一个军团的恶魔。在我们继续前进之前，必须先把它们打发了。$b$b如果我计时准确的话——通常都是准确的——一个名叫伊利丹·怒风的暗夜精灵青年很快就会与我们相遇。他肯定能在我们猎杀恶魔时帮上忙。$b$b去帮助伊利丹关闭恶魔的传送门，然后杀死它们的首领佩罗萨恩吧。

english.title: In Unending Numbers
english.objectives: Disable the three demon portals, then slay Peroth'arn.
english.description: Between us and the Dragon Soul lies a legion of demons. They will have to be dispatched before we proceed.$b$bIf my timing is correct - and it usually is - a young night elf named Illidan Stormrage should be crossing our path shortly. He will undoubtedly be of some use when it comes to demon hunting.$b$bHelp Illidan disable the demons' portals, then slay their leader, Peroth'arn.

text.title: 虚荣的女王
text.objectives: 拖住艾萨拉女王。
text.description: 前方就是艾萨拉女王和她的皇家守卫了。我们的计划绝不能受一点干扰，我们承受不起这后果。所以我们必须在她插手之前先同她开战。$b$b你今天不大可能杀死艾萨拉女王；几乎没有时间流向这个方向。因此你只要能吸引她的注意力就算是胜利了，哪怕只是暂时的。

english.title: The Vainglorious
english.objectives: Dispatch of Queen Azshara.
english.description: Queen Azshara and her royal guard lie ahead of us. We cannot afford the possibility of any interference with our plan. So we will take the fight to her, before she has a chance to meddle.$b$bIt is quite unlikely that you will kill Queen Azshara today; very few coherent timelines exist along that branch. Consider it a victory if you are simply able to occupy her attention, however temporarily.

text.title: 通往巨龙之魂的道路
text.objectives: 杀死玛诺洛斯。
text.description: 我没法直接飞上去拿走巨龙之魂。上古之神们守护着它。$b$b更糟的是，源自永恒之井的奥术能量还强化了他们的护盾。大恶魔玛诺洛斯正守护着这些能量。$b$b你要去吸引玛诺洛斯的注意力，这样就能打破巨龙之魂与永恒之井间的联系。没有了永恒之井的力量，上古之神的护盾就会被削弱，巨龙之魂也会衰弱。$b$b然后我就能拿走它了。

english.title: The Path to the Dragon Soul
english.objectives: Slay Mannoroth.
english.description: I cannot simply fly up and grab the Dragon Soul. The old gods protect it.$b$bTo make matters worse, their shield is strengthened by the swirling, arcane energies that emanate from the Well of Eternity, and those energies are being focused by the great demon Mannoroth.$b$bDistract Mannoroth, and the link between the Dragon Soul and the Well will be broken. Without the Well's power, the old gods' ward will be weakened, and the Dragon Soul will be vulnerable.$b$bAnd then I will take it.

text.title: 暮光审判
text.objectives: 与暮光审判中的萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我们不用一直干站在这儿。你忘了吗？我们可以控制时间。尤其是你之前干掉未来的那个姆诺兹多之后。$b$b你刚才带来的巨龙之魂？它已经在萨尔手里了，就在你来的那个时代。而他需要你的帮助。$b$b你做好出发的准备了吗？
text.completed: 与暮光审判中的萨尔谈一谈。

english.title: The Hour of Twilight
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Hour of Twilight.
english.description: There's no need to stand around here forever. Have you forgotten? We can CONTROL TIME. Especially since you got rid of that Murozond fellow, back in the future.$b$bThat Dragon Soul that you just liberated? Thrall already has it, back in your present day. And he's going to need your help.$b$bYou ready to go?
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Hour of Twilight.

text.title: 进军龙眠神殿！
text.objectives: 护送萨尔安全抵达龙眠神殿。
text.description: 巨龙之魂……这件强大的武器足以击败死亡之翼。多亏了你，它终于安全地落到了我们手中。$b$b来吧！守护巨龙们在等着我们。我们必须将巨龙之魂送到位于龙骨荒野中心的龙眠神殿。

english.title: To Wyrmrest!
english.objectives: Escort Thrall safely to Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: The Dragon Soul... a weapon with enough power to defeat Deathwing. Thanks to you, it is now safely in our hands.$b$bCome! The aspects await us. We must bring the Dragon Soul to Wyrmrest Temple, in the center of Dragonblight.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送萨尔安全抵达龙眠神殿

text.title: 记录时间流
text.objectives: 杀死一个军团恶魔，一个皇家侍女以及禁卫队长瓦罗森，然后用艾鲁尔米的容器收集他们的信息。
text.description: 你是……$n，对吧？你以前帮我们做过档案记录。呃，从技术上说，那应该是在未来，不过我相信你明白，时间总是相对的。$b$b我还需要更多的档案信息。虽然你和诺兹多姆不打算像在时光之末那样改写这条时间流，但更多的数据对我们总是有好处的。$b$b我需要的信息包括禁卫队长瓦罗森，艾萨拉的一个漂亮小侍女，还有……嗯……噢，那个巨大的恶魔卫士怎么样？它就在这条阶梯底下。

english.title: Documenting the Timeways
english.objectives: Slay a Legion Demon, a Royal Handmaiden, and Captain Varo'then, then allow Alurmi's Vessel to archive their information.
english.description: You... $n, was it? You assisted with our archival in the past. Well, technically it was the future, but I believe you understand. Time is highly relative.$b$bI require more information for our archive. While you and Nozdormu don't intend to overwrite this timestrand, as you did in the End Time, we can still benefit from more data.$b$bI require information on Captain Varo'then, one of Azshara's pretty little handmaidens, and... hmm... oh, how about that big felguard, just down those stairs?

text.title: 暮光先知
text.objectives: 找到并揭露暮光先知的身份。
text.description: 这封信件的内容如下：$b$b“暮光审判已经降临。救世萨满萨尔正带着巨龙之魂赶往龙眠神殿，那是对我们光荣的主最后的威胁。”$b$b“阻止萨尔，我们就能赢得这场战争。我会在附近注视着你们。”$b$b   ——暮光先知

english.title: The Twilight Prophet
english.objectives: Find and unmask the Twilight Prophet.
english.description: The missive reads as follows:$b$b"The Hour of Twilight is upon us. The world-shaman Thrall approaches Wyrmrest with the Dragon Soul in hand, feebly whimpering one final threat to destroy our glorious master."$b$b"Stop Thrall, and we win our war. I will be watching you from nearby."$b$b   ~ The Twilight Prophet

text.title: The Deed is Done
text.objectives: Report your success to Prince Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.description: Prince Wrathion will be pleased to hear that you've succeeded. You should report back to him at Ravenholdt Manor.$B$BThe Prince has been known to be extremely generous to those who help him.
text.completed: Report your success to Prince Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: The Deed is Done
english.objectives: Report your success to Prince Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: Prince Wrathion will be pleased to hear that you've succeeded. You should report back to him at Ravenholdt Manor.$B$BThe Prince has been known to be extremely generous to those who help him.
english.completed: Report your success to Prince Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 收集宝石簇
text.objectives: 在巨龙之魂团队副本内，从怪物身上收集源质宝石簇，并取得333颗暗影宝石。
text.description: 我给你的匕首是一些贝壳。如果按照我所提供的方法使用，这种匕首可以发挥巨大的作用。$B$B我需要你收集一些暗影宝石。这种奇特宝石的切面就像一个通向无尽空间的窗户。暮光之锤的仆从们通常使用这种石头控制最强大的元素生物。$B$B龙眠神殿附近正在进行着激烈的战斗。从死亡之翼的仆从们身上收集源质宝石簇，然后交给我。

english.title: Cluster Clutch
english.objectives: Collect 333 Shadowy Gems by looting Elementium Gem Clusters from creatures in the Dragon Soul Raid encounter.
english.description: The daggers I have given you are lifeless shells. They can do great things, once they are given a means to contain the power I have in mind.$B$BI need for you to acquire Shadowy Gems for me. The facets of these unusual stones are like windows into the infinite. They are often used by minions of the Twilight's Hammer to control the most powerful of elementals.$B$BA great battle is raging around Wyrmrest Temple. Collect Elementium Gem Clusters from Deathwing's minions and bring the gems to me.

text.title: 卡拉赞的密探
text.objectives: 向卡拉赞东南方废墟内的扎佐·耀指复命。
text.description: 你的下一个目标是黑龙纳莉丝，她沉迷于魔法，就躲在卡拉赞废弃的高塔下。$B$B你的主要任务是消灭她，但如果你能帮我带一瓶她的龙血回来，我就可以用它来强化我给你的那把匕首了。$B$B我已经派你的帮手扎佐先去那里等你了。具体的情况他会告诉你的。
text.completed: 向卡拉赞东南方废墟内的扎佐·耀指复命。

english.title: Our Man in Karazhan
english.objectives: Report to Zazzo Twinklefingers in the ruins just southeast of Karazhan.
english.description: Your next target is the Black Dragon Nalice, who is engaged in some sort of arcane debauchery beneath the ruined tower of Karazhan.$B$BYour primary mission is to destroy her, but if you can bring me back a vial of her blood, I'll be able to use it to augment the power of the daggers I've given you.$B$BYour accomplice Zazzo has already been dispatched to the scene and awaits you there. He'll have more details.
english.completed: Report to Zazzo Twinklefingers in the ruins just southeast of Karazhan.

text.title: 背叛者的龙血
text.objectives: 潜入卡拉赞废墟下的麦迪文的酒窖，击败纳莉丝，并获得一瓶黑龙血。
text.description: 我已经找到了纳莉丝的藏身处，就在麦迪文的酒窖里。你能在前头那片废墟下找到那个大型地窖。$B$B那里到处都是巨龙教徒，纳莉丝还在里面安装了一些奇怪的奥术存储装置。或许你能在战斗中利用那些东西？$B$B躲过那些邪教徒，干掉纳莉丝，并帮拉希奥弄一瓶她的龙血。$B$B我会时刻关注你，并在你陷入麻烦时救你出来。可我绝不会跟你一起下去的！

english.title: Blood of the Betrayer
english.objectives: Sneak into the Master's Cellar in the ruins around Karazhan, defeat Nalice, and acquire a Vial of Black Dragonsblood.
english.description: I've pinpointed Nalice to the Master's Cellar, an extended basement you'll find in the ruins up ahead.$B$BDragon cultists are everywhere, and Nalice has set up some strange arcane storage devices throughout the area. Perhaps you can use those to your advantage?$B$BSneak past the cultists, obliterate Nalice, and grab a vial of her blood for Wrathion.$B$BI'll keep my eyes on you and pull you out if you get into any trouble. But I'm NOT coming in there with you!

text.title: 旗开得胜
text.objectives: 黑暗游侠玛尔拉要求你进入乌特加德城堡，杀死凯雷塞斯王子。
text.description: 乌特加德的部队是在凯雷塞斯王子的建议下组建起来的，他是天灾军团的萨莱因大使。$B$B我们不能让他继续给维库人出谋划策了。去让他闭嘴吧。
text.giverWindow: 萨莱因的鲜血王子

english.title: A Score to Settle
english.objectives: Dark Ranger Marrah wants you to slay Prince Keleseth inside Utgarde Keep.
english.description: Utgarde's forces are organizing under the advisory of Prince Keleseth, a san'layn ambassador of the Scourge.$B$BWe cannot allow the vrykul to benefit from his counsel any further. Silence him.
english.giverWindow: Blood-Prince of the San'layn

text.title: 深渊中的胜利
text.objectives: 将一瓶密封的黑龙血以及你的双匕恐惧与复仇一起交给希尔斯布莱德丘陵的拉文霍德庄园里的拉希奥。
text.description: <扎佐对装鲜血的瓶子施放了一个魔法，然后迅速把它还给了你，仿佛这瓶子有毒一般。>$B$B完成了！你得尽快把它和你那两把匕首一起交给拉希奥。$B$B我不知道他打算用它来做什么。我也就是私下跟你说说，有时那条小龙让我觉得很恐怖。祝你好运！

english.title: Victory in the Depths
english.objectives: Take the Vial of Preserved Dragonsblood, along with your daggers Fear and Vengeance, to Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: <Zazzo performs an enchantment on the vial of blood, then quickly hands it back to you, as though it's toxic.>$B$BDone! You'll want to get this back to Wrathion as soon as possible, along with those two daggers of yours.$B$BI don't know what he plans to do with this stuff. Between you and me, sometimes that little dragon kid creeps me out. Good luck!

text.title: 磨利你的牙
text.objectives: 在巨龙之魂团队副本内，从怪物身上收集60个源质宝石簇。
text.description: 你知道我为什么要你去刺杀黑龙，却放过那些凡人吗？因为那不是他们的错。他们必须掌握自己的命运，摆脱我的黑龙同胞们的操纵。$B$B我们的任务已经接近完成了，现在你也该去追寻你自己的命运了。我可以继续强化你的武器，可光靠你收集来的暗影宝石已经不够了。我需要完整的宝石簇。你可以从我父亲的爪牙身上找到宝石簇……

english.title: Sharpening Your Fangs
english.objectives: Collect 60 Elementium Gem Clusters from creatures in the Dragon Soul Raid encounter.
english.description: Do you understand why I have you assassinate the dragons, yet spare the mortals? It isn't their fault. They must seek out their own destiny, free from the meddling of my kind.$B$BWe are nearing the end of our mission, and it is time for you to seek out your own destiny as well. I can continue to augment your weapons, but collecting shadowy gems won't be enough. My work will require entire clusters. Gather them from my father's minions...

text.title: 石犁村的渴望
text.objectives: 将一小桶“帝王酒”送给四风谷石犁村的麦龙。
text.description: 打扰一下……$n？我没听错你的名字吧？$b$b我是从西边的石犁村过来的。他们派我来买些应急的酒，但风暴烈酒酿造厂全被木板封住了！$b$b跟你同行的那位帅哥……不，不是泥盏，是另一位……他好像带着几桶酒。你能匀出一小桶来，以解我们村的燃眉之急吗？

english.title: Stoneplow Thirsts
english.objectives: Deliver a cask of The Emperor to Loon Mai at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Excuse me... $n? Did I hear your name correctly?$b$bI've come from Stoneplow, in the west. They sent me to pick up some emergency beer rations, but the Stormstout Brewery is all boarded up!$b$bIt looks like your handsome friend there - no, not Mudmug, the other one - has a few casks with him. Could you spare a keg for a town in need?

text.title: 大义灭亲
text.objectives: 消灭死亡之翼，获得一块死亡之翼的下颚碎片。
text.description: 你的下一个目标已经夺走了我手下其他所有刺客的性命。我要你去击败我的父亲。$B$B你必须消灭死亡之翼。$B$B我们没时间了。他的疯狂已经腐蚀了我所有的同胞。如果再不阻止他，他的黑暗将会吞噬整个世界。$B$B万一你奇迹般地成功了，请帮我带一块他的遗物回来——也许就是一块他用来掩饰自己混乱本质的装甲碎片——我将会给你无与伦比的奖励。

english.title: Patricide
english.objectives: Destroy Deathwing and retrieve a Fragment of Deathwing's Jaw.
english.description: Your next target has claimed the lives of all of my other assassins. I need you to kill my father himself.$B$BYou must destroy Deathwing.$B$BWe are out of time. His madness has already corrupted all the others of my kind, and his darkness will consume the world if he is not stopped.$B$BIf you by some miracle succeed, and can retrieve for me a piece of him - perhaps a fragment of the armor he uses to disguise his true chaotic nature - the reward I give you will be without equal.

text.title: Well of Eternity RP Tracker
text.objectives: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
text.description: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Well of Eternity RP Tracker
english.objectives: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
english.description: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here.
