I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 净化达克萨隆
text.objectives: 达库鲁要求你前往达克萨隆，并对他的火盆使用达库鲁的药剂。使用达库鲁的药剂需要消耗5份耐久魔精。
text.description: 嘿，朋友，你来了啊！这太好了，朋友！$b$b达克萨隆里面那些肮脏的亡灵很快就将被清理干净，让她恢复原有的高贵。为了报答你的帮助，达克萨隆里面最珍贵的财宝都将归你了，朋友！$B$B等你到达它的顶端之后，就可以开始召唤我，我会启动整个仪式。$B$B唉，可惜召唤我还需要付出一点代价。你必须从达克萨隆中的幸存者身上收集一些魔精。
text.completion: We done a great thing, mon! And dis just be da beginning....$b$bSeek me out in Zul'Drak when da time be right.$b$bDere be a war to be won, mon!

english.title: Cleansing Drak'Tharon
english.objectives: Drakuru wants you to use Drakuru's Elixir at his brazier inside Drak'Tharon. Using Drakuru's Elixir there will require 5 Enduring Mojo.
english.description: 'Ey, mon, you be here! Dis is good, mon!$b$bDrak'Tharon soon be cleansed of them foul undead and restored to her noble purpose. In return for your help, the keep's most valuable treasures be yours, mon!$b$bOnce ya be reachin' its top, ya must summon me, and I'll perform the ritual.$b$bAlas, my summonin' will be comin' at a cost. Ya must collect mojo from the survivors.
english.completion: We done a great thing, mon! And dis just be da beginning....$b$bSeek me out in Zul'Drak when da time be right.$b$bDere be a war to be won, mon!

text.title: 搜索小分队
text.objectives: 在卡桑利废墟中搜寻切森·逐晨者。
text.description: 我派出外交使节在东面的废墟中寻找盟友。$b$b我的外交使节还没回来复命，现在康又告诉我说这个丛林到处是叫做魔古的残忍家伙。$b$b切森是我朋友，也是莱莎的兄弟。失去兄弟会让她绝望。发烧已经够她头疼的了。$b$b你能在这里东面的废墟调查一下，看看发生什么事了吗？
text.completed: 去卡桑琅丛林的卡桑利废墟和切森·逐晨者谈一谈。

english.title: Search Party
english.objectives: Search the Krasari Ruins for Chezin Dawnchaser.
english.description: I sent a diplomat to look for allies in the ruins east of here.$b$bMy diplomat has not returned and now Kang tells me this jungle is filled with a sinister people known as the mogu.$b$bChezin is my friend and Leza's brother. To lose a brother would cause her to give in to despair. She already has enough to worry about with her fever.$b$bCould you investigate the ruins east of here and find out what happened?
english.completed: Speak with Chezin Dawnchaser at The Krasari Ruins in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: Silver Filigree Flask
text.objectives: Fill the vial with a potent alchemical mixture.
text.description: You have found a beautiful silver flask decorated with ornate filigree.  With the right materials and your skill in alchemy, it could become quite magical.

english.title: Silver Filigree Flask
english.objectives: Fill the vial with a potent alchemical mixture.
english.description: You have found a beautiful silver flask decorated with ornate filigree.  With the right materials and your skill in alchemy, it could become quite magical.

text.title: 飞掠者炖肉
text.objectives: 收集5个完整的飞掠者腺体。
text.description: 莱莎发烧了，待产的孕妇是不能发烧的。$b$b棘杖妈妈曾经告诉我，飞掠者炖肉几乎可以治愈一切疾病，让我们试试看她的说法是否正确。$b$b我去采药，请你帮我收集一些完整的飞掠者腺体，然后我来做一顿看看效果如何。

english.title: Skitterer Stew
english.objectives: Gather 5 Intact Skitterer Glands.
english.description: Leza has a fever. No mother in labor should have a fever.$b$bMama Bramblestaff once told me that Skitterer Stew could heal almost any illness. Let us put this knowledge to the test.$b$bGather some intact skitterer glands for me while I get the herbs we'll need and I'll whip up a batch.

text.title: 敌明我暗！
text.objectives: 击败达纳苏斯先锋。
text.description: 这些烈日行者太烦人了。我需要的是真正流着部落热血，心怀部落荣耀的士兵，而不是一些崇拜太阳的和平主义渣滓。$b$b联盟也来到了这里，$p。他们可能是跟踪我们过来的，也可能是得到了和莱莎一样的预见。这就不用管了。但我不想让他们知道我们目前的分歧有多么严重。趁他们的斥候还没有回去报告，先去南边杀掉那些探子吧。$b$b地狱咆哮之眼注视着你。

english.title: Blind Them!
english.objectives: Kill the Darnassian Outrider.
english.description: These sunwalkers are a tiresome lot. I need soldiers with horde blood in their veins and honor in their hearts. Not some pacifist sun spirit filth.$b$bThe Alliance are here, $p. Followed us no doubt, or somehow tracked the same visions Leza had that led us here. It doesn't matter. I don't want them to know how divided we are at the moment. Go kill their scout south of here before it can report back.$b$bHellscream's eyes upon you.

text.title: Profit Mastery
text.objectives: Obtain 12 Vials of Tiger Blood.
text.description: Two words: Tiger Blood!$b$bThis is gonna sell better than saronite back on the black market. Especially once I finish spreading a rumor about how it makes you all buff and stuff.$b$bThing is, I ran out of ammo. Can you round up a few vials of tiger blood for me? I'll cut you in on the scam.
text.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider within the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Profit Mastery
english.objectives: Obtain 12 Vials of Tiger Blood.
english.description: Two words: Tiger Blood!$b$bThis is gonna sell better than saronite back on the black market. Especially once I finish spreading a rumor about how it makes you all buff and stuff.$b$bThing is, I ran out of ammo. Can you round up a few vials of tiger blood for me? I'll cut you in on the scam.
english.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider within the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: Crane Mastery
text.objectives: Kill 8 Carp Hunters.
text.description: Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up.$b$bCan't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good.$b$bCan I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here.
text.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider within the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Crane Mastery
english.objectives: Kill 8 Carp Hunters.
english.description: Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up.$b$bCan't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good.$b$bCan I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here.
english.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider within the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 都阳的威胁
text.objectives: 击败6个都阳复国者，8个都阳勘测者和4个都阳暴徒。
text.description: 魔古？他们和精灵很像，历史悠久而且领地观过强。总有一天，艾泽拉斯的所有生命都得明白，部落不是这个世界的“过客”。我们就在这里并将扎根下去。$b$b去教训他们一下，让他们明白这个道理吧。去削减他们在南部和西部废墟里的兵力，趁他们发动攻击前打散他们的集结部队。$b$b尽量多了解他们的战斗方式和致命弱点。

english.title: Threat from Dojan
english.objectives: Kill 6 Dojani Reclaimers and 8 Dojani Surveyors, and 4 Dojani Enforcers.
english.description: Mogu? They seem like the elves, ancient and an over developed sense of entitlement. Everyone of Azeroth must learn, sooner or later, that the Horde is not "visiting" this world. We are here. We are staying.$b$bTeach them this lesson. Quell their numbers in the ruins south and west of here. Break their amassing forces before they decide to attack.$b$bLearn what you can of how these creatures fight, and how they die.

text.title: 青春之池
text.objectives: 获得青春之池中的泉水。
text.description: 魔古族发现了青春之池！$b$b棘杖妈妈曾经给我讲过有关青春之池的传说。在魔古帝国时期，他们曾用青春之池的水来延寿。$b$b不过由于某些原因，这些故事的结局都不怎么美妙。似乎是池水受到过诅咒。$b$b不管怎样，我们都得调查一下。那些水可能会对莱莎有帮助。$b$b青春之池似乎就在废墟的西北边。

english.title: The Pools of Youth
english.objectives: Recover water from the Pools of Youth.
english.description: The mogu found the Pools of Youth!$b$bMama Bramblestaff used to tell me old stories about those. During the mogu empire they would use the waters to extend life.$b$bThing is those stories never ended well for some reason. As if the waters were cursed.$b$bEither way, we should investigate. There is a good chance those waters might help Leza.$b$bIt looks like the Pools of Youth are on the northwestern side of the ruins.

text.title: 魔古的阴谋
text.objectives: 找回都阳指令。
text.description: 魔古族很少像这样大规模集结。我们必须查清他们的目的。$b$b我想我听到过有人在废墟中心附近大声发号施令。$b$b我们或许应该去看看那个人身上有没有相关的信息。

english.title: The Mogu Agenda
english.objectives: Recover the Dojani Orders.
english.description: Mogu don't often gather in numbers like this. We should find out what they are up to.$b$bI thought I heard someone shouting orders near the center of the ruins.$b$bWe should probably see if he has information.

text.title: 草药治疗
text.objectives: 收集20片霸王莲叶子。
text.description: 康的药物不管用。$b$b这里有什么别的东西在作祟。这里的泥土深处有一种力量。它在侵蚀我们心中的希望，用沮丧和绝望腐蚀着我们。$b$b康说这里生长着一种莲花。我或许可以用它们做成一种茶，但愿那东西能给莱莎一些力量。$b$b拜托了，$p，请去南边和西边的废墟收集一些莲叶回来。我会报答你的。

english.title: Herbal Remedies
english.objectives: Find 20 Imperial Lotus Leaves.
english.description: Kang's remedy isn't working.$b$bThere is something else at work here. A power deep beneath the soil. It is sapping us of hope, hitting us with depression and despair.$b$bKang tells me this land has lotus plants. I might be able to make a tea that would hopefully lend Leza some strength.$b$bPlease, $p, search the ruins south and west of here for lotus leaves. I will pay you for your efforts.

text.title: 生命
text.objectives: 和烈日行者德兹科谈一谈，并等待孩子的降生。
text.description: 我的孩子快要出生了，我得去搭把手。$b$b别走开，英雄。如果我的妻儿能够活下来，我一定要让她们看看救命恩人的样子。

english.title: Life
english.objectives: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco, and wait for the newborn.
english.description: My child is coming. I must help as I may.$b$bStay nearby, hero. If my wife and child survive, I would have them look on the face of the one who saved them.

text.title: 一路向西
text.objectives: 找到朱鹤寺附近的烈日行者斥候。
text.description: 莱莎已经客死异乡，我现在必须以活着的人为重。$b$b科尔率领一队斥候深入进西边的丛林。$b$b我也派出了斥候去调查朱鹤寺。拜托了，$p，帮我找到那些斥候，拿到他们的情报，然后跟科尔碰头并尽可能地帮助他。$b$b我们会尽快赶上你们的。

english.title: Going West
english.objectives: Find the Sunwalker Scout near the Crane Temple.
english.description: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living.$b$bKor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle.$b$bI sent a scout of my own to investigate the crane temple. Please, $p, seek out my scout, get their report, then meet up with Kor and lend what aid you can to him.$b$bWe will join you as quickly as we are able.

text.title: 深入荒野
text.objectives: 在都阳河的北部流域找到失踪的朱家堡信使，然后继续前往朱鹤寺和科洛·迷雾行者谈一谈。
text.description: 在丛林深处，卡桑琅河入海口的南岸，坐落着朱鹤寺——那是伟大的赤精和他最虔诚的信徒们的家园。$B$B我们必须把这里发生的事告知他们。$B$B如果你要去那儿，我有件事想请你帮忙：我们经常为寺庙输送补给，可我们的上一个信使却没有回来。请你在旅途中顺便找找他留下的痕迹——大路会在都阳河边的分出岔路，他应该是走北边那条路。你到达寺院后，就去找科洛·迷雾行者吧。

english.title: Into the Wilds
english.objectives: Locate the missing Zhu's Watch Courier in the northern area of the Dojani River, then continue on to the Temple of the Red Crane and speak with Koro Mistwalker.
english.description: Deep in the wilds, on the southern coast where the Krasarang River meets the sea, rests the Temple of the Red Crane, home of the great Chi-Ji and his most devout followers.$B$BThey should be told of what happened here.$B$BIf you're headed that way, I have a favor to ask; We often send supplies to the temple, but our last courier has not returned. Please look for signs of him as you travel - where the road forks at the Dojani River, he'd have gone north. When you reach the temple, find Koro Mistwalker.

text.title: 局势失控
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的临风岛找佟教头。
text.description: 欢迎来到云端翔龙骑士团，$r。我能从你渴望的眼神里看出，你想加入骑士团。$B$B让我好好地瞧瞧你。$B$B<安离长老轻轻地支住你的头，仔细观察着你。>$B$B嗯……我能看出你的内心充满了真挚与诚实。你从遥远的地方长途跋涉来到此处，但我恐怕你还要经历更多的磨练。$B$B你通往骑士团的道路从现在开始。$B$B去东北面的临风岛和佟教头谈一谈，他会指引你的道路。

english.title: Wild Things
english.objectives: Find Instructor Tong at Windward Isle in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Welcome to the Order of the Cloud Serpent, $r. I can see from the spark in your eye that you wish to join the Order.$B$BLet me get a good look at you.$B$B<Elder Anli gently holds your head and gazes at your face.>$B$BHmm. I see honesty and earnestness in your heart. You have journeyed far to come here, but I am afraid you must go yet further.$B$BYour path into the Order begins now.$B$BSpeak to Instructor Tong at Windward Isle to the northeast to take the first step.

text.title: 放手一搏
text.objectives: 击败8个滑鳞切裂者或滑鳞啜蛋者。
text.description: 想当初，滑鳞氏族不敢接近野生翔龙。$B$B但后来，我发现他们在夜幕的掩护下盗取龙蛋。$B$B而现在，他们开始明目张胆地屠杀成年翔龙和雏龙了！$B$B如果我们袖手旁观，这些温顺的物种将彻底灭绝。那么所谓加入云端翔龙骑士团也就无从说起了！$B$B快去杀掉这些卑鄙的滑鳞蜥蜴人，然后我们再谈。

english.title: Beating the Odds
english.objectives: Kill 8 Slitherscale Rippers or Slitherscale Eggdrinkers.
english.description: At first, the Slitherscale were too frightened to approach the wild serpents.$B$BThen, I caught them snatching the eggs under the cover of night.$B$BNow, they are slaughtering adults and hatchlings alike!$B$BIf we do not do something, these gentle creatures will be completely wiped out. Then there won't even be an Order of the Cloud Serpent to join!$B$BGo and slay these vile Slitherscales, and then we will talk.

text.title: 空荡荡的巢穴
text.objectives: 拴住6只临风雏龙并把它们送回家。
text.description: 遭到偷猎者攻击后，年幼的雏龙惊慌地四处奔逃。$B$B它们在岛上四处游荡、惊恐万分。$B$B如果你愿意帮忙的话，就拿着这根绳子把那些走丢了的小可怜带回来。带它们回到龙穴，带它们回家。

english.title: Empty Nests
english.objectives: Leash and return 6 Windward Hatchlings to their nests.
english.description: When the attacks began, the young hatchlings scattered in terror.$B$BThey are roaming around the island, lost and scared.$B$BIf you want to help, take this rope and leash the lost little ones. Take them back to their nests. Return them home.

text.title: 收集龙蛋
text.objectives: 收集6个翔龙蛋。
text.description: 啊，我早就该知道！一看你就是个跃跃欲试的新人。$B$B要是从前，我会很乐意帮你挑选一个龙蛋的，但是滑鳞蜥蜴人把翔龙巢穴洗劫一空。$B$B我非常抱歉，真不知该怎么跟你说。$B$B除非你疯狂到愿意潜入东边的蜥蜴人营地，去取回一些被盗的翔龙蛋，否则我也帮不上什么忙。

english.title: Egg Collection
english.objectives: Collect 6 Serpent Eggs.
english.description: Ahhh, I should have known! You have the look of a hungry initiate.$B$BI would gladly help you choose a serpent egg, but the Slitherscale have thoroughly raided the cloud serpent nests.$B$BI'm terribly sorry. I don't know what to tell you.$B$BUnless you're crazy enough to sneak into the saurok camp to the east and retrieve some stolen cloud serpent eggs, I'm afraid I can't help you.

text.title: 选择龙蛋
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的临风岛和佟教头谈一谈。
text.description: 我把每一个蛋都检查过了,$n。我从你带给我的这些蛋中选出三个最好的来。$B$B你只能选择并带走其中的一个。准备好作出最终决定了吗？

english.title: Choosing the One
english.objectives: Speak to Instructor Tong at Windward Isle in the Jade Forest.
english.description: I have examined each egg, $n. Out of the lot that you brought me, I have chosen the three eggs with the most promise.$B$BYou may choose only one egg to take with you. Are you ready to make your final selection?

text.title: 骑士之旅
text.objectives: 回翡翠林的百木园找天荆教头。
text.description: 很好，非常好！我会把剩下的龙蛋完好无损地送回它们的巢穴去。$B$B同时，你也要把你的龙蛋带回百木园给天荆教头。

english.title: The Rider's Journey
english.objectives: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed.$B$BIn the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

text.title: The Rider's Journey
text.objectives: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
text.description: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed.$B$BIn the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

english.title: The Rider's Journey
english.objectives: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed.$B$BIn the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

text.title: 骑士之旅
text.objectives: 回翡翠林的百木园找天荆教头。
text.description: 很好，非常好！我会把剩下的龙蛋完好无损地送回它们的巢穴去。$B$B同时，你也要把你的龙蛋带回百木园给天荆教头。

english.title: The Rider's Journey
english.objectives: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed.$B$BIn the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

text.title: 这是个……
text.objectives: 看着你的龙蛋孵化。
text.description: 哦，天呐！这个蛋随时有可能孵化！$B$B嗯，看来这个小家伙迫不及待想要见你了。$B$B准备好了吗？

english.title: It's A...
english.objectives: Watch your egg hatch.
english.description: Oh my! This egg is going to hatch at any second!$B$BWell, looks like this little guy is eager to meet you.$B$BAre you ready?

text.title: 比杂草长得还快
text.objectives: 和百木园的风刃教头谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，又见面了，$n。$B$B风刃教头正在找你，你可以在东边的山脊上找到她。$B$B她有些事要告诉你，是关于翔龙的。

english.title: They Grow Like Weeds
english.objectives: Speak to Instructor Windblade at The Arboretum.
english.description: Ahh, it is you again, $n.$B$BInstructor Windblade is looking for you. You can find her on the ridge to the east.$B$BShe has some news about your cloud serpent.

text.title: 飞行训练：穿越云环
text.objectives: 骑乘云端翔龙穿越6个云之环。
text.description: 既然你的翔龙已经长大了，也是时候开始你的飞行训练了。$B$B跟所有新手一样，你必须从最基本的开始。$B$B你的第一个任务很简单，穿越东面山峰间的6个云之环。

english.title: Flight Training: Ring Round-Up
english.objectives: Fly through 6 cloud rings while riding your cloud serpent.
english.description: Now that your serpent is fully grown, you are ready to begin flight training.$B$BAs with all novices, you must start at the beginning.$B$BYour first task is simple. Fly through 6 of the cloud rings between the spires to the east.

text.title: 飞行训练：全速前进
text.objectives: 跟上风刃教头。
text.description: 下一个任务要稍微难一点了。$B$B你准备好了吗？

english.title: Flight Training: Full Speed Ahead
english.objectives: Follow Instructor Windblade.
english.description: The next task will be a little harder.$B$BAre you ready?

text.title: 打牙祭
text.objectives: 从潘达利亚的盐水或淡水湖中钓10条甜白鱼。
text.description: 云端翔龙喜欢吃东西，而它们的最爱则是甜白鱼。$B$B这些鱼可以在潘达利亚的任何一处咸水或淡水水体中找到。我相信你在钓鱼方面很有一手，你有自己的鱼竿吧？$B$B给我带几条新鲜的甜白鱼回来，我肯定这些饥肠辘辘的小家伙们一定会非常感激你的。

english.title: Snack Time
english.objectives: Fish 10 Sugar Minnow from any fresh or salt water in Pandaria.
english.description: Cloud serpents love to eat, and one of their favorite treats is the sugar minnow.$B$BThese fish can be found in salt or fresh water anywhere in Pandaria. I trust you have some skill in fishing, and your own fishing pole to catch them?$B$BBring me a fresh catch and I'm sure the hungry beasts around here will be very grateful.

text.title: 历史的残片
text.objectives: 探索潘达利亚的考古挖掘场，并利用你的考古学技能找到6件翔龙骑士遗物。
text.description: 云端翔龙骑士团的历史可以追溯到数千年前，尽管我们作出了最大的努力，但还是有不少传统的技艺失传了。$B$B你可以研究一下潘达利亚的挖掘场，找寻过去的线索，从而帮我们恢复一些传统的技艺。$B$B运用你的考古学技能来调查潘达利亚的各个地区，并把你的发现统统带来给我看。

english.title: Fragments of the Past
english.objectives: Visit archaeology dig sites around Pandaria and use your survey ability to retrieve 6 Serpentrider Relics.
english.description: The Order of the Cloud Serpent's history stretches back thousands of years, and although we have tried to preserve the old ways, there are ancient techniques that have been lost over time.$B$BYou can help us recover some of this knowledge by searching Pandaria's dig sites for clues to our past.$B$BUse your archaeology skill to survey around Pandaria and bring me whatever you find.

text.title: 只是皮肉伤
text.objectives: 在临风岛使用风绒绷带或厚风绒绷带治疗8条受伤的雏龙。
text.description: 临风岛上的很多雏龙都在战斗中负伤了。$B$B我听说你好像擅长急救。$B$B请速速赶往东北面，用你最好的绷带救救受伤的雏龙。

english.title: Just a Flesh Wound
english.objectives: Use Windwool Bandages or Heavy Windwool Bandages to heal 8 Injured Hatchlings at Windward Isle.
english.description: Many of the baby hatchlings at Windward Isle have been injured as a result of all the fighting.$B$BI have been told that you may be skilled in the art of first aid.$B$BPlease go northeast and use some of your best bandages to save the injured hatchlings.

text.title: 味觉盛宴
text.objectives: 收集5份鱼饼。
text.description: 我听说你对烹饪很有心得。$B$B恰巧，翔龙喜欢吃鱼饼。$B$B如果你能展现一下你的厨艺，给我做5份鱼饼，这里的翔龙一定会非常开心的。

english.title: A Feast for the Senses
english.objectives: Collect 5 Fish Cakes.
english.description: I have heard that you know a thing or two about cooking.$B$BAs it so happens, serpents love to eat Fish Cakes.$B$BIf you use your culinary skills and bring me 5 of these dishes, the cloud serpents around here will be very happy.

text.title: 甜如蜜
text.objectives: 在百木园从愤怒的蜂蜜守护者身上收集30份蜂巢。
text.description: <雏龙在地上蹦蹦跳跳，不一会儿又开始发牢骚和哀鸣了。>$B$B你通过它的行为得知，它是想要一顿丰盛的美食来大快朵颐了。$B$B百木园的树上有很多蜂巢。$B$B从附近的蜂蜜守护者身上收集一些蜂巢并不是什么难事。

english.title: Sweet as Honey
english.objectives: Collect 30 Honeycomb from Angry Honeykeepers in The Arboretum.
english.description: <The hatchling scampers about, then whines and whimpers.>$B$BFrom the cloud serpent's behavior, you have a hunch that it wants a sweet treat.$B$BThe fragrant trees in The Arboretum are home to many honey hives.$B$BIt will be a simple matter to collect combs from the nearby honeykeepers.

text.title: 接球游戏！
text.objectives: 将弹力球丢给你的翔龙，然后连续接球、丢球8次。
text.description: <雏龙无精打采地看着你，脸上写满了倦容。>$B$B你突然意识到，小家伙整天被关着会觉得很无聊。$B$B不如玩玩接球游戏怎么样？

english.title: Catch!
english.objectives: Use the Bouncy Ball. Then, catch and return the ball to your hatchling 8 times.
english.description: <The hatchling looks up at you with a bored, listless expression.>$B$BYou have a feeling the serpent is tired of being cooped up all day.$B$B How about playing a little game of catch?

text.title: 飞行竞技赛
text.objectives: 飞越10个检查点来完成飞行竞技赛，然后从百木园的终点线下方穿过。
text.description: 万众瞩目、激动人心的飞行竞技赛就要开始了！$B$B穿行于山峰间的赛道，将10个热气球检查点上的方格旗全部摘走。$B$B摘得所有旗帜后，记得要从终点线下方越过。$B$B比赛会很激烈，祝你好运。准备好了就跟我说一声。

english.title: The Sky Race
english.objectives: Complete the Sky Race by flying through 10 checkpoints, then passing underneath the Finish Line at The Arboretum.
english.description: The time for the great race is upon us!$B$BTraverse the course among the spires and pass through the checkered flags on each of the 10 balloon checkpoints.$B$BMake sure to pass underneath the finish line when you are done.$B$BThe competition will be fierce, but I wish you luck. Speak to me when you are ready to begin.

text.title: Full Speed Ahead
text.objectives: Follow Instructor Windblade.
text.description: It is time for our training session.$B$BFollow me around the spires. Let's see if you can keep up while staying mounted.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Windblade at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Full Speed Ahead
english.objectives: Follow Instructor Windblade.
english.description: It is time for our training session.$B$BFollow me around the spires. Let's see if you can keep up while staying mounted.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Windblade at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 想要抓住心，得先抓住胃
text.objectives: 收集5块老虎腰肉。
text.description: <翔龙愁眉苦脸地看着你。>$B$B呃……看来某人今天的心情不佳啊！$B$B不过还好，你知道用什么方法能够哄小家伙开心。$B$B云端翔龙喜欢吃老虎肉，不过想要弄到老虎腰上的肉……还是有些……挑战的。$B$B幸运的是，你回忆起在临风岛的西北面，有一群慵懒肥硕的大老虎。$B$B没错，你可能会被抓伤，或是被咬上两口……但为了翔龙，这还是值得的，不是吗？

english.title: The Easiest Way To A Serpent's Heart
english.objectives: Collect 5 Tiger Flanks.
english.description: <The hatchling scowls at you.>$B$BUh-oh, looks like someone is in a bad mood today!$B$BLuckily, you know just the thing that will cheer up the little beast.$B$BCloud serpents love the taste of tiger meat, but the tender flanks can be... challenging... to acquire.$B$BLuckily, you recall there are some fat, juicy tigers to the northwest, on Windward Isle.$B$BSure, you might suffer some scratches and a little mauling, but it's all worth it for your serpent, right?

text.title: 恢复平衡
text.objectives: 击败8个滑鳞切裂者或滑鳞啜蛋者。
text.description: 岛上的形势仍然很严峻，$n。$B$B滑鳞蜥蜴人对我们的和平意愿置若罔闻，看来他们是要敬酒不吃吃罚酒了。$B$B为了保护野生的云端翔龙，我们必须让他们从岛上消失。只有这样，云端翔龙才能平静地生活。

english.title: Restoring the Balance
english.objectives: Kill 8 Slitherscale Rippers or Slitherscale Eggdrinkers.
english.description: The situation at the islands remains dire, $n.$B$BThe Slitherscale saurok have not responded to our attempts at peace, so only one option remains.$B$BIn order to protect the wild cloud serpents, we must rid the island of their presence. Only then can the cloud serpents be left to live in peace.

text.title: Feeding Time
text.objectives: Collect 3 Saltback Meat and feed them to your hatchling companion.
text.description: <The serpent darts forward and bites your fingers.>$B$BOuch! It seems, without a doubt, that the little beast is hungry. You recall that some meaty-looking turtles can be found on the wild cloud serpent island to the northeast.$B$BPerhaps some turtle meat will fill the hatchling's voracious appetite.

english.title: Feeding Time
english.objectives: Collect 3 Saltback Meat and feed them to your hatchling companion.
english.description: <The serpent darts forward and bites your fingers.>$B$BOuch! It seems, without a doubt, that the little beast is hungry. You recall that some meaty-looking turtles can be found on the wild cloud serpent island to the northeast.$B$BPerhaps some turtle meat will fill the hatchling's voracious appetite.

text.title: 空空如也的巢穴
text.objectives: 拴住6只临风雏龙并把它们送回家。
text.description: 哦，谢天谢地，总算又来了一个翔龙训练师！$B$B我刚听说东北面临风岛上的野生雏龙遇到大麻烦了！$B$B当成年翔龙和可怕的蜥蜴人交战时，谁来照看那些可爱的小家伙？没人，只能是我们！$B$B我们得救救它们！$B$B我把我能找到的训练师都派去帮忙了。如果你现在不是很忙，你能确保那些雏龙可以安全无恙地回到它们母亲的巢穴中吗？

english.title: Emptier Nests
english.objectives: Leash and return 6 Windward Hatchlings to their nests.
english.description: Oh, thank goodness, another cloud serpent trainer!$B$BI just received word that the wild hatchlings at Windward Isle to the northeast are in serious trouble!$B$BWhile the adults fight those terrible saurok, who is watching the cute little babies? No one, that's who!$B$BWE HAVE TO SAVE THEM!$B$BI'm sending every trainer I can find to go and help. If you aren't too busy, can you make sure the hatchlings are safely delivered back to their mothers' nests?

text.title: Disarming the Enemy
text.objectives: Collect 5 Slitherscale Harpoons.
text.description: If we are to stop the poachers, we need to take more aggressive action.$B$BIf we can remove the enemies' primary tools for killing and capturing serpents, we may be able to stop their operation altogether.$B$BI need you to go into their territory on the eastern end of Windward Isle and steal their weapons.$B$BA cat without claws cannot strike.

english.title: Disarming the Enemy
english.objectives: Collect 5 Slitherscale Harpoons.
english.description: If we are to stop the poachers, we need to take more aggressive action.$B$BIf we can remove the enemies' primary tools for killing and capturing serpents, we may be able to stop their operation altogether.$B$BI need you to go into their territory on the eastern end of Windward Isle and steal their weapons.$B$BA cat without claws cannot strike.

text.title: 保护龙蛋
text.objectives: 收集8个被偷的蛋。
text.description: 哦不！我们必须阻止他们！$n，你说呢？骑士团需要你的帮助！$B$B你知道那些可怕的滑鳞蜥蜴人在做什么吗？$B$B他们竟厚颜无耻的直接从母龙巢穴里窃取翔龙蛋！$B$B云端翔龙本来就已经很稀少了，那些恶棍竟然还……还……$B$B<苏琪倒吸了一口凉气。>$B$B……他们竟然把翔龙蛋当点心吃！这太可恶了！$B$B去东北面的临风岛，找回所有你能找到的还未破损的蛋。作为骑士团的准学员，这是我们的职责所在！

english.title: Preservation
english.objectives: Collect 8 Stolen Eggs.
english.description: Oh no! We must stop them! $n, is it? The Order needs your help!$B$BDo you know what those horrible Slitherscale saurok are doing?$B$BThey have the audacity to steal cloud serpent eggs straight from the matriarch's nests!$B$BWhile the cloud serpents become ever rarer, those brutes are... are...$B$B<Suchi takes a deep breath.>$B$B...they're eat their eggs for dinner! It's horrible!$B$BGo to Windward Isle to the northeast and recover any unbroken eggs that you can. As students of the Order, it's our duty!

text.title: 为了部落
text.objectives: 营救8名逐晨者俘虏。
text.description: 当魔古族进攻时，我们向后撤到了避难所。不过沿途有许多人被抓了。$b$b请前往西北边，尽你所能救出那些俘虏，这些人都可以帮助我们作战。$b$b至于联盟的人，就让他们见鬼去吧。

english.title: For the Tribe
english.objectives: Rescue 8 Dawnchaser Captives.
english.description: We fell back to the refuge when the mogu attacked but lost a number of our people along the way.$b$bTravel west and north of here and look for any captives you can rescue that could help us in our fight.$b$bLeave any Alliance you find to their fate.

text.title: 石犁村守卫
text.objectives: 对7个石犁使者使用霸王莲软膏。
text.description: 我已经尽力抢救这些石犁使者了，但还是有很多人被这些“螳螂妖”拖入了丛林。$b$b这些平民需要我们的帮助。$b$b请带上你之前收集的草药，我已向其中注入了自己仅存的圣光之力。请用它们尽量多救几个石犁使者吧。

english.title: The Stoneplow Convoy
english.objectives: Use Imperial Lotus Poultice on 7 Stoneplow Envoys.
english.description: I tried to save as many of the Stoneplow envoys as I could but these "mantid" dragged many of them off into the jungle.$b$bThese are civilians in need of our help.$b$bPlease take the herbs you gathered earlier. I've infused them with what gifts of the Light are still granted me. Use them on as many of the Stoneplow envoys as you can.

text.title: 野蛮入侵
text.objectives: 夺回5件遭劫的锦鱼战利品。
text.description: 蜥蜴人！$b$b这些卑鄙的家伙就知道烧杀抢掠，在没有任何缘由和警告的情况下攻击我们。$b$b求你了，$c，能帮帮我们吗？$b$b帮我们从这些河刃掠夺者手中拿回被抢的战利品，他们正沿着河岸行军。我们会很乐意支付你酬劳的。

english.title: Thieving Raiders
english.objectives: Recover 5 pieces of Pillaged Jinyu Loot.
english.description: Saurok!$b$bThese vile creatures are obsessed with killing and stealing. They attacked our settlement without provocation or warning.$b$bPlease, $c, can you aid us?$b$bHelp us recover our lost possessions from these Riverblade raiders that march along the river and we will gladly reward you.

text.title: 掠夺者首领司罗凡
text.objectives: 击败司罗凡。
text.description: 侵略者的首领是一只异常凶猛的蜥蜴人，名叫司罗凡。以前我们受到攻击时，朱鹤寺总会来帮助我们。但现在，我们发现自己在人数和计谋上都拼不过他们。$b$b$c，请帮我们干掉这个侵略者的首领。$b$b你能在卡桑利瀑布后面的洞穴里找到他。
text.giverWindow: 瀑歌村的恐惧之源。

english.title: Raid Leader Slovan
english.objectives: Kill Slovan.
english.description: The raiders are led by a particularly violent saurok known as Slovan. The Crane Temple usually comes to our aid when he attacks but now we find ourselves outmatched and outmaneuvered.$b$bPlease, $c, aid us by destroying this raid leader.$b$bYou can find him in his den behind the Krasari Falls.
english.giverWindow: The terror of the falls.

text.title: 一起走
text.objectives: 带泥盏回到半山。$b$b如果与泥盏走散了，可以在金扇泽的大香蕉旁找到他。
text.description: 不，不，不，你不用担心怎么带上它们。我可以扛着这些木桶。$b$b我可能不是最帅的熊猫人，也不是最机灵的，甚至也算不上最幽默的，但我比穆山兽还要强壮。$b$b你只要在前头带路就行了。
text.completion: Good! The water's here!

english.title: Barreling Along
english.objectives: Lead Mudmug back to Halfhill.$b$bIf you become separated from Mudmug, you can find him next to the giant banana in the Gilded Fan.
english.description: No, no, no, don't you worry about pickin' 'em up. I can hold these here barrels.$b$bI may not be the handsomest pandaren, or the smartest, or any fun to be around in the slightest, but I'm stronger than a mushan beast.$b$bI'mma just need you to lead the way.
english.completion: Good! The water's here!

text.title: 为了家人
text.objectives: 在科夏废墟里寻找科尔·血牙。
text.description: 科尔早就应该赶上来了。他说过要去扫荡东边的科夏废墟，然后与我们汇合，一起击退螳螂妖。$b$b他可能需要些帮手一起对付碎地者勃罗耶。你能不能去帮帮他？我和康随后就到。
text.giverWindow: 复国领主

english.title: For Family
english.objectives: Search for Kor Bloodtusk.
english.description: Kor should have caught up by now. He said he was going to secure the Ruins of Korja east of here and meet us to help with the mantid threat.$b$bHe may need help against Groundbreaker Brojai. Could you assist him? Kang and I will follow shortly.
english.giverWindow: The Lord Reclaimer

text.title: 螳螂妖
text.objectives: 杀死10个伊克提克先锋。
text.description: 螳螂妖！这些家伙突然就冒了出来，击溃了我们的护卫队，把我们的人都驱散了。$b$b现在它们正准备攻打石犁村。$b$b请帮帮我们，$c，在它们召集大军包围我们的村庄之前，消灭掉一些有生力量。$b$b如果我的表哥林大使还活着，并仍在护卫队的话，他应该会酬谢你的帮助的。

english.title: The Mantid
english.objectives: Kill 10 Ik'thik Precursors.
english.description: The mantid! They came out of nowhere and smashed our convoy to ruin, scattering our people this way and that.$b$bNow they are preparing to hit Stoneplow.$b$bPlease, $c, destroy some of these beasts before they get sufficient numbers to flank our home.$b$bIf my cousin, Ambassador Len, is still alive and at our convoy he should be able to reward you for your help.

text.title: 深入荒野
text.objectives: 在都阳河的南部流域找到失踪的朱家堡信使，然后继续前往朱鹤寺和科洛·迷雾行者谈一谈。
text.description: 在丛林深处，卡桑琅河入海口的南岸，坐落着朱鹤寺——那是伟大的赤精和他最虔诚的信徒们的家园。$B$B我们必须把这里发生的事告知他们。$B$B如果你要去那儿，我有件事想请你帮忙：我们经常为寺庙输送补给，可我们的上一个信使却没有回来。请你在旅途中顺便找找他留下的痕迹——大路会在都阳河边的分出岔路，他应该是走南边那条路。你到达寺院后，就去找科洛·迷雾行者吧。

english.title: Into the Wilds
english.objectives: Locate the missing Zhu's Watch Courier in the southern area of the Dojani River, then continue on to the Temple of the Red Crane and speak with Koro Mistwalker.
english.description: Deep in the wilds, on the southern coast where the Krasarang River meets the sea, rests the Temple of the Red Crane, home of the great Chi-Ji and his most devout followers.$B$BThey should be told of what happened here.$B$BIf you're headed that way, I have a favor to ask; We often send supplies to the temple, but our last courier has not returned. Please look for signs of him as you travel - where the road forks at the Dojani River, he'd have gone south. When you reach the temple, find Koro Mistwalker.

text.title: 中毒！
text.objectives: 收集5把魔古毒刃。
text.description: 魔……魔古族，不可轻信。下毒。取……取一些毒刃样品，交给德兹科……他在西边的雷霆裂口。

english.title: Poisoned!
english.objectives: Gather 5 Mogu Poisoned Blades.
english.description: The... mogu. Do not trust. Poison. Get sample... sample blades. Bring to Dezco... in Thunder Cleft, west of here.

text.title: Labor for Labor
text.objectives: Gather 8 pieces of Fire Wood.
text.description: My wife, Leza, is going into labor but she is very very sick. I need to keep her warm but we've exhausted our supply of dry firewood.$b$bCould you grab some twigs and branches from the nearby trees for me? Time is of the essence!
text.completed: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Labor for Labor
english.objectives: Gather 8 pieces of Fire Wood.
english.description: My wife, Leza, is going into labor but she is very very sick. I need to keep her warm but we've exhausted our supply of dry firewood.$b$bCould you grab some twigs and branches from the nearby trees for me? Time is of the essence!
english.completed: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 猎穆山兽
text.objectives: 杀死15只沙背穆山兽。
text.description: 那些穆山兽！看看它们的体型！它们可能跟脚下这片大地一样古老。应该是不错的战利品。$b$b如果你想试试自己做为王牌猎人的潜质如何，就先拿它们开刀吧。
text.completion: Well done $p.$b$bMy father travels across the sea to a new continent and all he can seem ta' want to hunt is old borin' wolves.$b$bMe, I like to hunt stuff with meat on its bones.

english.title: Mushan Mastery
english.objectives: Kill 15 Dustback Mushans.
english.description: Mushan! Would ya look at the size o' 'em. Old as the dirt they walk on probably. A fine trophy.$b$bIf you are lookin' to test your mettle as a big game hunter, start with them.
english.completion: Well done $p.$b$bMy father travels across the sea to a new continent and all he can seem ta' want to hunt is old borin' wolves.$b$bMe, I like to hunt stuff with meat on its bones.

text.title: 猎狐狸
text.objectives: 杀死15只狡猾的狐狸。
text.description: 当我在侦查这里以东时看到了一群狐狸，这是我在迷踪岛时学习捕猎的第一课。$b$b如果你想看看一个年轻的熊猫人猎人在成长过程中所面临的挑战，就向东去和一群狐狸厮杀吧。它们既聪明又狡猾，所以一定要小心。
text.completion: Well done! You outfoxed the foxes. I will talk to Mr. Pleeb about getting you another trophy made.

english.title: Fox Mastery
english.objectives: Kill 15 Sly Foxes.
english.description: So, when I was scouting east of here I saw a collection of foxes. That's what I first learned to hunt when back on the Wandering Isle.$b$bIf you want to see the challenge a young pandaren hunter faced when growing up, head east and face off against a bunch of foxes. They tend to be clever and cunning so be on your guard.
english.completion: Well done! You outfoxed the foxes. I will talk to Mr. Pleeb about getting you another trophy made.

text.title: 猎虎
text.objectives: 杀死15只峡谷追猎者。
text.description: 虎群！不管去哪里，我都能听到有关这些巨大利齿野兽的消息。到现在我还没有机会猎到一只。$b$b我们去猎些虎吧。我去东边，你去西边。我记得我在沙背峡谷附近见过它们。我确定穆山兽周围会有很多。
text.completion: Wow! You really racked up a count. I'll chat with Mr. Pleeb about getting the best one converted to a trophy for you.

english.title: Stalker Mastery
english.objectives: Kill 15 Gorge Stalkers.
english.description: Tigers! No matter what land I go to I hear about these big fanged beasts. And yet I haven't had a chance to hunt any of them.$b$bLet's go hunt some tigers. I'll go east, you go west. I think I saw some near Dustback Gorge. I'm sure there are tons near those mushan.
english.completion: Wow! You really racked up a count. I'll chat with Mr. Pleeb about getting the best one converted to a trophy for you.

text.title: 猎穆山兽：黑暗之皮
text.objectives: 获得黑暗之皮的脑袋。
text.description: 我儿子是个天才猎手……不过还需要训练。让我们给他演示一下传统的奈辛瓦里式捕猎，怎么样？$b$b我看到这里往东有一只超大的穆山兽，它的皮毛像夜一般黑。它看起来好像曾经撂倒过很多猎人。$b$b如果你想玩个刺激的捕猎游戏，就去搞定它。
text.completion: Now that's a proper trophy right there.
text.giverWindow: 在当地广为流传的野兽。

english.title: Mushan Mastery: Darkhide
english.objectives: Obtain Darkhide's Head.
english.description: My boy here is a talented hunter... in training. Let's show him an old 'Nessy style hunt shall we?$b$bI saw a mighty big mushan east of here with a hide dark as night. It looked like it had taken down a number of hunters in its day.$b$bIf you want a big game hunt, go try an' take it on.
english.completion: Now that's a proper trophy right there.
english.giverWindow: The beast of local legend.

text.title: 猎龟
text.objectives: 收集5块完整的龟壳。
text.description: 我知道乌龟算不上是狩猎的重头戏，但这并不意味它们对付起来很轻松。乌龟同时还能作为捕捉大猎物的诱饵！$b$b高特尔找到了一些旧石板，上面写着托加尼洼地就是献身之地。在古老的帝国，似乎乌龟会被用来喂养某些凶猛的水怪。$b$b嗯，我看现在就去搞清楚水里面到底有什么东西吧。去收集一些新鲜的龟壳，在地洞那里等我。$b$b我们看看那些古代传说是不是真的。
text.completion: Thank ye. This one aught ta' one up me pop.

english.title: Tortoise Mastery
english.objectives: Gather 5 Intact Tortoise Shells.
english.description: Granted, tortoises are not big game but they can be mean game. They also work as the perfect bait for bigger game!$b$bGotcher found some ol' tablets sayin' that the Torjari Pit is a sacrificin' site. The old empire used ta' feed unruly sorts to the waters as it were.$b$bWell ah mean to see me what's down in that water. Gather up some fresh tortoise shells and meet me at the pit.$b$bLet's see if ol' legends be true.
english.completion: Thank ye. This one aught ta' one up me pop.

text.title: 父亲的压力
text.objectives: 消灭托加尔之怨。
text.description: 如果石板上说的是真的，那我们要做就是举行一场简短的祭祀活动，然后下面的那个怪物就会被召唤出来。$b$b当怪物出现时，我们要抓住它。就让我父亲看看，我们都是当之无愧的王牌猎人，并不比他差。
text.completion: You saved me son! I canno' ever thank ye enough. Please! Take this fer your efforts.
text.giverWindow: 传说中的野兽

english.title: Parental Mastery
english.objectives: Destroy Torjar's Bane.
english.description: If them tablets were correct, all ay got ta do is a small dance ritual and the big thing o' the deep will be summoned.$b$bWhen it comes out, we'll get 'em and show me pop we are both true big game hunters like him.
english.completion: You saved me son! I canno' ever thank ye enough. Please! Take this fer your efforts.
english.giverWindow: The Beast of Legend

objectiveDetails.description: 营救赫米特·奈辛瓦里二世

text.title: 飞行训练：熟悉赛道
text.objectives: 飞越漂浮在纱雾海上方的检查点，收集10面竞赛旗帜。
text.description: 既然你已经了解了竞技赛的基础知识，那么你该去熟悉一下赛道了。$B$B去实地考察一下那些山峰，并从每一个检查点摘取一面竞赛旗帜。$B$B在飞行中触碰那些方格旗，就能收集到它们了。

english.title: Flight Training: In Due Course
english.objectives: Fly through 10 Race Flags at the Checkpoints floating above the Mistveil Sea.
english.description: Now that you have learned the basics of the race, you should go learn the course.$B$BExplore the spires and collect a race flag from each of the checkpoints.$B$BFly through each checkered flag to collect it.

text.title: Riding the Skies
text.objectives: Join the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
text.description: I can no longer call myself your teacher, $n.$B$BYou have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent.$B$BToday, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

english.title: Riding the Skies
english.objectives: Join the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
english.description: I can no longer call myself your teacher, $n.$B$BYou have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent.$B$BToday, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

objectiveDetails.description: Join the Order of the Cloud Serpent

text.title: Sprite Plight
text.objectives: Kill 8 Slateskin Troublemakers.
text.description: Sprites again! I hate these things. We need to stop them before they hurt someone or burn down half of the village!$B$BIf you see any of the pests, please deal with them!

english.title: Sprite Plight
english.objectives: Kill 8 Slateskin Troublemakers.
english.description: Sprites again! I hate these things. We need to stop them before they hurt someone or burn down half of the village!$B$BIf you see any of the pests, please deal with them!

text.title: Steer Clear of the Beer Here
text.objectives: Recover 10 Stolen Mistfall Kegs.
text.description: Someone left some beer out up on the southern rise and now the sprites have developed a taste for our brew. They've been sneaking into town all morning, stealing whatever kegs they find.$B$BBring back what you can. A pandaren worker without brew is just... it won't be very productive. We need the men in good spirits.
text.completed: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: My Town, It's on Fire
text.objectives: Put out 30 Brazier Fires.
text.description: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is burning...$B$BThe sprites have started kicking the braziers! They're going to set fire to the whole town!$B$BPlease help us! Stamp out any fires you see!

text.title: Meating Expectations
text.objectives: Retrieve 10 slabs of Fairlands Gazelle Meat.
text.description: Hard workers deserve hearty meals, but I'm all out of good meat!$B$BCan you head out into the forest and get me some fresh gazelle meat?

english.title: Meating Expectations
english.objectives: Retrieve 10 slabs of Fairlands Gazelle Meat.
english.description: Hard workers deserve hearty meals, but I'm all out of good meat!$B$BCan you head out into the forest and get me some fresh gazelle meat?

text.title: Encroaching Storm
text.objectives: Kill 8 Thundermaw Wolves.
text.description: The villagers have lost another yak this morning to one of the thundermaw wolves from across the river. The wolves grow bold.$B$BThis is a sign that they are breeding beyond the vale's ability to sustain them. It's time to thin their numbers again.$B$BIf you are willing to aid me in this, you would have my sincere appreciation.

text.title: Blooming Blossoms
text.objectives: Collect 10 Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: Would you do a humble merchant a favor? I've been needin' to refresh my stock of eternal blossoms. They grow in the woods nearby.$B$BCould you help me out, perhaps?

english.title: Blooming Blossoms
english.objectives: Collect 10 Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: Would you do a humble merchant a favor? I've been needin' to refresh my stock of eternal blossoms. They grow in the woods nearby.$B$BCould you help me out, perhaps?

text.title: Lushroom Rush
text.objectives: Collect 12 Lushrooms.
text.description: Building a new village makes for hungry workers it seems!$B$BI have a hearty stew recipe prepared, but I need some lushrooms from the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east. Apparently there are roused spirits causing trouble up there though, and I'm not very well suited for the violent life.$B$BIf you're heading up the burial grounds today, could you collect some lushrooms for me?
text.completed: Return to Cooke Tope at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Cart Ride
text.objectives: Ride a delivery cart to XXX Village.
text.description: The vale has been quiet all morning. I'm sending Rook with a cart of supplies out to the XXX Village. You should join him.

english.title: Cart Ride
english.objectives: Ride a delivery cart to XXX Village.
english.description: The vale has been quiet all morning. I'm sending Rook with a cart of supplies out to the XXX Village. You should join him.

text.title: In Ashen Webs
text.objectives: Kill 8 Ashweb Spiders.
text.description: We used to have the trainees clear out the ruins of spiders as part of their training, but now we send them straight to the mogu front. The spiders have gotten out of control.$B$BCare to put things back in control?

english.title: In Ashen Webs
english.objectives: Kill 8 Ashweb Spiders.
english.description: We used to have the trainees clear out the ruins of spiders as part of their training, but now we send them straight to the mogu front. The spiders have gotten out of control.$B$BCare to put things back in control?

text.title: That's Not a Rock!
text.objectives: Kill 50 Ashweb Spiderlings. Use Kun's torch to burn them inside their pods.
text.description: Okay, these spiders are seriously creeping me out. Especially those egg sacs they leave lying around that I keep accidentally stepping on only to be covered in very little but very creepy spiderlings. Ug, makes me shudder just thinking about it.$B$BI say you burn them. Burn them all.

english.title: That's Not a Rock!
english.objectives: Kill 50 Ashweb Spiderlings. Use Kun's torch to burn them inside their pods.
english.description: Okay, these spiders are seriously creeping me out. Especially those egg sacs they leave lying around that I keep accidentally stepping on only to be covered in very little but very creepy spiderlings. Ug, makes me shudder just thinking about it.$B$BI say you burn them. Burn them all.

text.title: Runelocked
text.objectives: Retrieve the Ancient Mogu Artifact.
text.description: Hello, friend.$B$BOne of Leven's men brought word to me of a mogu artifact in the eastern ruins, but said he couldn't figure out how to retrieve it. I suspect it's guarded by one of their rune locks.$B$BIf you go to the artifact, you should find four runes somewhere nearby that when activated will release the lock. If you could bring the artifact back to me, I would be very grateful.

english.title: Runelocked
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ancient Mogu Artifact.
english.description: Hello, friend.$B$BOne of Leven's men brought word to me of a mogu artifact in the eastern ruins, but said he couldn't figure out how to retrieve it. I suspect it's guarded by one of their rune locks.$B$BIf you go to the artifact, you should find four runes somewhere nearby that when activated will release the lock. If you could bring the artifact back to me, I would be very grateful.

text.title: Runes in the Ruins
text.objectives: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.
text.description: In the walls of the ruins themselves, there are precious runestones that we can make use of back in the eastern vale.$B$BIf you see any while you are within the ruins, would you be so kind as to bring them back to me?

english.title: Runes in the Ruins
english.objectives: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.
english.description: In the walls of the ruins themselves, there are precious runestones that we can make use of back in the eastern vale.$B$BIf you see any while you are within the ruins, would you be so kind as to bring them back to me?

text.title: The Ashweb Matriarch
text.objectives: Kill Bloodtip, the Ashweb Matriarch.
text.description: My dear Kun spotted more spiders pouring out of the Guo-Lai Halls this morning, and when he went to investigate, he uncovered another spider matriarch inside.$B$BI need you to kill it.
text.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: The Ashweb Matriarch
english.objectives: Kill Bloodtip, the Ashweb Matriarch.
english.description: My dear Kun spotted more spiders pouring out of the Guo-Lai Halls this morning, and when he went to investigate, he uncovered another spider matriarch inside.$B$BI need you to kill it.
english.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Blood on the Rise
text.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on Ruin's Rise.
text.description: A small group of mogu have been sighted on Ruin's Rise, to the north.$B$BExtinguish them.

english.title: Blood on the Rise
english.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on Ruin's Rise.
english.description: A small group of mogu have been sighted on Ruin's Rise, to the north.$B$BExtinguish them.

text.title: Wulon, the Granite Sentinel
text.objectives: Kill Wulon, the Granite Sentinel.
text.description: One of the quilen statues in Guo-Lai Halls came to life and nearly killed my precious Kun. I won't have it! No one threatens my Kun.$B$BI want you to go in there and smash the thing to pieces. I'd do it myself, but I need to attend to my lover's wounds first.
text.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Wulon, the Granite Sentinel
english.objectives: Kill Wulon, the Granite Sentinel.

english.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Troubling the Troublemakers
text.objectives: Kill 8 Stonebark sprites.
text.description: The wood sprites are back. I need you to kill them before they cause anymore trouble.

english.title: Troubling the Troublemakers
english.objectives: Kill 8 Stonebark sprites.
english.description: The wood sprites are back. I need you to kill them before they cause anymore trouble.

text.title: 更大的危险
text.objectives: 击败8个科夏复国者。
text.description: 我得为我之前的恶语相向道歉。德兹科坚持原地等待，并且统一向西推进的做法或许是对的。$b$b在我们搜索西边的废墟时，魔古族重创了我们。他们利用传送门和某种黑暗魔法伏击了我们。自从离开外域之后，我就再也没见过如此邪恶的巫术了。$b$b我们需要休整一下。请你到西边去，杀死他们的召唤师，切断他们的运输线吧。

english.title: The Greater Danger
english.objectives: Kill 8 Korjani Reclaimers.
english.description: I apologize for my harsh words earlier. Dezco might have been right to wait and move west with a unified strength.$b$bThe mogu hit us hard when we were searching the ruins west of here. They ambushed us using summoning portals and some dark magics. I haven't seen such evil sorcery used since Outland. $b$bWe need a respite. Head west, kill their summoners, cut their supply line.

text.title: 重夺神器
text.objectives: 找回10件魔古神器。
text.description: 魔古族就是群恶棍，他们一直就是群恶棍。只有在传说中的魔古帝国时期，他们才会使用一些魔法。$b$b但这些魔古族竟然会用奥术传送门和法术，我们必须制止他们！$b$b$p，去找出魔古族用来施展魔法的所有神器，我看到很多收集者和复国者在西北边收集这种东西。

english.title: Re-Reclaim
english.objectives: Recover 10 Mogu Artifacts.
english.description: Mogu are thugs. They have always been thugs.$b$bOnly when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic.$b$bBut these mogu are using arcane portals and spells. We need to stop them!$b$b$p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw a number of their collectors and reclaimers to the west and north that were gathering these items.

text.title: Pomfruit Pickup
text.objectives: Gather 12 Pomfruit.
text.description: I need more pomfruit! Go knock some loose from the trees for me, would you?$B$BTake this, I use it when I go harvesting. Things go quicker when the fruit comes to you!

english.title: Pomfruit Pickup
english.objectives: Gather 12 Pomfruit.
english.description: I need more pomfruit! Go knock some loose from the trees for me, would you?$B$BTake this, I use it when I go harvesting. Things go quicker when the fruit comes to you!

text.title: Ruffling Some Feathers
text.objectives: Gather 80 Silken Feathers.
text.description: The hawk numbers in the vale are thriving. This is opportune for our fletchers, for we will need a great number of feathers if we are to keep the archers upon the wall stocked with arrows.$B$BIf you would not mind, could you aid us in gathering these feathers?

english.title: Ruffling Some Feathers
english.objectives: Gather 80 Silken Feathers.
english.description: The hawk numbers in the vale are thriving. This is opportune for our fletchers, for we will need a great number of feathers if we are to keep the archers upon the wall stocked with arrows.$B$BIf you would not mind, could you aid us in gathering these feathers?

text.title: The Pandaren Uprising Relived
text.objectives: Kill 8 Ancient Mogu Spirits.
text.description: In the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east, the spirits of ancient mogu are locked in battle with the spirits of our pandaren ancestors that rose up against them. The spirits have seen no rest since the return of the mogu to the valley.$B$BIf you would be willing to go to the graveyard and force the mogu to relive their defeat again, we might offer some lasting peace to the spirits of our ancestors.
text.completed: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 生存之环：火焰
text.objectives: 进入生存之环，并在不出圈的情况下坚持60秒。
text.description: 这是我的士兵必须完成的挑战之一，目的是为了让他们保持强大而迅猛的战力。让我们看看你的表现如何。$B$B在环中坚持60秒，保证自己不被推出圈外或被杀死。保持警惕。

english.title: Survival Ring: Flame
english.objectives: Enter the Survival Ring and survive for 60 seconds without leaving.
english.description: This is one of the challenges I put upon my warriors to keep them strong and fast. Let's see how you fare.$B$BSurvive the ring for 60 seconds without getting pushed out or killed. Stay on your toes.

text.title: 示警石犁村
text.objectives: 到四风谷的石犁村去。
text.description: 已经死了这么多人。如果韩大使关于螳螂妖的故事所言不虚的话，还会死更多的人。$b$b我们必须伸出援手，我们必须履行拯救生命的职责。$b$b到石犁村去，警告他们螳螂妖即将来犯。$b$b等我把科尔的遗体安葬好，我会召集尽可能多的人手加入你。
text.completed: 到四风谷的石犁村那去。

english.title: Warn Stoneplow
english.objectives: Travel to Stoneplow Village in Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: So much death. And more to come, if Ambassador Han's stories of the mantid are to be believed.$b$bWe must help. We must do our part to save lives.$b$bTravel to Stoneplow. Warn them of the coming mantid attack.$b$bI will join you with what forces I can muster once I have laid Kor's body to rest.
english.completed: Travel to Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 生存之环：刀刃
text.objectives: 进入生存之环，并在不出圈的情况下坚持60秒。
text.description: 这是我的士兵必须完成的挑战之一，目的是为了在和平时期让士兵保持强大而迅猛的战力。让我们看看你的表现如何。$B$B在环中坚持60秒，保证自己不被推出圈外或被杀死。保持警惕。

english.title: Survival Ring: Blades
english.objectives: Enter the Survival Ring and survive for 60 seconds without leaving.
english.description: This is one of the challenges I put upon my warriors to keep them strong and fast. Let's see how you fare.$B$BSurvive the ring for 60 seconds without getting pushed out or killed. Stay on your toes.

text.title: 火烧螳螂
text.objectives: 使用热油大锅击败残阳关附近的80个螳螂妖。
text.description: 螳螂妖又发起进攻了，我们在城墙那边有些人手不足。因为希望你能伸出援手，我为你留了一个有趣的任务：浇热油！$B$B这任务做起来比听起来更暴力，绝对的体面活儿。$B$B其实很简单。爬到墙上去，找到一个油站，然后把热油泼到涌向城墙的这些螳螂妖身上。这非常奏效。

english.title: Mantid Under Fire
english.objectives: Use a Hot Oil Cauldron to kill 80 mantid near the Gate of the Setting Sun.
english.description: The mantid are attacking again, and we're a bit short-handed up on the wall. In hopes that you'd help, I saved one of the more fun posts for you: the hot oil!$B$BIt's a bit more violent and a bit less scandalous than it sounds.$B$BIt's simple really. Get up on the wall, find one of the oil stations, and dump it on any of the mantid pouring up against the wall. It's very effective.

text.title: Lost Scouts
text.objectives: Recover 3 Shado-Pan Scout reports.
text.description: We sent some scouts towards the Five Sisters to the north to try and find whatever mogu leader has risen up to direct their movements in the valley. Few have returned.$B$BI'd like to think they're just off downing too much ale or being irresponsible with some young pandaren, but they may actually be in some trouble.$B$BCan you scout for the scouts? And see if they've turned up any information on that leader while you're at it?

english.objectives: Recover 3 Shado-Pan Scout reports.

And see if they've turned up any information on that leader while you're at it?

text.title: Upon the Ramparts
text.objectives: Kill 10 Krik'thik mantid on top of the Gate of the Setting Sun.
text.description: Some of the mantid have made it on top of the wall. There's some risk they'll route the soldiers we have posted there if their numbers are large enough.$B$BI need you to get on top of the wall and help clear out any that have broken through.

english.objectives: Kill 10 Krik'thik mantid on top of the Gate of the Setting Sun.
english.description: Some of the mantid have made it on top of the wall. There's some risk they'll route the soldiers we have posted there if their numbers are large enough.$B$BI need you to get on top of the wall and help clear out any that have broken through.

text.title: Roll Club: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
text.objectives: Complete the Vale of Eternal Blossoms roll course.
text.description: Follow the flags. Make the checkpoints. Round the loop. Get back to me before your time is up.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to roll.

english.title: Roll Club: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
english.objectives: Complete the Vale of Eternal Blossoms roll course.
english.description: Follow the flags. Make the checkpoints. Round the loop. Get back to me before your time is up.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to roll.

text.title: Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord
text.objectives: Kill Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord.
text.description: A giant mantid is terrorizing the inside of the wall. It seems doubtful that the defenders will be able deal with it without you.

english.title: Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord
english.objectives: Kill Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord.
english.description: A giant mantid is terrorizing the inside of the wall. It seems doubtful that the defenders will be able deal with it without you.

text.title: 帮把手
text.objectives: 摧毁8块顽石。
text.description: 我整个上午都在那边推呀铲呀敲呀，但毫无进展。$B$B这些石块还是纹丝不动！$B$B爷爷曾说过：“干农活就好比呼吸，仿佛微风拂面一般自然。”。对他来说或许是这样，可对我不是！$B$B如果我连农田都清理不了，我又怎么能开始耕作呢？$B$B嘿，等等，你看上去肌肉挺发达的。$B$B你愿不愿意帮帮我？只要能让我喘口气就好。
text.completion: What? You cleared the rocks? That's great news!$B$BMaybe now I can actually start growing something on this farm!

english.title: A Helping Hand
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Unbudging Rocks.
english.description: I've been pushing and shoving and hammering all morning, but it's hopeless.$B$BThese rocks won't budge!$B$B"It will be a breeze," Grandpa said. "Farming's like breathing!" he said. Maybe for him, but not for me!$B$BHow am I supposed to succeed at this whole FARMING thing if I can't even clear my farm for planting?$B$BHey, wait a minute. You look like you've got some muscle on you.$B$BWould you be willing to help me out? Just until I can catch my breath.
english.completion: What? You cleared the rocks? That's great news!$B$BMaybe now I can actually start growing something on this farm!

text.title: The Family Farm
text.objectives: Join Farmer Yoon.
text.description: D-did you hear what they said?$B$BIt's almost like they don't want me here. Like...I'm not good enough.$B$BSure I've never run a farm before, but I know how to plant a seed and how to pick a turnip.$B$B<Farmer Yoon's eyes light up.>$B$BYou know what? I'm going to show them that I can also become a master farmer!$B$BI'm going to turn this farm into one of the most prosperous in the Valley!$B$BIt's too much work for one pandaren, though. Come on! Will you help me?
text.completed: Speak to Farmer Yoon at [Your Farm] in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Will you help me?
english.completed: Speak to Farmer Yoon at [Your Farm] in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 学习农事（二）：耕种
text.objectives: 开垦两片未开垦的土壤。然后，在这两片开垦过的土壤上播下易种型绿色卷心菜种子。
text.description: 好的，现在我们有了种子，是时候种植了。$B$B首先，我们要准备好合适的土壤！你必须先开垦土地，敲松土块，为我们的小嫩苗铺好土层。$B$B开垦那儿的两片土壤，然后在上面播种。
text.completion: Nicely done.$B$BNotice how those seeds sprouted immediately? That's part of what makes this valley so ideal for farming - something about the soil here just makes veggies grow like crazy!$B$BThe work's not done yet, though.

english.title: Learn and Grow II: Tilling and Planting
english.objectives: Till 2 plots of Untilled Soil to create Tilled Soil. Then, use the EZ-Gro Green Cabbage Seeds on 2 plots of Tilled Soil.
english.description: Okay, now we've got our seeds, it's time to plant them.$B$BFirst, we have to prepare the soil! You gotta till the soil and break it up to make a nice bed for our little sprouts.$B$BTill those two plots of soil over there, then plant the seeds in them.
english.completion: Nicely done.$B$BNotice how those seeds sprouted immediately? That's part of what makes this valley so ideal for farming - something about the soil here just makes veggies grow like crazy!$B$BThe work's not done yet, though.

objectiveDetails.description: 播撒易种型绿色卷心菜种子

text.title: 学习农事（三）：照料
text.objectives: 在日歌农场使用生锈的洒水壶为两片干枯的易种型绿色卷心菜浇水。
text.description: 我爷爷曾对我说“小愚，卷心菜就像女人一样：如果你不理会她，她就会烂掉。如果你精心照料她，她就会变得茁壮丰满，你可以为她系上缎带，把她带去市集炫耀给你的朋友们看。”嘿，他那个年代就是那样好吧？$B$B重点是，现在我们的卷心菜已经发芽了，你要好好照料它们！它们今天看起来有点干燥，所以你应该给它们浇水。$B$B这是我爷爷留下的旧水壶。你要是想用的话，它就放在农田旁边。
text.completion: Great, the cabbages are tended and looking good!$B$BToday they were thirsty, but you never know what they might need. Pay close attention to your crops and tend them accordingly.$B$BI got all kinds of advice from my grandpa, so if you're ever unsure of how to take care of something, feel free to ask!$B$BJust make sure it's strictly related to farming...

english.title: Learn and Grow III: Tending Crops
english.objectives: Use the Rusty Watering Can to water 2 Parched EZ-Gro Green Cabbages at Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: My grandfather used to say "Yoonie, a cabbage is like a woman: ignore her and she'll turn rotten. Pamper her and she'll grow big and plump and you can put a ribbon on her and take her to market to show her off to your frie-" look, he was from a different time, okay?$B$BThe point is, now that our cabbages have sprouted, they need attention! Today they look a little dry, so you should water them.$B$BHere's the old watering can grandpa left. It will always be near the field if you need it.
english.completion: Great, the cabbages are tended and looking good!$B$BToday they were thirsty, but you never know what they might need. Pay close attention to your crops and tend them accordingly.$B$BI got all kinds of advice from my grandpa, so if you're ever unsure of how to take care of something, feel free to ask!$B$BJust make sure it's strictly related to farming...

objectiveDetails.description: 给干枯的易种型绿色卷心菜浇水

text.title: 学习农事（四）：收割
text.objectives: 从你的农田中收割两株易种型绿色卷心菜，并带给日歌农场的农夫老愚。
text.description: 我们的辛勤劳作要得到回报了！通常我们要等上一天才能收割作物。$B$B幸运的是，绿野给我们的种子是快速生长型的。这种作物不怎么值钱，却很适合引导新农夫熟悉整个流程。$B$B我们的卷心菜应该可以收割了。这种好事我当然要让给你来做的！
text.completion: Well, those are the basics!$B$BTill the soil, plant the seeds, tend to any threats, then wait for the results!$B$BToday was easy, but stay on your toes: my grandfather told me all kinds of crazy stories about farming at Sunsong Ranch.$B$BFarming ain't all giant turnips and roses, you know.

english.title: Learn and Grow IV: Harvesting
english.objectives: Harvest 2 EZ-Gro Green Cabbages from your field and bring them to Farmer Yoon in Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: It's time for our hard work to pay off! Normally we'd have to wait a day before the crops are ready to harvest.$B$BFortunately, those seeds Greenfield gave us were specially designed to grow FAST. The yield won't be worth much, but they're good for stepping new farmers through the process.$B$BOur cabbages should be ready to harvest. I'll let you do the honors, of course!
english.completion: Well, those are the basics!$B$BTill the soil, plant the seeds, tend to any threats, then wait for the results!$B$BToday was easy, but stay on your toes: my grandfather told me all kinds of crazy stories about farming at Sunsong Ranch.$B$BFarming ain't all giant turnips and roses, you know.

text.title: 学习务农（五）：半山市集
text.objectives: 调查一下农夫老愚房子下面的黑色泥土，然后给半山市集的吉娜·泥爪送去一份礼物。
text.description: 好吧，伙计，所有那些农活儿都只是热热身！$B$B准备好干点正经事了吗？$B$B半山市集是由一个名叫吉娜·泥爪的女士在运营着，就在街对面的南边。$B$B我听说她想买些蔬菜。既然你们是初次见面，两手空空总归不大体面。$B$B你为什么不去农场试试手气，看看有没有什么收获呢？$B$B要是我们能送新邻居一份礼物，那就再好不过了！
text.completion: Oh my, a marsh lily!$B$BHow did you know that these are my favorite? I just might take a liking to you, stranger.$B$BThank you!

english.title: Learn and Grow V: Halfhill Market
english.objectives: Investigate the Dark Soil underneath Farmer Yoon's house, then give a gift to Gina Mudclaw at the Halfhill Market.
english.description: All right friend, all of that farming was just for practice!$B$BAre you ready to try the real thing?$B$BThere's a lady by the name of Gina Mudclaw who runs the Halfhill Market, which is across the street to the south.$B$BI heard she's looking to buy some vegetables. Since it's your first time meeting her, you shouldn't go empty-handed.$B$BWhy don't you look around the ranch and see if there are any items hiding around?$B$BMight be that we'll find a good gift to take to our new neighbor!
english.completion: Oh my, a marsh lily!$B$BHow did you know that these are my favorite? I just might take a liking to you, stranger.$B$BThank you!

text.title: 蒙蒙的选票（一）：猢狲的烦恼
text.objectives: 去四风谷的郝瀚·泥爪屋外和蒙蒙谈一谈。
text.description: 我一直在想如何才能得到阡陌客的青睐，$n。$B$B现在，阡陌客每年都会招收新的成员，而投票理事会共有五名成员。$B$B我们已经拿到了吉娜的选票，现在只要和理事会剩下的四名成员交上朋友就能搞定了。$B$B你为什么不去跟蒙蒙打个招呼呢？他在西北边的泥爪农场和泥爪先生一起干活呢。

english.title: Mung-Mung's Vote I: A Hozen's Problem
english.objectives: Speak to Mung-Mung at Haohan Mudclaw's House in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: I've been thinkin' about how to get into the Tiller's good graces, $n.$B$BNow, the Tiller's Union accepts new farmers each year, and there are five members on the voting council.$B$BWe already got Gina's vote, but we'll have to prove ourselves to the other four members of their board.$B$BWhy don't you go over and say hello to Mung-Mung? He works with Mr. Mudclaw out on the Mudclaw's farm to the northwest.

text.title: 蒙蒙的选票（二）：兔妖坏透了
text.objectives: 收集10根被咬过的胡萝卜。
text.description: 该死的兔妖又回来了！$B$B它们咬烂了泥爪先生的胡萝卜，毁坏了他的庄稼。谁要为此负责呢？除了蒙蒙还能有谁！$B$B你得赶在泥爪先生看到前，把被咬过的胡萝卜都清理掉。它们遍布在西南边的田地里，地下的兔妖洞里也有。$B$B否则，蒙蒙就有大麻烦了。$B$B你能帮我这个忙吗？

english.title: Mung-Mung's Vote II: Rotten to the Core
english.objectives: Collect 10 Partially Chewed Carrots.
english.description: Dem virmen's back!$B$BThey been biting Mr. Mudclaw's carrots. Ruining his crop. And who is gonna pay? Mung-Mung, that's who!$B$BYou go get the chewed up carrots before Mr. Mudclaw sees. They all over the fields to the southwest, and down under the ground in the virmen's tunnels, too.$B$BOtherwise, Mung-Mung in big trouble.$B$BYou do this for me?

text.title: 农场物语（一）：杂草
text.objectives: 去四风谷的汇风岭和蓝盖谈一谈。
text.description: 嗨，$n，我最近一直在考虑扩张农田。$B$B看到那片被杂草覆盖的园地了吗？如果我们能除掉这些杂草，就能在这片土地上耕种了。$B$B我听说有个叫蓝盖的农夫，他对除草还颇有两下子。$B$B他的农场就在西面。去和他谈一谈，看他是否愿意帮助我们。

english.title: Growing the Farm I: The Weeds
english.objectives: Speak to Gai Lan at The Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Hey $n, I've been thinkin' recently about expanding my farm.$B$BSee that plot there that's just covered in weeds? If we can get rid of those weeds, we could use that land for planting.$B$BI heard there's a farmer by the name of Gai Lan who knows a thing or two about weed whackin'.$B$BHis farm is just out west. Go talk to him and see if he'd be willing to help us.

text.title: 翻滚俱乐部：蟠龙脊
text.objectives: 完成蟠龙脊的翻滚路线。
text.description: 以最短的时间到达城墙底部。$B$B准备翻滚时请告诉我一声。
text.completion: When they built the wall, I don't think they knew we'd be using it for this.

english.title: Roll Club: Serpent's Spine
english.objectives: Complete the Serpent's Spine roll course.
english.description: Get to the bottom of the wall in the fastest time possible.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to roll.
english.completion: When they built the wall, I don't think they knew we'd be using it for this.

text.title: Clearing in the Forest
text.objectives: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu in Winterbough Glade.
text.description: The Shao-Tien are on their heels. Most of them retreated to Winterbough Glade after their last defeat. We should press the advantage.$B$BTake the fight to these mogu in the clearing to the northwest. Let us leave them no minute of rest as long as they remain in the Vale.

english.title: Clearing in the Forest
english.objectives: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu in Winterbough Glade.
english.description: The Shao-Tien are on their heels. Most of them retreated to Winterbough Glade after their last defeat. We should press the advantage.$B$BTake the fight to these mogu in the clearing to the northwest. Let us leave them no minute of rest as long as they remain in the Vale.

text.title: Enemy at the Gates
text.objectives: Use a Shado-Pan Sky Serpent to kill 60 Krik'thik attackers, 3 Krik'thik War Wagons, and 3 Krik'thik Catapults.
text.description: The mantid forces are pouring against the wall. I've arranged for some flying serpents to cut away at their forces from the air.$B$BWould you be willing to take the reigns on one of them?

english.title: Enemy at the Gates
english.objectives: Use a Shado-Pan Sky Serpent to kill 60 Krik'thik attackers, 3 Krik'thik War Wagons, and 3 Krik'thik Catapults.
english.description: The mantid forces are pouring against the wall. I've arranged for some flying serpents to cut away at their forces from the air.$B$BWould you be willing to take the reigns on one of them?

text.title: Sparkle in the Eye
text.objectives: Recover 8 Shining Rubies.
text.description: I've been staring down into the waters of the lake, pondering life, love, and everything beautiful, and suddenly I realized that the sparkles in the water aren't just a reflection of my radiant personality, there are actually some sort of shining objects down there! Surely valuable.$B$BWould you mind taking a drip and relieving the lake's depths of its mysterious sparkles? Pretty please?

english.title: Sparkle in the Eye
english.objectives: Recover 8 Shining Rubies.
english.description: I've been staring down into the waters of the lake, pondering life, love, and everything beautiful, and suddenly I realized that the sparkles in the water aren't just a reflection of my radiant personality, there are actually some sort of shining objects down there! Surely valuable.$B$BWould you mind taking a drip and relieving the lake's depths of its mysterious sparkles? Pretty please?

text.title: 浸血的苍穹
text.objectives: 用残阳炮塔击败30只科里克提克螳螂妖。
text.description: 我们在大门侧面的哨塔上架设了多门火炮。如果飞行螳螂妖想和现在一样企图飞过城墙，那这就是扫荡天上敌人的最佳办法了。$B$B看来你已经跃跃欲试了，$n。

english.title: Bloodied Skies
english.objectives: Kill 30 Krik'thik Swarmers using a Setting Sun Turret.
english.description: We have cannons set up on the top of the towers flanking the main gate. They are our best method to clear the skies when the flying mantid try to pass over the wall, like they are now.$B$BLooks like you're on, $n.

text.title: 水上悲情
text.objectives: 获得18只林地萤火虫和5根细长的血羽。
text.description: 我爱钓鱼。但如果能找回我的鱼料和鱼饵，我就能更畅快地享受钓鱼的乐趣了。我跟我老婆之间有点误会……这些宝贝都被她扔掉了。$b$b<林间钓叟老朗叹息道。>$b$b难道就因为这点家庭琐事，就要让我一整天美妙的垂钓时光化为乌有了吗？绝不！只需要一些虫子和羽毛，我就能做出新的鱼饵，而这些东西林地里多的是。$b$b能帮我这个渔夫一点小忙吗？
text.completion: Finally, someone who understands me. Fishing is what it's all about, right?$b$bMaybe I should leave New Cifera... just pack up my things and join the Anglers, down in the south. Of course, I couldn't leave my family behind...$b$bBut still... a pandaren can dream, right?

english.title: Watery Woes
english.objectives: Obtain 18 Glade Glimmers and 5 Spindly Bloodfeathers.
english.description: I love fishing. I'd be enjoying myself much more, however, if I had my bait and my lures. They were thrown away in a... a misunderstanding with my wife, Rin.$b$b<Gladecaster Lang sighs.>$b$bShould I let a whole day of fishing be ruined, just because of a little domestic squabble? No! All I need is bugs and feathers, after all, and this glade is filled with those two things.$b$bCare to help a fisherman out?
english.completion: Finally, someone who understands me. Fishing is what it's all about, right?$b$bMaybe I should leave New Cifera... just pack up my things and join the Anglers, down in the south. Of course, I couldn't leave my family behind...$b$bBut still... a pandaren can dream, right?

text.title: 污鳞盗汗症
text.objectives: 从卡桑琅河的污鳞打击者身上收集6颗污鳞蛇头。
text.description: 仔细瞧好。这种毒蛇生活在附近的河流中，它们的毒液会造成一种当地人称之为“污鳞盗汗症”的病状。$B$B一些难民在逃离寺院的过程中被咬伤了，并且已有人出现了中毒症状：恶心、呕吐、盗汗、滴水不进，从而造成脱水甚至死亡。$B$B我们正尽全力研究抗毒血清，但我们需要更多的毒囊。你不用管摘取毒囊的事——只要把整颗蛇头带回来就行了。

english.title: The Murksweats
english.objectives: Gather 6 Murkscale Heads from Murkscale Strikers in Krasarang River.
english.description: Take a good look. The river nearby is swarming with these snakes. Their venom causes a condition the locals call "the murksweats."$B$BSeveral refugees were bitten as they fled the temple and have already begun to show symptoms: nausea, vomiting, and intense sweating as the body rejects all fluids, causing dehydration and potentially death.$B$BWe are administering anti-venom as quickly as possible, but we'll need more venom glands. Don't bother removing the glands yourself - just bring back the whole head.

text.title: 危险的小径
text.objectives: 帮助科洛·迷雾行者护送一队难民从朱鹤寺前往鹤翼庇护所。和科洛交谈以开启任务。
text.description: 正如我们在寺里常说的：“前门打虎，后门进猴。”$B$B我们迟早会对付煞魔的，但先要解决掉迫在眉睫的……麻烦。$B$B<科洛狠狠地将挣扎的蜥蜴人摔到石头上。>$B$B有几队难民正从寺庙前往北面的营地，但他们遭到了蜥蜴人的伏击。请帮我照料下一队前往营地的难民，然后我们再计划接下来的行动。

english.title: Unsafe Passage
english.objectives: Help Koro Mistwalker escort a group of refugees from the Temple of the Red Crane to Crane Wing Refuge. Speak with Koro first to begin.
english.description: As we say at the temple: "Never fight a tiger with a hozen on your back."$B$BWe will deal with the sha, but first we must see to the more immediate... nuisance.$B$B<Koro slams the writhing saurok HARD against the stone.>$B$BGroups of refugees from the temple are heading for a camp to the north, but they're being ambushed by saurok. Help me see the next group to the camp and we'll figure out our next move from there.

objectiveDetails.description: 陪伴科洛前往鹤翼庇护所

text.title: 斩断耳目
text.objectives: 在鹤翼庇护所周边地区杀死8个河刃密径猎手。
text.description: “被遮住双眼的猎鹰抓不到猎物。”$B$B这是我们教给寺内年轻武僧的第一课。它的意思是，即使如猎鹰般凶猛敏捷的敌人，在被剥夺了感官后也就毫无威胁了。$B$B蜥蜴人在附近遍洒斥候，为他们的后续进攻部队刺探军情。$B$B现在是我们除掉他们眼线的时候了，你认为呢？

english.title: Blinding the Riverblades
english.objectives: Kill 8 Riverblade Pathstalkers in the areas surrounding Crane Wing Refuge.
english.description: "A hooded falcon catches no quarry."$B$BThis is one of the first mantras we teach young monks at the temple. It means that even a foe as swift and lethal as a falcon can be neutralized by depriving its senses.$B$BThe saurok have scouts all over the region acting as eyes for their raiding parties.$B$BIt's time we put their eyes out, don't you think?

text.title: 不惧强敌
text.objectives: 在10名绝望的武僧或助祭旁边杀死煞魔，以鼓舞他们的士气。
text.description: 煞魔拥有神秘的力量，他们能使受害者产生强烈的情绪波动，直至崩溃。$B$B当我们从寺院逃离的时候，鹤翼的高手们奉命断后掩护我们。毫无疑问他们会遭受到巨大的精神冲击，而我担心他们还不够坚强，迟早会陷入绝望。$B$B$p，我们必须向他们证明一切还有希望！向他们证明绝望也是可以被打败的！

english.title: Sha Can Awe
english.objectives: Kill sha near 10 Hopeless Monks or Acolytes to inspire them.
english.description: The sha have the mysterious ability to evoke powerful, often overwhelming, emotional responses in their victims.$B$BAs we fled the temple, senior members of the Crane Wing order stayed behind to cover our escape. They are no doubt being subjected to intense emotional trauma, and I fear they are not all strong enough to resist falling into despair.$B$B$p, we have to show them there is still hope! Show them that despair CAN be defeated!

objectiveDetails.description: 鼓舞绝望的鹤翼防御者

text.title: 拨云见日
text.objectives: 在朱鹤寺杀死18只惘之影。
text.description: 关于“向雨挥拳”的部分……嗯，有时候你不得不这么做。$B$B“希望宛如阴云背后的太阳——浮云总蔽目，红日常在心。”$B$B看起来寺院中涌出的煞魔好像无穷无尽。但为了破开蔽目的绝望阴云，你就必须勇敢前行。$B$B幸运的话，你就会看到云层之后的红日……

english.title: Striking the Rain
english.objectives: Kill 18 Haunts of Despair at the Temple of the Red Crane.
english.description: Now as for that "striking the rain" part... well, sometimes you have to.$B$B"Hope is the sun behind a stormy sky - ever in the heart, but veiled to the eye."$B$BThere seems to be no end to the sha pouring out of the temple. But in order to see beyond the veil of despair, you must carve through it.$B$BWith any luck, you'll find a sun behind the clouds...

text.title: 朱鹤之室
text.objectives: 进入朱鹤寺的地下室，击败惘之煞。
text.description: “精钢之躯，溃于灰心——绝望总源于内心。”$B$B这是朱鹤在煞魔爆发前夕，给我上的最后一课。现在看来，这句话说得丝毫不差……$B$B$p，煞魔就是首先从寺院的地窖内发动攻击的……$B$B他的所有教诲，朱鹤之道……都是为了应对惘之煞而存在的。$B$B几个世纪以来，朱鹤一直在蓄势等待此战！
text.giverWindow: 一直徘徊在朱鹤寺的地下室中。

english.title: In the House of the Red Crane
english.objectives: Enter the basement of the Temple of the Red Crane and defeat the Sha of Despair.
english.description: "Broken are the bodies wherein hopeless hearts reside - the blight of despair strikes forth from inside."$B$BThis was the last piece of wisdom the Red Crane imparted to me, just hours before the Sha outbreak.  It makes sense now...$B$B$p, when the Sha attacked, they broke forth from the temple's basement...$B$BAll of his teachings - the very Way of the Crane itself... it's all been preparation for facing the Sha of Despair.$B$BThe Red Crane has been expecting this conflict for centuries!
english.giverWindow: Haunting the basement of the Temple of the Red Crane.

text.title: 奥法地牢
text.objectives: 找出并毁掉3个地牢镣铐。
text.description: 你是联盟的人？怎么会在这里？赞美艾露恩。$b$b我的队伍遇到了大麻烦。我们发现了一些早于艾萨拉时期的古老卷轴，并通过这些卷轴传送到了这里。$b$b不幸的是，石板上的坐标被施加了魔法结界，传送门没有把我们送到目的地，而是把我们抛在这个地牢中。$b$b我们在这里已被困好多天了，它正在汲取我们的力量来壮大自己。$b$b你能去找出附近几个与地牢相连的镣铐并毁掉它们吗？
text.giverWindow: 他的声音在你的脑海里萦绕。

english.title: The Arcanic Oubliette
english.objectives: Find and disable the 3 Oubliette Shackles.
english.description: An Alliance member? Here? Elune be praised.$b$bMy team has encountered a snag. We opened a portal to this land using some ancient scrolls we had found that predated Azshara's rule.$b$bUnfortunately, the coordinates provided on the tablets were warded and the portal that meant to take us to our destination landed us in this oubliette.$b$bWe have been trapped here for days, and it is slowly leaching our energies to power itself.$b$bCan you find the nearby shackles that bind the oubliette and disable them?
english.giverWindow: His voice echoes in your mind.

text.title: 鳄鱼传说
text.objectives: 去四风谷的新希菲拉。将巨型鳄鱼尾交给颜。
text.description: 这只鳄鱼怎么能长这么大？$b$b当然，传说存活至今的上古鳄鱼能够长到惊人的尺寸……但这雌鳄应该也不过十几岁吧。$b$b可能新希菲拉有人知道此间原由。

english.title: A Crocolisk Tale
english.objectives: Bring the Enormous Crocolisk Tail to Yan at New Cifera in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: How could this crocolisk have grown so large?$b$bCertainly, rumors exist of very old crocolisks that have grown to enormous sizes... but this female can't be more than a dozen years old.$b$bPerhaps someone in New Cifera can shed some light on the subject.

text.title: 破败的大厅
text.objectives: 夺回远古郭莱神器。
text.description: 在雕像大厅后面的郭莱宝库里发现了一个古代魔古神器。我们曾多次试图夺回这个神器，但都失败了。$B$B绝不能让神器落入韶天部族之手。我需要一个可以夺回神器的人，而且动作要快。$B$B你能行吗？

english.title: The Crumbling Hall
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ancient Guo-Lai Artifact.
english.description: An ancient mogu artifact has been uncovered in the Guo-Lai Vault, beyond the Hall of Statues. We've made repeated attempts to retrieve it, but none have been successful.$B$BWe cannot let this artifact fall into the hands of the Shao-Tien. I need someone capable to retrieve it, and quickly.$B$BAre you in?

text.title: 雷电
text.objectives: 击败秘烙。
text.description: 轰鸣声在郭莱古厅内回荡。魔古族唤醒了远古的野兽。很快，他们就会用它来对付我们了。$B$B我要你去找出通往翔龙大厅的道路，并在野兽出笼前将其击败。像这样危险而重要的任务，我也只能托付给你。

english.title: The Thunder Below
english.objectives: Slay Milau.
english.description: Roars have been echoing out from inside the Guo-Lai Halls. The mogu have awakened some ancient beast, and it will not be long before they attempt to release it upon my men.$B$BFind your way to the Hall of the Serpent and slay the beast before it can be unleashed upon us. I would trust no other with such a dangerous and important task.

text.title: The Silent Approach
text.objectives: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu at Whitepetal Lake.
text.description: <He leans over and draws a picture of what can only be a mogu, points towards the lake to the west, drags the blunt side of his dagger across his throat, and looks at you expectantly. It seems he wants you to kill mogu at Whitepetal Lake.>
