text.title: Burning Away the Filth
text.objectives: Burn 10 Shao-Tien Banners.
text.description: The mogu have erected their filthy banners around the lake to the west, claiming it as their own. Take this torch and show them what we think of their banners.

english.title: Burning Away the Filth
english.objectives: Burn 10 Shao-Tien Banners.
english.description: The mogu have erected their filthy banners around the lake to the west, claiming it as their own. Take this torch and show them what we think of their banners.

text.title: A Smashing Impression
text.objectives: Destroy the Shao-Tien Ritual Statues.
text.description: Sometimes I feel sorry for these mogu... maybe ripping out the spirits of other races is just their way of coping with family issues at home? Maybe we should be more sympathetic to where all this aggression stems from?$B$BOr we could just smash all their soul-stealing ritual objects down at the lake. That sounds more fun to me personally.

text.title: A Thousand Pointy Teeth
text.objectives: Kill 9 Knifetooth Swarmers.
text.description: The water has been frothing with danger this day! Some sort of swarming, meat-eating fishy nastiness has taken up residence in our lake! Deplorable. And just when I was considering stripping down to my nothings to take a mid-day dip!$B$BYou are adept in the ways of slaughtering any manner of nasty, are you not? Would you put your skills to use this day, in the name of pandaren everywhere desiring a swim?$B$BIt's a truly noble cause, especially with me among their ranks!
text.completed: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Wu Kao Scouting Reports
text.objectives: Recover 3 Wu Kao Scouting Reports.
text.description: There were some scouting reports unaccounted for after the attack. If we're lucky, they're still out in the village, but the mogu may have gotten their hands on some of them as well.$B$BIf you could bring back any scouting reports you find, it would definitely put my mind at ease. We can't afford to let the mogu in on our positions or any of the artifacts we've found, lest the men be in even more danger than they already are.
text.completed: Return to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Backed Into a Corner
text.objectives: Rescue 6 Cornered Mistfall Villagers.
text.description: Many villagers are cornered and scared, unable to defend themselves. You will need to defend them. Rescue them.$B$BGo quickly friend, save as many as you can!
text.completed: Return to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Mogu Make Poor House Guests
text.objectives: Kill 6 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.
text.description: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone.$B$BYou help?  Rook will tell Leven you helped.  Promise.
text.completed: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: My Town, It's On Fire Again
text.objectives: Use Mistfall Water Buckets to douse 60 fires.
text.description: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is on fire... again.$B$BWe have water buckets all over town, but no one can get out to put out the fires. Please, please, help us!
text.completed: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Freeing Mind and Body
text.objectives: Free 6 Dominated Guards by killing their controllers.
text.description: Mogu stealing peoples minds! Making them do evil things.$B$BDon't kill them, just kill the mogu, then they forget about all the mogu mind stealing and stop being evil. You should fix people like Rook is.
text.completed: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Stonebound Killers
text.objectives: Kill 8 Stonebound Quilen.
text.description: Mogu stone dog creatures chasing villagers and hurting them. Rook try to smash some, but they too fast.$B$BYou help smash some too?
text.completed: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Stunning Display
text.objectives: Collect 12 Stunned Whitepetal Carp.
text.description: I've been talking to Tantan here... again... and he insists that fishing is some kind of fabulous. I was skeptical, but I gave it another go. I'm not a big fan of that whole holding a stick and waiting method though, so I tried something a bit more direct.$B$BWould you be a doll and go collect any of the still intact fish floating belly up in the lake for me?

english.objectives: Collect 12 Stunned Whitepetal Carp.

I'm not a big fan of that whole holding a stick and waiting method though, so I tried something a bit more direct.$B$BWould you be a doll and go collect any of the still intact fish floating belly up in the lake for me?

text.title: Rude Awakenings
text.objectives: Kill 8 Dominated Paleblade Flesheaters.
text.description: The mogu are taking over the minds of the saurok at the lake to our west and turning them against us! The thing is, they were already against us, so I'm not sure they really thought this thing through fully.$B$BAnyway, Anji's the fighter in this pair, I'm more the lover, so I'm looking for someone to do all the weapon swinging and spell flinging and war crying and such.$B$BCan you go kill some saurok for me?

text.title: In Enemy Hands
text.objectives: Beat 8 Possessed Whitepetal Defenders until they're freed of mogu possession.
text.description: The Shao-Tien Mindbenders have taken over the minds of our defenders down at Whitepetal Lake to the west. Get down there and kill the mogu that are controlling them, but don't kill the defenders! Killing their captors should free them from their mind control.$B$BSooner would be better. Anji might try to go down there to help soon, and her ability to restrain herself when in the heat of things is not one of the qualities I married her for.
text.completed: Return to Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: NOT USED
text.completed: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: NOT USED
english.completed: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: Hard as a Rock
text.objectives: Destroy 10 Mogu Statues.
text.description: Hey! You know what awesome thing happened to me this morning?$B$BI was strolling through the ruins with Anji, eyes on the ground so I wouldn't step on anymore of those creepy spider pods, when one of the statues came to life and tried to smash me!$B$BAnji ended up doing the smashing. But I'm not satisfied. I think that you should go out there and smash all the statues, whether they're moving or not. It's the only way to be sure.

text.title: 大竞技场
text.objectives: 在大竞技场中击败20名影踪派受训者。
text.description: 我们有一些新入门的弟子，不过他们还远远不是你的对手。但如果他们一拥而上，可能也足以构成威胁。如果他们失败了，这次经历将教会他们何为谦逊。$B$B如果你已经准备好了，就进入大竞技场吧。不要对他们手下留情。

english.title: The Battle Ring
english.objectives: Defeat 20 Shado-Pan Trainees in the Battle Ring.
english.description: We have some fresh trainees that are far from being a danger to you, but in numbers, they may prove enough of a challenge. And if not, they could use the lesson in humility.$B$BStep into the battle ring when you're ready. Don't go easy on them.

text.title: The Eternal Vigil
text.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on the Golden Terrace.
text.description: Good to have you with us, $c. If you're joining the fight, I need more men out up at the Golden Stair to clear out the mogu setting up base there.$B$BCan I count on you?

english.title: The Eternal Vigil
english.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on the Golden Terrace.
english.description: Good to have you with us, $c. If you're joining the fight, I need more men out up at the Golden Stair to clear out the mogu setting up base there.$B$BCan I count on you?

text.title: Stone Hard Quilen
text.objectives: Kill 6 Granite Quilen.
text.description: Leven always says the only good quilen is a dead quilen, and I'm inclined to agree. You here to aid the cause?

english.objectives: Kill 6 Granite Quilen.

text.title: Set in Stone
text.objectives: Destroy 6 Mogu Effigies.
text.description: The mogu have been sending their narcissistic stone effigies onto our battlefield today. They're brining them to life up on the Golden Stair.$B$BThe bigger they are, the harder we hit'm. You in?

text.objectives: Kill 3 Subjugated Serpents.
text.description: The mogu have bent the will of sky serpents and turned them against us.$B$BThe defenders won't fare well against them, but you would. Head northwest towards the Golden Stair and remove them from the sky.

text.title: High Standards
text.objectives: Erect 6 Golden Lotus Standards.
text.description: If I had to pick the most important quality for a battle standard, it would be that it's standing up... and not on fire, but mostly the first one. So needless to say, I'm a bit concerned about our standard situation at the moment.$B$BIf some unknown $c were to be so kind as to take a walk out on the battlefield to our northwest and stand our standards back up, both myself and my extremely sexy yet somewhat commanding wife would be very grateful.

english.title: High Standards
english.objectives: Erect 6 Golden Lotus Standards.
english.description: If I had to pick the most important quality for a battle standard, it would be that it's standing up... and not on fire, but mostly the first one. So needless to say, I'm a bit concerned about our standard situation at the moment.$B$BIf some unknown $c were to be so kind as to take a walk out on the battlefield to our northwest and stand our standards back up, both myself and my extremely sexy yet somewhat commanding wife would be very grateful.

text.title: Given a Second Chance
text.objectives: Heal 6 Wounded Defenders.
text.description: A foolish contingent attempted to mount an offensive on the Golden Stair through the eastern pass, and were bombarded by cannons. Those that made it back are in bad shape, and there are still wounded out in the field.$B$BHere are some bandages. Use these, or any other healing skills you possess, and help get our wounded defenders back to safety.$B$BPlease hurry, there is little time.

english.title: Given a Second Chance
english.objectives: Heal 6 Wounded Defenders.

Those that made it back are in bad shape, and there are still wounded out in the field.$B$BHere are some bandages. Use these, or any other healing skills you possess, and help get our wounded defenders back to safety.$B$BPlease hurry, there is little time.

text.title: The Moving Mists
text.objectives: Kill 8 Fog Walkers.
text.description: <He looks down at the dead fog creature at his feet, looks up at you, then points out into the mists surrounding the lake. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these fog creatures.>

english.title: The Moving Mists
english.objectives: Kill 8 Fog Walkers.
english.description: <He looks down at the dead fog creature at his feet, looks up at you, then points out into the mists surrounding the lake. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these fog creatures.>

text.title: The Displaced Paleblade
text.objectives: Kill 8 Paleblade Saurok.
text.description: <He looks down at the dead saurok at his feet, looks up at you, then points out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these saurok.>

english.title: The Displaced Paleblade
english.objectives: Kill 8 Paleblade Saurok.
english.description: <He looks down at the dead saurok at his feet, looks up at you, then points out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these saurok.>

text.title: 正常任务测试例子
text.objectives: 给我东西。
text.description: 什么事？

english.title: Normal Quest Test Case
english.objectives: Give me stuff.
english.description: Yes?

text.title: 水，到处都是水
text.objectives: 和“飞翼”小雅谈一谈，向她借一只风筝，然后给汇风岭的35处干旱的土地浇水。
text.description: 你想帮点忙吗？$b$b最近天气变得非常干燥。我需要有人去给汇风岭的庄稼浇水。这么说吧：我需要你去给所有庄稼浇水。$b$b我在道路那边的飞行管理员——“飞翼”小雅那里存着一些风筝。去坐上一只风筝，然后往所有看上去又干又燥的地方浇水吧。

english.title: Water, Water Everywhere
english.objectives: Speak with Wing Nga to borrow a kite, then throw water onto 35 Dusty Spots in the Heartland.
english.description: How'd you like to make yourself useful?$b$bThe season's been awful dry lately. I need someone to water the crops out in the Heartland. Here's the thing: I need you to water ALL of the crops.$b$bI keep a few kites with Wing Nga, the flightmaster across the way. Grab one of those kites, then throw water on any areas that look dry and dusty.

text.title: 捉小鸡
text.objectives: 捕捉山掌的小鸡，直到你找到他的获奖小鸡为止。
text.description: 嗨，说你呐！你是$n吗？我有麻烦了，我需要一个腿脚灵便的人来帮我办这事儿。$b$b我的获奖小鸡跑出笼子啦！现在她一定跑到了外面，和其他母鸡、野鸟，还有……<哽咽>没安好心的公鸡混在一起了。$b$b我的农场在西边，摩天山脊的南面。你能找到她，并把她给我带回来吗？

english.title: Chasing the Chicken
english.objectives: Pick up Hillpaw's Chickens until you find his Prize-Winning Chicken.
english.description: Say, you there! $n, was it? I've got a problem, and I need someone with better legs than mine to help me solve it.$b$bMy prize-winning chicken has flown the coop! Now she's out in the open, mingling with the other hens, wild birds, and... <gulp> ill-intentioned roosters.$b$bMy farm is west of here, south of the Skyrange. Could you find her, and bring her back to me?

text.title: 害虫问题
text.objectives: 和维卡维卡谈一谈，然后踩死25只黑鼻土拨鼠。
text.description: 我的雇农维卡维卡一直在最西边的农田里耕地。我听说最近他那里在闹虫灾。$b$b他的杀虫剂足够对付那些吃我庄稼的害虫，但是我担心他对付不了土拨鼠。$b$b你可以去助他一臂之力吗？由于猢狲和兔妖的不断侵扰，我现在可承受不起害虫带来的收成损失了。

english.title: Pest Problems
english.objectives: Speak with Wika-Wika, then stomp on 25 Black-Nose Marmots.
english.description: One of my farmhands, Wika-Wika, has been tilling the soil in my westernmost field. I understand he's had some problems with pests.$b$bHe's got plenty of pesticide to spray the bugs that eat my crops, but I'm afraid he has no way to deal with the marmots.$b$bWould you lend him a hand? With rampant hozen and virmen attacks, I can't afford to lose crops to simple pests.

text.title: Free Spirits
text.objectives: Enter Spirit Vortexes and free 15 pandaren spirits inside.
text.description: I came upon one of the Shao-Tien Soul-Render's daggers. It radiates a strong magic. I've been told it should allow you to enter their spirit vortexes.$B$BThe mogu use these to harvest spirits and bind them to their will, but I'm hoping you can use it to free the spirits.$B$BEnter any of the spirit vortexes you can find up on the Golden Stair, and free all the captive spirits you find.

english.title: Free Spirits
english.objectives: Enter Spirit Vortexes and free 15 pandaren spirits inside.
english.description: I came upon one of the Shao-Tien Soul-Render's daggers. It radiates a strong magic. I've been told it should allow you to enter their spirit vortexes.$B$BThe mogu use these to harvest spirits and bind them to their will, but I'm hoping you can use it to free the spirits.$B$BEnter any of the spirit vortexes you can find up on the Golden Stair, and free all the captive spirits you find.

text.title: 第二次除草大战
text.objectives: 和蓝盖谈一谈，然后在他的农场里拔除100棵杂草。你可以在骑乘状态下拔除杂草。
text.description: 嗨……你认识农场那边的家伙吗，就是被……*嗝*……杂草困扰的那个？蓝盖，我想他是叫这个名字。我挺喜欢那小子，伙计。$b$b总之，他说过如果我*嗝*派一名冒险者去帮他拔草，他就会给我一些麦芽酒。$b$b就一点杂草，并没有很多。$b$b*嗝*

english.title: Weed War II
english.objectives: Speak to Gai Lan, then pick 100 Weeds on his farm. You can pick Weeds while mounted.
english.description: Ssshhay... d'you know that guy over on the farm, with the... the *hic*... the weed problem? Gai Lan, I think his name was. I love that guy, man.$b$bAnywayshh, he said that if I *hic* sent an adventurer over to go pick his weeds, he'd get me some ale.$b$bIt's jusht a few weeds, not too many, probably.$b$b*hic*

text.title: 金钱问题
text.objectives: 获得香料大师金椒的欠款、商人迦姆比兹的欠款、旅店老板雷岚的欠款和廖洛洛的欠款。
text.description: 我喜欢集市里的工作，但有一样工作实在令我讨厌：讨债。$b$b大多数熊猫人欠账只不过是因为懒得来付账，但是镇上还是有几个名声不大好的家伙就是不打算付账，还有一些人是因为太穷了。$b$b这座镇上有几个人欠我的钱。你能去和他们谈一谈，提醒一下他们关于欠钱的事吗？

english.title: Money Matters
english.objectives: Obtain Spicemaster Jin Jao's Payment, Trader Jambeezi's Payment, Innkeeper Lei Lan's Payment, and Lolo Lio's payment.
english.description: I love working in the market, although there's one aspect of this job I really dislike: collecting debts.$b$bWhile most pandaren debts are simply due to laziness, there are a few unsavory characters around town who simply don't want to pay, and there's some who are just too poor.$b$bA few people here in town owe me money. Could you go talk to them, and remind them about what they owe?

text.title: 偷了也不戴
text.objectives: 获得一顶被偷的头冠、一只被抢的戒指和一只失窃的手镯。
text.description: 几周前，一群蹦蹦跳跳的弹尾兔妖闯进我家，从我的保险箱里偷走了好几件珠宝。后来我找回了几件，但它们仍霸占着我大部分的收藏。$b$b如果你要去北边悬崖上的弹尾峭壁，你可得帮我留意那些珠宝，我很想把它们拿回来。

english.title: They Don't Even Wear Them
english.objectives: Obtain a Stolen Circlet, a Ransacked Ring, and a Burglarized Bracelet.
english.description: A few weeks ago, a group of those jumpy little Springtail virmen broke into my lockbox and stole several handfuls of my jewelry. I've since found a few pieces, but they still have most of my collection.$b$bIf you're headed up to the Springtail Crag, in the cliffs to the north, you should keep an eye out for them. I'd love to get my jewelry back.

text.title: 不许在吱吱后院撒野
text.objectives: 在昆森村击败8个昆森部族的成员。
text.description: 猢狲并不都是一个德行。吱吱的部族是森林猢狲……来自翡翠林。我们的部族很好相处。$b$b那些昆森入侵者……他们来自北方遥远的大山。它们一点也不像吱吱这么好。$b$b他们闯进我们的农场，抢走我们的东西，只留下一堆烂摊子。$b$b吱吱真想宰了他们。你愿意帮忙吗？

english.title: Not in Chee-Chee's Backyard
english.objectives: Kill 8 members of the Kunzen tribe in the Kunzen Village.
english.description: Not all hozen are the same. Chee-Chee's tribe was forest hozen... came from Jade Forest. Pretty easy to get along with.$b$bThe Kunzen invaders... they come from mountains, far to the north. Not nearly as nice as Chee-Chee.$b$bThey come into our green land, take our things, leave big mess behind.$b$bChee-Chee wants to kill them. You like to help?

text.title: 管用的招数
text.objectives: 扔掉8支昆森仪式蜡烛，踢散4堆烈焰余烬并击败1名昆森仪祭师。
text.description: 我观察那些昆森猢狲很久了，并注意到他们有一种特殊习惯。每当他们要准备进攻时，都会围绕着图腾举行古怪、野蛮的仪式。$b$b如果我们能打断这个仪式，不单会延缓他们的进攻，还能对他们的士气造成极大的打击！因此，到他们的营地里去给他们制造点麻烦，并尽可能地把场面搞乱！

english.title: Where It Counts
english.objectives: Throw 8 Kunzen Ritual Candles, kick 4 Blazing Embers, and slay 1 Kunzen Ritualist.
english.description: I've been watching those Kunzen hozen, and I've noticed a consistent pattern. Whenever they're getting ready to attack, they participate in strange, barbaric rituals around their totem.$b$bIf we can disrupt this ritual, not only will we put off any impending attacks, we can deal a huge blow to their morale! So get in there, rough them up, and make as much of a mess as possible!

text.title: 昆森传法酋长
text.objectives: 从昆森传法酋长身上获取一本昆森传说集。
text.description: 我曾听人们谈起过猢狲，说猢狲是由一群仅有一定自理能力的白痴组成的部族……但事实并非如此！他们也有大脑——只是不经常用而已。$b$b我听说昆森部族有两个酋长——一个负责指挥打仗，另一个负责管理故事、传说和历史。$b$b我真想看看他们的故事到底在说些什么……
text.giverWindow: 我其实不知道他的名字是什么——他们的传法酋长经常都会换人。

english.title: The Kunzen Legend-Chief
english.objectives: Obtain a Kunzen Legend-Book from a Kunzen Legend-Chief.
english.description: I've heard people talk about the hozen like they're just some tribe of barely-functional idiots... but that's not true! They have brains, too - they just don't all like to use them that much.$b$bI've heard that the Kunzen tribe has two chiefs - one in charge of fighting, and one in charge of stories, lore, and history.$b$bWhat I wouldn't give to see what kind of stories they tell...
english.giverWindow: I don't know what his name will be - they regularly elect new legend-chiefs.

text.title: 必须烧断绳子
text.objectives: 烧掉6条昆森绳索。
text.description: 我，呃……那个……$b$b噢，别在意。这是个愚蠢的主意。$b$b我在想我们也许可以阻止昆森猢狲的攻击，而不用……“杀死”任何人。我注意到山侧有一些绳子。我想他们就是顺着绳子爬到我们的农场里的，而且……$b$b不，还是别听我的。这只不过是一个愚蠢的主意。

english.title: You Have to Burn the Ropes
english.objectives: Burn 6 Kunzen Ropes.
english.description: I, umm... well...$b$bOh, never mind. It was a stupid idea.$b$bIt's just that, I was thinking that maybe we can stop the Kunzen hozen from attacking us without having to, you know... KILL anything. I noticed a few ropes on the side of the mountain. I think they're using them to climb down to our farms and...$b$bNo, forget it. It was a silly idea anyways.

text.title: 千年饺
text.objectives: 获得7罐腌制的蔬菜。
text.description: 用腌制蔬菜做馅儿的千年饺是我这里最受欢迎的食品之一。$b$b我通常把蔬菜放在房子下面的洞里发酵，但今天早晨我去查看的时候，却发现它们不见了！$b$b这都得怪那些偷东西的兔妖。$b$b把被偷的腌菜带回来，我会让你帮我做菜的！

english.title: The Thousand-Year Dumpling
english.objectives: Obtain 7 jars of Preserved Vegetables.
english.description: One of my most popular recipes is the Thousand-Year Dumpling, which is filled with preserved vegetables.$b$bI normally let the vegetables ferment in a hole underneath my house, but when I looked for them this morning, they were gone!$b$bI blame those thieving virmen.$b$bBring them back, and I'll let you help me cook!

text.title: 呛火辣椒
text.objectives: 获得4份呛火辣椒。
text.description: 这附近有几个熊猫人特别能吃辣。不幸的是，我要弄这些辣椒却并不容易。$b$b西边山里的昆森猢狲经常带着呛火辣椒。只需少许这种辣椒，就足够我用上一阵子了。$b$b我说，你能帮我收集一些这种辣椒吗？如果你打算直接用手抓这种辣椒的话，你最好得先带上手套。

english.title: Cindergut Peppers
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Cindergut Peppers.
english.description: A certain few pandaren around here prefer their dishes unbearably spicy. Unfortunately, my access to such peppers is limited.$b$bThe Kunzen hozen, in the mountains to the west, often carry cindergut peppers. A few of those and I'll be set for a few days.$b$bSay, could you collect some for me? You might want to wear gloves if you'll be handling them directly.

text.title: 松露蛋奶酥
text.objectives: 获得8块影光松露，并种植8颗影光孢子。
text.description: 我喜欢用松露烘焙……只要我能找到它们。它们只生长在摩天山脊上，而且数量非常稀少。$b$b它们是一种梦幻般的食材，但我们绝不能过度采摘它们。因此，我们摘一些就得种一些。给我带一捧成熟的松露来，并在原处种下一些松露的孢子。

english.title: The Truffle Shuffle
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Shadelight Truffles, and plant 8 Shadelight Spores.
english.description: I like to bake with truffles... when I can find them. They only grow up on the Skyrange, and in very, very scarce amounts.$b$bThey're a fantastic ingredient, but we can't risk over-farming them. That's why we need to replace what we've taken. Bring me a handful of adult truffles, and plant some of these spores in their place.

text.title: 高地美味
text.objectives: 在昆森村的篝火上烹制20碗炖穆山兽尾。
text.description: 你吃过炖穆山兽尾吗？就算你尝过，可能也会觉得那东西又老又无味。你瞧，要做出完美的炖穆山兽尾是有窍门的：你需要在高海拔的地方烹制它。$b$b我已经收集好了原料。把这口锅带到西边山上的昆森村去，用那里的篝火烹调炖肉。

english.title: The Mile-High Grub
english.objectives: Prepare 20 bowls of Mushan Tail Stew over the bonfire in the Kunzen Village.
english.description: Have you ever tried Mushan Tail Stew? Chances are, if you have, that it was stringy and tasteless. You see, there's a trick to making the perfect Mushan Tail Stew: you need to cook it at high elevation.$b$bI've already gathered the ingredients. Take this pot up to the Kunzen Village, up in the mountains to the west, and prepare the stew over their bonfire.

text.title: 肥美的山羊肉排
text.objectives: 获得4份肥美的山羊肉排。
text.description: 你知道吗？我今天想烤一些山羊肉排。$b$b不，我不会用他们在附近养的那种瘦小的角羊。它们身上没多少肥肉。$b$b<厨师拍了拍他的大肚子。>$b$b你觉得我是靠吃无脂山羊长成这种体型的吗？$b$b西边摩天山脊上有一些角羊……它们的味道会很不错哦。

english.title: Fatty Goatsteak
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Fatty Goatsteaks.
english.description: You know what? I think I want to grill up some goatsteak today.$b$bNo, not from the puny little shaghorns they keep around here. They don't have nearly enough fat on them.$b$b<The chef pats his voluminous belly.>$b$bYou think I got to this size eating no-fat-havin' goats?$b$bNow, the shaghorns up on the Skyrange, to the west... those'll do just fine.

text.title: 两害相权取其轻
text.objectives: 击败弹尾密径主母。
text.description: 和其他农村一样，我们这也会时不时地闹兔妖。$b$b最强大的弹尾兔妖生活在北边高耸的悬崖上，它们只在吃光了蔬菜时才会跑下山来。$b$b老实讲，我以前曾对付过兔妖。它们就是要严加提防的害虫，除了击败它们的主母外没有更好的解决方法了。就这么简单。
text.giverWindow: 你要明白“刀耕”的真正含义，邻居。

english.title: The Lesser of Two Evils
english.objectives: Slay the Springtail Warren-Mother.
english.description: Like any farming community, we have the occasional virmen troubles.$b$bThe most powerful Springtail virmen live high up in the cliffs to the north, and only come down when they run out of veggies to nibble on.$b$bFrankly, I've dealt with virmen before. They're nothing but a pest that must be kept in check, and there's no better way to do that than by killing their warren-mother. Easy as that.
english.giverWindow: Till and kill, neighbor. Till and kill.

text.title: 偷窃不好……但偷回来就没问题
text.objectives: 偷回16颗被偷的蔬菜。
text.description: 西边山上的猢狲一直在偷窃我的农夫朋友们的蔬菜。因为离半山镇很近，所以我很少受到猢狲的骚扰，可我的朋友们就没这么幸运了。$b$b在我看来，他们偷走的东西远比他们能吃得下的要多。如果你能在那些山上找到任何完好的蔬菜……就把它们偷回来！

english.title: Stealing is Bad... Re-Stealing is OK
english.objectives: Re-steal 16 Stolen Vegetables.
english.description: The hozen, up in the mountains to the west, continue to steal vegetables from my fellow farmers. Being so close to Halfhill, I very rarely suffer hozen attacks, but my friends have not been so lucky.$b$bSeems to me like they steal way more than they can eat. If you can find any intact vegetables up there in those mountains... steal them back!

text.title: 延缓劫掠
text.objectives: 击败12只昆森猢狲。
text.description: 西边山上的昆森猢狲们已经点燃火把喊起号子，准备行动了。根据目前的情况来看，他们马上就要发动攻击了。$b$b我们似乎已无法阻止这场劫掠，但至少可以在他们进攻之前削减他们的数量。

english.title: Stalling the Ravage
english.objectives: Slay 12 Kunzen Hozen.
english.description: The Kunzen hozen, up in the mountains to the west, have been acting up, lighting their fires and shouting their chants. Based on what I've heard and seen around here, that means that a ravage is coming.$b$bThere's not much we can do to stop the ravage, but we can at least thin their numbers before they attack.

text.title: 昆森狩猎酋长
text.objectives: 击败昆森狩猎酋长。
text.description: 据我所知，昆森猢狲有两个酋长。一个善良无害——他负责调配药剂、钻研医学和研究古代神话。另一个掌管着昆森猎手——这些猎手们最近一直在抢夺我们的作物。$b$b我们急需解决狩猎酋长这个大麻烦。如果你能去那里“照顾”下他的话，我敢肯定当地的农夫会对你感激不尽的。
text.giverWindow: 昆森狩猎酋长虽然都很勇敢，但通常都会摔下摩天山脊的悬崖。

english.title: The Kunzen Hunter-Chief
english.objectives: Slay the Kunzen Hunter-Chief.
english.description: From what I've gathered, the Kunzen hozen have two chiefs. One is harmless - he deals with potions, medicines, and ancient fables. The other one is in charge of the Kunzen's hunters - and the only thing they've been hunting lately is our crops.$b$bThe Hunter-Chief is a problem waiting to be solved. I'm sure the local farmers would be grateful if you went up there and, you know, "took care" of him.
english.giverWindow: Kunzen Hunter-Chiefs, while brave, will regularly fall off the edge of the Skyrange.

text.title: 猴子大破坏
text.objectives: 在失窃的武器堆、失窃的工具堆、失窃的啤酒堆和失窃的谷物堆附近放置一桶烟花。
text.description: 猢狲不停地偷我们东西，我们又不停地从他们手里再偷回来。是时候结束这一切了。$b$b<农夫老愚递给你一桶烟花。>$b$b去西边山上他们的营地里找到一些失窃的物资，把这些烟花放在物资旁边。但愿他们在看到爆炸以后，会认为我们的物资是性能不稳定的次品，从而停止偷窃的行为。$b$b这值得一试，不是吗？

english.title: Simian Sabotage
english.objectives: Use the Barrel of Fireworks near the Pile of Stolen Weapons, the Pile of Stolen Tools, the Pile of Stolen Beer, and the Pile of Stolen Grain.
english.description: The hozen steal from us, and we keep stealing our stuff back. It has to stop sometime.$b$b<Farmer Yoon hands you a barrel of fireworks.>$b$bFind some of our stolen supplies in their mountain camp to the west, and place these fireworks beside them. Hopefully, if they see the explosions, they'll think our supplies are defective and stop stealing altogether.$b$bIt's worth a shot, right?

text.title: A Weighty Task
text.objectives: Recover 8 Mogu Artifacts.
text.description: For the life of me, I can't figure out why the mogu would have built all their statues and such down in that lake. I'm sure there wasn't always water down there, but it still seems wickedly inconvenient should it ever have rained.$B$BAh well, who's to fathom the strange intentions of the mogu...$B$BWould you be so kind as to swim down there and bring back any artifacts that seem even vaguely carry-able? I'd certainly appreciate it.

english.objectives: Recover 8 Mogu Artifacts.

I'm sure there wasn't always water down there, but it still seems wickedly inconvenient should it ever have rained.$B$BAh well, who's to fathom the strange intentions of the mogu...$B$BWould you be so kind as to swim down there and bring back any artifacts that seem even vaguely carry-able? I'd certainly appreciate it.

text.title: Getting your Hands Dirty
text.objectives: Gather 12 Fresh Whitepetal Worms.
text.description: Some of the best fishin' in all of pandaria in this lake right here. I brought enough brew to last me all day, but I didn't think to bring any bait.$B$BWho can really remember such things?$B$BIf you'd be willing to gather me some bait along the shore, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?

Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?

text.title: Stick in the Mud
text.objectives: Gather 12 Whitepetal Reeds.
text.description: I came out for a beautiful day of fishin', but I didn't think to bring a pole. There are so many things to remember for fishin', I just can't keep it all in my head.$B$BThose reeds along the river look alright for makin' a pole out of. If you'd gather me some number of them, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?

There are so many things to remember for fishin', I just can't keep it all in my head.$B$BThose reeds along the river look alright for makin' a pole out of. text.title: Under Watchful Eyes
text.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Surveyors.
text.description: <He looks down at the dead mogu scout at his feet, looks up at you, then points out out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these mogu scouts.>

english.title: Under Watchful Eyes
english.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Surveyors.
english.description: <He looks down at the dead mogu scout at his feet, looks up at you, then points out out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these mogu scouts.>

text.title: Fiery Tongue, Fragile Feet
text.objectives: Kill 6 Stillwater Crocolisks.
text.description: I was kicking the water for fun again when one of those vicious crocolisks lunged out to try to bite my foot off! Rude! I have proceeded to rest my weary soles a few feet farther from the water, but I already look back on my water-kicking days longingly.$B$BWould you be so kind as to kill a crocolisk or eight for me? I assure you they deserve it for frightening me though.

english.title: Fiery Tongue, Fragile Feet
english.objectives: Kill 6 Stillwater Crocolisks.
english.description: I was kicking the water for fun again when one of those vicious crocolisks lunged out to try to bite my foot off! Rude! I have proceeded to rest my weary soles a few feet farther from the water, but I already look back on my water-kicking days longingly.$B$BWould you be so kind as to kill a crocolisk or eight for me? I assure you they deserve it for frightening me though.

text.title: To the Waterline!
text.objectives: Rig powder barrels in the hold of all six ships.
text.description: This is Sky-Reaver Stormhowl, captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh and commander of this operation.$B$BYour first task is to burn the 7th Fleet to the waterline while it's still at anchor$B$BCaptain Drok's marines will hold the harbor entrance while your team works.$B$BRig powder barrels in the hold of every ship and then regroup at the harbor entrance to inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse, who will trigger the exposives and signal the airship forward.
text.giverWindow: Operation commander and captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh.
text.turninWindow: Operation commander and captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh.

english.title: To the Waterline!
english.objectives: Rig powder barrels in the hold of all six ships.
english.description: This is Sky-Reaver Stormhowl, captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh and commander of this operation.$B$BYour first task is to burn the 7th Fleet to the waterline while it's still at anchor$B$BCaptain Drok's marines will hold the harbor entrance while your team works.$B$BRig powder barrels in the hold of every ship and then regroup at the harbor entrance to inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse, who will trigger the exposives and signal the airship forward.
english.giverWindow: Operation commander and captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh.
english.turninWindow: Operation commander and captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh.

text.title: 失落的王朝
text.objectives: 获得6块前朝石板。
text.description: 这或许有些冒昧，不过我能不能再请你帮我一个忙？我女儿，也就是我们亲爱的哨兵指挥官丽娅拉，不肯让我到野外去考察。$b$b我在地牢里的每一天都盯着北方的那片遗迹，渴望去探索一番。$b$b如果我的猜测是对的，那片遗迹中应该隐藏着找到传说中的青春之池的钥匙！$b$B请你去探索一番吧，$c！前往那片遗迹，收集仍残留有字迹的石板。

english.title: The Lost Dynasty
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Dynastic Tablets.
english.description: I wonder if I could bother you for another task. My daughter, the good Sentinel Commander Lyalia here, refuses to let me go into the field.$b$bI have spent everyday in that oubliette staring at the ruins to our north, itching to investigate.$b$bIf we are where I suspect we are those ruins could contain the key we need to finding the fabled Pools of Youth!$b$BPlease, $c! Go to those ruins and salvage any tablets that still have writing on them.

text.title: Poisoned!
text.objectives: Gather 5 Mogu Poisoned Blades from Mogu Reavers in the Lost Dynasty.
text.description: Poison... I... I can feel it... burning. Please, $p... grab... grab some of the mogu swords. We need... need poison samples. For an... ant... antidote.
text.completed: Speak with Lorekeeper Vaeldrin at The Incursion in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Poisoned!
english.objectives: Gather 5 Mogu Poisoned Blades from Mogu Reavers in the Lost Dynasty.
english.description: Poison... I... I can feel it... burning. Please, $p... grab... grab some of the mogu swords. We need... need poison samples. For an... ant... antidote.
english.completed: Speak with Lorekeeper Vaeldrin at The Incursion in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 青春之池在哪里
text.objectives: 获得都阳指令。
text.description: 那些魔古族可能知道青春之池在哪里。$b$b我们的斥候报告说在都阳废墟的南面看到一名魔古指挥官。$b$b去把他干掉，从他身上搜出有用的情报。这些情报应该能帮助你找到青春之池。
text.giverWindow: 你与牧师之间建立了精神通道。
text.turninWindow: 你与牧师之间建立了精神通道。

english.title: Where are the Pools
english.objectives: Obtain the Dojani Orders.
english.description: Perhaps these mogu know where the pools are.$b$bOur scouts have reported seeing a commander along the southern side of the Ruins of Dojan.$b$bKill him and take whatever information he is carrying. They should lead you to the pool.
english.giverWindow: The priest's mind touches yours.

text.title: 青春之池
text.objectives: 获得一些青春之水。
text.description: 向北！到北边去找青春之池，取一些青春之水回来，不过要保持警惕。$b$b魔古族已将那里列为了“重点”目标。如果康·棘杖没有赶上你的话，他会到那里跟你碰面的。
text.giverWindow: 你心中充满了紧迫感。

english.title: The Pools of Youth
english.objectives: Obtain some of the Water of Youth.
english.description: North! Go north to the Pools of Youth. Get some of the water but be on your guard.$b$bThe mogu list this as a "high value" target. Kang Bramblestaff will meet you there if he has not already arrived by your side.
english.giverWindow: A sense of urgency fills you.

text.title: 长生不老？
text.objectives: 观察瓦尔德林测试青春之水后的反应。
text.description: 有点……不对劲，这水有问题。$b$b我们刚这里时，我就感觉到圣光的存在。它很强大，且充满了活力，在遥远的北方熠熠生辉。$b$b我觉得那就是青春之池散发出的力量。但现在……池水好像被玷污了，被魔古族的法术玷污了。$b$b我最好还是先尝一小口，看看会发生什么。

english.title: Immortality?
english.objectives: Observe Vaeldrin as he tests the water of youth.
english.description: Something is... off. The water feels strange.$b$bWhen we arrived here I felt the presence of the Light, strong and vibrant, far to the north.$b$bI thought it would be the Pools of Youth. But this... this water is tainted somehow. Stained with mogu magics.$b$bI think it best I try only a sip and we see what happens.

objectiveDetails.description: 观察博学者瓦尔德林的仪式

text.title: 都阳的威胁
text.objectives: 击败6个都阳复国者，8个都阳勘测者和4个都阳暴徒。
text.description: 就在你前往废墟为我父亲挖掘石板时，魔古巡逻队杀害了我手下的5名斥候。$b$b这些人显然对和平的兴趣不大，而且跟部落一样不值得信任。$b$b但他们人多势众，而我们势单力薄。$b$b去西面的废墟杀掉一些魔古士兵吧。他们肯定抵挡不住你这样的$c。

english.title: Threat from Dojan
english.objectives: Kill 6 Dojani Reclaimers, 8 Dojani Surveyors, and 4 Dojani Enforcers.
english.description: While you were at the ruins dusting off tablets for my father I lost five scouts to wandering mogu patrols.$b$bThese creatures apparently have little interest in peace and are about as trustworthy as the Horde.$b$bThey are too numerous and we are too weak, however.$b$bGo to the ruins west of here and cull the mogu numbers. They won't be expecting a $c.

text.title: 飞掠杂碎汤
text.objectives: 收集5个完整的飞掠者腺体。
text.description: 隐秘大师恐怕得等一等了。看看那些人，$p。$b$B瘦得只剩下皮包骨了！他们一定是饿坏了。$b$B知道我们需要什么吗？一大碗热气腾腾的飞掠杂碎汤。$b$B在你经过附近的河流时，请收集一些完整的飞掠者腺体来，我可以用它们做一顿大餐。

english.title: Squirmy Delight
english.objectives: Gather 5 Intact Skitterer Glands.
english.description: The hidden master may have to wait. Look at these people, $p.$b$BThey are so THIN! They must be starving.$b$BYou know what we need? A big steaming bowl of Squirmy Delight.$b$BIf you find yourself near a river, try rounding up some intact skitterer glands and I'll cook up a batch.

text.title: 莲叶茶
text.objectives: 收集20片霸王莲叶子。
text.description: 魔古族还真是喜欢用毒药和诅咒啊，棘杖妈妈过去总是说莲叶茶可以治疗魔古族的诅咒。$b$b我看到都阳废墟附近生长着一些霸王莲。我们应该去采集一些莲叶随身带着，以防魔古族不干好事。$b$B而且，这样我就有机会让魔古族尝尝我的拳头了。

english.title: Lotus Tea
english.objectives: Gather 20 Imperial Lotus Leaves.
english.description: The mogu really like their poisons and curses. Mama Bramblestaff always said lotus tea cures any mogu curse.$b$bI saw some imperial lotus plants in the nearby Ruins of Dojan. We should go gather some of their leaves and keep them on hand just in case the mogu get unruly.$b$BAlso, this will give me a chance to introduce my fists to some mogu faces.

text.title: 猎鹤
text.objectives: 杀死12个鲤鱼猎人。
text.description: 打鸟的时候当然需要弹药——不过我可没有。而要跟着奈辛瓦里一起打猎，那就得证明你是有真材实料的，而不能只会夸夸其谈。$b$b不会打猎，就不要吹牛。可我这个人就喜欢吹牛，所以这就比较麻烦了。$b$b我可以雇你去帮我杀些鲤鱼猎手吗？你可以在西边的河面上找到它们。它们数量众多，所以不要犹豫，尽情打猎吧。

english.title: Crane Mastery
english.objectives: Kill 12 Carp Hunters.
english.description: Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up.$b$bCan't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good.$b$bCan I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here. There are a bunch of them so don't hesitate to hunt while doing other stuff.

text.title: 唯利是图
text.objectives: 获得12瓶虎血。
text.description: 我就说两个字：虎血！$b$b在黑市里，它比萨隆邪铁更值钱。尤其是我在外面放话说了，它还有着强身健体的功效。$b$b这座丛林里满是老虎，你能帮我收集几瓶虎血吗？我可以算你一份。

english.title: Profit Mastery
english.objectives: Obtain 12 Vials of Tiger Blood.
english.description: Two words: Tiger Blood!$b$bThis is gonna sell better than saronite back on the black market. Especially once I finish spreading a rumor about how it makes you all buff and stuff.$b$bAnd this jungle is just full of tigers. Can you round up a few vials of tiger blood for me? I'll cut you in on the scam.

text.title: 一个姐妹也不能少
text.objectives: 从魔古手中救出8名俘虏。
text.description: 当时我们正在搜索南边的废墟，不知从哪儿突然冒出一群魔古族袭击了我们。$b$B我们中的一部分人好不容易突围撤回了营地，但大部分都被抓了。魔古族还抓了许多碰巧经过那里的部落人。$b$b求求你，$p，尽量多救出一些我们的哨兵。$b$b让那些逐晨者见鬼去吧。

english.title: No Sister Left Behind
english.objectives: Rescue 8 captives of the mogu.
english.description: We were searching the ruins south of here when the mogu fell upon us out of nowhere.$b$BSome of us were able to retreat to this encampment but many others were captured. The mogu have also caught a number of the Horde who happened to be in the area as well.$b$bPlease, $p, rescue any sentinels that you can.$b$bLeave the Dawnchasers to their fate.

text.title: 重新夺回
text.objectives: 找回10件魔古神器。
text.description: 魔古族是不会使用奥术魔法的。$b$b他们就是群恶棍，他们一直就是群恶棍。只有在传说中的魔古帝国时期，他们才会使用一些魔法。$b$b但这些魔古族竟然会用奥术传送门和古代神器，我们必须制止他们！$b$b$p，去找出魔古族用来施展魔法的所有神器，我看到在南面的科夏废墟附近有很多这样的东西。

english.title: Re-Reclaim
english.objectives: Recover 10 Mogu Artifacts.
english.description: Mogu do NOT use arcane magics.$b$bThey are thugs. They have always been thugs. Only when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic.$b$bBut these mogu are using arcane portals and old artifacts. We need to stop them!$b$b$p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw piles of these items being collected near the Ruins of Korja south of here.

text.title: 切断补给线
text.objectives: 击败8个科夏复国者。
text.description: 魔古复国者利用传送门连通了昆莱山，从那里源源不断地获取援兵和补给品。$b$b更糟糕的是，他们还通过这些传送门运走俘虏。$b$b赶快去科夏废墟，把你见到的科夏复国者全部干掉。

english.title: Sever Their Supply Line
english.objectives: Kill 8 Korjan Reclaimers.
english.description: The mogu reclaimers are using portals to connect to Kun-Lai Summit, bringing in reinforcements and supplies.$b$bWhat is worse, they are sending their captives through these portals.$b$bGo to the Ruins of Korja and destroy as many of these Korjan Reclaimers as you can find.

text.title: 石犁村守卫
text.objectives: 对7个石犁使者使用霸王莲软膏。
text.description: 帮帮我，$p。这些可怜的熊猫人需要治疗，但我的力量已所剩无几。$b$b我在自己的藏书中找到一本古籍，上面记载了如何将你之前采集的草药制成药膏。$b$b把这种药膏涂到受伤的熊猫人身上，应该能让他们重新站起来。

english.title: The Stoneplow Convoy
english.objectives: Use Imperial Lotus Poultice on 7 Stoneplow Envoys.
english.description: Help me, $p. These poor pandaren are in need of healing, and my powers are weakened.$b$bI did find an old tome in my collection that allowed me to convert the herbs you collected earlier into a healing poultice.$b$bUse this on the injured pandaren and it should get them back on their feet.

text.title: 复国领主
text.objectives: 找到丽娅拉并击败碎地者勃罗耶。
text.description: 他们抓走了我的女儿！勃罗耶……那个复国领主！我能透过丽娅拉的眼睛清楚地看到他的身影。$b$b那个傻姑娘一定是想凭一己之力把他干掉。$b$b拜托了，$p！快去科夏废墟把她救出来。$b$b我会找康一起试着吸引勃罗耶的注意力，把他从废墟里引出来。
text.giverWindow: 复国领主

english.title: The Lord Reclaimer
english.objectives: Find Lyalia and kill Groundbreaker Brojai.
english.description: They have my daughter! Brojai... that Lord Reclaimer! I can see him clearly through Lyalia's eyes.$b$bThat foolish girl must have tried to take him head on.$b$bPlease, $p! Go to the Ruins of Korja and try to free her.$b$bI'll get Kang and try to draw out Brojai from the ruins with a distraction.
english.giverWindow: The Lord Reclaimer

text.title: 示警石犁村
text.objectives: 到四风谷的石犁村去。
text.description: 父亲给了我生命。泰兰德赐予我信任。我的哨兵们对我忠心耿耿。$b$b现在是我报答他们的时候了。$b$b勃罗耶一死，我们就能好好地收拾魔古族的残兵败将了。螳螂妖将是我们的下一个威胁。$b$b快去北面的石犁村，向村里的受害者伸出援手。告诉他们，我会带去所有能够集结的部队，帮他们的村子抵抗螳螂妖。
text.completed: 前往四风谷的石犁村。

english.title: Warn Stoneplow
english.objectives: Travel to Stoneplow Village in Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: My father gave me his life. Tyrande gave me her trust. My sentinels gave me their allegiance.$b$bIt is time I repaid them all.$b$bWith Brojai dead we can mop up the remaining mogu. The next threat is the mantid.$b$bGo north to Stoneplow and lend them your help. Tell them I will be bringing what sentinels I can muster to aid in the defense of their city against the mantid.
english.completed: Travel to Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 螳螂妖
text.objectives: 杀死10只伊克提克螳螂妖。
text.description: 螳螂妖！这些家伙突然就冒了出来，击溃了我们的护卫队，把我们的人都驱散了。$b$b现在它们正准备攻打石犁村。$b$b请帮帮我们，$c，在它们召集大军包围我们的村庄之前，消灭掉一些有生力量。$b$b如果我的表哥林大使还活着，并仍在护卫队的话，他应该会酬谢你的帮助的。

english.title: The Mantid
english.objectives: Kill 10 Ik'thik Mantid.
english.description: The mantid! They came out of nowhere and smashed our convoy to ruin, scattering our people this way and that.$b$bNow they are preparing to hit Stoneplow.$b$bPlease, $c, destroy some of these beasts before they get sufficient numbers to flank our home.$b$bIf my cousin, Ambassador Len, is still alive and at our convoy he should be able to reward you for your help.

text.title: 准备进攻
text.objectives: 获得先遣队哨兵的报告。
text.description: 哈！所以我父亲白白浪费了二十年的生命！$b$b从现在起由我指挥。$b$b当泰兰德将我们派来这里时，就非常明确的说过，我们只有找到她在预见中看到的圣光之源之后才能回去。现在很明显，青春之池并不是这个圣光的来源。$b$b我想让你去找到我的斥候。我派她去调查朱鹤寺，可她却一去不返。$b$b你去拿到她的报告，然后去最西边的哨兵营地跟我们碰面吧。

english.title: Going on the Offensive
english.objectives: Get Incursion Sentinel's Report.
english.description: Ha! So my father just wasted twenty years of our lives on a fool's errand!$b$bI'm taking charge.$b$bWhen Tyrande sent us here she was very specific that we not come back until we find the source of the Light that she saw in her visions. It's obvious now that the Pools of Youth were not it.$b$bI want you to look for my scout. I sent her to investigate the Crane Temple but she hasn't returned.$b$bGet her report and rendezvous with us at the Sentinel Basecamp further west.

text.title: Sea Snakes
text.objectives: Gather 6 Murkscale Heads from Murkscale Strikers in Krasarang River.
text.description: The rivers here are crawling with venomous aquatic snakes. Several evacuees were bitten as they fled from the temple, and already some are beginning to succumb to the poison.$B$BWe are administering anti-venom as quickly as possible, but we'll need more venom glands.$B$BI won't ask you to remove the glands in the field - that would take too long. Just bring back the heads and I'll take care of the rest.
text.completed: Return to Anduin Wynn in Redwing Refuge.

text.title: Hope Springs Eternal
text.objectives: Speak with Loon Mai in Stoneplow.
text.description: The Shado-Pan are likely dealing with similar outbreaks elsewhere in Pandaria.$B$BSeek out Loon Mai, the Shado-Pan Watch Commander in Stoneplow on the western end of the Valley of the Four Winds. Let him know that we have the situation here under control; the Shado-Pan need not send any aid.$B$BQuite the opposite, in fact - I will be sending many of my followers on pilgrimage, to bring a message of hope to those in need.$B$BThank you again, $p. Farewell.
text.completed: Speak with Loon Mai in Stoneplow.

text.title: 敌明我暗！
text.objectives: 击败烈日行者斥候。
text.description: 部落的烈日行者！就在你们到达前不久，我还看见他们的一名斥候在地牢附近巡查。$b$b我也不晓得他是怎么到这里的，但我知道他绝不是单独行动。他们从不单独行动。$b$b在他暴露我们的位置前，杀死烈日行者斥候。

english.title: Blind Them!
english.objectives: Kill the Sunwalker Scout.
english.description: Horde sunwalkers! We saw one of their scouts patrolling by the oubliette not long before you arrived.$b$bI don't know how he got here but I can guarantee you he isn't alone. They never are.$b$bKill the sunwalker scout before he reports our position.

text.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.
text.description: I offer you my heartfelt appreciation for your aid. Anji awaits you in the Setting Sun Garrison to the west.$B$BMay the day favor you, young $c.

text.title: 青春之水
text.objectives: 将瓦尔德林的消息带给丽娅拉。
text.description: 我的小丽娅拉，她就是太任性了。我早应该知道她会去挑战复国领主的。$b$b自从她母亲去世后，我牺牲了本该陪她的时间，一心扑在寻找长生不老药上，坚信着我们父女凭着这个就能永远在一起。$b$b现在看来，是我的执念让我的小丽娅拉付出了生命代价。$b$b帮帮我，$p，当她醒来的时候，告诉她我爱她。

english.title: The Waters of Youth
english.objectives: Give Vaeldrin's message to Lyalia.
english.description: She is headstrong, my little Lyalia. I should have known she would try to challenge the Lord Reclaimer.$b$bSince her mother died, I forsook much of the time I should have spent with her in search of immortality, insisting that we could live forever, together.$b$bAnd now my obsession has cost my little Lyalia her life.$b$bPlease, $p, when she wakes, tell her I love her.

text.title: 暗月朱鹤套牌
text.objectives: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把朱鹤套牌交给他们。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了朱鹤套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。

english.title: Darkmoon Crane Deck
english.objectives: Return the Crane Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Crane cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."  You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

text.title: 引出他们的头儿
text.objectives: 在昆莱小径上击败10个巴塔里部落的成员，等待巴塔里火战士出现。然后击败他。
text.description: 你一定是来帮助我们的英雄。$B$B快去干掉西北边昆莱小径上的巴塔里部落，直到巴塔里火战士冲出来找你算账。然后干掉他。
text.giverWindow: 去击败10个野牛人，把他引出来，然后干掉他！

english.title: Call Out Their Leader
english.objectives: Slay 10 Bataari Tribe Members in the Kun-Lai Pass until the Bataari Fire-Warrior appears.  Then kill him.
english.description: Clearly, you are a hero come to aid us.$B$BSlay the Bataari Tribe in the Kun-Lai Pass to the northwest until the Bataari Fire-Warrior is angered enough to appear.  Dispatch him.
english.giverWindow: Slay 10 of the Bataari Tribe Members to anger him into appearing.  Then kill him!

text.objectives: Speak to Rell Nightwind at the Glassfin Village in the Jade Forest.
text.description: $n, your friends have returned from their scouting mission. They need to see you immediately.$B$BI'm afraid...$B$BWell, I'd better say no more. You will see for yourself.

text.title: 多多益善
text.objectives: 为指挥官萧合收集12支箭。
text.description: 一旦野牛人的增援部队到达，我们将被彻底击垮。那样的话，我们将失去整个村子。$B$B你能不能从战场上取回尽可能多的箭矢？我有一个计划，如果你能提供帮助的话，我们或许能活下来。

english.title: All of the Arrows
english.objectives: Collect 12 Arrows for Commander Hsieh.
english.description: As soon as their reinforcements arrive, the yaungol are going to overrun our position here. If they do that, the village will be lost.$B$BWould you be willing to retrieve as many arrows off the battlefield as you can carry? I have a plan that just might save us with your help.

text.title: 救死扶伤
text.objectives: 使用跌打酒或你自己的治疗法术救助8个受伤的滨岸村战士。
text.description: 我们的战士正在西北部的昆莱小径和野牛人英勇作战。$B$B拿着这些药。这是我们家祖传下来的，疗效非常好。$B$B如果你没有治疗能力的话，就请你用这些跌打酒治疗我们受伤的战士。

english.title: Hit Medicine
english.objectives: Use the Dit Da Jow or your own healing to aid 8 Injured Binan Warriors.
english.description: Our warriors are fighting to keep the yaungol at bay in the Kun-Lai Pass to the northwest.$B$BTake this liniment.  It is a powerful medicine that has been passed down in my family over the generations.$B$BUse the dit da jow to heal the injured warriors if you do not have healing powers of your own to use on them.

objectiveDetails.description: 治愈受伤的滨岸村战士

text.title: Into the Wilds
text.objectives: Locate Koro Mistwalker near the Temple of the Red Crane at the southern end of Krasarang River.
text.description: Deep in the wilds rests the Temple of the Red Crane, home of the great Chi-Ji and his most devout followers. I suspect they'll know something about what happened here.$B$BThe temple is located on the southern coast of the wilds, where the Krasarang River meets the sea.

text.objectives: Travel to Dawnchaser Retreat.
text.description: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living.$b$bKor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle.$b$bTrack him down and lend what aid you can to him. We will join you as quickly as we are able.

text.title: 高效激励
text.objectives: 激励10个懒惰的猢狲。
text.description: 训练这群野蛮人可真不简单，$n。$b$b想办法激励他们非常容易；但问题在于怎样让他们保持干劲……保持专注……还有不睡着。$b$b既然你回来了，我想你可以帮我让这些纪律涣散的猢狲动起来，要使用什么方法取决于你，你懂的。

english.title: Sufficient Motivation
english.objectives: Motivate 10 Lazy Hozen.
english.description: Training these savages has been quite a task, $n.$b$bFinding ways to motivate them was easy enough; the problem is keeping them motivated.. and focused... and awake.$b$bNow that you're back, you can help me in getting the less disciplined Hozen moving, if you catch my drift. I'll leave the method up to you.

text.title: 我的儿子……
text.objectives: 在墨鳃潭找到武鹏。
text.description:
我的儿子——你能去把我的儿子找回来吗？

锦鱼人攻击我们的时候，他在慌乱中走失了。我不知道他们对他做了什么，甚至不知道他是生是死。

如果我失去了他，那一切就都没有意义了。我想找阿梅帮忙……不过，我有点信不过她。自从袭击发生以来，她变得太……冲动了。我不觉得她能把他安然无恙地带回来。

english.title: My Son...
english.objectives: Find Wu-Peng in the Inkgill Mere.
english.description:
My son - can you find my son?

When the Jinyu attacked, he ran off in the confusion. I don't know if they've done anything with him, or if he's still alive, even.

Nothing else matters if I can't find him. 

I'd ask Mei... but something's wrong with her. She seems too... impulsive since the attack. I just can't trust that she'd bring him back safely.

text.title: 复仇之怒
text.objectives: 击败15个暴怒的锦鱼人。
text.description: <宝剑女侠看来很不对劲。她眼中的阴霾一点也不像是熊猫人应有的。>$b$b我从没这么……愤怒过！这是赤裸裸的背叛！$b$b我在他们袭击的时候击退了他们，还顺手杀了几个，但是胆小怕事的商人施禄不敢让我继续追击！$b$b你，帮我个忙。杀了他们。通通杀光。

english.title: Enraged Vengeance
english.objectives: Kill 15 Enraged Jinyu.
english.description: <The Swordmistress does not look well. There's a darkness to her eyes uncharacteristic of the pandaren.>$b$bI don't think I've ever been as... as furious as now. What betrayal!$b$bI fought them off when they attacked, killed a few here, but Merchant Shi is too much of a coward to let me go and finish the job!$b$bYou, do it for me. Kill them. Kill them all.

text.title: 取回补给
text.objectives: 收集8包失窃的补给品。
text.description:
当然，首要任务是找到我的儿子。但如果我们拼死脱困只为最后落得个饿死的下场，似乎有些黑色幽默。

拜托了，请你去找回一些锦鱼人从我们车队偷走的补给品。

english.title: Repossession
english.objectives: Collect 8 Stolen Supplies.
english.description:
Of course, the first priority is finding my son. But, if we save ourselves only to starve, then what have we accomplished, in the end?

Please, I need you to recover some of the supplies that the Jinyu took from our caravan.

text.title: 给迪娜的礼物
text.objectives: 获得一块未切割的金绿玉。
text.description: 迪娜·泥爪今天在半山市集探望了她的妹妹。她是个非常善良的好姑娘，但要给她挑一件礼物却不是件容易的事儿。$b$b在北边的山崖上可以找到一种小型宝石，那宝石叫金绿玉，当你拿着它的时候它的色彩会不停地变幻。我敢打赌她没有那种宝石！$b$b到兔妖的洞穴里去找找看，我相信你很容易就能找到一块。
text.giverWindow: 她还真是衣食无缺啊！

english.title: A Gift For Tina
english.objectives: Obtain an Uncut Chrysoberyl.
english.description: That Tina Mudclaw is in the Halfhill Market today, visiting her sister. She's really nice, but she's really hard to get gifts for!$b$bThere's a little jewel that can be found in the cliffs to the north. It's called a chrysoberyl, and it changes color when you hold it. I'll bet she doesn't have one of THOSE!$b$bLook inside the virmen caves. I bet you'll find one really fast.
english.giverWindow: She already HAS everything!

text.title: 给吱吱的礼物
text.objectives: 获得一份正宗谷地小炒。
text.description: 你知道，吱吱那家伙其实挺不错的。我曾一度认为他只会制造麻烦，但是……我不知道。我猜想他是只与众不同的好猢狲吧。$b$b我们应该对他好一点。西边的山地猢狲有一份正宗猢狲小炒食谱，而且经常在他们的家里备着一碗那种小炒。$b$b我相信如果你去找一些小炒带给他的话，他会很感激你的。
text.giverWindow: 曼说猢狲的嘴巴很脏。可在我看来还是挺干净的……

english.title: A Gift For Chee Chee
english.objectives: Obtain an Authentic Valley Stir Fry.
english.description: That crazy Chee Chee is actually pretty neat. Mah always said that hozen were nothing but trouble, but... I guess he's just a better hozen then the rest of them.$b$bWe should do something nice for him! Those mountain hozen in the west make some really fancy stir fry, and keep bowls of it inside their little hozen houses.$b$bI bet Chee Chee would love some!
english.giverWindow: Mah said hozen have filthy mouths. It looks pretty clean to me...

text.title: 给阿烁的礼物
text.objectives: 获得一碗苹果鱼汤。
text.description: 阿烁——那个住在山上的女孩——今天也到镇里来了。我看到她向半山市集的方向去了。$b$b走了这么远的路……她一定饿了。而且我知道一个东西，她准会喜欢。$b$b摩天山脊上的猢狲会做一种用鱼和苹果制成的汤。奇怪的搭配，我知道……但是很美味。你会在他们巨大的仪式图腾附近找到那种汤。
text.giverWindow: 我可不想像她那样住在山里。

english.title: A Gift For Sho
english.objectives: Obtain a bowl of Yu-Ping Soup.
english.description: Sho - that girl who lives up in the mountains - is in town today. I saw her walking toward the Halfhill Market.$b$bSuch a long walk... she must be hungry! And I think I know just the thing that she'll like.$b$bThe hozen up on the Skyrange cook a soup out of fish and apples. It sounds gross, I know... but it's awesome. You'll find it near their big, scary totem.
english.giverWindow: I wouldn't want to live up in the mountains like her.

text.title: 给玉儿的礼物
text.objectives: 从昆森猢狲的棚屋中获得一个牦牛雕像。
text.description: 那个玉儿·采苇真古怪。首先，她的名字叫玉儿，这就很奇怪了。$b$b但如果你跟她聊聊，就会发现她是个好姑娘。你知道她特别喜欢小动物吗？$b$b我有主意了！西边大山里的昆森猢狲会雕刻动物雕像，并将它们放在棚屋里来震慑敌人。我相信玉儿一定会喜欢那种稀奇古怪的东西的！
text.giverWindow: 哈哈！她居然叫玉儿。

english.title: A Gift For Fish
english.objectives: Obtain a Yak Statuette from the inside of a Kunzen hozen hut.
english.description: That Fish Fellreed is kind of weird. First of all, her name's Fish. That's weird.$b$bOnce you talk to her, though, she's really a nice lady. Did you know that she's an animal lover?$b$bI've got an idea! The Kunzen hozen, in the mountains to the west, make little animal statues and put them in their huts to scare off bad guys. I bet Fish would LOVE something weird like that!
english.giverWindow: Ha ha! Her name is Fish.

text.title: 给艾拉的礼物
text.objectives: 获得香辣虾饺。
text.description: 那个可怜的艾拉，她太害羞了。我看到她站在半山市集里，饥肠辘辘却不敢开口告诉任何一名厨师。$b$b我们应该给她一些食物,而且不只是简简单单的一顿饭而已——要特别点的。$b$b昆森猢狲会用从我们农田里偷走的原料制作香辣虾饺。我不爱吃辣，可艾拉或许会喜欢的！
text.giverWindow: 我大老远就听见她的肚子叫得震天响了！

english.title: A Gift For Ella
english.objectives: Obtain Spicy Shrimp Dumplings.
english.description: That poor Ella. She's so shy! I saw her standing in the Halfhill Market, looking really hungry, but afraid to talk to any of the chefs.$b$bWe should bring her some food! And not any boring food - something special.$b$bThe Kunzen hozen make spicy shrimp dumplings from ingredients they've stolen from our farms. I don't like spicy food, but Ella might!
english.giverWindow: I can hear her stomach growling from way over here!

text.title: 给老方的礼物
text.objectives: 从巨大的平原鹰身上获得一根血淋淋的平原鹰腿，将其带给半山市集中的柯·铁掌。
text.description: 农夫老方很凶，还有点吓人。可曼总说他是山谷里最好的农夫之一。$b$b我想我知道给那种吓人的家伙送什么最合适。$b$b此处西边的小山丘附近有一些相当大的平原鹰在翱翔着。你可以去打一只下来，从它身上挑一块好肉，然后请柯·铁掌把肉烤一烤！
text.giverWindow: 诺米说他连小孩子都吃。

english.title: A Gift For Fung
english.objectives: Obtain a Bloody Plainshawk Leg from a Monstrous Plainshawk, and then bring it to Kol Ironpaw in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: Farmer Fung is pretty mean, and just a little scary. Mah always said that he was one of the best farmers in the valley, though.$b$bI think I know the perfect gift for a mean, kind of scary guy like him.$b$bThere's some big plainshawks that circle the hills to the west of here. You should get one, find a big piece of meat, and then ask Kol Ironpaw to grill it up!
english.giverWindow: Nomi said that he eats cubs.

text.title: 给老农山掌的礼物
text.objectives: 找到一颗蓝色淡水珍珠。
text.description: 老农山掌在他的农场里养着几百只小鸡……但那不是他真正的爱好。$b$b我见过。他一直在收集蓝色羽毛。$b$b我压根不知道这附近哪儿能找到蓝色羽毛，但是我知道一个地方能找到蓝色珍珠！$b$b去西北方的香蒲湖查看一下那些牡蛎，我敢肯定，一颗蓝色珍珠和他收藏的羽毛会很相称！
text.giverWindow: 那位老人家肯定很喜欢小鸡。

english.title: A Gift For Old Hillpaw
english.objectives: Find a Blue Freshwater Pearl.
english.description: Old Hillpaw has about a million chickens on his farm... but that's not what he REALLY loves.$b$bI saw. He collects blue feathers.$b$bI don't realy know where to get a blue feather around here, but I do know where to find some blue pearls!$b$bCheck the oysters in Cattail Lake to the northwest. I'm sure a blue pearl will look nice with his feather collection!
english.giverWindow: That old guy sure likes chickens.

text.title: A Gift For Haohan
text.objectives: Obtain an Enormous Cattail Grouper Tooth.
text.description: Haohan Mudclaw is the big boss of the Tillers union and the richest guy in the Valley! He's been nice to let me stay here, so I want to do something nice for him.$b$bHe likes expensive stuff, like ruby shards, but I don't have a lot of money, so I need to get him something else.$b$bI know! I've seen a great big fish in Cattail Lake! We should get one of its teeth as a gift!
text.giverWindow: I need to be nice to him if I want to be a farmer someday!

english.title: A Gift For Haohan
english.objectives: Obtain an Enormous Cattail Grouper Tooth.
english.description: Haohan Mudclaw is the big boss of the Tillers union and the richest guy in the Valley! He's been nice to let me stay here, so I want to do something nice for him.$b$bHe likes expensive stuff, like ruby shards, but I don't have a lot of money, so I need to get him something else.$b$bI know! I've seen a great big fish in Cattail Lake! We should get one of its teeth as a gift!
english.giverWindow: I need to be nice to him if I want to be a farmer someday!

text.title: 给贾古的礼物
text.objectives: 获得8个老愚的苹果和50个老愚的蔓越莓，然后将它们带给博布·铁掌并酿成莓果烈酒。
text.description: 有时候我真替贾古感到难过，他是附近唯一的锦鱼人，而且我看他也没有多少朋友。当然，除了他的酒瓶子。$b$b你猜怎么着？我有主意了。老愚的屋子里刚好有一筐蔓越莓，还有一些苹果。我觉得你可以把它们带到半山市集的蒸馏大师那里去，然后请他为贾古酿造一些特别的东西。
text.giverWindow: 他呼出的空气闻着很像我叔叔。

english.title: A Gift For Jogu
english.objectives: Obtain 8 of Yoon's Apples and 50 of Yoon's Craneberries, then bring them to Bobo Ironpaw to brew into Apple-Berry Hooch.
english.description: Sometimes I feel sad for Jogu. He's the only jinyu around, and I don't think he has any friends. Other than his smelly bottle, of course.$b$bYou know what? I've got an idea. Farmer Yoon has a basket of craneberries inside his house, and a few apples as well. I'm sure you could bring them to the stillmaster in the Halfhill Market and get him to brew something special for Jogu.
english.giverWindow: His breath smells like my uncle.

text.title: 给吉娜的礼物
text.objectives: 获得一朵金火兰。
text.description: 你见过那个集市老板娘吉娜·泥爪了吗？她拥有着一切——美貌、智慧和一个漂亮的大圆肚。你能代我给她送去一份礼物么？$b$b我想摘一些长在西边山丘顶上的兰花送给她，但是我爬不了那么高。你能摘一些送给吉娜吗？$b$b噢对了，当你见到她的时候……请替我向她问好。
text.turninWindow: 我觉得她又善良又美丽。你可千万别告诉她这是我说的！

english.title: A Gift For Gina
english.objectives: Obtain a Goldenfire Orchid.
english.description: Have you seen Gina Mudclaw, the market girl? She has it all - looks, brains, and nice big tummy. Could you deliver a gift for me?$b$bI wanted to pick some orchids that grow on top of the big hills to the west, but I can't climb that high. Could you pick a few and bring them to Gina?$b$bOh, and when you see her... tell her I said "hi".
english.giverWindow: <Sigh...>
english.turninWindow: I think she is very nice and pretty. Don't tell her that I said that!

text.title: 仪式
text.objectives: 和水语者苟莱谈一谈并完成仪式。
text.description:
在初次浮出水面的那一刻，我就知道我注定要成为一名水语者。

我学会了很多仪式，也曾一一举行过，只有一个除外。

那是个极其古老的仪式。我们都被反复教导，只有当我们的同胞自相残杀时，才能举行这种仪式。

而有史以来，我们的村子从没有发生过这种情况。

但我想现在是时候了。

english.title: The Ritual
english.objectives: Speak with Waterspeaker Gorai, and then complete the Ritual.
english.description:
From the moment I first rose from the river, I knew I was destined to be Waterspeaker.

I was taught many rituals, and have performed all of them, save one.

There was one, an extremely ancient one, that we were told to call upon if our people ever turned against us. 

This must have happened in our people's distant past, because we haven't needed to use it in our village's memory.

I suppose now is the time to do so.

objectiveDetails.description: 与水语者苟莱交谈开始仪式
让死亡的墨鳃锦鱼人安息

text.title: The Soul-Gatherer
text.objectives: Kill Shadowmaster Sydow and recover the beads from his corpse.
text.description: A single large mogu performing a ritual on the lake caught your attention while you were killing the other mogu in the area. It seems unwise to let his ritual complete.

english.title: The Soul-Gatherer
english.objectives: Kill Shadowmaster Sydow and recover the beads from his corpse.
english.description: A single large mogu performing a ritual on the lake caught your attention while you were killing the other mogu in the area. It seems unwise to let his ritual complete.

text.title: NOT USED
text.completed: Return to Ren Firetongue at the Twin Monoliths in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: NOT USED
english.completed: Return to Ren Firetongue at the Twin Monoliths in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 评估进度
text.objectives: 听取匿踪大师琪麟、利维特·急刹、夏琪亚和里克的报告。
text.description: 开战的时机就在眼前，$n！$b$b自从你离开之后，我们就一刻不停地训练着这些土著，我相信他们已经达到了最佳状态。$b$b你可以亲自去看看。听一听其他人的报告，然后向我回报你的发现。$b$b我们必须指望敌人由于某种原因……疏于备战。

english.title: Gauging Our Progress
english.objectives: Check in with Shademaster Kiryn, Rivett Clutchpop, Shokia, and Riko.
english.description: The time for war is at hand, $n!$b$bWe've been training these natives non-stop since you left, and I believe they're as good as they're going to get.$b$bSee for yourself. Check in with the others and return with your findings.$b$bWe must rely on our enemy being somehow... even less prepared.

text.title: 最后一块拼图
text.objectives: 在青龙瞭望台上的周家神龛使用周氏传家宝。$b$b和米师谈一谈，他会带你过去的。
text.description: 这些猢狲的行为太不同寻常了，$n。列队站好？全副武装？$b$b这可给我出了个难题。无论如何，我们必须下次再讨论这件事。我此行是来请求你的协助。$b$b我们上次谈到的古代壁画，已经快要重见天日了。我很确定其中包含着某种古老的智慧，就是皇帝希望我们找回的知识。$b$b我独自一人进行冥想可能不足以领悟其中的含义。请将这个传家宝带到我祖先的神龛。我将请求他们的帮助。

english.title: Last Piece of the Puzzle
english.objectives: Use Cho's Heirloom at Cho's Family Shrine on Serpent's Overlook.$b$bSpeak with Mishi for transportation.
english.description: These hozen are behaving most unnaturally, $n. Marching in formation? In armor?$b$bThis troubles me. We must discuss it at another time, however. I have come to ask for your assistance.$b$bThe ancient fresco, where last we spoke, is nearly unveiled. I am certain that it holds ancient wisdom - knowledge that the emperor wanted us to remember.$b$bMy meditations alone may not be enough to discern its meaning. Please, take this heirloom to the shrine of my ancestors. I shall require their assistance.

objectiveDetails.description: 将传家宝放入周家神龛

text.title: 环山路
text.objectives: 护送马车和向导安全登上不息山。
text.description: 山间小路非常危险，你需要很好的运气才能活着走出来。表侄弯指甲会给你带路的。$b$b也许今天就是个好日子。风从东边吹来，这是个好兆头。在东风吹起时，土地精的旅程总是很顺利。$b$b当你做好出发的准备后，就上车吧。

english.title: Comin' Round the Mountain
english.objectives: Escort the cart and guides safely up Neverest Mountain.
english.description: The mountain pass is very dangerous. You need much luck to survive. Nephew Bentnail will show you the way.$b$bPerhaps today is a lucky day to travel though. Wind blows from the east; this is good sign. Grummles always travel best when east wind blows.$b$bClimb in the cart when you are ready to leave.

text.title: 找回麝香爪
text.objectives: 去顽灵洞找到小麝香爪。
text.description: 你到底是什么鬼东西？一个$c？从来没听说过。你来这儿也是打算偷我的牛的吗？$b$b听着，如果你想帮忙的话，就去帮我把儿子找回来吧。他被一群林精抓去了，而且很可能不知道我们失去了牧场。$b$b那些林精把他抓到了东南边的顽灵洞。把他救回来，我会给你些东西报答你。
text.completed: 去昆莱山的顽灵洞和小麝香爪谈一谈。

english.title: The Missing Muskpaw
english.objectives: Find Muskpaw Jr. in Pranksters' Hollow.
english.description: What the heck are you supposed to be? A $c? Never heard of one of them. You here to help or to steal my yaks?$b$bLook, if yer' insistin' on helpin' out, go find my boy. He got himself grabbed by a bunch of sprites and probably doesn't even know we lost the ranch.$b$bThey dragged him off to Pranksters' Hollow south east of here. Go rescue him an' I'll see about giving you a reward of some sort.
english.completed: Speak with Muskpaw Jr. at Pranksters' Hollow in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 鲜松针的香味
text.objectives: 收集100根提神松针。
text.description: 如果你真是来帮忙的，就去顽灵洞帮我搞一些林精身上的松针来。$b$b土地精觉得好运气是可以闻得到的。如果能让牦牛散发出那种鲜松针的香味，他们就会出更高的价钱。

english.title: Fresh Needle Scent
english.objectives: Gather 100 Pungent Sprite Needles.
english.description: Say, if you really are here to help, I could use me some needles off them sprites in Pranksters' Hollow.$b$bThe grummles don't believe in luck they can't smell. They'll pay better for yaks that have that fresh needle scent.

text.title: Yakity Yak
text.objectives: Kill 9 Burilgi Despoilers at the Muskpaw Ranch.
text.description: Yaungols! They come through here taking what they want and destroying whatever's left.$b$bI can't have these thugs destroy the last pieces of the Yak Wash here. It's all my boy and I have left.$b$bHead over to our old ranch and dish out some pain on them yaungols. I bet if you kill enough of them they'll think twice before attacking anything in this area.

english.title: Yakity Yak
english.objectives: Kill 9 Burilgi Despoilers at the Muskpaw Ranch.
english.description: Yaungols! They come through here taking what they want and destroying whatever's left.$b$bI can't have these thugs destroy the last pieces of the Yak Wash here. It's all my boy and I have left.$b$bHead over to our old ranch and dish out some pain on them yaungols. I bet if you kill enough of them they'll think twice before attacking anything in this area.

text.title: 洗牛站
text.objectives: 把6头逃走的牦牛带到父子洗牛站的清洗入口处。
text.description: 听着，我爸疯了。虽然我很爱他，但他真的疯了。$b$b那些野牛人彻底毁掉了我们的农场，并且把我们的牦牛都给放跑了。$b$b如果我没料错的话，我爸一定会去和那些野牛人硬碰硬，让他们把我们的牛还回来。$b$b你能不能帮我们找回一些牛，免得他去做了傻事？$b$b你只需要把它们赶到洗牛站就行，到时候再给它们清洗一下就可以把它们卖给那些土地精了。

english.title: At the Yak Wash
english.objectives: Bring 6 Escaped Yaks to the Wash Entrance at Lao & Son's Yak Wash.
english.description: Look, my father is crazy. I love him, but he's crazy.$b$bThese yaungol managed to completely obliterate our ranch and scattered our yaks every which way.$b$bIf I know my father though, he's going to try to go head to head with the yaungol to get the yaks back.$b$bCan you help us round up some of the yaks so my father doesn't do anything stupid?$b$bJust ride them over to the Yak Wash so we can clean them up and sell them to the grummles.

text.title: 再说牦牛
text.objectives: 把清洗干净的牦牛给昆莱山土地精集市上的八铜钱送去。如果你把牛弄丢了，就回去找小麝香爪。
text.description: 对于你的报酬，我不会赖账。把这些清洗干净的牦牛给土地精商队首领八铜钱送去。$b$b你可以在西边的土地精集市找到他。他会给我们记账，然后给你一点送货费。$b$b他的个子或许不高，但他却是我们最大的客户。$b$b如果你把牛弄丢了，记得回来找我。它们常常会直接跑回来。一旦把它们洗干净了，它们就会这样。

english.title: Back in Yak
english.objectives: Bring the Washed Yaks to Lucky Eightcoins at the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit. Return to Muskpaw Jr. if you lose your yaks.
english.description: I wasn't lying about your reward. Here, take these washed yaks to the grummle caravan master Eightcoins.$b$bYou can find him at the Grummle Bazaar west of here. He'll credit us and give you a delivery fee.$b$bHe may be short, but he is our biggest customer.$b$bReturn to me if you lose the yaks. More often than not they just come right back here anyway. Once they've been cleaned that is.

objectiveDetails.description: 将牦牛群带给好运的八铜钱

text.title: 爱的劳动
text.objectives: 把玉石交给历史学家丁先生、勘测员萨瓦、风筝大师卓续和监工艾米。
text.description: 再帮我个忙好吗？$B$B我们的工期已经延误了，但还需要再运送这最后一玉石来完成这座伟大的雕像。$B$B我忙不过来了，你能帮我把这块玉石带去给其他工头吗？$B$B你可以在雕像底座附近找到历史学家丁先生、勘测员萨瓦、和风筝大师卓续。监工艾米正在雕像顶部指挥工作。$B$B我们时间不多了，一定要快一点！别浪费时间了！
text.completion: What, done already? You're quite the runner, $c. You ever thought about making a living out of this?

english.title: Love's Labor
english.objectives: Deliver the jade to Historian Dinh, Surveyor Sawa, Kitemaster Shoku, and Taskmaster Emi.
english.description: Can I trouble you for another favor?$B$BWe're way behind schedule, and this jade shipment is the last we need to finish the great statue.$B$BI've got my hands full, so could you run this ore over to the other foremen?$B$BHistorian Dinh, Surveyor Sawa, and Kitemaster Shoku can all be found around the base of the statue. Taskmaster Emi is directing production at the top of the statue.$B$BWe're on a deadline, so make sure you do it fast! Time's a wasting!
english.completion: What, done already? You're quite the runner, $c. You ever thought about making a living out of this?

text.title: 水语者的法杖
text.objectives: 从墨鳃潭的太蛇那里夺回水语者苟莱失窃的墨鳃仪式法杖。
text.description: 墨鳃部族爆发了一场严重的内讧，$r。刹嗳呼长老喝下了被煞魔腐蚀的潭水，还强迫其他人也这么做。而我反抗之后，村中卫队的太蛇没收了我的仪式法杖并放逐了我。$b$b现在，我不但成了流亡者，而且无法与曾经指引着我的水流对话！$b$b我不是战士。但你是，或许你能帮我从太蛇手中夺回法杖？他就在我们北面的村子里。

english.title: The Waterspeaker's Staff
english.objectives: Recover Waterspeaker Gorai's Stolen Inkgill Ritual Staff from Orachi in Inkgill Mere.
english.description: There is great dissent in Inkgill, $r. Elder Shai Hu drank the sha-corrupted waters of the mere, and forced the others to do the same. When I protested, Orachi of the town guard confiscated my ritual staff and banished me.$b$bNow, I am not only an exile, I am unable to speak with the waters that once gave me guidance!$b$bI am not a fighter. But if you are, perhaps you can recover my staff from Orachi? He is in town to our north.

text.title: 快回来！
text.objectives: 向珠鳍村中的海军上将泰勒汇报。
text.description: 哦，差点忘了，有人拜托我交给你这个东西。我觉得这封信应该来自你的某个同伴。$b$b有人设法使我相信你的出现是当务之急，因此我擅自安排了你的行程。$b$b当你做好准备后，请和南边的金莎·箭眼谈一谈。她的风筝正在等着你。
text.completion: Welcome back, $n. I trust your journey has been insightful, particularly in regards to the layout of the land. There is still much to do before we march into battle.
text.completed: 向珠鳍村中的海军上将泰勒汇报。
text.turninWindow: 海军上将泰勒正在等你回去。

A letter from one of your companions, I assume.$b$bI was made to understand that your presence was urgently required, so I took the liberty of arranging your passage.$b$bSpeak to Ginsa Arroweye just south of here when you're ready. She has a kite waiting.

english.completed: Report to Admiral Taylor in Pearlfin Village.

text.title: 残存的影响
text.objectives: 消灭10个邪煞回响。
text.description: 潘达利亚是一片神奇的土地，旅行者。$b$b它反复提醒着我们这片土地上还有很多未解之谜，即便对游学者来说也是如此。$b$b堵住那些裂隙并不能修复已经造成的破坏。如果那些传说都是真的，那么要将这片土地从煞魔的魔爪下拯救出来，我们还有很长的路要走。$b$b这场侵略唤醒了一系列具象的负面情感。你在这里看到的很可能只是这些情感的头一个具象。$b$b现在，我们只能尝试削弱它们对这里的影响。
text.completion: This is terrible...$b$bWe must find a way to undo what has been done here.

english.title: Residual Fallout
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Sha Echoes.
english.description: Pandaria is a mystical land, traveler.$b$bIt bears repeating that some of its secrets remain hidden, even to Lorewalkers.$b$bSealing those fissures did not mend what has been broken. If the legends are true, it will take much more to release this land from the grasp of the Sha.$b$bThe aggression of that battle awakened a host of living negative emotions. What you see here is likely the first of many such manifestations.$b$bFor now, we can only try to diminish their presence here.
english.completion: This is terrible...$b$bWe must find a way to undo what has been done here.

text.title: 接受小道消息测试例子
灵玉之心
text.objectives: 使用天神灵玉削弱并击败6个邪煞残影。
text.description: 那些强大的邪恶残影恐怕不是你一个人单枪匹马能够对付的，$n。$b$b在真刀真枪的战斗中，我恐怕很难帮上忙，但我可以提供一个妙计。$b$b青龙雕像原本就是为了青龙的重生而造，她可是我们供奉的天神。这些用来建造雕像的玉石被注入了特殊的力量，也许能用来削弱这些敌人。
text.completion: <Cho looks at you despondently.>$b$bThis jade was meant for... so much more.

english.title: Jaded Heart
english.objectives: Use Celestial Jade Chunks to defeat 6 Sha Remnants.
english.description: The more powerful remnants of that horrible manifestation may be too much for you to handle on your own, $n.$b$bI fear I'd be of little help in terms of actual combat, but I can suggest a solution.$b$bThe great jade statue was soon to become a living serpent - one of our revered celestials. Its construction imbued it with special powers that may sufficiently weaken these adversaries.
english.completion: <Cho looks at you despondently.>$b$bThis jade was meant for... so much more.

text.title: 紧急救援
text.objectives: 在纳兹戈林将军、匿踪大师琪麟、夏琪亚和利维特·急刹附近使用周卓的烟火。
text.description: 你的同伴们在我们的土地上可真是一点也不客气，一到这里就大打出手。$b$b我们还尚未了解他们造成的全部破坏。目前所知的情况……已经是难以言喻。$b$b然而，出于报复而遗弃你的朋友有悖于我们的处世之道。毫无疑问，所有幸存者都已经身负重伤，并需要紧急救护。$b$b这些烟火原本准备用于庆祝雕像的完工。请在你的同伴附近使用它们以便给米师发信号，她会把他们运到安全的地点。

english.title: Emergency Response
english.objectives: Use Cho's Fireworks near General Nazgrim, Shademaster Kiryn, Shokia, and Rivett Clutchpop.
english.description: Your companions have made themselves at home in our land, and brought with them a dangerous conflict.$b$bThe full extent of their destruction here we cannot yet know. Already it is... unspeakable.$b$bNevertheless, to forsake your friends out of spite would be against our way. Any that yet live are doubtlessly wounded and in desperate need of care.$b$bThese fireworks were to celebrate the statue's completion. Use them near your companions to signal Mishi, and she will bear them off to safety.

english.description: It would seem that your Admiral Taylor has awakened from his injuries. He and his people are upstairs in the apothecary's house back in Binan Village.$B$BHe has requested your presence.

text.title: 西风之息
text.objectives: 与野牛人前线的雇农小波和素兰长老谈一谈。
text.description:
<海军上将泰勒的脸上痛苦抽搐着。>

翡翠林的战斗简直就是一场灾难。

安度因失踪了，我们还损失了大量优秀的战士，我们没能阻止部落染指这片大陆。

但我想到了一个争取当地人的好方法，你刚帮他们击退了一些“野牛人”，不是吗？

我听说野牛人洗劫了当地一个叫西风之息的村落，有两支幸存者队伍就在镇西边的路上安营扎寨了。

我们过去帮帮忙，或许他们会考虑加入联盟。

english.title: Westwind Rest
english.objectives: Speak with Farmhand Bo and Elder Tsulan in the Yaungol Advance.
english.description:
<Admiral Taylor winces in pain.>

Jade Forest was a disaster. 

Anduin's gone. We lost some good people. We didn't stop the Horde from advancing into the continent. 

But I think I've found a way to get the locals on our side. You just helped fight off some of these "yaungol", no?

I hear yaungol sacked Westwind Rest, a local village. We've been told that two groups of survivors have camped out along the road west out of town.

We help them out, maybe they'll consider siding with the Allliance.

text.title: 东风之眠
text.objectives: 和昆莱山的雇农小寇还有邵长老谈一谈。
text.description:
我受伤了，但我们不能止步不前。

猢狲是一群……不可靠的家伙，熊猫人显然是更好的盟友。

我相信你已经注意到了村子里的难民，也听说了野牛人的入侵，不是吗？

我们从当地人口中得知，附近一个叫东风之眠的村庄被野牛人摧毁了。

一些幸存者就聚集在镇外的路边。

去西边，把幸存者聚集起来。

我们将帮助他们重建。如此一来，他们便能体会到加入部落的优越性！

english.title: Eastwind Rest
english.objectives: Speak with Farmhand Ko and Elder Shiao in Kun Lai Summit.
english.description:
I am injured, but we can't stop here.

The hozen were... unreliable. The pandaren would be much better allies.

You have seen the refugees in this village, and heard of the yaungol invasion, no?

Well, we've heard from the locals that Eastwind Rest, a nearby village, was destroyed by the Yaungol.

Apparently some survivors have gathered along the road out of town.

Go. Take the road west. Gather the survivors. 

We'll help them rebuild. Then, they will see the advantage of joining the Horde!

text.title: 接受挑战
text.objectives: 点燃野牛人旗帜，召唤并击败厄尔巴塔尔。
text.description:
野牛人是一支高傲的种族，素以骁勇好斗著称，但他们从来没有表现出这种暴力性或攻击性。

我不知道是什么促使他们的行为改变，但我们现在没有时间找出原因。只要巴塔里野牛人的头领厄尔巴塔尔还活着，我们的生命安全和正常生活就令人担忧。

点燃他营地的旗帜，挑战并击败他。那时候我们才安全。
text.giverWindow: 厄尔巴塔尔，野牛人勇士

english.title: Challenge Accepted
english.objectives: Set the Yaungol Banner ablaze to summon Ur-Bataar, and then defeat him in combat.
english.description:
The yaungol have always been a difficult, proud people, but never this violent or aggressive. 

I do not know what has prompted this change in their behavior, but we don't have time to find out, now. We fear for our lives and livelihoods as long as Ur-Bataar, leader of the Bataari yaungol, lives.

Go, set the banner in his camp ablaze to challenge him, and then defeat him in battle. Only then will we be secure.
english.giverWindow: Ur-Bataar, Champion of the Yaungol
