text.title: 农场物语（一）：小麻烦
text.objectives: 为蓝盖采集6株蛛棘根。
text.description: 这么说你需要除掉那些可恶的杂草？$B$B没问题，邻居！唯一的问题是，我的除草剂所剩无几了。$B$B我的药剂是自己调配的——强效、有机，养护土壤。植物都爱它！嗯……当然，那些讨厌的杂草可不这么想！它们恨死我的除草剂了！$B$B你要是能从西边的梯田那儿给我带些蛛棘根来，我就能现做一批新的除草剂，然后去老愚农场帮忙除草。$B$B我本可以自己去采集的，不过……嗯……我讨厌蜘蛛。你明白我的意思啦。

english.title: Growing the Farm I: A Little Problem
english.objectives: Gather 6 Spideroot for Gai Lan.
english.description: So you need to whack some wily weeds?$B$BNo problem, neighbor! Only thing is, I'm running low on weed killer.$B$BI make my own concoction - very potent, totally organic and good for the earth. Plants love it! Well... except for those pesky weeds. They hate the stuff!$B$BIf you bring me some Spideroot from the terraces just west of us, I'll make a fresh batch and go down to Yoon's farm myself.$B$BI would gather some myself but... well... I hate spiders. You'll see what I mean.

text.title: 农夫老方的选票（一）：牦牛跑了
text.objectives: 去四风谷的汇风岭或半山市集，和农夫老方谈一谈。
text.description: 阡陌客议会第二个有权投票的成员是农夫老方，原因很简单。$B$B他种植的蔬菜是整个山谷里最大的！我只希望有一天我种出的南瓜能和他的一样大。$B$B要想加入阡陌客，我们接下来就得取得他的信任。

english.title: Farmer Fung's Vote I: Yak Attack
english.objectives: Speak to Farmer Fung at The Heartland or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: The next voting member on the Tiller's council is Farmer Fung, and it's easy to see why.$B$BThat man's vegetables are the biggest in the valley! I only hope that someday I can grow pumpkins as big as his.$B$BIf we hope to join the Tillers, he would be the next person to convince.

text.title: 农夫老方的选票（二）：找回牦牛
text.objectives: 将5只逃走的粗皮牛带回农夫老方位于翠绿草场最北边的牦牛棚。
text.description: 你想让我把票投给农夫老愚？哈哈！你在开玩笑吧？$B$B听着，我不会为这种城里人投票的，他们对耕种土地一窍不通。$B$B在你或老愚那个蠢货旁边种地简直叫人难堪。$B$B行了，别烦我了。某些混蛋放跑了我心爱的金牌牦牛，它们现在正在半山的西北边到处乱窜。$B$B只有找回我的牦牛，我晚上才能睡个安稳觉。

english.title: Farmer Fung's Vote II: On the Loose
english.objectives: Return 5 Escaped Shagskins to Farmer Fung's yak pen at the very north end of the Verdant Belt.
english.description: You want my vote for Farmer Yoon? Ha! You're joking, right?$B$BListen, I'm not going to vote for some citypaw with no lick a' knowledge about farming the earth.$B$BIt would be an embarrassment to farm alongside you or that Yoon shmuck.$B$BNow let me deal with my own problems. Some devil let my prize yaks loose, and now they're running wild northwest of Halfhill.$B$BIf I could just get my yaks back, then maybe I'd be able to sleep at night.

text.title: 娜娜的选票（一）：娜娜的秘方
text.objectives: 去四风谷的半山和娜娜·泥爪谈一谈。
text.description: 接下来，我们要争取的选票来自于娜娜·泥爪。她是郝瀚的祖母，她做阡陌客的时间比你我活着的时间还要长！$B$B她现在仍在半山的阡陌客之家工作。你为什么不去拜访一下她呢？

english.title: Nana's Vote I: Nana's Secret Recipe
english.objectives: Speak to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: The next vote we'll need is from Nana Mudclaw. She's Haohan's grandmother, and she's been a Tiller longer than you and I have been alive!$B$BShe's still working at the Tillers building in Halfhill. Why don't you pay her a visit?

text.title: Tummy Trouble
text.objectives: Use Gooseberries to cure sick Halfhill Villagers.
text.description: I like Farmer Yoon just dandy as a neighbor, but getting my vote is another matter entirely. He does know that my father is the head of the Union, right?$B$BAnyway, I've got bigger problems to worry about. Lotta folks been getting sick from eating bad vegetables.$B$BSince they bought the produce from my market, my reputation is in jeopardy.$B$BNow I've got an idea to cure the stomach rumbles, but it ain't pretty.$B$BIf you'd be willing to... um... hurry things along, I just might be indebted to you.
text.completed: Return to Gina Mudclaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.description: I like Farmer Yoon just dandy as a neighbor, but getting my vote is another matter entirely. He does know that my father is the head of the Union, right?$B$BAnyway, I've got bigger problems to worry about. Lotta folks been getting sick from eating bad vegetables.$B$BSince they bought the produce from my market, my reputation is in jeopardy.$B$BNow I've got an idea to cure the stomach rumbles, but it ain't pretty.$B$BIf you'd be willing to... um... hurry things along, I just might be indebted to you.
english.completed: Return to Gina Mudclaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 郝瀚的选票（一）：不速之客
text.objectives: 去四风谷的汇风岭或半山市集和郝瀚·泥爪谈一谈。
text.description: 这可能有点棘手，$n。$B$B我们需要的最后一票来自于郝瀚·泥爪，阡陌客的头领。$B$B我知道他开始对我们并不在意，但我们已经学习了这么多关于耕种的事情，我相信他会对我们有所改观的！$B$B去和他谈一谈。你很善于说服他人，不是吗？

english.title: Haohan's Vote I: Bungalow Break-In
english.objectives: Speak to Haohan Mudclaw at The Heartland or at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: This is going to be tough, $n.$B$BThe last vote we need comes from Haohan Mudclaw, the head of the Tillers Union.$B$BI know he wasn't too keen on us to start, but we've learned so much about farming, I'm sure he'll have a change of heart!$B$BGo speak to him. You can be very convincing, right?

text.title: 郝瀚的选票（二）：真凶
text.objectives: 调查8处可疑的脚印。
text.description: 你在这里做什么，城里人？$B$B听着，我正忙着处理棚屋被劫的事件呢。某些无赖半夜闯了进来并洗劫了这里。$B$B我现在不得不处理种子丢失、工具损坏和存货被吃掉等这些倒霉事。$B$B现在还有其他的麻烦我得记录下来：一整车失窃的甜瓜、一个坏掉的水泵、各种毁坏我庄稼的动物……$B$B我真想现在就查清楚事情的真相，看看是哪个混蛋干的好事！

english.title: Haohan's Vote II: The Real Culprits
english.objectives: Investigate 8 Suspicious Footprints.
english.description: What are YOU doing here, citypaw?$B$BLook, I've got my hands full with a break-in at my shed to the west. Some rascals came in the middle of the night and ransacked the place.$B$BI've got missing seeds, broken tools, and eaten inventory to deal with.$B$BI'll just add it to my list of other troubles: a whole wagon of melons stolen, a broken water pump, animals ruining my harvest...$B$BI wish that I could just get to the bottom of all this already!

text.title: 农场物语（二）：破损的马车
text.objectives: 去四风谷中的香蒲湖畔或半山市集找玉儿·采苇谈一谈。
text.description: 嗨，$n。自从搬来这里以后，我每天都能看到那辆马车。太碍眼了，你不觉得吗？$B$B我在镇上听说玉儿·采苇很擅长使用工具。也许她能把它修好，然后我们就可以把那片土地开垦为农田。$B$B不如你去跟她谈谈，看看她愿不愿意接下这份工作。

english.title: Growing the Farm II: The Broken Wagon
english.objectives: Speak to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Hey $n. I've been looking at that wagon every day, day in and day out, since the day I moved in. Quite an eyesore, don't you think?$B$BI heard in town that Fish Fellreed is quite handy with tools. She might be able to fix it up, and then we could turn that patch of land into a plot for farming.$B$BWhy don't you talk to her and see if she'd be willing to do the job?

text.title: 农场物语（二）：找竹板
text.objectives: 收集100块打蜡的竹板。
text.description: 当然！我知道你说的那辆马车！$B$B我马上就能修好它，但我需要材料。$B$B在湖底有很多竹板。如果你能把它们钓出来——哈哈，弄出来？钓？哦，我有时候把自己都搞糊涂了。$B$B不管怎样，你给我带些那儿的竹板回来，我就能马上开工了！

english.title: Growing the Farm II: Knock on Wood
english.objectives: Collect 100 Waxed Planks.
english.description: Sure! I know just the wagon that you're talkin' about!$B$BI can fix it right up, but I'll need wood.$B$BThere's a whole lot of it down at the bottom of the lake. If you fish it right out - haha, get it? Fish? Oh I just crack myself up sometimes.$B$BAnyway, you bring me here some 'o that wood and then I'll get right to work!

text.title: 郝瀚的选票（三）：致命毒药
text.objectives: 收集1朵血色花、1朵岩洞百合、1朵鬼面菇和1朵紫地衣。
text.description: 太好了，$n，这是我们的好机会！$B$B泥爪先生的农场遇到大麻烦了。那些山地猢狲夜里跑过来践踏他的庄稼，吃掉他辛苦栽培的作物。$B$B我们得帮泥爪先生除掉它们，而且我知道该怎么做。$B$B过去，我爷爷教过我如何制作一种致命的毒药，用来对付田里的害虫。$B$B北边的兔妖洞穴里藏着我这混合制剂的核心配料。$B$B别一副忧心忡忡的样子，$n！我很确信这能够奏效。

english.title: Haohan's Vote III: Pure Poison
english.objectives: Collect 1 Bloodbloom, 1 Cave Lily, 1 Ghostcap, and 1 Violet Lichen.
english.description: All right, $n. This is our big chance!$B$BMr. Mudclaw's farm is in big trouble. Those mountain hozen are coming down at night, wrecking his crops and eating his hard-earned harvest.$B$BWe've got to get rid of them for good, and I know just how to do it.$B$BBack in the day, my grandpa showed me how to mix a wounding poison to deal with the pests on the farm.$B$BThe virmen warrens to the north hold the key ingredients for my mixture.$B$BDon't look so worried, $n! I'm pretty sure this is going to work.

text.title: 迷失和孤独
text.objectives: 从四风谷摩天山脊的摩天穆山兽身上收集20根美味的丁骨肉排。
text.description: 这只饥饿的癞皮狗拼命地摇着尾巴，呜呜哀鸣。$B$B看起来它需要饱餐一顿。
text.completion: The dog perks its ears up at the sight of the juicy steak.$B$BAs soon as you throw it down, the dog starts eating ravenously.

english.title: Lost and Lonely
english.objectives: Collect 20 Tasty T-Bone from the Skyrange Mushan on the Skyrange in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: The starving, mangy dog whines piteously and attempts a brief wag of its tail.$B$BIt looks like it could use a good meal right about now.
english.completion: The dog perks its ears up at the sight of the juicy steak.$B$BAs soon as you throw it down, the dog starts eating ravenously.

text.title: 郝瀚的选票（四）：罪有应得
text.objectives: 种植并收获4颗菜瓜，然后将20颗菜瓜送给农夫老愚。$B$B你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里买到菜瓜种子。耕种并灌溉后，你必须等到次日才能收获成熟的菜瓜。
text.description: 好吧，现在我碰巧知道那些山地猢狲喜欢吃一种甘甜可口的菜瓜。$B$B郝瀚先生上季的收成都被偷光了，所以我们得自己种一些出来。$B$B一旦我们丰收了，我们就用种出来的菜瓜去把那个卑鄙的猢狲首领引出来！

english.title: Haohan's Vote IV: Melons For Felons
english.objectives: Plant and harvest 4 Striped Melons, then deliver 20 Striped Melons to Farmer Yoon.$B$BStriped Melon Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and tending your plant, you must wait until the next day to harvest ripe Striped Melons.
english.description: All right, now I happen to know that those mountain hozen love a delicious, sweet melon.$B$BMr. Haohan's last harvest of melons got stolen, so we're going to have to grow some of our own.$B$BOnce we have our harvest, we'll use them to lure the nasty hozen's leader out of its cave!

text.title: 郝瀚的选票（五）：酋长伊普伊普
text.objectives: 去西北方的昆森洞窟击败酋长伊普伊普。
text.description: 你准备好进行计划的最后一步了吗？$B$B昆森猢狲的首领是一个残暴的家伙，名叫伊普伊普。据说他百痛不侵。$B$B我已将我的剧毒合剂注射到菜瓜之中，你可千万别吃啊！$B$B一旦你引起他的注意，就将这些菜瓜丢在地上。伊普伊普是无法抵挡美味的菜瓜诱惑的。$B$B只要他咬上一口，就会被严重削弱，你就找机会攻击他。
text.giverWindow: 昆森猢狲的首领。

english.title: Haohan's Vote V: Chief Yip-Yip
english.objectives: Kill Chief Yip-Yip at Kunzen Cave to the northwest.
english.description: You ready for the final step of the plan?$B$BThe leader of the Kunzen hozen is a brute by the name of Chief Yip-Yip. It's said that he is nearly impervious to pain.$B$BI've injected the melons with a toxic mixture, so don't try eating them!$B$BOnce you get his attention, throw these melons onto the ground. Yip-Yip won't be able to resist a sweet striped melon.$B$BWhen he takes a bite, he'll be temporarily weakened, and you should find yourself an opening to attack.
english.giverWindow: The leader of the Kunzen hozen.

text.title: 农场物语（三）：移走巨石
text.objectives: 去四风谷的汇风岭或半山市集和郝瀚·泥爪谈一谈。
text.description: 现在我们是阡陌客的正式成员了，泥爪先生说他很乐意帮助我们移走农田中间的大石头。$B$B我们把石头清理掉后，我还有一件特别的事情要做。$B$B快去找他，告诉他我们已经准备好了。

english.title: Growing the Farm III: The Mossy Boulder
english.objectives: Speak to Haohan Mudclaw in The Heartland or at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Now that we're officially members of the Tillers Union, Mr. Mudclaw said he'd be happy to help us upturn this big ole' rock in the middle of our field.$B$BOnce we clear away that stone, I've got something special planned.$B$BRun down and give him a holler to let him know that we're ready.

text.title: 找帮手
text.objectives: 和你的好朋友谈一谈，请他们来日歌农场帮把手。
text.description: 尽管你很努力，但农场的工作还是越积越多。$B$B或许你可以去问问你的好朋友，看谁愿意来日歌农场帮把手。

english.title: A Second Hand
english.objectives: Speak to one of your best friends and ask them to work on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: Despite your best efforts, the work is starting to pile up around here.$B$BPerhaps you could ask one of your best friends if they'd like to help out at Sunsong Ranch.

text.title: 学习务农（一）：播种
text.objectives: 和半山市集的商人绿野谈一谈，获得一包绿色卷心菜种子。
text.description: 好吧，先从重要的事开始！我回头会需要很多帮助的。$B$B如果你想成为我的合伙人，你得先学会如何收割庄稼；要想收割庄稼，你得先学会播种！$B$B曾经有位先生，呃……吕叶？不，不是那个……绿椰？听起来也不像……$B$B绿野！他的名字叫绿野！你可以从他那儿搞到种子。$B$B绿野在半山市集有个摊位，市集就在东南边——去找他，弄些蔬菜种子回来。
text.completion: He waved at me! And he gave you the first pack of seeds for free?$B$BWell, what a nice guy!$B$BYou're doing a great job so far. Here's a little... seed money. Hah!

english.title: Learn and Grow I: Seeds
english.objectives: Speak with Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market and acquire a Packet of Green Cabbage Seeds.
english.description: Well, first things first! I'm going to need lots of help 'round here.$B$BIf we're going to be partners, you've got to learn how to harvest crops, and if you wanna harvest crops you gotta plant seeds!$B$BNow it's my understanding that a mister, uh... Grainfell? No, that wasn't it... Greedfill? That doesn't sound right...$B$BGreenfield! That's his name! He's the man to see for seeds.$B$BGreenfield's got a stall over at Halfhill Market, directly southeast of here - go see him and pick up some vegetable seeds.
english.completion: He waved at me! And he gave you the first pack of seeds for free?$B$BWell, what a nice guy!$B$BYou're doing a great job so far. Here's a little... seed money. Hah!

text.title: FLAG - Weed War Training
text.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
text.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

text.title: 意外之喜
text.objectives: 把丢失的水渍齿轮和生锈螺栓从东面的猢狲伏击者手里夺回来。
text.description: 事情近来发展得越来越顺利了，$n。我外出考察时发现了这个小可爱。$b$b<苏利指着他右边的弩箭车。>$b$b问题是，她和另一个装置是成套的，而那个装置目前仍是堆杂乱的零件。要不是那些讨厌的恐目猢狲伏击了我并偷走了一些齿轮和螺栓，我早已把她组装好了。$b$b嘿，你好像跟当地人打交道很有一套。你不会介意帮我老苏利一个忙的，对吗？
text.completion: Well these aren't as good as she deserves, but it will have to work.$b$b<Sully pats the dismantled ballista.>$b$bI'll get 'er up and runnin' in no time, just ye watch!

english.title: An Unexpected Advantage
english.objectives: Retrieve the missing Water-Damaged Gears and Rusty Locking Bolts from the Hozen Ambushers to the East.
english.description: Things seem to be goin' our way more and more lately, $n. I was out doin some explorin' when I came upon this little beauty.$b$b<Sully gestures to the ballista to his right.>$b$bProblem is she's one of a set and the other one is still in pieces. I'd have gotten it together by now if those pesky Grimleers hadn't ambushed me and taken some of the gears and bolts.$b$bHey, ye seem to be pretty good at handlin' the natives. Ye wouldn't mind goin' and helpin' ol'Sully out would ye?
english.completion: Well these aren't as good as she deserves, but it will have to work.$b$b<Sully pats the dismantled ballista.>$b$bI'll get 'er up and runnin' in no time, just ye watch!

objectiveDetails.description: Listen to Xiao and his companions

text.title: 布兰琪的闪电陈酿
text.objectives: 完成“酝酿风暴”场景战役。
text.description: 你察觉到空气中的异样了吗？一场风暴正在酝酿！我也想酝酿些什么了！$B$B当风暴来袭时到山顶来见我，我们一起酿制一桶我最拿手的美酒。你愿意帮助我吗？

english.title: Blanche's Boomer Brew
english.objectives: Complete the "Brewing Storm" Scenario.
english.description: Can you smell it in the air? A storm is brewing! And so am I!$B$BMeet me at the hilltop when the storm hits and together we'll whip up a keg of my most famous brew. Can I count on your help?$B$B

text.title: 略尽绵力
text.objectives: 与勇敢的卡拉什、安玻·吉尔妮以及米希卡会面。
text.description: 欢迎回来，$n！锦鱼人对训练的适应程度大大超过了我的预料。我们的准备工作即将大功告成了。$b$b我需要有人去和安玻、勇敢的卡拉什以及米希卡会一下面。去看看他们的训练是否需要帮助。$b$b你可以去去珠鳍村找卡拉什和米希卡。安玻正在西北面的吊尾围栏中训练新兵。
text.completion: Impressive work, $n. We should be ready to move out shortly. With our allies at our side, there is no way we can be defeated.

english.title: Helping the Cause
english.objectives: Check in with Bold Karasshi, Amber Kearnen, and Mishka.
english.description: Welcome back, $n! It seems the Jinyu have taken to our training even better than I had hoped. We're in the final stages of our preparations now.$b$bI need someone to go check in with Amber, Bold Karasshi, and Mishka. See if they need any help to complete their training.$b$bYou'll find Karasshi and Mishka here in Pearlfin Village. Amber is training recruits in Slingtail Pits to the northwest.
english.completion: Impressive work, $n. We should be ready to move out shortly. With our allies at our side, there is no way we can be defeated.

objectiveDetails.description: 协助受伤的珠鳍锦鱼人

text.title: 农场的麻烦
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的周家农田和农夫老周谈一谈。
text.description:
我……我从东南部农夫老周那里逃到这里。那里现在受制于野牛人，但那老家伙和他的妻子是不会放弃的！

去那帮助他脱离困境。如果你去的话，他也许会派些人回到这里，帮你们在新镇耕种一些作物。你说呢？

english.title: Trouble on the Farmstead
english.objectives: Speak with Farmer Chow at the Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
I... I escaped from Farmer Chow's, to the southeast of here. It's been taken over by yaungol, but the old man and his wife just won't give it up!

Please, go there and help him out. Maybe if you do, he'll be willing to send some folks back here and help you guys farm up some food for the new town?

text.title: 农场的麻烦
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的周家农田和农夫老周谈一谈。
text.description:
我……我从东南部农夫老周那里逃到这里。那里现在受制于野牛人，但那老家伙和他的妻子是不会放弃的！

去那帮助他脱离困境……如果你去的话，他也许会派些人回到这里，帮你们在新镇耕种一些作物。你说呢？

english.title: Trouble on the Farmstead
english.objectives: Speak with Farmer Chow at the Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
I... I escaped from Farmer Chow's, to the southeast of here. It's been taken over by yaungol, but the old man and his wife just won't give it up!

Please, go there and help him... Maybe if you do, he'll be willing to send some folks back here and help you guys farm up some food for the new town?

text.title: 解救雇农
text.objectives: 击败斡耳朵督工，解救12名农场奴隶。
text.description: 斡耳朵野牛人快把我的雇农们给累死了！这样可不好。$B$B拜托了，$c，请在事情变得不可挽回之前救出他们。

english.title: Farmhand Freedom
english.objectives: Free 12 Farmstead Slaves by killing Ordo Overseers.
english.description: Those Ordo yaungol are working my farmhands to death! It just ain't right.$B$BPlease, $c, save them before it's too late.

text.title: 赶牛
text.objectives: 围捕三只野生中原牦牛，将它们放回西风之息。
text.description:
机动性将成为我们在这块新土地立足的关键。问题是，没有坐骑则无法维持机动性……但是，在这里，我们没有足够的坐骑，不是吗？

当地牦牛似乎可以成为上好的坐骑。至少当地的熊猫人说可以。你何不去围捕几只给我们呢。

english.title: Round 'Em Up
english.objectives: Round up 3 Wild Plains Yaks and return them to Westwind Rest.
english.description:
Mobility is going to be key to maintaining our foothold in this new land. Problem is, there's no way to maintain mobility without mounts, and... well, we don't have many of those here, now do we?

The local yaks seem to make good mounts. At least, the local pandaren say they do. Why don't you go round some up for us?

text.title: ……锅呢？
text.objectives: 收集12份块茎蔬菜和一口生铁大锅。
text.description: 当然，我很乐意帮你们，但我们也要吃饭啊！我甚至都没个锅来煮！巧妇难为无米之炊啊！$B$B这些是我要的东西，都在这单子上了。拿着！

english.title: ... and the Pot, Too!
english.objectives: Collect 12 Root Vegetables and 1 Cast Iron Pot.
english.description: Sure, I'm willing to help you guys out. But we need to eat, too! I don't even have a pot to cook in! Let alone ingredients to put in it!$B$BHere's a list of the things that I need. Now get!

text.title: 已故的麝香爪夫人
text.objectives: 把麝香爪的信物给老麝香爪送去。
text.description: 这件满是刻痕、饱经风霜的小饰物承载着已故麝香爪夫人对她丈夫的爱慕之情。$b$b老麝香爪肯定想找回她夫人的饰物。

english.title: The Late Mrs. Muskpaw
english.objectives: Bring the Muskpaw Keepsake to Lao Muskpaw.
english.description: This well worn trinket has several markings on it confessing love and adoration from the late Mrs. Muskpaw.$b$bPerhaps Lao would like his wife's trinket back.

text.title: 食物危机
text.objectives: 收集160份昆莱肉末。
text.description:
噢！

如果我们想继续在这里生存下去，我们就需要食物！

你也许还不知道，我有时自己做饭。何不去外面找一些肉末给我们。我把它们烧一烧，够我们吃几个礼拜的！至少可以吃个几天。

english.title: Blue Dwarf Needs Food Badly
english.objectives: Collect 160 Kun-Lai Meaty Bits.
english.description:
Oi!

We need ta' get us some food, if we're gonna survive here for long!

Ye' may not know it, but I'm somethin' of a cook me'self. Why don'tcha go out there and fetch us some meaty bits. I can cook 'em up and feed us for weeks! Or, days, at least.

text.title: 人间美味！
text.objectives: 在卡桑琅丛林的都阳河捕获7条都阳鳗鱼。
text.description: 你吃过新鲜的都阳鳗鱼吗，$n？没有？$b$b那你可真是白活了！前往北面的都阳河，为我们捕一些鳗鱼回来。当心哦，要是不注意的话会被那些鳗鱼电着的！

english.title: Shocking!
english.objectives: Fish up 7 Dojani Eels from the Dojani River in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: Have you ever had a fresh dojani eel $n?  No?$b$bWell you have not lived then!  Head north up to the dojani river and fish up a few for us.   Be careful, those eels can zap you if you're not careful!

text.title: 深潭水怪
text.objectives: 找到位于西北方卡桑利瀑布下的远古钓鱼场所，在其中钓鱼以诱出藏匿的野兽。
text.description: 传说，北边的森林里生活着一只巨兽。我儿子失踪了，我担心他去了巨兽巢穴的附近……$b$b请到西北方的卡桑利瀑布去寻找一个神秘的旋涡——那里就是揭开真相的钥匙。杀死那可恶的野兽，找到任何有关我儿子行踪的线索。

english.title: What Lurks Below
english.objectives: Find an Ancient Fishing Pool at Krasari Falls to the northwest and fish in it to lure the beast out of hiding.
english.description: Legend tells of a great beast in the forest to the north.  My son is missing and I fear he may have wandered too near its lair....$b$bHead northwest to Krasari Falls and look for a mysterious whirlpool - this is the key to revealing what is hidden there.  Kill the wretched beast and recover any clues to my son's whereabouts.

text.title: 粗糙的鲍鱼
text.objectives: 在东北边的纳松海沟从粗糙的鲍鱼身上收集9块粗糙的鲍鱼肉。
text.description: 熊猫人祖祖辈辈都在这片区域捕捞粗糙的鲍鱼，现在是你学习这一传统的时候了。$b$b你能在东北边的纳松海沟里找到鲍鱼。不过要小心，我们发现这一海域的鲨鱼数量最近变多了。

english.title: Jagged Abalone
english.objectives: Harvest 9 Jagged Abalone Meat from the Jagged Abalone in Narsong Trench to the northeast.
english.description: Pandaren have been harvesting jagged abalone in this area for generations.  Now it's time for you to learn the ritual.$b$bThe abalone can be found just northeast of here in narsong trench.  Be careful, we have noticed increased shark activity in that area recently.

text.title: 喋喋不休
text.objectives: 在麝香爪牧场击败9个伯里尔基抢劫者。
text.description: 目前看来，他们似乎也就是整天偷偷牛而已！但是你勘察四周后意识到，这些家伙随时都有可能进犯洗牛站。$b$b去干掉几个野牛人，这样他们就知道这个地方是有人保护的。

english.title: Yakity Yak
english.objectives: Kill 9 Burilgi Despoilers at the Muskpaw Ranch.
english.description: For now, the yaungol invaders seem content to steal yaks. Surveying the area, however, you notice they could easily move on the Yak Wash at any moment.$b$bThinning their numbers may help show the yaungol that this area is protected.

text.title: 殊死捕鱼
text.objectives: 到渔人远征队杀死8只河刃沙滩掠夺者，就在渔人码头的西边。
text.description: 河刃蜥蜴人部族正在攻击我们当地的一支捕鱼远征队！他们急需帮助！$b$b快去干掉一些蜥蜴人，帮助远征队安全返回吧！
text.giverWindow: 作为凶猛的丛林战士，蜥蜴人可不是那么好对付的。

english.title: Fishing for a Bruising
english.objectives: Kill 8 Riverblade Beach Raiders at Anglers Expedition, just west of Anglers Wharf.
english.description: The riverblade saurok clan is attacking one of our local fishing expeditions!  They need help right away!$b$bThin those saurok out and help that expedition return safely!
english.giverWindow: Fierce jungle fighters, the Saurok are not to be trifled with.

text.title: 炸毁残骸
text.objectives: 和悲雾林的迈凯尔·贝交谈。
text.description: 要想把联盟舰船弄出来，我们需要找到我们的工程师。在我们从飞船残骸逃离的时候，他和大伙走散了。$B$B你应该能在西边森林里找到他。告诉他是科尔加派你来的，他会想办法帮助你的。
text.completion: Korga sent you, eh? Well, I wouldn't mind doing a number on that ship for my own reasons anyway, but it's going to take some work.$B$BGive me a moment to think...

english.title: Wrecking the Wreck
english.objectives: Speak to Makael Bay in the Pei-Wu Forest.
english.description: To dislodge the alliance ship, we need to find our engineer. He parted ways with us when we were escaping the wreckage.$B$BYou should be able to find him somewhere in the western forest. Tell him Korga sent you and he'll get in line to help.
english.completion: Korga sent you, eh? Well, I wouldn't mind doing a number on that ship for my own reasons anyway, but it's going to take some work.$B$BGive me a moment to think...

text.title: 小心轻放
text.objectives: 找回6包炸药。
text.description: 我们可以帮你把船弄出来，但是需要从联盟手里夺回更多的炸药。$B$B在逃跑前，我命令船员带走了所有能拿走的炸药。如果你仔细翻找南边的飞船残骸和遇难者，应该还能找到一些还没有爆炸的炸药包。$B$B为我取回足够多的炸药包，我就帮你搞点好东西出来。
text.progress: You're in one piece. That's a good sign.$B$BDid you get your hands on what I asked for?
text.completion: More than enough. I've got the main control panel constructed. We should be ready very soon!

english.title: Handle With Care
english.objectives: Recover 6 Packed Explosive Charges.
english.description: We can help you get your ship free, but we'll need more of the explosives we were trying to take back from the Alliance to make it happen.$B$BI ordered the men to grab all the explosives they could before making our escape. If you sift through the wreckage and bodies to our south, there should be some explosive bundles among them, those that didn't already blow up anyway.$B$BGet me enough of them and I think I can put something together for ya.
english.progress: You're in one piece. That's a good sign.$B$BDid you get your hands on what I asked for?
english.completion: More than enough. I've got the main control panel constructed. We should be ready very soon!

text.title: 捕食掠夺者
text.objectives: 杀死9只悲雾猛虎。
text.description: 自从神真子开始晃动以来，森林变得越发危险了。老虎们变得躁动不安并开始袭击难民，连我都曾遭到过几次攻击。$B$B如果想让那些虚弱的伤病员安全抵达这里，我们就需要帮他们清扫一遍树林。
text.completion: These survivors are in your debt, $c.

english.title: Preying on the Predators
english.objectives: Kill 9 Pei-Wu Tigers.
english.description: The forest has become far more dangerous ever since Shen-zin Su began shaking. The tigers are agitated and have begun attacking the refugees, and on occasion, me as well.$B$BIf these injured and weak survivors are to make it to safety here at the hut, we need to help clear the forest for them.
english.completion: These survivors are in your debt, $c.

text.title: 粗麻小径：前往粗麻驿站
text.objectives: 护送一队土地精前往粗麻驿站，确保至少要有一名土地精存活下来。$b$b如果你与土地精失散了，你可以去粗麻小径找找看，或是回酒坛集等候下一队土地精。
text.description: 今天土地精走霉运了。猢狲又开始破坏行动了！他们攻击了我们向蟠龙脊输送给养的补给线。$b$b你能帮帮忙吗？我们不是战士。我们只是土地精。帮助土地精的人都会有好运的。$b$b护送一队土地精前往粗麻驿站。保护他们的安全。确保至少有一个土地精活下来。$b$b土地精会报答你的。土地精一向知恩图报。

english.title: The Burlap Trail: To Burlap Waystation
english.objectives: Protect a group of grummles travelling to the Burlap Waystation. At least one grummle must survive.$b$bIf you lose your grummles, you can search the Burlap Trail or return to One Keg and wait for the next group to leave.
english.description: Bad fortune for grummles today. Hozen have begun to ravage! They attack our supply line to the Serpent's Spine.$b$bCan you help? We are not fighters. We are grummles. Good fortune to those who help grummles.$b$bGo with a group of grummles to the Burlap Waystation. Keep them safe. Make sure at least one grummle survives.$b$bGrummles shall reward. Grummles always reward.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送土地精抵达粗麻驿站

text.title: 复活的雕像
text.objectives: 摧毁任意14个陶俑战士或陶俑卫士。
text.description: 将军派我来处理一个重大问题，但我的特长是治疗，不是战斗！$B$B营地中的熊猫人告诉我，在东北方向的魔古岬，有什么东西正在复活那些雕像。$B$B你愿意帮助我们吗，$n？我们现在没有实力和雕像大军进行战斗。

english.title: Deanimate the Reanimated
english.objectives: Destroy any 14 Terracotta Warriors or Terracotta Guardians.
english.description: The admiral's asked me to take care of a major problem, but my specialty's in healing, not fighting!$B$BThe pandaren in the camp here have told me that something is animating the statues to the northeast at Mogujia.$B$BWill you help me out, $n? We can't afford to have a fight with an army of statues right now.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁陶俑战士或陶俑卫士

text.title: 复活的雕像
text.objectives: 摧毁14个陶俑战士或者陶俑卫士。
text.description: 我这有很多事要做，$n。我需要你的帮助。$B$B西北方有个地方。熊猫人称之为魔古岬。有什么东西正在那里激活雕像，这让我们的熊猫人朋友很受惊吓。$B$B如果不尽快处理这件事，我们很快就会有大麻烦了。但以我们军队目前的情况，是力不从心了。

english.title: Deanimate the Reanimated
english.objectives: Destroy any 14 Terracotta Warriors or Terracotta Guardians.
english.description: I've got much to do here, $n. I could use your help.$B$BThere's a place to the northwest. The pandaren here call it Mogujia. Something's causing the statues there to animate, and our pandaren friends here are pretty spooked about it.$B$BIf they're not dealt with soon, we might have a serious problem. We just moved in. It's not like we can afford to fight a war with an army of statues right now.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁陶俑战士或陶俑卫士

text.title: 生财有道
text.objectives: 收集12件魔古遗物。
text.description: 我猜你是来对付那些被唤醒的魔古雕像的吧。真巧，我是来，呃……研究魔古的。$B$B告诉你吧，如果你能带给我尽可能多的魔古遗物，我就分你一份……研究基金。

english.title: Profiting off of the Past
english.objectives: Collect 12 Mogu Relics.
english.description: Let me guess, you're here to deal with the mogu statues that are being reanimated. What a coincidence, I'm here to, um... conduct research on the mogu.$B$BI tell you what, if you bring me as many of the mogu relics in there that you can carry, I'll give you a cut. Of the research... funding.

text.title: A Zandalari Troll?
text.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
text.description: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

english.title: A Zandalari Troll?
english.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
english.description: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

text.title: 古怪的石球
text.objectives: 用一些黄金莲来浸泡石球。
text.description: 这块漂亮的石头里显然蕴含着神奇的魔力……至少对于受过专业炼金训练的人来说是如此。你确信只要以潘达利亚土产的药草作为引子，这块石头就能发出强大的力量。

english.title: Strange Spherical Stone
english.objectives: Infuse the stone with several Golden Lotus.
english.description: This beautiful stone clearly has magical potential... at least to one trained in alchemy.  You are certain that with the right herbs native to Pandaria, this stone could become very useful.

text.title: 鱼喜欢蛋？
text.objectives: 在纳松峰收集一颗新鲜仙鹤蛋，然后用它来捕捉一条银鳞虾虎鱼。
text.description: 巨型仙鹤世代都在这片区域筑巢，纳松峰是它们繁育后代的场所。$b$b它们的蛋是捕捉银鳞虾虎鱼的绝佳诱饵。去弄一颗仙鹤蛋来，看看你能不能用它抓到一条银鳞虾虎鱼！

english.title: Who Knew Fish Liked Eggs?
english.objectives: Collect a Pristine Egg from the Narsong Spires and use it to catch a Silver Goby.
english.description: Great cranes have been nesting in this area for generations.  The Narsong Spires provide a sheltered area to rear their young.$b$bTheir pristine eggs are revered as bait for catching the silver goby.  Retrieve a crane egg and see if you can catch a goby!

text.title: 猴子神像
text.objectives: 在祭坛上超度塔克塔克、达卡达卡和科科。
text.description: 以前，土地精通过向猢狲进贡食品来维系着双方的和平。$b$b但如今，南面的断牙猢狲拥有了巨大的魔法神像。乌克头领训练猢狲通过献祭从神像中获得力量。$b$b他们正在利用这些神像屠杀土地精！$b$b你必须去摧毁它们。$b$b每一座神像都由一位酋长驻守。击败酋长，并在祭坛上超度他们。

english.title: A Monkey Idol
english.objectives: Use the Corpses of Tak Tak, Dak Dak, and Ko Ko on their respective altars.
english.description: Before, grummles keep hozen from ravaging by bribing with food.$b$bBut now the Broketooth hozen south of here have their big magic idols. The Ook of Dook has trained them to use their idols to get power from sacrifices.$b$bThey are using them to kill grummles!$b$bYou must destroy these idols!$b$bFor every idol, there is a chief. Kill the chief and throw corpse on their altar.

text.title: 一个也不能少
text.objectives: 在断牙营地或者深石窟找回8个土地精包裹。
text.description: 南面的断牙猢狲杀死了我所有的土地精。更糟糕的是，他们的包裹还没有递送到目的地。$b$b要是土地精包裹未能递送，幸运就不会垂青我们。$b$b请你给我们的运输小径带来安宁，并把土地精包裹带给我。$b$b我会保证它们被及时送达。

english.title: No Pack Left Behind
english.objectives: Recover 8 Grummlepacks from Camp Broketooth or The Deeper.
english.description: The Broketooth hozen south of here killed all of my grummles. What is worse, their packages are undelivered.$b$bFortune frowns on a grummlepack undelivered.$b$bPlease, give my grummles peace on the great trail of beyond and bring their grummlepacks to me.$b$bI will see they are delivered.

text.title: 一鼓作气
text.objectives: 鼓励3个躲在凛风洞里的向导来帮助你。
text.description: 没有好的向导却要去爬山路简直糟糕透了。我们土地精是最好的向导，但很多人都逃走了。他们现在畏惧着山路。很多优秀的土地精在那儿失踪了。$b$b土地精擅长很多事，只是缺乏勇气。但是业火莲熏香也许可以使他们重拾勇气。然后他们就会为你指路了。

english.title: Instant Courage
english.objectives: Inspire 3 Hiding Guides in Howlingwind Cavern to help you.
english.description: It is very bad fortune to travel mountain paths without a good guide. We grummles make the best guides, but many have run away. They fear the mountain pass now. Many good grummles disappear up there.$b$bGrummles are good at many things, but are not very brave. Maybe with fire lotus incense you can make them brave. Then they will show you the way.

text.title: 兔子脚
text.objectives: 把堂弟兔子脚从断牙哨站救出来。
text.description: 断牙猢狲劫走了我们的堂弟兔子脚！他是我们当中最幸运的土地精！$b$b我们现在真是霉运当头了。$r，请你把我们的兔子脚带回来。我们得把他的好运带回来。$b$b你能去断牙哨站找到他吗？

english.title: The Rabbitsfoot
english.objectives: Rescue Brother Rabbitsfoot from the Broketooth Outpost.
english.description: The Broketooth hozen stole our Rabbitsfoot! He was the grummle with the biggest luckydo.$b$bThis is very bad fortune indeed. Please, $r, we need our Rabbitsfoot back. We need his good fortune back.$b$bCan you search the Broketooth Outpost for him?

text.title: 断牙猢狲的破坏
text.objectives: 从墨墨手中夺回幸运兔脚。
text.description: 他们抢走了我的幸运符！猢狲头领墨墨偷了我的兔子脚。$b$b这对土地精来说是最大的霉运。我的兔子脚对所有的土地精来说都是一个强大的幸运符。如果猢狲知道了怎么从我的兔子脚得到好运，那一切就全完了。$b$b你能帮我把它找回来吗？

english.title: The Broketooth Ravage
english.objectives: Retrieve Rabbitsfoot's Luckydo from Mo Mo.
english.description: They took my luckydo! Their leader hozen here, Mo Mo, stole my rabbitsfoot.$b$bThis is most bad fortune for grummles. My rabbitsfoot is a big luckydo for grummles everywhere. If hozen learn how to get luck from my rabbitsfoot then all is lost.$b$bPlease can you get it back?

text.title: 铲除断牙猢狲
text.objectives: 杀掉8个断牙冲锋者和6个断牙投掷者。
text.description: 猢狲们只有在食物供应不足时才会四处掠夺。$b$b但问题是，他们的食物总是不够吃。$b$b这段时间土地精的人数急剧减少。$b$b虽然有点难以启齿，但我还是得问你，作为土地精的朋友，你可以去南面消灭一部分断牙猢狲吗？这是阻止他们毁掉这块土地的唯一办法了。

english.title: Breaking Broketooth
english.objectives: Kill 8 Broketooth Chargers and 6 Broketooth Tossers.
english.description: Hozen only ravage when they think their supplies are too few for their number of mouths.$b$bProblem is, hozen always have more mouths than food.$b$bWe have very few grummles these days.$b$bIt is a hard thing to ask, but can you be a friend to grummles, and destroy some of the Broketooth hozen south of here? It is the only way to prevent them from destroying the landscape.

text.title: 两肋插刀
text.objectives: 营救堂弟牦牛鞋。
text.description: 在你离开的这段时间，有一群土地精来到了粗麻小径。是我的堂弟牦牛鞋带着他们来的。$b$b但是他们遭到了肘锤猢狲的袭击。他们把我的堂弟和他的族人抓到北边去了。$b$b请你帮帮我，$p！救救我的堂弟。虽然他总是霉运不断，但他毕竟是我的堂弟啊。去银背堡垒前面的祭坛找他。

english.title: Bros Before Hozen
english.objectives: Rescue Brother Yakshoe.
english.description: While you were gone, I saw a group of grummles coming down the Burlap Trail. It was led by my Brother Yakshoe.$b$bBut then the Knucklethumps attacked. They took my brother and his grummles north.$b$bPlease, $p! Save my brother. He always has bad fortune and no luck, but he is my brother. Look for him at the alter in front of Fort Silverback.

text.title: 重挫肘锤猢狲
text.objectives: 在肘锤洞窟杀掉8个肘锤重击者或肘锤掷矛者。
text.description: 肘锤猢狲推举了一个新酋长——乌克头领。$b$b他看到了西边的恐惧、南边的愤怒、北边的仇恨和东边的野牛人。$b$b所以他派出手下的猢狲大肆破坏，为即将到来的饥荒搜刮食物和物资。$b$b肘锤猢狲人数众多，危险异常。$b$b大救星，你能去消灭他们的战士吗？

english.title: Thumping Knucklethump
english.objectives: Slay 8 Knucklethump Smashers or Jibstabbers at Knucklethump Hole.
english.description: The Knucklethump hozen have new chief, the Ook of Dook.$b$bHe sees fear in the west, anger in the south, hatred in the north, and yaungols in the east.$b$bAnd so he sets his hozen to ravage, gathering food and supplies for coming famine.$b$bThey are many Knucklethumps and dangerous.$b$bPlease, Luckydo, can you defeat their fighters?

text.title: 猢狲和钥匙
text.objectives: 从怪猴奇奥奇奥身上找到雪人镣铐钥匙，放出老波波。
text.description: 猢狲养了一个雪人！他们管这个雪人叫“老波波”，并把他关在洞穴的后面。$b$b猢狲通常很怕雪人，但现在他们却用土地精来喂养雪人。$b$b他们有一个狩猎酋长，名叫怪猴奇奥奇奥。你能不能去看看他身上有没有雪人镣铐的钥匙？$b$b如果雪人的镣铐被打开了，那些猢狲可就要遭殃了。

english.title: Hozen Love Their Keys
english.objectives: Get the Yeti Shackle Key from Cho Cho the Wicked and release Old Poot Poot.
english.description: The hozen have a yeti! They call it Old Poot Poot and keep it at the back of their cave.$b$bHozen are normally scared of yeti, but now they feed it grummles.$b$bThey have a Hunter Chief, Cho Cho the Wicked. Can you see if he has a key on him to the yeti shackles?$b$bBad fortune for hozen if a yeti is loose in their fort.

text.title: 打牙祭
text.objectives: 割开绳索或者打开笼子，救出5个被囚的土地精。
text.description: 他们把我的土地精族人抓走了！猢狲不吃土地精，但是雪人会。肘锤猢狲已经抓到了一个雪人。$b$b快救救我的族人吧！割开他们的绳索或者把他们从笼子里放出来。用尽一切办法拯救他们。$b$b如果成功了的话，你就会得到很多好运和报酬。

english.title: The Snackrifice
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Imprisoned Grummles by cutting them down or releasing them from cages.
english.description: They took my grummles! Hozen don't eat grummles, but yeti do. And the Knucklethumps have a yeti.$b$bPlease rescue my grummles. Cut them down or let them out of cages. Rescue them any way you can.$b$bMany fortunes and rewards if you do this.

text.title: 土地精！土地精！土地精！
text.objectives: 把5个没有包裹的土地精带到暴徒末路附近的补给箱处。
text.description: 既然土地精已经成功得救了，现在我们得想办法把物资夺回来。$b$b乌克头领之所以能成为头领，是因为它占有着物资。$b$b到西北面的暴徒末路去，带上几个土地精。你只要保证他们的安全，把他们带到补给箱附近就行了。$b$b土地精知道该怎么做。$b$b我和兔子脚会在那和你会面。

english.title: Grummle! Grummle! Grummle!
english.objectives: Lead 5 Packless Grummles to Supply Crates near the Dooker Dome.
english.description: Now that grummles are rescued, we need to rescue our supplies.$b$bThe Ook of Dook is only chief because he has supplies.$b$bGo to the Dooker Dome area north west of here. Take some grummles with you. Keep them safe and get them near supply crates.$b$bGrummles know what to do from there.$b$bRabbitsfoot and I will meet you there.

text.title: 释放雪人！
text.objectives: 杀掉4个笼监。
text.description: 看到你骑雪人，我突然来了灵感。乌克头领有一头叫乔普乔普的宠物雪人。$b$b他用这只雪人吓唬其他猢狲，借此成为猢狲的大头领。我们得放了那个雪人。$b$b到西北面的暴徒末路去除掉一些笼监，这样一来乔普乔普就不会被看得很紧。$b$b牦牛鞋和我会带着很多熏香和一头脏牦牛跟你在那里会面。

english.title: Unleash The Yeti!
english.objectives: Kill 4 Cagemasters.
english.description: Your yeti ride gave me an idea. The Ook of Dook has a pet yeti he named Chomp Chomp.$b$bHe uses this yeti to scare other hozen in to making him the leader hozen. We need to get rid of that yeti.$b$bGo to Dooker Dome northwest of here and defeat some of the Cagemasters so Chomp Chomp is not tied up as much.$b$bYakshoe and I will meet you there with lots of incense and a dirty yak.

text.title: 猢狲头领
text.objectives: 激怒乔普乔普，然后击败乌克头领。
text.description: 是时候挑战乌克头领了。只要我们击败他，就不会有人再指示猢狲为其报仇了。$b$b计划是这样的：牦牛鞋会领塔索尔到角斗场，并吓跑乔普乔普。$b$b当雪人践踏猢狲的家园，猢狲无暇它顾的时候，你悄悄进去和乌克头领决斗。$b$b我们会在寇塔营地与你相会，你会得到一份重赏。愿土地精的朋友一路好运！
text.giverWindow: 山地部族的首领。

english.title: The Leader Hozen
english.objectives: Enrage Chomp Chomp and then defeat the Ook of Dook.
english.description: The time has come to face the Ook of Dook. We beat him, and the hozen won't have someone telling them to ravage.$b$bHere is the plan: Yakshoe will lead Tassle in to arena and scare away Chomp Chomp.$b$bThen, you sneak in and fight the Ook of Dook while his hozen are distracted by the yeti rampaging through their home.$b$bWe'll meet you back at Kota Basecamp with a big reward. Good fortune to you, friend of grummles.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the mountain tribes.

text.title: 铁鳞鲤鱼
text.objectives: 在渔人码头南边的水域使用鱼叉捕捉5条铁鳞鲤鱼。
text.description: 铁鳞鲤鱼在这一带远近闻名的美味。$b$b可惜我们没有办法钓它们上来，因为它们有力的下颚会咬断我们的钩子。带上这把鱼叉，看看你能否为我们抓一些铁鳞鲤鱼来。
text.giverWindow: 要捕这种鱼，用钩子是不行的。

english.title: Armored Carp
english.objectives: Use the Fishing Spear to catch 5 Armored Carp in the waters south of Anglers Wharf.
english.description: Armored Carp are a delicacy around these parts.$b$bUnfortunately we can't fish them up since they snap our hooks with their powerful jaws.  Take this fishing spear and see if you can catch a few for us.
english.giverWindow: Hooks won't work on this one.

text.title: 采油站
text.objectives: 在野牛人油井架那里装满空油瓶。
text.description: 野牛人来这儿以后就开始采一种油。不知道这个“油”到底是什么东西。那可能是一种我们从未见过的幸运玩意儿。我必须弄清楚。$b$b给，拿着这个瓶子，从他们的风车那儿弄点油来。如果你能弄到，我会好好回报你的。

english.title: Oil Stop
english.objectives: Fill the Empty Oil Vial at a Yaungol Oil Derrick.
english.description: When the yaungols came, they began to dig up oil. What is this "oil", I wonder? Perhaps it is thing of much undiscovered luck. This I must know.$b$bHere, take this vial, and fill it with yaungol oil from one of their windmills. I will give you many fortunes if you bring me some.

text.title: A Zandalari Troll?
text.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
text.description: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

english.title: A Zandalari Troll?
english.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
english.description: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

text.title: 交通问题
text.objectives: 消灭8个卢秦火营的野牛人。
text.description: 野牛人封锁了我们的粗麻小径。这对土地精来说是最大的不幸。$b$b我们常通过那条小径运送补给到蟠龙脊。没有补给，长城便岌岌可危。$b$b土地精是挑夫，不是战士。你能作为我们的幸运符，去打败拦路的野牛人吗？

english.title: Traffic Issues
english.objectives: Defeat 8 Fire Camp Ruqin Yaungols.
english.description: Yaungols are attacking our Burlap Trail. This is most bad fortune for grummles.$b$bWe use that trail to carry supplies to the Serpent's Spine. Without supplies, the defenders of the wall are in danger.$b$bGrummles are packers and explorers, not fighters. Could you be a luckydo for us and stop the yaungol blockade?

text.title: 道路救援
text.objectives: 点燃酒坛集沿路的8支幸运粗麻熏香。
text.description: 幸运的人会记着带上熏香一起进山。味道越香，运气越好。$b$b你能到酒坛集去走一趟，顺便把沿路的熏香都点燃吗？$b$b这样好运就会一直伴随着赶路的土地精了。$b$b堂弟皮棉兜会好好犒劳你的。你到那之后，就去跟他谈谈吧。

english.title: Roadside Assistance
english.objectives: Light 8 Lucky Burlap Incense sticks along the road to One Keg.
english.description: A luckydo remembers to bring incense on a journey in to the mountains. The smellier the luck the better.$b$bCan you journey up the road to One Keg and light the incense you find along the way?$b$bThis will give good fortune to grummles that must travel the road.$b$bBrother Lintpocket can give you many rewards. Speak to him when you arrive.

text.title: 恢复酒坛集的补给
text.objectives: 去凛风洞找回8箱失窃的补给品。
text.description: 如果你想在昆莱找到最好的补给品，那你可来对地方了！的确，这里看着有点萧条，但别光看表面……$b$b嗨，我这是蒙谁呢？！自从猢狲和林精洗劫了我们为数不多的补给品后，我的库存已跌到警戒线位置了。$b$b如果你能帮我找回一些补给品，我一定会有所回报的。

english.title: Resupplying One Keg
english.objectives: Recover 8 Stolen Supplies from Howlingwind Cavern.
english.description: If you're looking for the best supplies in Kun-Lai you've come to the right place! Oh sure, it looks a bit empty. Don't let appearances deceive you..$b$bOh, who am I kidding?! Between the hozen attacks, and the sprites pillaging what few supplies we do get, my stock has dwindled to a dangerous level.$b$bIf you could help me recover some of my supplies I should have enough to contribute to your journey.

text.title: 魔古族？！哦，不！
text.objectives: 击败魔古岬唤魂者。
text.description:
我知道你的朋友在担心魔古岬那边的活动雕像，但我要告诉你，你们真正应该担心的是什么。

只要有这种活动雕像的地方，就有魔古族。我不知道你以前是否见过这个种族，但如果你没有……

好吧，简单来说魔古族对我们而言是非常非常糟糕的消息。

无论要做什么，都必须首先解决掉制造麻烦的魔古族！
text.giverWindow: 魔古岬麻烦的真正源头……

english.title: Mogu?! Oh No-gu!
english.objectives: Kill the Mogujia Soul-Caller.
english.description:
I know your friends are worried about the animating statues over at Mogujia, but I'll tell you what you should really be worried about.

Where there are animated statues, there are mogu. I don't know if you've seen one before, but if you haven't...

Well, let's just say mogu are bad, bad, news.

While you're dealing with whatever else you're doing, you need to get the mogu behind the trouble!
english.giverWindow: The real source of the problems at Mogujia...

text.title: 魔古族？！哦，不！
text.objectives: 击败魔古岬唤魂者。
text.description:
我知道你的朋友在担心魔古岬那边的活动雕像，但我要告诉你，你们真正应该担心的是什么。

只要有这种活动雕像的地方，就有魔古族。我不知道你以前是否见过这个种族，但如果你没有……

好吧，简单来说魔古族对我们而言是非常非常糟糕的消息。

无论要做什么，都必须首先解决掉制造麻烦的魔古族！
text.giverWindow: 魔古岬麻烦的真正源头……

english.title: Mogu?! Oh No-gu!
english.objectives: Kill the Mogujia Soul-Caller.
english.description:
I know your friends are worried about the animating statues over at Mogujia, but I'll tell you what you should really be worried about.

Where there are animated statues, there are Mogu. I don't know if you've seen one before, but if you haven't...

Well, let's just say Mogu are bad, bad, news.

While you're dealing with whatever else you're doing, you need to get the Mogu behind the trouble!
english.giverWindow: The real source of the problems at Mogujia...

text.title: 他们偷走了我的好运！
text.objectives: 找回季禄的幸运兔妖脚、牦牛蹄铁、四风四叶草和金币。
text.description: 这趟昆莱之行教会我两件事：第一，永远别偷偷靠近一头熟睡的牦牛；第二，好运是必需的，也是可遇而不可求的。$b$b土地精总会带着一个幸运饰物。在我认为，如果一个饰物能偶尔带来好运，那么很多的饰物就一定能带来好运了！$b$b来到酒坛集后，我的幸运饰物都被那些可恶的林精偷走了。如果你能帮我把它们找回来，我会由衷地感谢你。

english.title: They Stole My Luck!
english.objectives: Return Ji-Lu the Lucky's Lucky Virmen's Foot, Yak Shoe, Four Winds Clover, and Gold Coin.
english.description: My journeys through Kun-Lai have taught me two things. First, never sneak up on a sleeping yak. Second, having luck on your side is both necessary and hard to come by.$b$bThe grummles believe in carrying a lucky trinket at all times. In my mind, if one trinket can sometimes bring luck, then many trinkets would guarantee it!$b$bAfter arriving in One Keg my lucky trinkets were stolen by those little menace sprites. I'd be truly grateful if you could retrieve them for me.

text.title: 虫群入侵
text.objectives: 击败15名伊克提克战士或伊克提克传染者。
text.description: 失去了长城的保护，我们几乎没有胜算。要不是你召集了这么多人来帮忙，就算老天爷也帮不了我们。$b$b去联络一下守卫队长橡盾——他应该就在长城的缺口附近。在去那儿的路上，尽量多消灭点螳螂妖。$b$b如果我们赢了，那自然天下太平。如果输了，那就血拼到底。为了潘达利亚！

english.title: The Swarm Begins
english.objectives: Slay 15 Ik'thik Warriors or Ik'thik Infestors.
english.description: Without the wall to protect us, we barely stand a chance. If you hadn't gathered so many people to help us, we wouldn't have a prayer.$b$bCheck in with Captain Oakenshield - he should be up near the break in the wall. Kill as many mantid as you can on the way there.$b$bIf we win, we win. If we lose, we go down fighting. For Pandaria!

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死伊克提克传染者或战士

text.title: 螳螂妖
text.objectives: 在5个伊克提克空军指挥官身上使用肯肯的面具，然后打败出现的恐惧化身。
text.description: <梅指着战场说道。>$b$b你看到战场上那些巨型螳螂妖指挥官了吗？他们身上的气息让我想起了朱家堡那惨烈的一幕。$b$b或许……他们也被煞魔腐蚀了？$b$b我还保留着肯肯的面具——他以前就是用这个除掉了易默身上的煞魔。我相信，如果我们把它用在螳螂妖身上，我们就能劝他们偃旗息鼓了。

english.title: The Mantidote
english.objectives: Use Ken-Ken's Mask on 5 Ik'thik Wing Commanders, then defeat the Manifestations of Fear that come out.
english.description: <Mei motions towards the battlefield.>$b$bYou see those huge mantid commanders out there? They have a strange aura about them. It reminds me of the sadness we saw at Zhu's Watch.$b$bPerhaps... they're under the influence of the sha, too?$b$bI kept Ken-Ken's mask - the one he used to remove the sha from Yi-Mo. I believe that, if we use it on the mantid, we can convince them to turn back.

objectiveDetails.description: 对伊克提克空军指挥官使用肯肯的面具

text.title: 来桶小酒助兴
text.objectives: 将啤酒带给朱家戒卫、鹤翼祭司、影踪派和暗夜精灵定居者。
text.description: 我一直在想啊。$b$b我们有了陈酿造的酒，同时你也召集到了这些士兵。我们应当把二者结合起来。$b$b这么多人正在外面浴血奋战，为了潘达利亚，他们不惜牺牲生命。我们至少应该带一两桶酒给他们。$b$b他们既可以用这酒来庆祝胜利，也可以在被螳螂妖切成肉片前，享受人生的最后一次痛饮。无论如何，我绝不会让他们连口酒都喝不上就去陷阵杀敌的。

english.title: It Does You No Good In The Keg
english.objectives: Bring beer to Zhu's Wardens, the Crane Wing Priests, the Shado-Pan, and the night elf settlers.
english.description: I been thinkin'.$b$bWe got all this beer that Chen brewed, and we got all these people that you've gathered. We should bring the two together.$b$bThere's a bunch o' folks out there in the fields, riskin' their lives for Pandaria. You an' I should at least bring 'em a keg or two.$b$bThey might raise their mugs in victory. They might enjoy one last drink before gettin' skivvered by a mantid. Either way, I wouldn't want 'em to fight without a good brew in their belly.

objectiveDetails.description: 将啤酒交给暗夜精灵定居者

text.title: 出师
text.objectives: 找到武术弟子，然后帮助他们打败伊克提克狂血者、伊克提克监护者、伊克提克切裂者和伊克提克威慑者。
text.description: 那五个弟子——就是寻找隐秘大师的那五个人——他们单独冲到前线去了。我想调些影踪派的人去帮他们，但现在已经无人可用了。$b$b长城附近出现了一些危险的生物。如果你找到那些弟子，务必要保护他们活着回来。

english.title: Students No More
english.objectives: Find the martial arts students, then help them defeat an Ik'thik Bloodrager, Egg-Matron, Tendon-Slicer, and Fearmonger.
english.description: Those five students - the ones who were looking for the Hidden Master - they went up to the front lines, alone. I'd send Shado-Pan to aid them, but I haven't got any left.$b$bThere's dangerous creatures up there near the wall. If you find those students, make sure that they haven't fallen to any of them.

text.title: 撤退！
text.objectives: 去四风谷的石犁村向麦龙报告。
text.description: 我准备撤回我仅剩的几支残部了。我们可能必须撤回到风暴烈酒酿造厂，甚至是半山。但那得由执勤官麦龙决定。$b$b你们先撤。把我的话转达给执勤官。我们影踪派随后就到。
text.completed: 去四风谷的石犁村向麦龙报告。

english.title: Retreat!
english.objectives: Report to Loon Mai at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: I'm going to withdraw what few forces I have. We may have to fall back to the Stormstout Brewery, or even Halfhill. That call is Commander Loon Mai's to make.$b$bYou go ahead. Deliver word to the Commander. My Shado-Pan will be shortly behind.
english.completed: Report to Loon Mai at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 石犁村的救星
text.objectives: 和石犁村的范妮小姐谈一谈，然后在她的帮助下击败螳螂巨像。
text.description: 指挥官的话言之过早。他掌握着赢得战斗的关键武器——那就是你。$b$b你可能会说：“但这太难了”。$b$b你错了，这不会太难。世上无难事，只怕有心人。$b$b去吧，$n。杀出重围，拯救石犁村！

english.title: The Savior of Stoneplow
english.objectives: Speak with Miss Fanny at Stoneplow. Then, with her help, defeat the Mantid Colossus.
english.description: That commander speaks hastily. He has the weapon he needs to win this battle. He has YOU.$b$b"But it's too hard," you might say.$b$bYou would be wrong. It is not too hard. NOTHING IS TOO HARD.$b$bGo now, $n. Go, and save Stoneplow!

text.title: 石犁村的谢意
text.objectives: 找到指挥官的箱子，领取你的奖励。
text.description: 还剩最后一件事，$n。别担心，不是让你帮忙的。你今天杀的螳螂妖已经够多了。$b$b我们最近收到了一批从昆莱山运来的高品质的护甲。我本来计划留着给自己的村民用……但我觉得你才是最有资格使用它们的人。你可以在镇上旅店的二楼找到那些护甲。
text.completed: 找到指挥官的箱子。

english.title: The Gratitude of Stoneplow
english.objectives: Find the Commander's Cache and collect your reward.
english.description: One last thing, $n. Don't worry, it's not another favor. You've killed enough mantid today.$b$bWe recently received a shipment of high-quality armor from Kun-Lai Summit. I was planning to keep them for my men... but I can't think of anybody more deserving than you. You'll find them on the second floor of the inn, here in town.
english.completed: Find the Commander's Cache.

text.title: FLAG - Player Began Finale
text.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
text.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

english.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.

objectiveDetails.description: Listen to Xiao and his companions

text.title: Into the Vale
text.objectives: Speak to Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.$B$BI wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.$B$BBut let us not speak of that now. Go visit Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars.$B$BShe should be able to settle you in.

english.objectives: Speak to Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 七星殿
text.objectives: 去锦绣谷和宽仁的贾鲁、“光之心”库鲁、幸运的林曦还有瓦妮阿姨谈一谈。
text.description: 看看这个家伙，旅行者。我们到达之后不久，这个魔古族刺客就毫无预兆地袭来。$B$B他意在刺杀金莲教的首领。非常幸运的是，我们在这儿阻止了这次刺杀。$B$B看到有人要取智先生的性命，我不禁要担心那些已经进谷的人们的安危。$B$B金莲护法把你们的人安顿在东南方的大殿中。去和首领谈一谈。确保他们的安全。

english.title: The Shrine of Seven Stars
english.objectives: Speak to Jaluu the Generous, Kuru the Light-Hearted, Lucky Lin, and Matron Vi Vinh in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: Look at this creature, traveler. Only moments after we arrived, this mogu assassin attacked with no warning.$B$BHis blade was intended for the leader of the Golden Lotus. It is very lucky indeed that we were here to stop the attack.$B$BSeeing this attempt on Zhi's life, I fear for the safety of those who have already entered the valley.$B$BThe caretakers are settling your people into the city to the southeast. Go and speak to the leaders. Make sure they are safe.

text.title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
text.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: According to Zhi the Harmonious, the mogu are moving into the Vale from the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the west.$B$BI sent Anji and Kun to investigate the situation, but they have not yet returned.$B$BI need a capable $c like you to go check on them.

english.title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
english.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: According to Zhi the Harmonious, the mogu are moving into the Vale from the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the west.$B$BI sent Anji and Kun to investigate the situation, but they have not yet returned.$B$BI need a capable $c like you to go check on them.

text.title: Out with the Scouts
text.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Precursor.
text.description: We'd been briefed on mogu sightings in the Vale, but the situation is worse than we had anticipated.$B$BScouts are swarming all over the ruins to the northwest, gathering intel and stealing treasures.$B$BYour objective is clear - dispatch of any scouts you see. An army cannot move if we take out its eyes.

english.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Precursor.

An army cannot move if we take out its eyes.

text.title: Barring Entry
text.objectives: Speak to Lao Softfoot at the entrance to Ruins Rise and follow him up the trail. Then, plant the Explosive Keg at the Ruins Rise Cave Entrance.
text.description: Lao Softfoot and I scouted up the ruins to the north.$B$BIt looks like the mogu are infiltrating the valley through a cave just up the hill, and already they are sending formidable reinforcements through.$B$BThere are too many enemies to take them head on, so you'll have to meet Lao Softfoot at the entrance to the ruins.$B$BHe'll help you sneak in under the cover of stealth. Then, plant this keg of explosives at the mouth of the cave.$B$BThe rest should take care of itself.

text.title: Killing the Quilen
text.objectives: Kill 9 Stone Guardians.
text.description: We've taken care of the scout problem for now, but there are still advance mogu forces inside the Guo-Lai Halls down the hill.$B$BUnfortunately, their vicious guard dogs are protecting their operations deeper in the ruins.$B$BGo and dispatch of their beasts. Be on your guard - they can be quite good at blending into their surroundings.

english.objectives: Kill 9 Stone Guardians.

text.title: Stones of Power
text.objectives: Collect 7 Revelite Crystals.
text.description: Many thousands of years ago, the rulers of the Vale sought energy from a powerful crystal known as Revelite.$B$BWith this substance, they were able to power cities, factories, and engines of war.$B$BZhi the Harmonious has asked us to collect some crystals and bring them back to the city.$B$BKeep an eye out for them while you are in the ruins.

english.objectives: Collect 7 Revelite Crystals.

text.title: The Guo-Lai Halls
text.objectives: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.
text.description: As you pass by the great door, you hear sounds from deep inside.$B$BAnji mentioned that advance mogu scouts had been sighted in this area. Perhaps they made their way down to the depths below.$B$BYour senses tingling, you decide to investigate.

english.objectives: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.

text.title: Leaving an Opening
text.objectives: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: This is serious.$B$BKun and I will keep an eye on things here, but you should go to the Golden Pagoda.$B$BGo, swiftly!

english.objectives: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: The Secrets of Guo-Lai
text.objectives: Meet with He Softfoot in the Guo-Lai Halls and uncover the mogu's purpose in the western chamber.
text.description: I just received information from a guard stationed near the Ruins of Guo-Lai that the Shado-Tien leader entered the halls, killing two of my men in the process. They're intent on something inside. We need to stop them.$B$BHe Softfoot has already followed them in. He should be waiting for you at the entrance to the western chambers.$B$BMove quickly, $n. I don't like the thought that the mogu may be a step ahead of us.

objectiveDetails.description: Uncover the mogu plan in the Hall of Statues

text.title: Battle Spear of the Thunder King
text.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.
text.description: I have received some troubling news, $n.$B$BThe mogu are plotting to steal three artifacts of power from the Vale.$B$BWe must retrieve the artifacts immediately and hide them for safekeeping.$B$BThe first artifact is the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.$B$BUpon emperor Lei Shen's death, the spear was placed in an ancient shrine to the northwest.$B$BBring the spear back to me.

english.title: Battle Spear of the Thunder King
english.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.

text.title: Battle Helm of the Thunder King
text.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.
text.description: The second artifact of power is the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.$B$BEmperor Lei Shen wore the helm into every battle. It became so well-known that his enemies would flee at the mere sight of it.$B$BWhen the Emperor died, they placed the helm in the very bottom of the Guo-Lai Halls to the west, surrounded by thousands of terracotta soldiers.$B$BThus, they could look upon their leader and follow him into death.

english.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.

text.title: Battle Axe of the Thunder King
text.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Axe of the Thunder King.
text.description: The final artifact is the Thunder King's axe.$B$BLei Shen charged into battle with his spear in one hand, and his axe in the other.$B$BIt is said that he could throw his axe with brutal accuracy, and when it hit its target, it made a sound like crashing thunder.$B$BAfter his death, the axe was placed in a ceremonial chamber to the southwest.$B$BNeedless to say, we must not let it fall into the mogu's hands.

text.title: The Mogu's Message
text.objectives: Speak to Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: The battle against the mogu rages fiercely with neither side giving quarter.$B$BWe cannot hold our position forever. Something must be done to strike a blow at the mogu, a blow from which they cannot recover.$B$BGo check in with Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary. I wish to hear his thoughts on this matter.

text.title: What Comes to Pass
text.objectives: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: You had better report back to the Golden Pagoda immediately.

english.title: What Comes to Pass
english.objectives: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: You had better report back to the Golden Pagoda immediately.

text.title: The Might of Three
text.objectives: Slay 100 mogu invaders at the Summer Fields in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: This is it, $n. This is the end.$B$BIf we don't drive the mogu from the valley, they will seize the remnants of their ancient power and use it to break Pandaria to their will.$B$BBut our forces are few, and tired, and small. We bleed, while their warriors are made of stone.$B$B$n, although all odds are against us, still I must ask you to go and help our forces slay the mogu invaders.$B$BI have prayed to the Celestials, begging their aid. I can only hope that they answer our call.

text.title: The Final Power
text.objectives: Kill Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter.
text.description: I never thought it would come to this!$B$BLeven went to face Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter at the top of the palace steps, but our reinforcements cannot get through!$B$BWe are the only ones who stand between him and the Vale's greatest... and most deadly... powers.$B$BPlease, $n, you must find a way to stop him!
text.giverWindow: The leader of the Shao-Tien mogu.

text.title: Tracking Quest: Opened the Golden Valley

english.title: Tracking Quest: Opened the Golden Valley

text.title: 勇往直前
text.objectives: 和菲谈一谈并前往四风谷。
text.description: 你在这片土地上经历了一段不同凡响的旅程，旅行者。很显然，我的旅程注定还要持续一段时间。$b$b自从你的人民到达这里，发生了一连串相互关联的事件，虽然其中一些令人不堪回首，但我感到上天安排你们到此一定有更重要的目的。$b$b目前看来，对你来说最明智的做法就是离开这里，然后继续探索潘达利亚的其他地区。$b$b当你准备好离开时，请和我谈一谈。
text.completion: Be wise, traveler.$b$bProve to these inhabitants that there is more to your people than war and destruction.

english.title: Moving On
english.objectives: Speak to Fei and travel to Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Your journey in this land has already proven most eventful, traveler. And mine, it appears, is destined to continue for a time.$b$bA chain of events began when your people arrived here, and while some of those happenings are traumatic to behold, I feel there must be a larger purpose behind your presence.$b$bFor now it is wisest that you leave this place and explore Pandaria's other regions.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready to leave.
english.completion: Be wise, traveler.$b$bProve to these inhabitants that there is more to your people than war and destruction.

text.title: 双月殿
text.objectives: 去锦绣谷和宽仁的贾鲁、强壮的莫吉莫、长者廖禄还有薇洛夫人谈一谈。
text.description: 看看这个家伙，旅行者。我们到达之后不久，这个魔古族刺客就毫无预兆地袭来。$B$B他意在刺杀金莲教的首领。非常幸运的是，我们在这儿阻止了这次刺杀。$B$B看到有人要取智先生的性命，我不禁要担心那些已经进谷的人们的安危。$B$B金莲护法把你们的人安顿在东北方的大殿中。去和首领谈一谈。确保他们的安全。

english.title: The Shrine of Two Moons
english.objectives: Speak to Jaluu the Generous, Mokimo the Strong, Elder Liao, and Madam Vee Luo in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: Look at this creature, traveler. Only moments after we arrived, this mogu assassin attacked with no warning.$B$BHis blade was intended for the leader of the Golden Lotus. It is very lucky indeed that we were here to stop the attack.$B$BSeeing this attempt on Zhi's life, I fear for the safety of those who have already entered the valley.$B$BThe caretakers are settling your people into the city to the northeast. Go and speak to the leaders. Make sure they are safe.

text.title: 熊猫人囚徒
text.objectives: 解救8个熊猫人囚徒。
text.description:
听着，我知道联盟需要新兵，而且目前镇上的人手不足以形成战斗力。

但是我知道西北方斡耳朵火营的野牛人抓走了许多我的族人，并将他们关押了起来。我还知道如果你愿意将他们从囚禁中解救出来，他们将很有可能愿意加入联盟。

你觉得怎么样，$n？

english.title: Pandaren Prisoners
english.objectives: Free 8 Pandaren Prisoners.
english.description:
Look, I know the Alliance needs recruits, and there's just not enough of us here right now to make a fighting presence of this town.

But I know that the yaungol over at Fire Camp Ordo, to the northwest, have taken many of my people as prisoners. And I also know that if you would be willing to rescue them from their captivity, they'd more than likely be willing to join the Alliance.

What do you say, $n?

text.title: 炸药桶的乐趣
text.objectives: 使用在斡耳朵火营找到的炸药桶摧毁西部、南部和东部的钻油机。
text.description: 哈哈，现在让我们找点乐子吧，$g小伙子:姑娘;！$B$B西北部的斡耳朵部族野牛人为我们省去了制造炸弹的麻烦，他们都帮我们准备好了。$B$B我们用他们自己的炸药桶炸掉他们的抽油机器，你说怎么样？

english.title: Barrels of Fun
english.objectives: Use Explosive Barrels found in Fire Camp Ordo to destroy the West, South, and East Oil Rigs.
english.description: Oh, well now, let's have us some fun, $g boyo : girly;!$B$BThose Ordo yaungol to the northwest have saved us the trouble o' havin' to make some bombs. They already have them there.$B$BLet's put their explosive barrels to good use and destroy their oil-pumpin' machines, shall we?

text.title: 帐内导能
text.objectives: 击败斡耳朵唤烬者、斡耳朵炎术师、斡耳朵火语者和斡耳朵炽炎使。
text.description: 斡耳朵火营的野牛人是个巨大的威胁。我要你到西北边去把他们的首领除掉。$B$B不幸的是，他的四个属下撑起了一个火焰屏障，护住了他藏身的洞穴，使我们难以靠近。$B$B干掉他们后，那个防护盾自会消失。他们就在帐篷里为火焰屏障引导能量，快去吧。

english.title: In Tents Channeling
english.objectives: Kill the Ordo Embercaller, Ordo Pyromancer, Ordo Firespeaker, and Ordo Blazecaster.
english.description: The yaungol of Fire Camp Ordo are a dire threat. I need you to head northwest and take out their leader.$B$BUnfortunately, his four subordinates are maintaining a fire barrier that prevents us from getting to him in the adjoining cave.$B$BTake them out and the shield will come down. You'll find them in their tents, channeling.

text.title: 来桶小酒助兴
text.objectives: 将啤酒带给朱家戒卫、鹤翼祭司、影踪派和牛头人定居者。
text.description: 我一直在想啊。$b$b我们有了陈酿造的酒，同时你也召集到了这些士兵。我们应当把二者结合起来。$b$b这么多人正在外面浴血奋战，为了潘达利亚，他们不惜牺牲生命。我们至少应该带一两桶酒给他们。$b$b他们既可以用这酒来庆祝胜利，也可以在被螳螂妖切成肉片前，享受人生的最后一次痛饮。无论如何，我绝不会让他们连口酒都喝不上就去陷阵抗敌的。

english.title: It Does You No Good In The Keg
english.objectives: Bring beer to Zhu's Wardens, the Crane Wing Priests, the Shado-Pan, and the tauren settlers.
english.description: I been thinkin'.$b$bWe got all this beer that Chen brewed, and we got all these people that you've gathered. We should bring the two together.$b$bThere's a bunch o' folks out there in the fields, riskin' their lives for Pandaria. You an' I should at least bring 'em a keg or two.$b$bThey might raise their mugs in victory. They might enjoy one last drink before gettin' skivvered by a mantid. Either way, I wouldn't want 'em to fight without a good brew in their belly.

objectiveDetails.description: 将啤酒交给牛头人定居者

text.title: The Guo-Lai Halls
text.objectives: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.
text.description: The mogu are up to something, I can feel it.$B$BThey've been sending scouts down into the Guo-Lai Halls.$B$BAccording to the caretakers, the Halls are home to ancient treasures of emperors past. Not only riches, but artifacts of great power.$B$BWe must prevent the mogu from accessing these treasures! Go down the ramp to the northwest and stop them!

text.title: 熊猫人囚徒
text.objectives: 解救8个熊猫人囚徒。
text.description:
你瞧，我知道部落需要兵源，而且我们这里的人手不足以保护这座镇子。

但我知道西边的斡耳朵火营那儿的野牛人关押着很多我们的同胞。我还知道，如果你愿意去救出他们，他们就有可能加入部落。

你看呢，$n？

english.title: Pandaren Prisoners
english.objectives: Free 8 Pandaren Prisoners.
english.description:
Look, I know the Horde needs recruits, and there's just not enough of us here right now to make a fighting presence of this town.

But I know that the yaungol over at Fire Camp Ordo, to the west, have taken many of my people as prisoners. And I also know that if you would be willing to rescue them from their captivity, they'd more than likely be willing to join the Horde.

What do you say, $n?

text.title: 炸药桶的乐趣
text.objectives: 使用在斡耳朵火营找到的炸药桶摧毁东部、南部和西部的钻油机。
text.description: 我就爱把东西炸上天，这是我与生俱来的天性！$B$B西边斡耳朵火营的野牛人有成堆的炸药桶，就摆放在营地附近。$B$B我说，我们用他们的炸药把他们的抽油机器炸个稀巴烂怎么样？多好玩啊！

english.title: Barrels of Fun
english.objectives: Use Explosive Barrels found in Fire Camp Ordo to destroy the East, South, and West Oil Rigs.
english.description: I love blowing stuff up. It's in my blood!$B$BThe yaungol to the west at Fire Camp Ordo have a ton of explosive barrels just lying around.$B$BI say we put them to good use and destroy their oil-pumpin' machines while having some fun!

text.title: 帐内导能
text.objectives: 杀死斡耳朵唤烬者、斡耳朵炎术师、斡耳朵火语者和斡耳朵炽炎使。
text.description: 斡耳朵火营的野牛人是我们目前面临的最大威胁。我要你到西边去把他们的首领除掉。$B$B这个懦夫躲在一个洞穴里，外面还有一道由他的四个手下撑起的火焰护盾。$B$B干掉他们，那个防护盾自会消失。他们就在帐篷里为火焰屏障引导能量，快去吧。

english.title: In Tents Channeling
english.objectives: Kill the Ordo Embercaller, Ordo Pyromancer, Ordo Firespeaker, and Ordo Blazecaster.
english.description: The yaungol of Fire Camp Ordo are the worst threat we're facing. I need you to head west and take out their leader.$B$BThe coward is hiding in a cave, which is protected by a fire shield cast by his four underlings.$B$BTake them out and the shield will come down. You'll find them in their tents, channeling.

text.title: 河豚毒刺
text.objectives: 在刹允深渊使用鱼叉杀死5条刺皮河豚，并把它们的尖刺带回来。
text.description: 你听说过刺皮河豚吗，$n？哦，你是新来的，肯定没听说过！$b$b你能在正西边的刹允深渊找到它们。带上这把鱼叉，看看你能否为我带回一些锋利的河豚毒刺来。
text.giverWindow: 小心，这些尖刺会留下讨厌的伤疤！

english.title: Huff & Puff
english.objectives: Use the Fishing Spear to kill 5 Prickly Puffer fish in Sarjun Depths and return with their spines.
english.description: Have you heard of the prickly puffer fish $n?  Of course you haven't, you're new around these parts!$b$bThey can be found in the sarjun depths, due west of here.  Take this fishing spear and see if you can bring me back of few of their poison tipped spines.
english.giverWindow: Careful, those spines have been known to leave nasty scars!

text.title: 斡耳朵战争使者
text.objectives: 击败斡耳朵战争使者。
text.description: <防护盾消失了。直捣黄龙，干掉斡耳朵野牛人的战争使者！>
text.giverWindow: 他失去了防护盾的保护！

english.title: The Ordo Warbringer
english.objectives: Kill Ordo Warbringer.
english.description: <The shield is down. Time to head into the cave and slay the Warbringer of the Ordo yaungol!>
english.giverWindow: No longer protected by his shield!

text.title: 斡耳朵战争使者
text.objectives: 击败斡耳朵战争使者。
text.description: <防护盾消失了。直捣黄龙，干掉斡耳朵野牛人的战争使者！>
text.giverWindow: 他失去了防护盾的保护！

english.title: The Ordo Warbringer
english.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
english.description: <The shield is down. Time to head into the cave and slay the Warbringer of the Ordo!>
english.giverWindow: No longer protected by his shield!

text.title: The Ordo Warbringer
text.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
text.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Go back there before the shield goes up again.$B$BTime to head into the cave and slay their chief!
text.giverWindow: No longer protected by his shield!

english.title: The Ordo Warbringer
english.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
english.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Go back there before the shield goes up again.$B$BTime to head into the cave and slay their chief!
english.giverWindow: No longer protected by his shield!

text.title: The Ordo Warbringer
text.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
text.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Get back over there before they get that shield up again.$B$BSlay the Warbringer of the Ordo!
text.giverWindow: No longer protected by his shield!

english.title: The Ordo Warbringer
english.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
english.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Get back over there before they get that shield up again.$B$BSlay the Warbringer of the Ordo!
english.giverWindow: No longer protected by his shield!

text.title: 保卫影踪别院
text.objectives: 击败15个感染煞能的野牛人。
text.description:
我派人去向影踪禅院求援，但一直杳无音信。现在我们的城镇已经失守。

一些村民侥幸逃了出来，但我们也被困于此。

我们没时间来款待陌生人了。如果你能参战，请帮助我们保卫这座城镇。如果不能，请你离开，因为在这里你也活不了多久。

english.title: The Defense of Shado-Pan Fallback
english.objectives: Kill 15 Sha-Infested Yaungol.
english.description:
I sent for reinforcements from the Shado-Pan Monastery, but have heard nothing back. We have already lost the town.

A few lucky villagers may have survived, but we are pinned down here.

We do not have time to entertain strangers. If you can fight, help my men defend this tower. If not, leave, for you will not survive long here.

text.title: 突然袭击
text.objectives: 去奇亚卡拉克杀死8只死息鳄鱼。
text.description: 我的一天通常是这么度过的：钓鱼、吃鱼、接着睡觉。请注意，我的日常活动可不包括“与鳄鱼搏斗”。$b$b你看上去是个能干的$c。你能去干掉一些鳄鱼，让我恢复日常的生活吗？鳄鱼通常在西北面的奇亚卡拉克居住，与我们井水不犯河水。

english.title: Sudden, Unexpected Crocolisk Aggression
english.objectives: Slay 8 Mortbreath crocolisks at Kea Krak.
english.description: Normally, my day consists of catching fish, and then eating the fish I caught, followed by sleeping. Note that I did not include "fight with a crocolisk" in that list of activities.$b$bYou look like a handy $c. Can you go get rid of some of these crocolisks, so I can get back to my regular routine? The crocolisks normally keep to themselves up at Kea Krak, to the northwest.

text.title: 特别的羽毛
text.objectives: 获得6根翡翠尾羽，6根赤红尾羽和6根暮色尾羽。
text.description: 当鳄鱼发起攻击时，我们西北面那个岛屿上的鹦鹉被吓得倾巢而出。$b$b我可以利用这些鹦鹉的羽毛做一些特殊的鱼饵，这样当哪天我终于可以不用再为了保护同胞而去和那些爬行动物纠缠时，我就可以用这些特别的鱼饵去钓鱼了。$b$b你愿意去收集一些羽毛吗？

english.title: Particular Plumage
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Emerald Tailfeathers, 6 Crimson Tailfeathers, and 6 Dusky Tailfeathers.
english.description: When the crocs started attacking, they scared a bunch of the lories out of their nests, up in that island to our northwest.$b$bI can use those lories' feathers to make some specialized lures, which will come in handy if and when I get to stop defending my brethren from these reptiles.$b$bYou up for some feather hunting?

text.title: 造木筏
text.objectives: 获得4块备用木板和一些结实的海藻。
text.description: <贾朝奇亚卡拉克的方向望去。>$b$b嗯，它们似乎还没有……冷静下来，我们得试试其他方法。$b$b你需要一只木筏。去给我找些木板和海藻来，看我来给你露一手。

english.title: Build Your Own Raft
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Spare Planks and some Tough Kelp.
english.description: <Jay looks off in the direction of Kea Krak.>$b$bHmm. They don't seem to be... calming down. We're going to have to try something different.$b$bYou'll need a raft. Go grab some wood planks and seaweed, and bring them over to me. I'll put something together for you.

text.title: 湖面上的游学者
text.objectives: 登上你的木筏，然后去纳耶里海礁的中央向睿智的阿娜·吴报告。
text.description: 你的木筏已经下水了。你可以乘着它到湖泊的中央去，你会在那里见到一个女人。她的名字叫阿娜·吴。$b$b只要我有自己没法解决的问题，我就会去向她讨教。她应该能解释为什么这群鳄鱼一直不停地攻击我们。

english.title: The Lorewalker on the Lake
english.objectives: Board your raft, then report to Wise Ana Wu in the middle of Nayeli Lagoon.
english.description: Your raft is down in the water below. Take it out to the middle of the lake, where you should find a woman. Her name is Ana  Wu.$b$bWhenever I have a question that I can't figure out on my own, I'll ask her. She should be able to tell us why these crocolisks won't stop attacking.

text.title: 道法自然
text.objectives: 从火树村的盲目怒火身上收集5份盲目怒火精华。
text.description:
我们真正的敌人是煞魔，而非野牛人。

煞魔是情感的实体化，拥有很强的破坏性，但却毫无组织纪律，没有组织性的力量不会持久。洪水越分散，冲击力越小；野火越是旺，消耗越是快。

在纪律和智慧的帮助下，我们就能让它们自灭。

去村里给我带些煞之精华，我会作进一步解释的。

english.title: Turnabout
english.objectives: Collect 5 Blind Rage Essences from Blind Rages in Firebough Nook.
english.description:
Our true enemies are the sha, not the yaungol.

The sha are emotion manifest. Destructive, yes. But undisciplined. Undisciplined force cannot last. The flood, in dispersion, loses its force. The wildfire burns its fuel.

And, discipline and wisdom can turn their destructive energy against themselves.

Bring me the essences of the sha in the village, and I will explain further.

text.title: 知识有价
text.objectives: 获得5块鲨鱼肉。
text.description: <阿娜听完你的讲述，然后点了点头。>$b$b鳄鱼进攻？我知道一点有关的情况，可以跟你分享一下。不过首先……我有点饿了。$b$b鲨鱼肉是个不错的选择，我们脚底下这片水域里有很多鲨鱼。

english.title: Wisdom Has A Price
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Shark Fillets.
english.description: <Ana listens to your story, and nods.>$b$bCrocolisks attacking? I know a story about that. And I will share it with you, but first... I grow hungry.$b$bShark meat should do the trick. You should find enough sharks in the water beneath us.

text.title: 平衡
text.objectives: 击败10个盎迦捕鱼者。
text.description: 这个故事最终以悲剧收场，纳松鳄鱼已不复存在了。$b$b不过，这次你也许有机会改变结局。$b$b南面的猢狲正在这片水域中竭泽而渔。当鱼都被捕完了，鳄鱼没了食物，就会变得饥饿和凶残——所以它们才入侵了马里斯塔。$b$b现在就行动吧，$r！阻止那些猢狲们的过度捕捞！

english.title: Balance
english.objectives: Slay 10 Unga Fish-Getters.
english.description: The story did not end happily. The Narsong crocolisk is no more.$b$bThis time, however, you may have a chance to change the ending.$b$bThe hozen to the south are overfishing these waters. With the fish gone, the crocolisks are hungry and desperate - and so they attack Marista.$b$bGo now, $r! Stop those hozen from their reckless fishing!

text.title: Holed Up
text.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
text.description: Thank the heavenly spirits for you, $c! I don't know how much longer I could've lasted.$B$BThere are other Firebough Nook survivors, I'm sure of it. Will you help rescue them and get us to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

english.title: Holed Up
english.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
english.description: Thank the heavenly spirits for you, $c! I don't know how much longer I could've lasted.$B$BThere are other Firebough Nook survivors, I'm sure of it. Will you help rescue them and get us to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

text.title: 自然法则
text.objectives: 将6条挣扎的鲤鱼扔进纳耶里海礁。
text.description: 盎迦猢狲捕来的部分鲤鱼好像还没有死，应该还来得及把它们扔回水里面。

english.title: Balance Without Violence
english.objectives: Throw 6 Flailing Carp into Nayeli Lagoon.
english.description: Some of the fish that the Unga hozen have gathered don't seem do be dead yet. There may still be time to throw them back into the water.

objectiveDetails.description: 将挣扎的鲤鱼扔回水里面

text.title: 埋好的猢狲财宝
text.objectives: 找到埋好的猢狲财宝。
text.description: 你手里的地图皱巴巴、脏兮兮的，而且绘制潦草。不过你可以看到在某个沙滩上画了一个大大的X号。$b$b莫非这个岛上的某个地方埋藏有宝藏？

english.title: Buried Hozen Treasure
english.objectives: Find the Buried Hozen Treasure.
english.description: The map you hold is crinkled, dirty, and poorly drawn, but you can see a big X on a beach.$b$bIs there buried treasure somewhere on this island?

text.title: 把鱼炸个底朝天
text.objectives: 使用地精渔业炸弹杀死3条钉刺鳐鱼，并把它们的蛰刺带回给菲兹尼克斯。你可以在渔人码头西边的浅湾找到它们。
text.description: 看来这些鳐鱼没有我想象中的那么好抓！你看上去像是个机灵的家伙，也许你能帮帮我？$b$b我制造了些炸弹，不过我没法拖着伤腿去划木筏。鳐鱼在西边的浅湾很常见，拿上这些炸弹，用我的木筏去帮我弄一些鳐鱼蛰刺回来！$b$b对了，要小心锤头鲨哦！

english.title: Like Bombing Fish In A Barrel
english.objectives: Use the Goblin Fishing Bombs to kill 3 Sting Rays and bring back their stingers to Fiznix.  The Rays can be found in the shallows west of Anglers Wharf.
english.description: Turns out these rays are not as easy to catch as I thought!  You seem like a pretty smart guy, think you can help me out?$b$bI made the bombs but have been having trouble using the raft with my hurt leg.  The rays are common in the shallows just west of here.  Take the bombs and use my raft to bring me back their stingers!$b$bOh yeah, watch out for the hammerheads!

text.title: Holed Up
text.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
text.description: Oh thank you, thank you, thank you. If you hadn't come along...$B$BWait! There must be other survivors in the Nook like me!$B$BPlease, $c, I beg you. Rescue the rest of my citizens and deliver us safely to Shado-Pan Fallback.

english.title: Holed Up
english.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
english.description: Oh thank you, thank you, thank you. If you hadn't come along...$B$BWait! There must be other survivors in the Nook like me!$B$BPlease, $c, I beg you. Rescue the rest of my citizens and deliver us safely to Shado-Pan Fallback.

text.title: Holed Up
text.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
text.description: Oh, thank you! There's no way I could have made it back on my own.$B$BCome to think of it, there must be others around Firebough Nook that need to be rescued. Shall we go collect them and then head to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

english.title: Holed Up
english.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
english.description: Oh, thank you! There's no way I could have made it back on my own.$B$BCome to think of it, there must be others around Firebough Nook that need to be rescued. Shall we go collect them and then head to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

text.title: 救民水火
text.objectives: 营救金·热桶、崖·火树、方老太和钟思亚。
text.description:
真不敢相信你居然做到了！

我不知道自己还能在这儿藏多久。$B$B我敢肯定还有其他幸存者。$C，我们得找到他们！然后我们就能去影踪别院了，那里的大师一定会有办法的！

english.title: Holed Up
english.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
english.description:
I can't believe you made it here!

I don't know how much longer I could have stayed hidden in here.$B$BI'm sure that there are others. $C, we have to rescue them! Then we can go to Shado-Pan Fallback. The master there will know what to do!

text.title: 一位旅行者的不幸
text.objectives: 搜索废弃的残骸寻找补给品。
text.description: 你非得把我们的补给品扔给他们吗？为什么不用你的武器？或者用你神奇的魔法或飞腿。为什么是补给品？！$b$b现在我们自己的粮食都不够吃了，尤其还养着表侄弯指甲。他的胃口跟雪人一样大！$b$b是你扔出去的，你得负责找更多的回来。沿着这条路走下去有一处残骸。你也许能在那里找到点补给品。

english.title: One Traveler's Misfortune
english.objectives: Search the Abandoned Wreckage for supplies.
