english.description: Did you have to throw our supplies at them?! Why not use your weapon? Maybe fancy spells or kicks? Why the supplies?!$b$bNow we don't have enough to last us, especially with Nephew Bentnail here. His appetite is like a yeti's!$b$bYou threw it, you get us more. There is wreckage down the path. Maybe you will find supplies there.

objectiveDetails.description: 搜索废弃的残骸寻找补给品

text.title: 探索者末路
text.objectives: 征服探索者末路，找到游学者周卓，并且在沿路的三个神龛稍停片刻，对自身进行一番反省。
text.description: 我肯定你的熊猫人朋友知道魔古族到底要找什么。$B$B他前几天独自上山去了，没有带向导，并且要求你自己去山上找他。他说得很详细：$B$B“$c必须独自完成这段艰难跋涉，让$g他:她;的思想指引前行之路。在山顶跟我碰面前，$g他:她;得拜祭每一个神龛。”$B$B上山的路径就在营地的西北边，已经用旗子标出来了。切记要小心！即使有老天保佑，探索者末路也是一段危险的路程。

english.title: Seeker's Folly
english.objectives: Brave the path of Seeker's Folly to find Lorewalker Cho, stopping to reflect at the three shrines along the way.
english.description: I'm sure your pandaren friend has some ideas about what the mogu are after.$B$BHe headed up the mountain a few days ago without a guide, and asked that only you be sent up after him. He was very specific:$B$B"The $c must endure the trek alone, with only $ghis:her; thoughts. $gHe:She; will honor each shrine before meeting me at the top."$B$BThe path is just northwest of the camp, marked by flags. Please be careful! Seeker's Folly is a dangerous trek even on a lucky day.

text.title: 幕后真凶
text.objectives: 将科拜可汗引诱至盲目怒火陷阱中，从他身上窃取怨毒之怒的面具，然后击败怨毒之怒。
text.description:
简单杀死科拜可汗没有任何意义，因为占据他身体的是一只异常强大且极具破坏性的煞魔——怨毒之怒。

你可以用我利用盲目怒火精华制造出来的陷阱。将科拜可汗引诱至陷阱中，然后窃取他的面具。一旦你带起面具，怨毒之怒就会出现在你面前，并尝试控制你。

击败他，为现在这般颓丧的局势注入一剂强心针。你可以在避难所的北部找到他，他正在那里疯狂的奚落我们。

english.title: Unmasking the Yaungol
english.objectives: Lure Kobai into the Blinding Rage Trap, steal the Mask of Malevolent Fury from him, and then defeat Malevolent Fury.
english.description:
Simply killing Kobai will accomplish nothing, as he is possessed by a particularly powerful and destructive Sha - Malevolent Fury.

You will use the trap I have fashioned from the Blinding Rage Essences you brought. Lure him into the trap, and then steal his mask. Once you put it on, Malevolent Fury will appear and attempt to take control of you.

Defeat him, and we will have made a victory of this tragic situation. You can find him to the north of the retreat, where he taunts us in insane rage.

objectiveDetails.description: 将科拜引入陷阱并偷走他的面具

text.title: 悲天悯人
text.objectives: 让纳赫煞脱离苦海。
text.description: 进入水下后，你要杀掉死息族长纳赫煞。它太痛苦了，我能感觉它濒死的悲鸣从水下一直传递到环礁湖面之上。$b$b找到它的洞穴，帮它脱离苦海吧。这并不是为了解决马里斯塔的鳄鱼问题，而是纯粹出于怜悯。
text.giverWindow: 即使是野兽也需要慈悲。

english.title: Misery
english.objectives: Put Nahassa out his misery.
english.description: While you are in the water below, you should slay Nahassa, the mortbreath patriarch. He suffers. I can feel his death cries ululating up to the surface of the lagoon.$b$bFind his cave, and put him out of his misery. Not because it will solve Marista's crocolisk problem. Simply out of mercy.
english.giverWindow: Even a great beast deserves mercy.

text.title: 粗麻小径：前往寇塔营地
text.objectives: 护送一队土地精从粗麻驿站前往寇塔营地，要确保至少有一名土地精存活下来。$b$b如果你与他们失散了，你可以去粗麻小径寻找他们，或者回到粗麻驿站等候下一队土地精。
text.description: 这里是猢狲的领地，非常危险。但土地精必须过去，一定要把补给品送到蟠龙脊去。$b$b快去，护送下一队土地精前往寇塔营地。$b$b只要有一个土地精活下来，好运一定会降临你的身上。

english.title: The Burlap Trail: To Kota Basecamp
english.objectives: Protect a group of grummles from the Burlap Waystation to the Kota Basecamp. At least one grummle must survive.$b$bIf you lose your grummles, you can search the Burlap Trial or return to the Burlap Waystation and wait for the next group to leave.
english.description: This here's hozen lands. Very dangerous. But grummles must trek through. Supplies must reach the Serpent's Spine.$b$bGo, protect the next wave of grummles on their trek to Kota Basecamp.$b$bIf at least one survives, good fortune will find its way to you.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送土地精抵达寇塔营地

text.title: 如履薄冰
text.objectives: 在安全距离使用“探路棍”引发10个河刃尖刺陷阱。
text.description: 弟子们报告说附近的地区遍布致命的陷阱，毫无疑问这是蜥蜴人干的。要是误踩了一个陷阱，你的脸可就变成刺猬了。$B$B俗话说得好：“路漫漫其艰险兮，吾将小心而求索”$B$B<科洛递给你一根长长的树枝。>$B$B拿着，这是“探路棍”。$B$B它的长度足以让你在安全距离触发陷阱。

english.title: Tread Lightly
english.objectives: Use "Scrutiny" to set off 10 Riverblade Spike Traps from a safe distance.
english.description: My students tell me the surrounding area is littered with deadly traps, no doubt set by the saurok. Stumbling into one gets you a face full of spikes.$B$BAs the saying goes: "The Way is rife with danger - tread lightly, and with scrutiny."$B$B<Koro hands you a long tree branch.>$B$BHere, this is scrutiny.$B$BIt should be long enough to set the traps off at a safe distance.

text.title: 一路向前
text.objectives: 在朱鹤寺东部和西部的宝塔杀死惘之喉。
text.description: 巨大的惘之喉在寺院两侧的宝塔里不断喷涌出煞魔来。与此同时，你在求道过程中的临时训练还将继续。$B$B“与其向雨挥拳，不如退而补伞。”$B$B对于这一课我倒有不同见解——有时候向雨挥拳也相当有效——这眼下这种情况下它就比较有效。$B$B去消灭那些惘之喉吧，这样我们的人才有机会夺回寺院。

english.title: Ahead on the Way
english.objectives: Kill the Maw of Despair in both the eastern and western pagodas at the Temple of the Red Crane.
english.description: Huge maws of despair are spewing out sha from the pagodas on either side of the temple. Meanwhile, your impromptu training in the Way continues.$B$B"She who mends torn umbrella will be more dry than she who strikes at rain."$B$BWhile I take issue with that particular lesson--sometimes punching the rain can be quite effective--the meaning holds true in this case.$B$BTake out those maws of despair and give my order a chance at reclaiming the temple grounds.

text.title: 废物利用
text.objectives: 划着地精捕鱼木筏，在沉船附近从漂浮的碎片中钓起15块锈蚀的沉船零件。
text.description: 你！你正是我要找的人！$b$b我需要更多的零件来装配我的地精渔业炸弹，可是我弄伤了腿，没法自己去收集那些零件了。$b$b你看到附近的沉船了吗？如果你能去把它们钓上来的话，我敢打赌里面会有我想要的东西。划我的捕鱼木筏去吧，看看你能找到些什么！我的朋友想帮我忙来着，所以你要是看到沉船附近还有其他的木筏，尽管用好了。

english.title: Scavenger Hunt
english.objectives: Use the Goblin Fishing Raft to fish up 15 Rusty Shipwreck Parts out of the floating debris near the shipwrecks.
english.description: YOU!  You're just who I have been looking for!$b$bI need more parts for my goblin fishing bombs but I hurt my leg and can't collect them myself.$b$bYou see those shipwrecks nearby?  I bet they have just what I need if you can get to it and fish it out.  Take my fishing raft and see what you can find!  My buddy has been trying to help me out too so you might find some extra rafts near the wreckage, feel free to use em' too.

text.title: 前往冬花营
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的冬花营和林·默拳谈一谈。
text.description:
我们与煞魔的战争永不停歇——所以我们不能离开此地。

但我对于禅院的援兵迟迟未到仍放心不下，毕竟我们数天前就发出了请求。

你的表现太出色了，或许你可以去冬花营看看，它就在通往影踪禅院的路上。到达之后立即和林·默拳谈一谈——他应该知道发生了什么事情。要去那里，你先朝村子的北面走，然后沿路一直走，穿过影踪谷就到了。

english.title: To Winter's Blossom
english.objectives: Speak with Lin Silentstrike at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
The battle against the Sha is eternal - we can not leave this place. 

But I am troubled by the absence of reinforcements from the Monastery given that we sent for them days ago. 

You have performed admirably, perhaps you could travel to Winter's Blossom, our base camp on the way to the Shado-Pan Monastery. Speak with Lin Silentstrike once you arrive - he should know what is happening. To get there, travel north of the village and follow the road through Shado-Li Basin to Winter's Blossom.

text.title: 钳爪
text.objectives: 杀死纳松海沟底部洞穴中的钳爪，带回它的爪子作为证明。
text.description: 一只巨型毒螃蟹正在大肆祸害我们当地的鲍鱼种群。我要你潜入纳松海沟，把它干掉！
text.giverWindow: 钳爪正在大肆破坏当地的鲍鱼种群。

english.title: Snapclaw
english.objectives: Kill Snapclaw in a cave at the bottom of Narsong Trench and return with his claw as proof.
english.description: A giant, poisonous crab is wrecking havoc on our local abalone stores.  I need you to go down into narsong trench and take it out!
english.giverWindow: Snapclaw has been wrecking havoc on the local abalone population.

text.title: 钳爪蟹汤
text.objectives: 杀死海滩上的钳爪捕鱼者，带回16颗眼珠来熬制美味的靓汤。
text.description: 没有什么比钳爪蟹汤更美味的了。这可是卡桑琅的招牌菜！$b$b我正准备熬一锅新汤，但突然发现少了一味关键的食材，那就是钳爪蟹的眼珠！$b$b我想请你到海滩上杀些钳爪捕鱼者，把它们的眼珠带回来给我煲靓汤！

english.title: Viseclaw Soup
english.objectives: Kill Viseclaw Fishers on the beach and return with 16 eyes to make some yummy soup.
english.description: Nothing tastes quite like viseclaw soup.  It's a krasarang specialty!$b$bI was just about to start up on a new batch when I realized I am missing a key ingredient, the eyes!$b$bI need you to kill the viseclaw fishers on the beach and return with their eyes for the soup!

text.title: Provoking the Trolls
text.objectives: Kill 10 Zandalari Stalkers and 5 Zandalari Hexers
text.description:
We've managed to push them back this far, but I doubt that we will remain safe for long if we do not deal with them once and for all.

My husband, coward or fool that he is, does not wish to provoke them. I will not be cowed so.

We will do just that. Slay their forward scouts. Perhaps we can provoke - and then defeat - their leader.
text.completed: Return to Xiao Meng

english.title: Provoking the Trolls
english.objectives: Kill 10 Zandalari Stalkers and 5 Zandalari Hexers
english.description:
We've managed to push them back this far, but I doubt that we will remain safe for long if we do not deal with them once and for all.

My husband, coward or fool that he is, does not wish to provoke them. I will not be cowed so.

We will do just that. Slay their forward scouts. Perhaps we can provoke - and then defeat - their leader.
english.completed: Return to Xiao Meng

text.title: Destroy the Leaders
text.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Blademaster and Zandalari Mage
text.description:
And, now they fear you.

Their leaders, a Blademaster and a Mage, lie deeper in the ruins. Kill them.
Make them hurt. For us.
text.completed: Return to Xiao Zi Hai

english.title: Destroy the Leaders
english.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Blademaster and Zandalari Mage
english.description:
And, now they fear you.

Their leaders, a Blademaster and a Mage, lie deeper in the ruins. Kill them.
Make them hurt. For us.
english.completed: Return to Xiao Zi Hai

text.title: 生死与共
text.objectives: 让影踪派智遥大师、一瞬千击刘刚拳和诗雅·勇剑安息。
text.description:
他们的攻击结束，我们重整了队伍，最后发现我们失去了三位战友。你的战斗力很强，但我们必须计划好防御战术，以防那些该死的野牛人再次发动攻击。

如果你愿意帮助我们，请为阵亡的人举行最后的仪式，并带回他们的盔甲。你可以在西面找到他们的遗体。

不要让食腐鸟类破坏他们的遗体。

english.title: A Line Unbroken
english.objectives: Lay Shado-Master Zhiyao, Liu of the Thousand Blows and Shiya Boldblade to rest.
english.description:
When we regrouped after their initial attack, we numbered three less. You can fight, and we must plan our defense should these cursed yaungol attack again. 

If you would help us, grant our fallen comrades their last rites, and recover their armor. You will find their bodies to the west, near the gate.

And try to keep the birds off them.

objectiveDetails.description: 让影踪派智遥大师安息
让一瞬千击刘刚拳安息

text.title: 追赶希望
text.objectives: 触摸3个仙鹤之魂。
text.description: 赤精一直与我们同在。即使他不在赤精栖木的时候，他的精魂也会穿越海岛的丛林与沙滩，守望着我们，考验着我们。$b$b让赤精看看你敏捷的身手吧，$n。找到并抓住仙鹤之魂。

english.title: Chasing Hope
english.objectives: Touch 3 Spirits of the Crane.
english.description: Chi-Ji is always with us. Even when he is not here in the Cradle, pieces of his spirit run through the forests and beaches of the island, watching us and testing us.$b$bProve your dexterity in the eyes of Chi-Ji, $n. Find and catch the spirits of the crane.

text.title: 神鹤的恩赐
text.objectives: 获得10个神鹤的恩赐。
text.description: 卡桑琅的仙鹤是赤精给我们的恩赐。即便是它们遗留下来的羽毛，也是让我们感激不尽的馈赠。$b$b我们可以用这些羽毛来装点服饰，也可以用作箭矢的尾翼。但首先……我们要把羽毛收集起来。

english.title: Gifts of the Great Crane
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Gifts of the Great Crane.
english.description: The cranes of Krasarang are a gift from Chi-Ji. Even the very feathers they leave behind are a gift for us to appreciate.$b$bWe use these feathers to adorn our garments and to fletch arrows. But first... they must be gathered.

text.title: 赤精的弟子们
text.objectives: 与10个赤精弟子切磋。
text.description: 我们赤翼派以招数精妙而著称。我们常在赤精栖木互相切磋，以磨练自己的格斗技巧。$b$b让朱鹤看看你的身手吧。向南走，到岛屿的中心与其他弟子切磋一番。

english.title: Students of Chi-Ji
english.objectives: Duel 10 Students of Chi-Ji.
english.description: Our order prides itself on excellence in combat. We hone these combat skills by dueling one another, here on the Cradle of Chi-Ji.$b$bProve yourself in the eyes of the Red Crane. Venture south, into the center of the island, and duel with your fellow students.

text.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 01

english.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 01

text.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 02

english.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 02

text.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 03

english.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 03

text.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 04

english.title: FLAG - Cradle of Chi-Ji Progress Bit 04

text.title: 马革裹尸
text.objectives: 杀死12只昆莱食腐鸟。
text.description:
嗯……如果影踪派翀大师都信的过你，也许你能帮我们做件事情。

野牛人是我们的敌人。

但是，我们仍要证明我们比他们更高尚。我们要尊重那些战死的将士。

每当大战过后，食腐鸟就会成群结队地闻风而来。我要你去削减它们的数量，让我们敌人的尸体免遭亵渎。那些鸟就在战场的西边聚集着呢。

english.title: Honor, Even in Death
english.objectives: Kill 12 Kun-Lai Scavengers.
english.description:
Hmm... If Shado-Master Chong trusted you, perhaps you can help us.

The yaungol are our enemies.

Still, we must prove we are better than they. We will show them honor in death.

As after most battles, the carrion birds have begun gathering. Thin their numbers, so the bodies of our foes will not be desecrated. They've gathered at the battlefield to the west.

text.title: 上城墙！
text.objectives: 和风筝大师林息谈一谈，他在昆莱山的冬花营，然后乘他的风筝飞到玄牛关。到那之后，和孙娜·默拳谈一谈。
text.description:
该死！他们又发动进攻了！

<林向玄牛关望去。>

弓箭手… 去城墙上待命！

我要你到那上边去。我妻子孙娜和那个蠢货老陈一起到上边侦察城墙去了。要是他之前能多花点时间准备防守，而不是去建那座荒谬的麦芽酒升降装置的话……

无所谓了。到西边的林息那里搞一只风筝，然后去城墙上找我的妻子。她会知道下一步该怎么做。

english.title: To the Wall!
english.objectives: Speak to Kite Master Len at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit to take a kite up to the Ox Gate. Once there, speak to Suna Silentstrike.
english.description:
They are attacking again!

<Lin looks to the Ox Gate.>

Archers... on the wall!

I need you to get up there. My wife Suna went to scout the wall with that fool Lao-Chen. Perhaps if he had spent more time preparing defenses and less building that ridiculous ale lift contraption...

It matters not. Get a kite from Len, to the west, and then get up there and find my wife. She'll know what to do next.

objectiveDetails.description: 与风筝大师林息交谈并乘坐风筝前往长城

text.title: 艾黎亚·鸦鬃
text.objectives: 去安卡阁击败艾黎亚·鸦鬃。
text.description: 我们会在弟子中挑出合适的人选，定期组织一对一的决斗。我们也为你挑了一位实力相当的弟子，$n。$b$b她的名字叫艾黎亚·鸦鬃，这也是她的第一次决斗。她会在南边的安卡阁等着你。
text.giverWindow: 你的第一个挑战者。

english.title: Ellia Ravenmane
english.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane at the Angkhal Pavilion.
english.description: We regularly organize one-on-one duels with trainees that we think are well-suited for one another. We have found one such trainee for you, $n.$b$bHer name is Ellia Ravenmane. This will be her first duel, too. She will be waiting for you at the pavilion just to the south of here.
english.giverWindow: Your first challenger.

text.title: Minh Do-Tan
text.objectives: Defeat Minh Do-Tan.
text.description: Your next challenger is another relatively new trainee. His name is Minh Do-Tan, and he has won his last two matches.$b$bHe will be waiting for you near the crane statue to the south.
text.giverWindow: Your next challenger.

english.title: Minh Do-Tan
english.objectives: Defeat Minh Do-Tan.
english.description: Your next challenger is another relatively new trainee. His name is Minh Do-Tan, and he has won his last two matches.$b$bHe will be waiting for you near the crane statue to the south.
english.giverWindow: Your next challenger.

text.title: 艾黎亚·鸦鬃：重赛
text.objectives: 在希冀台底层附近击败艾黎亚·鸦鬃。
text.description: 艾黎亚·鸦鬃要求跟你重赛。她似乎盯上你了，把你视为“死敌”。$b$b在赤精栖木，我们并不鼓励弟子们一味争强好胜，但如果有人要求重赛的话，我们一般也不会拒绝。你可以在岛屿东面的希冀台附近找到艾黎亚。
text.giverWindow: 她要求重赛！

english.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Rematch
english.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane near the base of the Pedestal of Hope.
english.description: Ellia Ravenmane requested a rematch with you. She seems to identify you as her "rival".$b$bWe discourage rivalries here within the Cradle of Chi-Ji, but we rarely decline a rematch request. You will find Ellia near the Pedestal of Hope, on the island's eastern side.
english.giverWindow: She demands a rematch!

text.title: Fat Long-Fat
text.objectives: Defeat Fat Long-Fat at the top of Angkhal Pavilion.
text.description: You have been matched with a... special trainee. His name is Fat Long-Fat.$b$b<Thelonius chooses his words carefully.>$b$bFat Long-Fat... operates outside of the normal rules of combat. He does not fight every day, and when he does, he chooses his competitor. Today, for some reason... he has selected you.$b$bYou will find him atop Angkhal Pavilion.
text.giverWindow: Long-Fat is his name. Fat just describes him.

english.title: Fat Long-Fat
english.objectives: Defeat Fat Long-Fat at the top of Angkhal Pavilion.
english.description: You have been matched with a... special trainee. His name is Fat Long-Fat.$b$b<Thelonius chooses his words carefully.>$b$bFat Long-Fat... operates outside of the normal rules of combat. He does not fight every day, and when he does, he chooses his competitor. Today, for some reason... he has selected you.$b$bYou will find him atop Angkhal Pavilion.
english.giverWindow: Long-Fat is his name. Fat just describes him.

text.title: Julia Bates
text.objectives: Defeat Julia Bates.
text.description: We welcome all kinds here within the Cradle, as long as they recognize and subscribe to the ideologies of the Red Crane. One of our new, more exotic trainees comes from the human kingdoms to the northeast. She goes by the rather foreign-sounding name of Julia Bates.$b$bShe is your next challenger. You will find her on the island's western shore.
text.giverWindow: A recent arrival to Pandaria.

english.title: Julia Bates
english.objectives: Defeat Julia Bates.
english.description: We welcome all kinds here within the Cradle, as long as they recognize and subscribe to the ideologies of the Red Crane. One of our new, more exotic trainees comes from the human kingdoms to the northeast. She goes by the rather foreign-sounding name of Julia Bates.$b$bShe is your next challenger. You will find her on the island's western shore.
english.giverWindow: A recent arrival to Pandaria.

text.title: Dextrous Izissha
text.objectives: Defeat Dextrous Izissha.
text.description: Jinyu normally avoid our order, but every few years, we find one that subscribes to the way of the Crane. One such jinyu is Dextrous Izissha.$b$bIzissha is your next challenger. He waits for you on the island's southwestern shore.
text.giverWindow: A surprisingly strong fighter, Izissha tends to keep to himself.

english.title: Dextrous Izissha
english.objectives: Defeat Dextrous Izissha.
english.description: Jinyu normally avoid our order, but every few years, we find one that subscribes to the way of the Crane. One such jinyu is Dextrous Izissha.$b$bIzissha is your next challenger. He waits for you on the island's southwestern shore.
english.giverWindow: A surprisingly strong fighter, Izissha tends to keep to himself.

text.title: 郭楠·翎爪
text.objectives: 击败郭楠·翎爪。
text.description: 在赤精栖木，大部分的决斗都是在两个弟子之间进行的。不过在极少数的情况下，如果弟子的技艺已炉火纯青，他们就有机会挑战自己的师父。$b$b今天，你将与郭楠·翎爪决斗。她将在希冀台那里等你。
text.giverWindow: 这是你第一次和师父同场竞技！

english.title: Kuo-Na Quillpaw
english.objectives: Defeat Kuo-Na Quillpaw.
english.description: Most of the duels within the Cradle take place between two trainees. Rarely, when a trainee exhibits a rare amount of skill, they will have an opportunity to duel their trainer.$b$bToday, you duel against Kuo-Na. She will be waiting for you at the Pedestal of Hope.
english.giverWindow: Your first sparring match against your trainers!

text.title: 艾黎亚·鸦鬃：复仇
text.objectives: 去巴尔利萨圆顶击败艾黎亚·鸦鬃。
text.description: 你的“死敌”再次出现了。艾黎亚·鸦鬃最近一直推卸岛上的执勤任务，整日埋头苦练，满脑子想的都是要在战斗中击败你。$b$b她说过：“我要毁掉$n”。$b$b我已经核准了她重赛的请求，但我会多盯着她一点的。她的战斗动机恐怕有些偏颇了。
text.giverWindow: 艾黎亚回来了，她决心要打败自己的“死敌”。

english.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Revenge
english.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane at Dome Balrissa.
english.description: Your "rival" has appeared again. Ellia Ravenmane has been avoiding her duties on the island, instead focusing on personal training, with the intent to defeat you in battle.$b$b"I will destroy $n," she said.$b$bI have honored her request for a rematch, but I will be keeping a close eye on her. Her motives may be shifting in a dangerous direction.
english.giverWindow: Ellia has returned, and she's determined to defeat her rival.

text.title: Tukka-Tuk
text.objectives: Defeat Tukka-Tuk.
text.description: You are making a name for yourself, $n. I received a challenge from one of our more skilled competitors. He believes you are not as strong as you seem.$b$bHis name is Tukka-Tuk, the hozen. If you've ever fought against hozen before, you know that their apparent juvenility belies their battle acumen. Good luck.
text.giverWindow: Hasn't lost once in his last ten matches.

english.title: Tukka-Tuk
english.objectives: Defeat Tukka-Tuk.
english.description: You are making a name for yourself, $n. I received a challenge from one of our more skilled competitors. He believes you are not as strong as you seem.$b$bHis name is Tukka-Tuk, the hozen. If you've ever fought against hozen before, you know that their apparent juvenility belies their battle acumen. Good luck.
english.giverWindow: Hasn't lost once in his last ten matches.

text.title: Huck Wheelbarrow
text.objectives: Defeat Huck Wheelbarrow.
text.description: Usually our trainees are adventurers like yourself, or monks from Tian Monastery, or occasionally retired Shado-Pan. Very rarely, though, we will greet trainees that have no fighting experience whatsoever.$b$bHuck Wheelbarrow is one such trainee. He has requested a duel with you. Look for him on the island's western shore.
text.giverWindow: An immigrant from the farmlands, to the north.

english.title: Huck Wheelbarrow
english.objectives: Defeat Huck Wheelbarrow.
english.description: Usually our trainees are adventurers like yourself, or monks from Tian Monastery, or occasionally retired Shado-Pan. Very rarely, though, we will greet trainees that have no fighting experience whatsoever.$b$bHuck Wheelbarrow is one such trainee. He has requested a duel with you. Look for him on the island's western shore.
english.giverWindow: An immigrant from the farmlands, to the north.

text.title: Mindel Sunspeaker
text.objectives: Defeat Mindel Sunspeaker.
text.description: Our highest-ranked trainee is an outsider like you. It is both strange and exciting to live in a time when so many foreigners have embraced the way of the Crane.$b$bYour challenger's name is Mindel Sunspeaker, and he awaits you within Angkhal Pavilion.
text.giverWindow: Mindel, like you, is undefeated.

english.title: Mindel Sunspeaker
english.objectives: Defeat Mindel Sunspeaker.
english.description: Our highest-ranked trainee is an outsider like you. It is both strange and exciting to live in a time when so many foreigners have embraced the way of the Crane.$b$bYour challenger's name is Mindel Sunspeaker, and he awaits you within Angkhal Pavilion.
english.giverWindow: Mindel, like you, is undefeated.

text.title: Yan Quillpaw
text.objectives: Defeat Yan Quillpaw at the Pedestal of Hope.
text.description: You have already defeated Kuo-Na Quillpaw. You have not yet fought her brother, Yan.$b$bHe will meet you at the Pedestal of Hope, and he will not hold back. His reputation as a trainer is at stake.
text.giverWindow: Yan has been on this island for decades. Fighting is his life.

english.title: Yan Quillpaw
english.objectives: Defeat Yan Quillpaw at the Pedestal of Hope.
english.description: You have already defeated Kuo-Na Quillpaw. You have not yet fought her brother, Yan.$b$bHe will meet you at the Pedestal of Hope, and he will not hold back. His reputation as a trainer is at stake.
english.giverWindow: Yan has been on this island for decades. Fighting is his life.

text.title: 肥龙：重赛
text.objectives: 去巴尔利萨圆顶的顶层击败肥龙。
text.description: 肥龙要求跟你再进行一场比赛。我对此深感奇怪，也十分关切。$b$b他会在巴尔利萨圆顶的顶层等着你。
text.giverWindow: 迷一般的战士回来了。

english.title: Fat Long-Fat: Rematch
english.objectives: Defeat Fat Long-Fat atop Dome Belrissa.
english.description: Fat Long-Fat has requested another match with you. I find this strange. And concerning.$b$bHe will be waiting atop the Dome Belrissa.
english.giverWindow: The enigmatic warrior returns.

text.title: Thelonius
text.objectives: Defeat Thelonius.
text.description: When we last spoke, I promised to tell you the secret of Fat Long-Fat. I still plan to tell you that secret... after I determine your worth.$b$bI will meet you on the western shore, and we will duel.
text.giverWindow: Thelonius' skill in battle is legendary.

english.title: Thelonius
english.objectives: Defeat Thelonius.
english.description: When we last spoke, I promised to tell you the secret of Fat Long-Fat. I still plan to tell you that secret... after I determine your worth.$b$bI will meet you on the western shore, and we will duel.
english.giverWindow: Thelonius' skill in battle is legendary.

text.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Redemption
text.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane atop the Pedestal of Hope.
text.description: Ellia Ravenmane, your rival, has returned. She demands that you meet her atop the Pedestal of Hope.$b$bYou need to understand, $n... something horrible has happened to her. She has changed. You will see for yourself when you arrive at the pedestal.$b$bGood luck, $n.
text.giverWindow: Your rival returns.

english.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Redemption
english.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane atop the Pedestal of Hope.
english.description: Ellia Ravenmane, your rival, has returned. She demands that you meet her atop the Pedestal of Hope.$b$bYou need to understand, $n... something horrible has happened to her. She has changed. You will see for yourself when you arrive at the pedestal.$b$bGood luck, $n.
english.giverWindow: Your rival returns.

text.title: Champion of Chi-Ji
text.objectives: Defeat a Champion of Chi-Ji.
text.description: While you will always hold a place of honor among our order, you are still welcome to participate in our duels.$b$bOne of our current champions awaits you in the Dome Balrissa. I know that they would be honored to duel with you.

english.title: Champion of Chi-Ji
english.objectives: Defeat a Champion of Chi-Ji.
english.description: While you will always hold a place of honor among our order, you are still welcome to participate in our duels.$b$bOne of our current champions awaits you in the Dome Balrissa. I know that they would be honored to duel with you.

text.title: 知错就改
text.objectives: 杀死寇塔峰上的12只咔啡成瘾的高山羊。
text.description: 我搞砸了。真糟糕。$B$B要把咔啡豆从咔啡果里挖出来是很困难的！但我发现山羊在吃了这些果子后，会把咔啡豆拉出来……可能要等一天左右。$B$B所以我把手头所有的果子一股脑地全喂给了寇塔峰上的山羊吃，现在它们都亢奋得发了疯！它们攻击所有移动的物体。$B$B以前土地精在寇塔收咔啡也没见什么危险。但现在不是了，就是因为这群山羊。你能帮忙解决吗？

english.title: Shut it Down
english.objectives: Kill 12 Kafa-Crazed Mountain Goats on Kota Peak.
english.description: I mussed up. Bad.$B$BIt's hard work cutting seeds out of kafa berries! But I noticed goots eat the berries up and give back the seeds... in a day or so.$B$BI fed everything I had to the goots on Kota Peak and now they're nuts! Chargin' everything that moves.$B$BKota used to be safe for Grummles to gather kafa. Not anymore. Not with them goots. Will you help?

text.title: 羊屎咔啡
text.objectives: 在寇塔峰上标出10处山羊咔啡“沉积物”。
text.description: 我真是天才！把咔啡果喂给山羊，等它们把咔啡豆拉出来。$B$B寇塔咔啡已经相当珍贵稀有了，但我的发明——山羊咔啡——甚至称得上极品。$B$B但现在都完了。山上乱成一团，表叔很生气，后果很严重。我们能做的就是挽救剩下的山羊咔啡，不要再犯同样的错误。$B$B我不会再让你来做了——这工作确实琐碎，不适合英雄来做——你只要在那些“沉积物”上做个标记，等山上安全后方便我轻松找到它们就行。

english.title: Gourmet Kafa
english.objectives: Mark 10 Kafa'goot "Deposits" on Kota Peak.
english.description: It was genius: kafa berries go in the goot, seeds come out.$B$BKafa'kota is already rare and worth a fortune, but my invention--Kafa'goot--is GOURMET.$B$BBut it's over now. Uncle is upset and peak is a muss. All that's left is to collect the rest of the Kafa'goot and never make it again.$B$BI won't ask you to gather it--kind of a mussy task, not fit for hero-- just mark it so I can find it easily when the mountain is safe again.

text.title: 寇塔混合咔啡
text.objectives: 从寇塔峰收集100个寇塔咔啡果。在山边的灌木丛或者雪人洞里都可以找到。
text.description: 寇塔峰以其咔啡灌木丛而闻名——其它品种在这个海拔都无法生存。$B$B土地精靠着贩卖寇塔混合咔啡日子也过得不错，但因为我表哥干的好事，现在那里成了危险之地。为了他的那点小算盘，他让山上的野生动物拼命吃咔啡果。$B$B山羊肆意啃食，雪人也拼命往自己洞里搬，现在寇塔咔啡已经相当稀少了。$B$B从寇塔带回来一些咔啡果吧，我都会给你个好价钱。$B$B给，我这有点样品，你拿去尝尝。尝过你就知道这东西劲头有多足。

english.title: Kota Blend
english.objectives: Collect 100 Kafa'kota Berries from Kota Peak. They can be found in bushes growing on the mountainside or piled up in the yeti caves.
english.description: Kota Peak is famous for its kafa bushes - no other can survive at this elevation.$B$BGrummles make very good living selling Kafa'kota Blend, but it's dangerous now thanks to my cousin here. He's got the wildlife up there hooked on kafa with his scheming.$B$BKafa'kota is more scarce than ever with goots gobblin' it up and yetis hoarding it in their caves.$B$BI pay you good for any berries you bring down from Kota.$B$BHere, take a sample. Eat it. See for yourself the power of kafa.

text.title: 制造难题
text.objectives: 在寇塔峰击败5只咔啡成瘾的雪人。
text.description: 寇塔峰上有许多雪人，但他们一般不怎么危险，通常只吃山羊。$B$B不过这次他们吃到了满肚子都是咔啡的山羊……$B$B<激情豆狠狠瞪了山羊毛一眼。>$B$B现在他们变得喜怒无常、脾气暴躁。睡得再多，还是一副亢奋的样子。这是典型的咔啡成瘾症状。$B$B我肯定，不久他们就会跑出山洞来找更多的咔啡。$B$B到那时我们就麻烦大了。

english.title: Trouble Brewing
english.objectives: Kill 5 Kafa-Crazed Yetis in the caves on Kota Peak.
english.description: Lots of yetis in Kota, yup. Usually not too dangerous. Usually just eat goots.$B$BThen they ate the goots full of kafa...$B$B<Keenbean shoots Gootfur a mean glance.>$B$BNow they're moody, cranky, sleep a lot but never seem rested. Typical kafa addicts.$B$BGonna come outta those caves soon, I'm sure. Come lookin' for more kafa.$B$BThen we all in trouble.

text.title: 公平的交易
text.objectives: 将一捆寇塔咔啡果带到靠近寇塔峰山顶的寇塔空巢穴。
text.description: <吼声再次响起，比你遇到过的任何雪人的吼声都更响亮、更狂暴。接着是一阵土地精的哀求……>$B$B天呐！伟大的寇塔空，请宽恕土地精吧。只要你放我走，我一定给你送许多咔啡来！我保证！$B$B<那头叫做寇塔空的怪兽发出一声有力的嘶吼，算是回应。>
text.giverWindow: 寇塔峰大魔王

english.title: A Fair Trade
english.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Kafa'kota Berries to the Lair of Kota Kon, near the top of Kota Peak.
english.description: <The roar bellows out again, louder and more fierce than any of the yetis you've encountered so far. Again, a grummle voice replies...>$B$BEep! Please, great Kota Kon, forgive grummle. Let me go, I'll bring lots of kafa right away! Promise!$B$B<The beast called Kota Kon answers with another meaty roar.>
english.giverWindow: The Terror of Kota Peak

text.title: 粗麻碾压者
text.objectives: 将一瓶咔啡喂给寇塔营地的寇塔空，然后沿粗麻小径击败100只猢狲。
text.description: 好了……她暂时不会吃人了。这是个好的开始。$B$B她一定还想要咔啡，但我们得给她找点儿事做，消耗她过剩的精力……$B$B有了！粗麻小径！她可以去那儿打击那些猢狲！$B$B<表侄八宝利转身向这个庞然大物问道。>$B$B你觉得怎么样，美女？想去教训几个猢狲吗？！$B$B我想是的。现在，把我这瓶紧急备用咔啡喂给她喝。她喜欢你。

english.title: The Burlap Grind
english.objectives: Feed the Flask of Kafa to Kota Kon at Kota Basecamp, then kill 100 Hozen along The Burlap Trail.
english.description: Okayyy... well, she's not eating anybody. That's a good start.$B$BShe must want more kafa, but we gotta give her somethin' to do with all the extra energy...$B$BI got it! The Burlap Trail! She can smash hozen out there all day!$B$B<Burrberry turns to the massive beast.>$B$BWhat do you think, pretty girl? Wanna smash hozens?!$B$BI think so. Here, feed her my emergency flask of kafa. She likes you.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败粗麻小径上的猢狲

text.title: 滚下去！
text.objectives: 击败12个奥苏尔射手老兵或奥苏尔火战士。
text.description:
这段城墙上的野牛人正在为下边的入侵者提供火力掩护。我不知道老陈在想什么，但是我要你去解决那些弓箭手。

好消息是，我们这儿有玄牛之灵的帮助。当他们被削弱时，玄牛之灵会打晕他们，然后你可以借机把他们打下城墙。

你可以在门外找到那些弓箭手。

english.title: Off the Wall!
english.objectives: Kill 12 Osul Veteran Archers or Osul Fire-Warriors.
english.description:
The yaungol on the wall here are providing covering fire for the ones below. I don't know what Lao-chen is thinking, but I want you to deal with these archers.

The good news is, up here we've got the spirit of the Ox helping us. When they're weakened, the ox spirit will stun them and you can use it to knock 'em off the wall.

You'll find the archers just out that door.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败奥苏尔射手老兵或火战士

text.title: 恐怖的献祭
text.objectives: 收集6桶野牛人火油。
text.description:
我有个主意……我准备进行一次恐怖的献祭。

据我所知，我们需要我自制的烈酒来帮助守卫打起精神，这样才能确保玄牛关的长期安全……

现在讨论细节未免太残酷了——如果你要来守护城墙，请收集一些他们用来点燃箭矢的油桶。我们会用到的。

english.title: A Terrible Sacrifice
english.objectives: Gather 6 Barrels of Yaungol Fire Oil.
english.description:
I have an idea, and... am prepared to make a terrible sacrifice.

As much as I know that we need my stout brew, to fortify our defenders for the long-term security of the Ox Gate...

It is too painful to discuss details now, but please - while you are up here defending the wall, gather the barrels of oil they are using to light their arrows. We will need them.

text.title: 难以置信！
text.objectives: 和影踪禅院的哨卫谈一谈，获得进入影踪派禅院的许可。
text.description:
我绝不相信，在我们说明了情况的严重性之后，那些守卫还会不让我们进入禅院。

朋友，向东走，去找禅院门前的哨兵，请求他们允许你进入寺院。我会和你一起去的。

english.title: Unbelievable!
english.objectives: Speak to the Shado-Pan Monastery Sentinel to gain entrance to the Shado-Pan Monastery.
english.description:
I simply refuse to believe the guards will not grant us entry to the monastery should we impress upon them the seriousness of the situation.

Friend, go east, to the sentinel in front of the Monastery, and demand admittance. I will come with you.

text.title: 骑鲨鱼
text.objectives: 赤手空拳地杀死1条发狂的暗礁鲨鱼。
text.description: 在我们那儿，要弄死鲨鱼只有一个方法——赤手空拳！$b$b我刚刚在码头那儿倒了好多鱼饵进水里，这儿应该很快就会挤满本地的暗礁鲨鱼了。跳上你看见的第一条，然后干掉它！

english.title: Jumping the Shark
english.objectives: Kill a frenzied reef shark with your bare hands.
english.description: There is only one way to kill sharks where I come from, with your bare hands!$b$bI dumped a good amount of chum in the water just off the dock here, this place should be crawling with the local reef sharks in no time.  Hop on the first one you see and take it out!

text.title: 发光的鱼饵
text.objectives: 在渔人码头北面的森林里收集7只日光爬行者。
text.description: 某些鱼类只对亮光感兴趣。在北边的森林里生活着一种萤火虫，本地的熊猫人称它们为日光爬行者。$b$b你应该能在这周围树干的底部发现它们的踪迹。给我去弄一些这种虫子来，我可以把它们做成鱼饵！
text.giverWindow: 这些发光的小虫子可以在卡桑琅丛林的树根上找到。

english.title: Bright Bait
english.objectives: Collect 7 Suncrawlers in the forest north of Anglers Wharf.
english.description: Certain fish are only attracted to bright lights.  The forest north of here is home to a local pandaren firefly called a suncrawler.$b$bYou should be able to find them on the base of the tree trunks all around that area.  Bring me back a handful of them and I can use them for bait!
english.giverWindow: These small, glowing insects can be found on the roots of trees in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 影踪派掌门
text.objectives: 帮祝踏岚解除恨之煞对他的控制。
text.description: 我们的掌门祝踏岚被恨之煞给击溃了，整座禅院随之沦陷！$B$B$C，你必须想个办法让他摆脱控制。据我所知，他还在落英林里进行冥想。
text.giverWindow: 解除恨之煞对他的控制！

english.title: Lord of the Shado-Pan
english.objectives: Rid Taran Zhu of his possession by the Sha of Hatred.
english.description: Our lord, Taran Zhu, has been overcome by a sha of pure hatred. The whole monastery has been lost!$B$B$C, you must find a way to free him of this possession. Last I knew, he was meditating in the Grove of Falling Blossoms.
english.giverWindow: Free him from the grip of the Sha of Hatred!
english.giverTarget: Taran Zhu, Lord of the Shado-Pan

text.title: Sotelo's Quest
text.objectives: Use Sotelo's Plunger.
text.description: Push the plunger.$B$BPUSH IT!

english.title: Sotelo's Quest
english.objectives: Use Sotelo's Plunger.
english.description: Push the plunger.$B$BPUSH IT!

text.title: 食人鱼！
text.objectives: 从卡桑琅丛林的卡桑琅河中钓到5条贪狼食人鱼。
text.description: 有些鱼类很难捕捉，贪狼食人鱼绝对名列其中。$b$b但幸运的是，你出现了！现在就是考验你钓鱼技术的时候了。去西北方的卡桑琅河里给我钓一些食人鱼回来。

english.title: Piranha!
english.objectives: Fish up 5 Wolf Piranha from the Krasarang River in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: Certain fish are very difficult to catch.  The wolf piranha falls squarely into this category.$b$bLucky for me that you showed up!  Put those fishing skills to the test and bring me back a few from the krasarang river due northwest of here.

text.title: Regaining Honor
text.objectives: Retrieve Zhen's Banner.
text.description: $n, the yaungol warchief, Humongous, killed Shado-Master Zhen. He has his banner.$B$BYou have to kill Humongous and regain Zhen's honor! If you don't, I will.
text.giverWindow: Retrieve the banner, and Zhen's honor, from Humongous!

english.title: Regaining Honor
english.objectives: Retrieve Zhen's Banner.
english.description: $n, the yaungol warchief, Humongous, killed Shado-Master Zhen. He has his banner.$B$BYou have to kill Humongous and regain Zhen's honor! If you don't, I will.
english.giverWindow: Retrieve the banner, and Zhen's honor, from Humongous!

text.title: Profiting off of the Past
text.objectives: Collect 11 more Mogu Relics.
text.description: <A relic drops off of the statue. Hmm, these could prove to be valuable to the right person.>$B$B<There's a collector on the outskirts of the ruins. Perhaps he'd be interested in purchasing them from you?>
text.completed: Speak with Bao Jian at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit

english.title: Profiting off of the Past
english.objectives: Collect 11 more Mogu Relics.
english.description: <A relic drops off of the statue. Hmm, these could prove to be valuable to the right person.>$B$B<There's a collector on the outskirts of the ruins. Perhaps he'd be interested in purchasing them from you?>
english.completed: Speak with Bao Jian at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit

text.title: 孤注一掷
text.objectives: 拔掉神真子身上的刺。
text.description: 等等，什么？！他怎么能这么鲁莽？他真是疯了，竟然想靠爆破来移走这条船！他们会杀死神真子和我们的。$B$B我知道所剩的时间不多了，但我们必须想想别的办法……
text.completion: The first step is done, but now we must save Shen-zin Su!

english.title: Risking It All
english.objectives: Remove the thorn from Shen-zin Su.
english.description: Wait, what?! How could he be so reckless? Blowing the ship free is insane! They could kill Shen-zin Su, and all of us with it. $B$BI know we don't have much time, but we need to think of another way...
english.completion: The first step is done, but now we must save Shen-zin Su!

text.title: 我的丈夫……
text.objectives: 在螳螂高原的龙影岗哨找到孙娜·默拳。
text.description:
林……

我不管班、老陈还是祝踏岚会说什么。我要去螳螂高原。仅凭我一人之力也许无法解救林，但是我不愿坐等别人出手相助。

一旦祝踏岚打开他宝贝禅院的大门，我们就能解救林了。到那时为止，我会在前方侦察，搞清楚林是否平安无事。

english.title: My Husband...
english.objectives: Meet up with Suna Silentstrike at Longying Outpost in the Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
Lin...

I don't care what Ban, Lao-Chin, or even Taran Zhu says. I'm moving ahead into Townlong. I may not be able to save Lin myself, but I'm not going to sit around waiting for everyone else to catch up.

Once Taran Zhu opens the doors to his precious monastery, we'll save Lin. Until then, I'll scout ahead and make sure he's alright.

text.title: 首波攻击
text.objectives: 击败6个奥苏尔锐角者。
text.description: 既然我们已经充分地研究了敌人的弱点，现在是时候给野牛人一个迎头痛击了。$B$B去西面的台地，给奥苏尔锐角者一点颜色瞧瞧。$B$B让他们知道我们来了，而且绝不惧怕他们的威胁。

english.title: First Assault
english.objectives: Kill 6 Osul Sharphorns.
english.description: Now that we have had time to assess our enemies' weaknesses, it is time for us to deal the yaungol a direct blow.$B$BGo and confront the Osul Sharphorn up the mesa to the west.$B$BLet them know that we are here, and that we are not scared of their threats.

text.title: 四散奔逃
text.objectives: 恐吓8只长毛牦牛或高原巨兽。
text.description: 有一样东西是每支部队都必不可少的，那就是补给线。$B$B驻扎在西面的敌营中圈养了一大群野兽，那是野牛人部队的主要食物来源。$B$B幸运的是，这一地区的牦牛和穆山兽都极易受惊。$B$B潜入进去，好好吓唬一下那些野兽，看看会发生什么事情。

english.title: Running Rampant
english.objectives: Scare 8 Long-Haired Yaks or Steppebeasts.
english.description: There is one thing that every army needs, and that is a supply line.$B$BThe enemy camp to the west contains a large beast herd, which serves as the yaungol army's main source of food.$B$BLuckily for us, the yaks and mushan beasts of this region are easily scared.$B$BSneak in, give the beasts a good slap, and watch the results.

text.title: 完美沥青
text.objectives: 收集8份黑色沥青。
text.description: 奥苏尔部落在作战时，会在长矛和弓箭上涂抹一种极易燃烧，而且很难熄灭的沥青。$B$B他们不仅能用这种可怕的武器屠杀生命，还用它们来焚毁敌人的家园。$B$B我要你在进入他们的兵营后，收集一些这样的沥青。$B$B我们要用这种沥青向野牛人证明，玩火者必自焚。

english.title: Perfect Pitch
english.objectives: Collect 8 Dark Pitch.
english.description: When the Osul tribe goes to war, they coat their spears and arrows with a highly flammable, ever-burning pitch.$B$BThey use this terrible weapon to shed not only blood, but to raze the homes of their enemies.$B$BI need you to collect some of this pitch while you are in their camp.$B$BWe will use it to show the yaungol that when you play with fire, you can get burned.

text.title: 红色高原
text.objectives: 击败8个奥苏尔劫掠者或奥苏尔喷火者。
text.description: 我们的前方就是野牛人大军的主力部队了。$B$B此刻，他们正在集结大军，准备进攻昆莱山的村庄。$B$B如果我们现在突袭奥苏尔劫掠者，那就是打蛇七寸，正中要害。$B$B记住，我们每干掉一个敌人，就是为自己的家园拯救了一条生命。

english.title: Seeing Red
english.objectives: Kill 8 Osul Marauders or Osul Spitfires.
english.description: Ahead of us is the main thrust of the yaungol army.$B$BHere, they prepare their vast army to attack the villages of Kun-Lai.$B$BIf we strike at the Osul now, we can cut them at their very core.$B$BRemember, for every of their number that we strike down here, we save one of our own back at home.

text.title: 借花献佛
text.objectives: 使用班的炸药摧毁6部奥苏尔弩车。
text.description: 野牛人的攻城武器——就是下面那些投矛弩车——正在撕裂我们龙影岗哨和昆莱山的防线。$B$B我们必须摧毁那些可怕的武器。$B$B带上这些炸药。我已经在上面涂满了你收集的沥青。$B$B把炸药投向弩车，让那些野牛人也尝尝他们自酿的苦果。

english.title: Pitching In
english.objectives: Use Ban's Explosives to destroy 6 Osul Ballistas.
english.description: The yaungol's siege weapons - those ballista spearthrowers down there - are tearing apart our defenses both at Longying Oupost and in Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BThose terrible weapons must be destroyed.$B$BTake these explosives. I've covered them in the pitch that you collected.$B$BToss them at those ballistas, and we'll give the yaungol a little taste of their own medicine.

text.title: 营救游侠
text.objectives: 打开枯木笼子救出4个龙影游侠和林·默拳。
text.description: 我必须请你去完成一件最重要的任务，$n。$B$B我的丈夫林被囚禁在奥苏尔兵营的某个牢笼里。他是我生命中的曙光。$B$B请找到他并把他带回我身边，同时尽可能帮我们营救其他的影踪派门人。$B$B你可以在那些奥苏尔劫掠者的身上找到那些牢笼的钥匙。

english.title: Ranger Rescue
english.objectives: Unlock Drywood Cages to save 4 Longying Rangers and Lin Silentstrike.
english.description: I must ask a most important task of you, $n.$B$BSomewhere among the cages in the Osul camp is my husband, Lin. He is the light of my world.$B$BPlease find him and return him to me, and save as many of our fellow Shado-Pan as you can as well.$B$BYou should find keys to those cages on the Osul Marauders.

text.title: 放逐
text.objectives: 击败厄尔昂、库桐和巴塔特。
text.description: 我还能说什么呢，陌生人？$B$B我跟江达克大战了一场，但败下阵来。我居然蠢到相信他会公平较量。$B$B如今，我自己的兄弟都背叛了我，而我却在这里和敌人说话。$B$B我知道你来这儿是为了让奥苏尔人血债血偿。$B$B但我只求你帮我杀掉那三个背叛我的小人。$B$B厄尔昂，那个给我酒里下毒的人。库桐，那个将我的长矛折断的人。还有巴塔特，那个在我即将胜利时却在背后捅我刀子的人。$B$B做完这些后，我死也瞑目了。

english.title: The Exile
english.objectives: Kill Urang, Ku-Tong, and Battat.
english.description: What is there to say, stranger?$B$BI fought Jung Duk and lost. I was the fool to believe he would fight fairly.$B$BNow, my own brothers turned against me, and here I am, speaking to our enemies.$B$BI know you have come for Osul blood.$B$BI only ask that you hunt down the three who betrayed me.$B$BUrang, who poisoned my drink. Ku-Tong, who bent my spear. And Battat, whose dagger slipped into my side as my victory was assured.$B$BDo this, and I can die in peace.

text.title: 江达克
text.objectives: 将影踪派旗帜插在仪式桩上，然后击败江达克。
text.description: 这就是战争。$B$B那些将林从我身边夺走的人，我要一个一个地收拾掉。他们一个也跑不了！$B$B我们要先拿奥苏尔的首领开刀，干掉江达克。$B$B带上这面影踪派的战旗，把它插在敌人营地的中央。$B$B江达克除了跟你战斗，别无他选。$B$B千万不要心慈手软，$n。
text.giverWindow: 奥苏尔野牛人的首领。击败他！

english.title: Jung Duk
english.objectives: Plant the Shado-Pan Banner on the Ceremonial Pile, then kill Jung Duk.
english.description: THIS. IS. WAR.$B$BI will have the heads of everyone who took Lin from me. EVERYONE!$B$BWe will begin with the Osul leader, Jung Duk.$B$BTake this Shado-Pan war banner and place it at the center of their camp.$B$BJung Duk will have no choice but to face you.$B$BShow him no mercy, $n.
english.giverWindow: The leader of the Osul yaungol. Bring him down!

text.title: 搜寻孙娜
text.objectives: 到达仇恨之恶后和班·熊心谈一谈。
text.description: 我有个坏消息。当我回来的时候，孙娜已经不见了。$B$B有人看见她带着行囊沿路向东边去了，嘴里还嘟囔着要追寻野牛人入侵的源头。$B$B我不能让她只身闯入那么危险的地方。$B$B我已经安排好一队人马准备向东挺进。$B$B我们马上就动身了。如果你想和影踪派一起的话，就登上篷车吧。你也可以自己去，到那与我们碰头。

english.title: In Search of Suna
english.objectives: Speak to Ban Bearheart after arriving at Hatred's Vice.
english.description: I have bad news. When I returned, Suna was already gone.$B$BThe others say that she took her things and headed down the road to the east, muttering about hunting down the source of the yaungol aggression.$B$BI cannot allow her to venture into dangerous territory alone.$B$BI've already prepared a group of soldiers to push further east.$B$BWe are leaving shortly. Hop on the caravan if you wish to travel with the Shado-Pan. You can also meet us there if you wish.

text.title: 尘归尘，土归土
text.objectives: 对20个苍风村民使用影踪派火把。
text.description: 如果我们要在这里扎营，就不能让这些野牛人暴尸荒野。$B$B拿着这根火把，去火化村民的尸体吧。$B$B火把散发的香气可以净化这片土地和四周的空气。$B$B即使是我们的敌人，也有权利获得安息。

english.title: Dust to Dust
english.objectives: Use the Shado-Pan Torch on 20 Palewind Villagers.
english.description: If we are to make camp here, we cannot leave all of these yaungol bodies lying to rot.$B$BTake this torch and set fire to the villagers' corpses.$B$BThe incense from the torch should purify the earth and air around them as well.$B$BEven our enemies deserve to be laid to rest.

text.title: 杀死食腐者
text.objectives: 杀死8只灰牙土狼。
text.description: 腐烂的尸体引来了许多专吃死尸的土狼。$B$B这些凶残的食腐野兽不仅会传播疾病，见到我们还会发起攻击。$B$B去收拾掉这些野兽。这虽然让人痛心，最终还是为了大家好。

english.title: Slaying the Scavengers
english.objectives: Kill 8 Ashfang Hyenas.
english.description: The rotting corpses are attracting hyena scavengers.$B$BIn addition to spreading diseases from feeding on the dead, the feral creatures will attack us on sight.$B$BGo and eradicate the beasts. It is unfortunate, but ultimately for the best.

text.title: 图腾研究
text.objectives: 收集9个苍风图腾。
text.description: 在进入村子的时候，我注意到那些散布在营地四周的野牛人图腾。$B$B我怀疑这里有黑暗力量作祟，而这些图腾也许就是找出这种力量的关键。$B$B你能带些图腾回来给我做进一步的调查吗？我要好好研究一下。

english.title: Totemic Research
english.objectives: Collect 9 Palewind Totems.
english.description: As we entered the village, I couldn't help but notice yaungol totems lying around this camp.$B$BI have a suspicion that there are dark forces at work here, and those totems may be the key to drawing them out.$B$BCould you bring me some of these totems for further inspection? I would like to study them.

text.title: 野牛人的丧钟
text.objectives: 将肖图带到仇恨之恶的浓烟痕迹处。
text.description: 班让我去侦察一下村里发生了什么事情。$B$B我发现在东面、西面、西北面和南面都升起了黑烟。$B$B我需要一个信得过的人来策应我。$B$B你怎么想？愿意参加我的首次侦察任务吗？

english.title: Last Toll of the Yaungol
english.objectives: Take Xiao Tu to the smoke trails at Hatred's Vice.
english.description: Ban has asked me to explore the village to determine what happened here.$B$BI noticed smoke rising up from the east, the west, northwest, and the south.$B$BI need someone I trust to watch my back.$B$BWhat do you say? Want to help me on my first scouting mission?

objectiveDetails.description: 检查西北部的浓烟痕迹

text.title: 怨恨的灵魂
text.objectives: 杀死10个怨恨的灵魂。
text.description: 那些死去村民的灵魂居然全部复活了！我能感觉到这些灵魂身上散发出来的怨恨。$B$B$n，如果我们要从这里活着出去，就必须自卫。这是唯一能够让他们安息的办法。

english.title: Spiteful Spirits
english.objectives: Kill 10 Spiteful Spirits.
english.description: The spirits of the fallen villagers have risen! I can feel the hatred emanating from the spirits.$B$B$n, if we are to survive here, we must defend ourselves. This is the only way we can put them to rest.

text.title: 恨之入骨
text.objectives: 使用祥和图腾驱除8个疯狂的影踪派游侠身上的煞魔。打败沸腾之怨，净化你的战友。
text.description: 我早就该想到这是煞魔在搞鬼！$B$B因为我们一直站在祥和图腾的防护结界内，所以没受影响。但其他许多人就没这么幸运了。$B$B当煞魔的力量侵袭时，他们都被困在了营地外面。现在，他们已经开始自相残杀了！$B$B请你带上这个图腾。把它放在我们那些发疯的战友身边，让他们得到净化，但要当心。$B$B你可能要面对操控他的黑暗力量。

english.title: Hatred Becomes Us
english.objectives: Use the Totem of Harmony to exorcise sha spirits from 8 Crazed Shado-Pan Rangers. Defeat the Seething Hatreds to purify your allies.
english.description: I should have suspected a sha presence earlier!$B$BWe are safe as long as we stand inside the Totem of Harmony's protective wards, but many of our people were not so lucky.$B$BThey were trapped outside the camp when the sha's powers manifested, and now they turn upon each other!$B$BTake one of my totems with you. Place the totem near a crazed ally to purify them, but beware.$B$BYou may have to face the darkness that gripped them.

objectiveDetails.description: 净化疯狂的影踪派游侠

text.title: 不归路
text.objectives: 找到孙娜·默拳。
text.description: 我们的一个游侠报告说，看见孙娜在西北面的山上出没。$B$B听到她没事的消息，我感到很欣慰。可我更担心她会因为过度悲痛而做出傻事。$B$B你可以代我去跟她谈谈吗？$B$B把这个图腾带上。如果沿路遇到什么危险，它或许能派上用场。

english.title: The Point of No Return
english.objectives: Find Suna Silentstrike.
english.description: One of our rangers reported seeing Suna up the hill to the northwest.$B$BI am relieved to find her safe. I had feared what she would do in her grief.$B$BWould you go speak to her on my behalf?$B$BTake this totem with you. If you encounter any danger along the way, you may find it useful.

text.title: 高岚阵
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原的高岚阵和祝踏岚掌门谈一谈。
text.description: 在你的帮助下，我们成功抚慰了这里的怨灵。$B$B他们终于能安息了。$B$B来到这片被诅咒的土地，恐怕只是我们旅程的开始。$B$B我在这有些重要的事要处理，但大部队很快就要出发了。$B$B我需要有人去找祝踏岚掌门，并通报我们即将与他会合。$B$B去高岚阵找到他，告诉他这里所发生的一切。

english.title: Gao-Ran Battlefront
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Taran Zhu at the Gao-Ran Battlefront in the Townlong Steppes.
english.description: With your help, we have quelled the spirits of this place.$B$BAt last, they may rest in peace.$B$BOur journey into this cursed land, I am afraid, has only begun.$B$BI have some important matters to finish up here, but we will be moving out soon.$B$BI need someone to go ahead and tell Lord Taran Zhu that we are joining him.$B$BFind him at the Gao-Ran Battlefront. Tell him what has transpired here.

text.title: 利矛穿心，铁锁囚魂
text.objectives: 击败囚禁奥比斯的萨满——迪蒙·纳努克。
text.description: 我已经活不了多久了。野牛人用这支利矛刺穿了我的身体。这个伤势足以要了我的命。$b$b他们还用扭曲而邪恶的魔法将我禁锢在这里。这种侮辱比身上的矛伤更让我痛苦。$b$b我的死亡已经无可避免。但这种身陷囹圄的困境……你也许可以帮我解脱。
text.giverWindow: 奥苏尔部落里强大的迷雾萨满。

english.title: A Spear Through My Side, A Chain Through My Soul
english.objectives: Slay Dmong Naruuk, the shaman who holds Orbiss hostage.
english.description: My fate is sealed. The yaungol put this spear in my side. The wound will kill me.$b$bThe yaungol hold me in place with their twisted, corrupted magic. The indignity of it hurts worse than my spear-wound.$b$bMy death, I cannot stop. My imprisonment... you may be able to help me with this.
english.giverWindow: A powerful mist-shaman of the Osul tribe.

text.title: 火把
text.objectives: 获得6个迷雾萨满的火把。
text.description: 不久之前，野牛人萨满还会来这里与我们共事。而现在，他们却在逼迫我的人民就范。$b$b如果我们拒绝，就会被杀。而且即使屈服……他们依然会屠杀我们。$b$b野牛人迷雾萨满的魔力都源于他的火把。拿走他的火把，他就没辙了。

english.title: The Torches
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Mist-Shaman's Torches.
english.description: Until recently, the yaungol shaman would come here to work alongside us. Now, they bend my people to their will.$b$bIf we refuse, they kill us. Even if we oblige... they kill us.$b$bThe yaungol mist-shaman's magic flows through his torch. Take his torch away, and he has nothing.

text.title: 高尔戈斯
text.objectives: 将迷雾萨满的火把插在上激流潭的泥炭块上，以召唤高尔戈斯。
text.description: 野牛人迷雾萨满的首领叫做迦赫什。他以强大的力量而闻名。$b$b我们之中也有这么一个人，他的力量也绝不逊色。他的名字叫高尔戈斯。$b$b高尔戈斯就沉睡在上激流潭的迷雾里。帮我把他召唤出来，他会加入我们的复仇行动，助我一臂之力。

english.title: Golgoss
english.objectives: Summon Golgoss by planting the Mist-Shaman's Torches into the Peat Clump in the Upper Sumprushes.
english.description: The leader of the yaungol mist-shaman is named Jahesh. He is known for his strength.$b$bOne of my kind is also known for his strength. His name is Golgoss.$b$bGolgoss sleeps within the mists of the Upper Sumprushes. Help me to summon him, and he will join me in avenging our people.

text.title: 阿孔尼斯
text.objectives: 将迷雾萨满的火把插在上激流潭的泥炭堆上，以召唤阿孔尼斯。
text.description: 如果要跟野牛人迷雾萨满的首领迦赫什战斗，我还需要阿孔尼斯从旁助阵。阿孔尼斯的勇猛无人能及。$b$b他栖息在上激流潭的迷雾里。找到他的栖息之地，然后使用这些火把唤醒他。

english.title: Arconiss
english.objectives: Summon Arconiss by planting the Mist-Shaman's Torches into the Peat Mound in the Upper Sumprushes.
english.description: If I am to fight Jahesh, leader of the yaungol mist-shaman, I must have Arconiss by my side. Arconiss' ferocity is second to none.$b$bHe rests beneath the mists of the Upper Sumprushes. Find his resting place, and then use these torches to awaken him.

text.title: 高尔戈斯饿了
text.objectives: 获得10根盘根藤。
text.description: 高尔戈斯强壮无比，但还要补充些营养才能投入战斗。$b$b上激流潭的乱齿灌木丛生长着粗壮且富含纤维的树枝。这应该蛮合他味口的。

english.title: Golgoss Hungers
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Snarlvines.
english.description: Golgoss' strength is great, but he requires nutrition before he can use it.$b$bThe snarlthorn bushes in the Upper Sumprushes have heavy, fibrous branches. These should sate his appetite.

text.title: 阿孔尼斯渴了
text.objectives: 获得4份凝结的河狸血。
text.description: 阿孔尼斯的勇猛无人能及，但在迷雾下的长期蛰伏让他虚弱不堪。$b$b沼泽地里的河狸数量众多，它们血管里满是营养丰富的鲜血。我要你带回足够的鲜血，帮阿孔尼斯恢复精神。

english.title: Arconiss Thirsts
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Clotted Rodent's Blood.
english.description: Arconiss fights with unmatched fury, but his extended stay beneath the mists has left him weakened.$b$bThe rodents of the swamp are plentiful, and their bodies are filled with nourishing blood. Return with blood enough to reignite Arconiss' spirit.

text.title: 虚弱的奥比斯
text.objectives: 穿过上激流潭的迷雾喷口，获得8份涌动的雾气。
text.description: 我知道自己大限将近。但没料到来得这么快。$b$b我必须争取时间。上激流潭的迷雾温暖而芳香。那种迷雾能有效滋养我们的身体。$b$b请你尽一切办法收集这种迷雾……放到罐子里、瓶子里或者你的背包里都可以。把它带回来给我，我能靠它们再多坚持一会儿。

english.title: Orbiss Fades
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Gushing Mists by walking through mist geysers in the Upper Sumprushes.
english.description: I knew death would come. I did not know that it would come this fast.$b$bI must buy time. The mist of the Upper Sumprushes is warm and fragrant. Such mist is nutritive to my kind.$b$bGather this mist however you can... in jars, in vials, within the interior of your bags. Bring it back to me, and I can use it to remain corporeal for a bit longer.

text.title: 迷雾的机遇
text.objectives: 击败奥苏尔氏族的迦赫什。
text.description: 进攻的时候到了。$b$b高尔戈斯、阿孔尼斯和我将潜入东面的迦赫什的领地。我们在那里会合，准备战斗。$b$b今天，我们要为我们的人民找回失去的尊严。
text.giverWindow: 奥苏尔迷雾萨满的首领。

english.title: Mists' Opportunity
english.objectives: Slay Jahesh of Osul.
english.description: Now is the time to strike.$b$bGolgoss, Arconiss, and I will go east, into Jahesh's domain. Meet us there, and prepare for battle.$b$bToday, we restore the pride of our people.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the Osul Mist-Shaman.

text.title: 紧急救护
text.objectives: 治愈廖贤者，让他重新振作起来。
text.description:
我……还活着……但也差不多了。其他人都被杀光了。我的朋友……我的家人……

我一定要回到村里……但我时间无多，而且自己也走不了……你是治疗者吗？在……我的小屋里有一瓶治疗药水……帮我找找。如果你会治疗魔法，也能用来治疗我。

english.title: Emergency Care
english.objectives: Heal Sage Liao to get him back on his feet.
english.description:
I... am alive... but barely. They killed the rest. My friends... and family...

I must return to the village... But, I do not have long, and cannot move on my own... are you a healer? I... have a healing potion in my hut... search my belongings. You can use your magic, if you have it.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用法术或小屋里的药膏治疗廖贤者

text.title: 保持联系
text.objectives: 在皇帝谷使用巴匈之舌。
text.description: 巴匈之舌应该能使我们进行远距离交谈，$n。$b$b如果这件遗物的作用和我想的一样，那我就能够留在这里继续我的冥想，同时你也可以去调查皇帝谷。$b$b米师会带你去山谷边缘，这样我们就能验证我的理论了。我可不希望你进入古墓后就没法联系到我。那太可怕了！

english.title: Staying Connected
english.objectives: Use the Tongue of Ba-Shon in the Valley of Emperors.
english.description: The Tongue of Ba-Shon should allow us to communicate from long distances, $n.$b$bIf the relic works the way I think it will, I should be able to stay here and continue my meditations while you do some scouting in the Valley of Emperors.$b$bMishi will take you to the edge of the valley so that we can test my theory. I would hate for you to be in the tombs with no way to contact me. That would be horrible!

objectiveDetails.description: 在皇帝谷中使用巴匈之舌

text.title: 尘埃落定
text.objectives: 消灭5个受折磨的鬼魂。
text.description: 这些灵魂应该是在坟墓开启时被释放出来的……$b$b死亡对魔古族来说并非生命的终结。相反，死亡仅仅是他们寻找下个宿体前的一次小憩而已。缚灵者能使用邪恶的魔法将灵魂从一个躯壳转移到另一个躯壳。$b$b长年困寄于坟墓中令他们感到十分困惑。在他们从困惑转变为愤怒，或是找到新的躯壳之前，我们必须消灭他们。

english.title: An End to Everything
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Tormented Spirits.
english.description: These spirits must have been released when the tombs were opened... $b$bDeath was not final for the Mogu. Instead, death was merely a stop over on the path to a new body. Spiritbinders used a foul magic to transfer spirits from one shell to the next.$b$bYears of being trapped in the tombs has left them confused. They need to be destroyed before their confusion turns to anger or worse, they find a new shell.

text.title: 功亏一篑
text.objectives: 从书中撕下一页纸，把它带给游学者周卓。
text.description: 这儿举行过一个仪式，不过看起来并没有成功。$b$b在被遗弃的物品里，有一本打开的书。你看不懂书中的文字。$b$b带走整本书也许有点困难，不过你可以只带走书中的一页。如果你能把书页带给游学者周卓，他或许能告诉你书上写了什么。

english.title: It Was Almost Alive
english.objectives: Tear a page from the open book to give to Lorewalker Cho.
english.description: A ritual took place here, and from the looks of it wasn't successful.$b$bAmong the abandoned items a book lies open. The text on the pages is foreign to you.$b$bCarrying the whole book may be difficult, but a single page might be enough. If you can get the page to Lorewalker Cho he may be able to tell you what it says.

text.title: 击破皇帝之盾
text.objectives: 终止隐秘古陵里的灵魂束缚仪式。
text.description: 多年来，魔古族一直散居各地，人口稀少。这样一看，他们来这山谷的目的就浮出水面了。$b$b有了这么多不安的灵魂，他们就可以利用每座坟墓里埋葬的守护者为自己建立一支军队。再加上赞达拉的军队，这将是一场毁灭性的灾难！$b$b隐秘古陵里安息着名为“皇帝之盾”的精锐战士。我们绝不能让他们复活！你可以在西南方最高的山坡上找到这座陵墓。

english.title: Breaking the Emperor's Shield
english.objectives: Stop the Spiritbinding Ritual in the Tomb of Secrets.
english.description: The Mogu have been scattered and sparse in number for many years. Their purpose in the valley makes sense now.$b$bWith this many restless spirits they can build themselves an army using the guardians buried in each tomb. Combined with the Zandalari forces this would be devastating!$b$bThe Tomb of Secrets houses elite warriors called the Emperor's Shield. They must not be resurrected! You'll find the tomb on the highest rise to the southwest.

text.title: 暗影古陵
text.objectives: 在暗影古陵收集沈朝石板、呙朝石板和齐昂朝石板的拓片。
text.description: 根据你从祭坛带回来的物品，我猜他们是想举行灵魂束缚仪式。$b$b大部分有关灵魂束缚的记载都被埋在了暗影古陵中。也许我们能在那里找到想要的答案。$b$b到那里之后，你要注意寻找一切有用的东西。你可以在最靠近仪式祭坛的第一个山坡上找到那座陵墓。

english.title: The Tomb of Shadows
english.objectives: Collect a rubbing of the Shen Dynasty Tablet, the Wai Dynasty Tablet, and the Qiang Dynasty Tablet in the Tomb of Shadows.
english.description: Given the artifacts you found on the altar, I would guess they were attempting to perform a Spiritbinding ritual.$b$bMost of the texts involving Spiritbinding were locked away in the Tomb of Shadows. Perhaps we will find the answers we seek there.$b$bLook for anything that might help us. You'll find the tomb on the first rise closest to the ritual altar.

text.title: 窃取他们的雷电之王
text.objectives: 找到雷神石板的下半部并修复雷电石板。
text.description: 我们唯一的希望就是赶在魔古族之前找到雷电之王的遗骸，他一定是被葬在征服者陵墓里了。$b$b要想找到他的遗骸可不容易，$n。毫无疑问，为了防止盗墓贼的光临，陵墓里肯定守卫森严、机关重重。$b$b当你进入陵墓之后，我们必须设法找出雷电之王真正的埋骨之所。

english.title: Stealing Their Thunder King
english.objectives: Find the Bottom Fragment of Lei Shen's Tablet and restore the Tablet of Thunder.
english.description: Our only hope is to find the Thunder King's remains before they do. He must be buried within the Tomb of Conquerors.$b$bGetting to his remains will not be easy, $n. The tomb will no doubt be defended by guardians and other unfriendly surprises intended to ward off thieves.$b$bOnce inside we will need to figure out where his remains have actually been placed.

text.title: 历史的教训
text.objectives: 在征服者陵墓里阅读雷电石板。
text.description: 雷电之王是个暴虐的皇帝，再加上赞达拉部族助纣为虐，他曾经不可一世。他的复活一定会让这片土地再次陷入混乱苦难之境。$b$b你必须找到他的遗骸，转移到安全的地方。雷电石板可以帮助你找到进入他陵墓的通道。

english.title: Lessons from History
english.objectives: Read the Tablet of Thunder in the Tomb of Conquerors.
english.description: The Thunder King was a vicious Emperor and with the Zandalari at his side he was unstoppable. His return would surely return this land to turmoil and misery.$b$bYou must locate his remains and take them somewhere safe. The Tablet of Thunder should help you figure out how to access his tomb.

text.title: 追逐风暴
text.objectives: 从赞达拉战士身上找到鲜血沁出的地图。
text.description: 我们必须搞清楚他们把雷电之王的遗骸藏到哪里去了。他们不可能在皇帝谷复活雷电之王。他们一定会找一个偏远、安全的地方。$b$b看来要离开这里也没那么容易……$b$b杀出一条血路，搜寻与遗骸下落相关的信息吧。

english.title: Chasing the Storm
english.objectives: Find the Blood-Revealed Map on a Zandalari Warrior.
english.description: We need to figure out where they are taking the Thunder King's remains. It won't be possible for them to resurrect him in the Valley of the Emperors. They would need to be somewhere remote and secure.$b$bIt appears that getting out of here may also prove to be a challenge....$b$bFight your way out and look for information concerning the location of the remains.

text.title: 恐惧大师
text.objectives: 击败恐惧大师。
text.description: 我忍无可忍了！我夫人，愿上天保佑她，在这座农场上倾注了她一生的心血，才使农场有了今日的繁荣。$b$b那群野牛人的首领霸占了我们的农场，还在那儿自鸣得意！如果你能让那自鸣得意的笑容从他肮脏、恶臭、狗屁不如的牛脸上消失，我就给你一笔可观的报酬。
text.giverWindow: 比起穆山兽的力量，他更喜欢牦牛的灵活。

english.title: The Fearmaster
english.objectives: Kill the Fearmaster.
english.description: I am not gonna take this anymore. My wife, bless her, poured her heart and soul in to that ranch making it what it is today.$b$bThem yaungol got a leader over there being all smug and what not. I'll pay you handsomely if you knock that smug smile off his filthy, stinking, good for nothing face.
english.giverWindow: He prefers the maneuverability of a yak versus the strength of a mushan.

text.title: 制裁
text.objectives: 击败队长撕肉和6个黑鬃雇佣兵。
text.description:
在雇佣兵们洗劫了我们之后，他们中的大多数都离开了。

但他们中的一个……在其他人抢走我们所有的财物之后，又刺死了我们剩下的人。他只是为了好玩！

去为逝者讨回公道。也许他们死掉的消息可以让我振作起来。

你能在西边找到他们那伙人。
text.giverWindow: 黑鬃雇佣兵的指挥官。

english.title: Justice
english.objectives: Kill Captain Ripflesh and 6 Blackmane Mercenaries.
english.description:
After the mercenaries robbed us, most left.

But one of them... after the others took all we had, he ran the rest of us through. For sport!

Get justice for the fallen. Perhaps news of their death will raise my spirits enough to go on.

You'll find them just west of here.
english.giverWindow: The commander of the Blackmane Mercenaries.

text.title: 长寿香
text.objectives: 收集1枚虹光蓝色蟹壳和8包失窃的熊猫人香料。
text.description:
逝者已矣。我们要好好安葬他们，就得去找到制作长寿香的原材料。

它不仅闻起来芳香怡人——而且对于身体恢复最具奇效，甚至有助于植物生长。也许配料的味道能让我重新振作起来。

你可以在附近的生物身上就找到这些原料——除了香料，它们被掠夺我们村庄的那帮雇佣兵偷走了。

english.title: The Scent of Life
english.objectives: Gather an Opalescent Blue Crab Shell and 8 Stolen Pandaren Spices.
english.description:
Many have perished here. We will need to honor them properly, which means gathering the makings of incense of life. 

It doesn't just smell nice - it has restorative properties, and can even help plants grow. Maybe I can get a whiff of the ingredients to get me back on my feet.

The materials can be found on creatures around here - except for the spices, which were stolen by the mercenaries who pillaged the village.

text.title: 瀑布之祭
text.objectives: 收集3块水洗石。
text.description:
我要为我死去的朋友们保留最后一点尊严，不能让他们连个像样的墓穴都没有。

但是我们从来没有一次埋葬过这么多人，而我也收集不动材料了。

请你沿着山脚的路一直往南走，到前面的瀑布去。在那里有很多被流水冲刷得十分光滑的石头。它们可以用来当作墓碑。

english.title: By the Falls, For the Fallen
english.objectives: Gather 3 Waterfall-polished Stones.
english.description:
I do not wish to dishonor my friends and leave them in unmarked graves.

Yet, we have never needed to bury so many at once, and I am in no condition to gather materials.

Please, visit the lakes that hug the mountains edge along the road to the south. Underneath the waterfalls there, you will find stones that have been polished to a sheen by the falling water. They will make suitable headstones.

text.title: 土地精的好运
text.objectives: 找到8个失窃的幸运符。
text.description: 野牛人抢走了我们的幸运符！这些挥着长矛的卑鄙骑手在粗麻小径抢劫了我们兄弟的车队！$b$b这真是莫大的不幸呀。如果让野牛人发现了获得好运的办法，那所有的土地精可就要倒大霉了！$b$b帮我们去北边的卢秦火营夺回幸运符，我们会给你很多很多好运。

english.title: A Grummle's Luck
english.objectives: Find 8 Stolen Luckydos.
english.description: The yaungols stole our luckydos! Mean riders with spears took them from our caravan of brothers coming down the Burlap Trail.$b$bThis is very bad fortune. If the yaungol discover the secrets of luckydos all grummles will be in big trouble.$b$bRecover our luckydos from Fire Camp Ruqin north of here and we will pay many fortunes to you.

text.title: 迈出第一步
text.objectives: 击败8个奥苏尔冲锋者。
text.description: <踏岚掌门凌厉的眼神令你浑身僵硬。>$B$B$C，你身上有着多次大战留下的痕迹。$B$B很好！我们需要更多像你这样经验丰富的战士来稳住战线。$B$B我们好不容易才在这里立足，但野牛人像疯了一样想将我们赶尽杀绝。$B$B如果你想证明自己的价值，就下山去让野牛人看看，我们绝不会退缩。

english.title: A Foot in the Door
english.objectives: Kill 8 Osul Chargers.
english.description: <Lord Taran immediately pins you down with his steely gaze.>$B$B$C, you bear the marks of many a past battle.$B$BGood! We need more seasoned people like you to hold back the front.$B$BWe've managed to secure a foothold here, but the yaungol are desperate to remove our presence.$B$BIf you wish to prove your worth, go down the hill and show the yaungol that we will not back down.

text.title: 我的死亡
text.objectives: 拔除奥比斯身上的长矛。
text.description: 我已下决心要把这根矛从身体里拔出来。$b$b不过这需要你的帮助。你健壮的双手比我更有力。

english.title: The Death of Me
english.objectives: Remove the spear from Orbiss.
english.description: I have resolved to remove this spear from my side.$b$bFor this, I require your assistance. Your grasping hands are stronger than mine.

objectiveDetails.description: 拔除奥比斯身上的长矛

text.title: 取得联络
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的卓金海滩探望廖贤者。
text.description: 巨魔来的时候，还带来了他们那些唯利是图的……同伙。我看见他们经过我们村，朝西北面的捕鱼营地进发了。我的表哥就住在那里。他是一个治疗者——你能去找他，确认一下他和他的村子是否安然无恙吗？

english.title: Checking In
english.objectives: Check on Sage Liao at the Zaochin Strand in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description: When the trolls came, they brought their mercenary... friends with them. I saw them go past us, to the fishing camp in the northwest. My cousin, a healer, lives there - can you check in with him and make sure he and his village are well?

text.title: The Healing of Shen-zin Su
text.objectives: Rescue and defend healers until Shen-zin Su's wound is healed.
text.description: This is what comes of such recklessness. How could he think this was even a possibility?$B$BNevermind, there's no time for that now. We need to act to save Shen-zin Su.$B$BFind any healers you can! Rescue them, relieve them - whatever you need to do to get them over here healing the wound.$B$BKeep the healers safe at all costs!

english.title: The Healing of Shen-zin Su
english.objectives: Rescue and defend healers until Shen-zin Su's wound is healed.
english.description: This is what comes of such recklessness. How could he think this was even a possibility?$B$BNevermind, there's no time for that now. We need to act to save Shen-zin Su.$B$BFind any healers you can! Rescue them, relieve them - whatever you need to do to get them over here healing the wound.$B$BKeep the healers safe at all costs!

text.title: A New Fate
text.objectives: Return to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the Skyfire Crash-Site to take you there.
text.description: $n, I'm thankful the plan worked, but just barely. We would be sinking to the bottom of the ocean with all of Shen-zin Su if you hadn't been here. I don't think I can ever forgive Ji for this kind of recklessness.$B$BThere will be plenty of time for reflection, but for now, we need to return to the Temple of Five Dawns. We need to let them know that Shen-zin Su has been saved, and we need to sort out the fates of these new allies.

english.title: A New Fate
english.objectives: Return to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the Skyfire Crash-Site to take you there.
english.description: $n, I'm thankful the plan worked, but just barely. We would be sinking to the bottom of the ocean with all of Shen-zin Su if you hadn't been here. I don't think I can ever forgive Ji for this kind of recklessness.$B$BThere will be plenty of time for reflection, but for now, we need to return to the Temple of Five Dawns. We need to let them know that Shen-zin Su has been saved, and we need to sort out the fates of these new allies.

text.title: 准备葬礼
text.objectives: 去找李海，告诉他有关葬礼的事。
text.description:
非常感谢，朋友。好在悲剧发生以后，命运女神开始眷顾我们了，一定是她派你来的。

你为我死去的朋友们讨还了公道，还帮忙收集了必要的材料来祭奠他们。我会去收集一下他们的尸首，并准备葬礼所需的材料，然后我们在墓地碰头。

与此同时，麻烦你回去找我表弟，让他召集村里的人来参加葬礼。
text.completed: 去卓金村找李海，告诉他有关葬礼的事。

english.title: Preparing the Remains
english.objectives: Return to Li Hai and tell him about the funeral.
english.description:
Thank you much, friend. After this tragedy, it is good that fortune has smiled on us and sent you.

You have gotten justice for my fallen friends, and gathered the necessary materials to honor them. I will gather their bodies, prepare the materials for their funerals, and meet you at the graveyard. 

In the meantime, however, please return to my cousin and ask him to gather the villagers for the funeral.
english.completed: Return to Li Hai in Zouchin Village and tell him about the funeral.

text.title: 葬礼
text.objectives: 参加葬礼，并点燃长寿香。
text.description:
我这就回去召集乡亲们，请他们来参加葬礼。

你为祭奠我们的朋友做了这么多事，我们觉得应该由你点燃长寿香，以超度他们的亡魂。

english.title: A Funeral
english.objectives: Attend the funeral and light the Incense of Life.
english.description:
As I said, I will gather the town - we will be at the funeral. 

As the one who has done so much to honor our friends, we feel it is only right that you will be the one to light the Incense of Life and usher their spirits to the life beyond.

text.title: 粗麻碾压者
text.objectives: 与寇塔营地的寇塔空谈一谈，然后骑上她，并沿粗麻小径击败100只猢狲。
text.description: 好了，现在该带寇塔空出去“散步”了。$B$B我们专门为她烹煮了两坛新鲜咔啡，她现在可是吃饱喝足了！

english.title: The Burlap Grind
english.objectives: Speak with Kota Kon at Kota Basecamp to ride her, then kill 100 Hozen along The Burlap Trail.
english.description: Alright, it's time to take Kota Kon out for her "walk."$B$BWe brewed two fresh pots of kafa just for her and she's all fueled up!

objectiveDetails.description: 击败粗麻小径上的猢狲

text.title: 知错就改
text.objectives: 杀死寇塔峰上的12只咔啡成瘾的高山羊。
text.description: 我那位在寇塔营地的表哥把事情搞砸了。他闯大祸了。$B$B他就是太懒，不想自己从咔啡果里挖种子。他发现山羊在吃了这些果子后，会把咔啡豆拉出来……大概要一天左右。$B$B所以他把手头所有的果子一股脑地全喂给了寇塔峰上的山羊吃，现在它们都亢奋得发了疯！它们攻击所有移动的物体。$B$B以前土地精在寇塔收咔啡也没见什么危险。但现在不是了，就是因为这群山羊。你能帮忙解决吗？

english.title: Shut it Down
english.objectives: Kill 12 Kafa-Crazed Mountain Goats on Kota Peak.
english.description: My cousin over at Kota Basecamp mussed up. He mussed up bad.$B$BHe was too lazy to cut seeds out of kafa berries by hand, but he noticed goots eat the berries up and give back the seeds... in a day or so.$B$BHe fed everything he had to the goots on Kota Peak and now they're nuts! Chargin' everything that moves.$B$BKota used to be safe for Grummles to gather kafa. Not anymore. Not with them goots. Will you help?

text.title: 羊屎咔啡
text.objectives: 在寇塔峰上标出10处山羊咔啡“沉积物”。
text.description: 这真是个疯狂的点子：把咔啡果喂给山羊，等它们把咔啡豆拉出来。$B$B寇塔咔啡已经相当珍贵稀有了，但我表兄弟的发明——山羊咔啡——甚至称得上极品。$B$B但现在都完了。山上乱成一团，表叔激情豆很生气，后果很严重。我们能做的就是挽救剩下的山羊咔啡，不要再犯同样的错误。$B$B我不会再让你来做了——这工作确实琐碎，不适合英雄来做——你只要在那些“沉积物”上做个标记，等山上安全后方便我们轻松找到它们就行。

english.title: Gourmet Kafa
english.objectives: Mark 10 Kafa'goot "Deposits" on Kota Peak.
english.description: It was a crazy idea: kafa berries go in the goot, seeds come out.$B$BKafa'kota is already rare and worth a fortune, but my cousin's invention--Kafa'goot--is GOURMET.$B$BBut it's over now. Uncle Keenbean is upset and peak is a muss. All that's left is to collect the rest of the Kafa'goot and never make it again.$B$BI won't ask you to gather it--kind of a mussy task, not fit for hero-- just mark it so we can find it easily when the mountain is safe again.

text.title: 寇塔混合咔啡
text.objectives: 从寇塔峰收集100个寇塔咔啡果。在山边的灌木丛或者雪人洞的贮藏室里都可以找到。
text.description: 寇塔峰以其咔啡灌木丛而闻名——其它品种在这个海拔都无法生存。$B$B土地精靠着贩卖寇塔混合咔啡日子也过得不错，但因为我表哥干的好事，现在那里成了危险之地。为了他的那点小算盘，他让山上的野生动物拼命吃咔啡果。$B$B山羊肆意啃食，雪人也拼命往自己洞里搬，现在寇塔咔啡已经相当稀少了。$B$B从寇塔带回来一些咔啡果吧，表叔激情豆都会给你个好价钱。$B$B给，我这有点样品，你拿去尝尝。喝过你就知道这东西劲头有多足。

english.title: Kota Blend
english.objectives: Collect 100 Kafa'kota Berries from Kota Peak. They can be found in bushes growing on the mountainside or piled up in the yeti caves.
english.description: Kota Peak is famous for its kafa bushes - no other can survive at this elevation.$B$BGrummles make very good living selling Kafa'kota Blend, but it's dangerous now thanks to our cousin. He's got the wildlife up there hooked on kafa with his scheming.$B$BKafa'kota is more scarce than ever with goots gobblin' it up and yetis hoarding it in their caves.$B$BUncle Keenbean will pay you good for any berries you bring down from Kota.$B$BHere, take a sample. Eat it. See for yourself the power of kafa.

text.title: 制造难题
text.objectives: 在寇塔峰击败5只咔啡成瘾的雪人。
text.description: 寇塔峰上有许多雪人，但他们一般不怎么危险，通常只吃山羊。$B$B但住在寇塔营地的那位表哥山羊毛真是够蠢的，居然把咔啡喂给山羊吃，而雪人又吃了这些满肚子咔啡的山羊。$B$B现在他们变得喜怒无常、脾气暴躁。睡得再多，还是一副亢奋的样子。这是典型的咔啡成瘾症状。$B$B我肯定，不久他们就会跑出山洞来找更多的咔啡。$B$B到那时我们就麻烦大了。

english.title: Trouble Brewing
english.objectives: Kill 5 Kafa-Crazed Yetis in the caves on Kota Peak.
english.description: Lots of yetis in Kota, yup. Usually not too dangerous. Usually just eat goots.$B$BThen stupid Cousin Gootfur over at Kota Basecamp fed kafa to the goots, and the yeti ate them goots.$B$BNow they're moody, cranky, sleep a lot but never seem rested. Typical kafa addicts.$B$BGonna come outta those caves soon, I'm sure. Come lookin' for more kafa.$B$BThen we all in trouble.

text.title: 幕后黑手
text.objectives: 和雅丽亚·圣言者谈一谈，然后开始仪式。$B$B然后再激活仁慈图腾、宁神图腾和静寂图腾。
text.description: 如果我的怀疑没错的话，这里仍然萦绕着一些残存的黑暗力量。$B$B无论这里发生过什么……那肯定是不合常理的事情。$B$B即使残暴如野牛人，也不可能像这样……自相残杀。$B$B我要用你带给我的图腾举行一个净化仪式。$B$B我需要有人协助完成仪式。你准备好了就告诉我一声。

english.title: What Lies Beneath
english.objectives: Speak to Yalia Sagewhisper to begin the ceremony.$B$BThen, activate the Totem of Kindness, the Totem of Tranquility, and the Totem of Serenity.
english.description: If my suspicions are correct, this place still reels from some lingering darkness.$B$BWhatever happened here... it could not have been the natural course of events.$B$BEven the yaungol are not so brutal as to slaughter their own kind to the point of... this.$B$BI will use the totems that you brought me to perform a cleansing ritual.$B$BI need someone to assist me in the ceremony. Let me know when you are ready.

text.title: 净化潭水
text.objectives: 在墨鳃潭向水语者苟莱指出需要净化的腐蚀之池，让他知道你已经准备好在净化仪式过程中保护他了。
text.description:
最近，湖中又出现了从阿梅体内流出的那种黑暗物质。

我会和你一起前往墨鳃潭。请为我指出需要净化的腐蚀之池。

在我完成仪式之前，你需要对付从潭水中出来的家伙，来保证我的安全。

english.title: Cleansing the Mere
english.objectives: Point out Pools of Corruption in Inkgill Mere to Waterspeaker Gorai to let him know you are ready to defend him while he completes the cleansing ritual.
english.description:
Pools of the same murky substance that came out of Mei emerged in the lake recently.

I will travel into the Mere with you. Point out the pools of corruption that you are ready for me to cleanse.

You will need to deal with whatever comes out and protect me as I complete the ritual.

text.title: 巴匈之舌
text.objectives: 帮助游学者周卓装上巴匈之舌。
text.description: 谢谢你能过来，$p。请原谅我故作神秘，但我不能冒险惊动魔古族，让他们知道我在这里的工作。$B$B他们正在谷里找寻某些东西。他们盗掘历代国王的陵寝，搜寻能够获得力量的圣物。$B$B我没能观察太久，否则就被发现了，不过我还是找到了一件宝贝。$B$B巴匈之舌能让我们进行远距离的安全通话，不过我得先把它跟自己绑定起来。$B$B如果你准备好了，我随时可以开始。

english.title: The Tongue of Ba-Shon
english.objectives: Assist Lorekeeper Cho in performing the Binding of Ba-Shon.
english.description: Thank you for coming, $p. I am sorry to have been so cryptic, but I could not risk alerting the mogu to my work here.$B$BThey are seeking something in the valley. Plundering the tombs of their old kings for relics of power.$B$BI could not observe them long before having to flee, but I did manage to recover a relic of my own.$B$BThe Tongue of Ba-Shon will let us communicate securely over long distances, but only after I have bound it to myself.$B$BI think I'm ready to begin, if you are.

text.title: 父子团聚
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的墨鳃潭东南岸找商人施禄和武鹏。
text.description:
他们活下来了？我的父亲还活着！

我还以为大家都会被这群疯狂的锦鱼人杀死在这可怕的深潭中呢。

我自己会回去的——到营地来找我吧。

english.title: Father and Child Reunion
english.objectives: Return to Merchant Shi and Wu-Peng at the southeastern shore of Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
They survived? My father is alive!

I thought we would all die here in this horrible mere, at the hands of these insane Jinyu.

I will find my way back - meet me back at camp.

objectiveDetails.description: 让武鹏和商人施禄团聚

text.title: 刹嗳呼之死
text.objectives: 击败水语者圣所的刹嗳呼。圣所就在昆莱山墨鳃潭中心的小岛上。
text.description:
我能听到墨鳃潭的水声——它已经得到了净化。

但是只要刹嗳呼不死，我们的历史就永远无法翻开新的篇章。

他退到了墨鳃潭中央的小岛上，正在腐蚀我们的圣地。

你要小心——他很强大。但我相信，经过我们之前的努力，我们会比他更强大。
text.giverWindow: 腐化墨鳃锦鱼人的罪魁祸首。如果我们想救其他锦鱼人，就必须杀了他。

english.title: The Fall of Shai Hu
english.objectives: Defeat Shai Hu. He can be found at the Waterspeaker's Sanctuary, the island in the center of Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
I can hear the voice of the Mere - it has been purified.

But, this chapter in my people's history will never be closed - not until we defeat Shai Hu.

He has retreated to the central island in the Mere, corrupting our holiest of sites.

Beware - he is strong. But, after all we have done, I am confident we will be stronger.
english.giverWindow: The corrupter of the Inkgill Jinyu. He must die if they are to be redeemed.

text.title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
text.objectives: Defeat Brewmaster Chani.
text.description: Welcome, Challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.$b$bYour first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.$b$bFight with strength, fight with honor.
text.giverWindow: New to her status as a Brewmaster, her brews are painfully bitter.

english.title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
english.objectives: Defeat Brewmaster Chani.
english.description: Welcome, Challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.$b$bYour first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.$b$bFight with strength, fight with honor.
english.giverWindow: New to her status as a Brewmaster, her brews are painfully bitter.

text.title: 第1回合：街头霸王
text.objectives: 打败街头霸王。
text.description: 欢迎参加勇者比武大会，挑战者！今天我们要看看潘达利亚的英雄们到底有多厉害。$b$b你的第一个对手正在东边的凉亭下等着你呢。打败她，你就能晋级下一轮。$b$b为了力量而战！为了荣誉而战！
text.giverWindow: 这位著名的武僧在潘达利亚动荡之时负责保护潘达利亚的大小道路，使其不受侵扰。

english.title: Round 1: The Streetfighter
english.objectives: Defeat the Streetfighter.
english.description: Welcome, challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.$b$bYour first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.$b$bFight with strength, fight with honor.
english.giverWindow: This famous monk defends the roads from the dangers of Pandaria.

text.title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
text.objectives: Defeat Clever Ashyo and Ken-Ken.
text.description: You may know your next challengers. They were arguing fiercely when they arrived, so I have charged them with fighting side by side.$b$bThis will teach them the strength of friendship, and possibly entertain me in the process.$b$bGo to the north eastern arena and face this jinyu and hozen.$b$bDo not be gentle, they need to learn to work together.
text.giverWindow: These two traveling companions continue to harass each other.

english.title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
english.objectives: Defeat Clever Ashyo and Ken-Ken.
english.description: You may know your next challengers. They were arguing fiercely when they arrived, so I have charged them with fighting side by side.$b$bThis will teach them the strength of friendship, and possibly entertain me in the process.$b$bGo to the north eastern arena and face this jinyu and hozen.$b$bDo not be gentle, they need to learn to work together.
english.giverWindow: These two traveling companions continue to harass each other.

text.title: 第2回合：康·棘杖
text.objectives: 击败康·棘杖。
text.description: 你接下来的对手来自于棘杖家族，力量在他们的血液里翻腾。我记得他们家族曾蝉联了整整一个世纪的冠军。$b$b不要有压力，$r。$b$b到北边的东竞技场去会会这个年轻的对手，你将切身体会到力量究竟是遗传的还是后天练得的。
text.giverWindow: 棘杖家族长期占据着比赛的冠军宝座。

english.title: Round 2: Kang Bramblestaff
english.objectives: Defeat Kang Bramblestaff.
