english.description: Your next challenger is a Bramblestaff. Strength is in their blood. I remember a full century of only Bramblestaff champions.$b$bNo pressure, little $r.$b$bGo to the eastern arena north of here and face this young challenger. See first hand if strength is earned or inherited.
english.giverWindow: The Bramblestaff family have long held the championship.

text.title: Round 3: The Wrestler
text.objectives: Defeat The Wrestler.
text.description: Your next challenger is a favorite of mine. He draws strength from raw force and determination.$b$bPlus he has a mask.$b$bFace him in the western arena when you are ready, and good luck.
text.giverWindow: He never removes his mask.

english.title: Round 3: The Wrestler
english.objectives: Defeat The Wrestler.
english.description: Your next challenger is a favorite of mine. He draws strength from raw force and determination.$b$bPlus he has a mask.$b$bFace him in the western arena when you are ready, and good luck.
english.giverWindow: He never removes his mask.

text.title: 战场后方
text.objectives: 在润泥藏身处找到陶矢。
text.description: 我不在昆莱山时，前线人手不够，物资供应线路太长了。在找到恨之煞的踪迹之前，我们需要将一切恢复正常。$B$B陶矢是我的最佳选择。我已派她到北方，调查战斗前线流传的螳螂妖谣言。我需要派一个可以相信的人去那里，和她一起弥补我们防线的漏洞。$B$B如果我这里关于你的资料是准确的，那么我相信你可以干好这件事，对吗$c？

english.title: Behind the Battlefront
english.objectives: Meet with Taoshi at Dampsoil Burrow.
english.description: This battlefront has been undermanned and unsupplied for too long during my absence in Kun-Lai. We need to get things back in order here before we can pick up the trail of the Sha of Hatred.$B$BTaoshi is my best. I've sent her north to investigate rumors of mantid that have somehow made it through the battlefront. I need someone I can trust to get out there and work with her to plug any holes in our defenses.$B$BIf my reports on you are correct, I can trust you with this, right $c?

text.title: 第3回合：布姆布姆大师
text.objectives: 打败布姆布姆大师。
text.description: 你下一位对手是在海滩上找到了自己的力量。准确的说，那是一个写着“炸药”的箱子。$b$b他证明了外力也可以像自己的力量一样致命。$b$b你要是准备好了的话，就去西竞技场会会这位布姆布姆大师吧。
text.giverWindow: 一个耍炸药的武僧。

english.title: Round 3: Master Boom Boom
english.objectives: Defeat Master Boom Boom.
english.description: Your next challenger found his strength on a beach. Particularly in a box labeled "dynamite."$b$bHe proves however that found strength can be as deadly as personal strength.$b$bWhen you are ready, face this Master Boom Boom in the Western Arena.
english.giverWindow: The Dynamite Monkey Monk.

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 在陶矢的帮助下击败12个科里克提克地底斥候。
text.description: 在那下边的是螳螂妖斥候。高岚阵的作用就是防止它们进入螳螂高原东部。如果我们让它们跑到壁垒北边，那我们就会失去在这里的立足点。$B$B让我们去把它们清理干净吧。我会跟你一起去的。

english.title: Unwelcome Intruders
english.objectives: Kill 12 Krik'thik Deep-scouts with Taoshi's help.
english.description: Those are mantid scouts down there. Gao-Ran's Battlefront is meant to keep them out of eastern Townlong Steppes. If we allow them north of the barricade, we may lose our foothold here.$B$BLet's clear them out. I'll be with you.

text.title: 防御缺口
text.objectives: 使用影踪派照明弹帮助你击败10个科里克提克追迹者。
text.description: 通常，这条小径只要几名斥候就能守住。城墙上可以俯瞰这片领地的大多数区域，所以弓箭手能够轻易射杀任何胆敢闯入这里的螳螂妖部队。问题是，绝大部分弓箭手都投入到城门那边的鏖战中了。$B$B带上这个照明弹——它可以帮你找出那些从东部小径乘虚而入的螳螂妖。杀光它们，我们绝不能给螳螂妖大军入侵高原留下任何机会。

english.title: Breach in the Defenses
english.objectives: Use the Shado-Pan Flare to aid in killing 10 Krik'thik Scentlayers.
english.description: Normally, it only takes a few scouts to hold this pass. Most of this territory is in sight of the wall, so archers would devastate any mantid force attempting to push through here. The problem is, most of the archers are occupied with the onslaught at the gate.$B$BTake this flare - it will help you locate the mantid that are sneaking through the eastern pass under our diminished watch. Kill any you find. We can't let them lay a trail that might lead the mantid swarms farther into the steppes.

text.title: 布置陷阱
text.objectives: 重新布置8个影踪派尖刺陷阱。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$c。我们沿路布下了许多陷阱，用以对付那些偷偷溜进来的螳螂妖。但它们的数量实在太多，且大部分陷阱都已被触发了。$B$B陶矢说你去那边的时候，也许能重新布置一些陷阱。你能帮忙吗？

english.title: Trap Setting
english.objectives: Rearm 8 Shado-Pan Spike Traps.
english.description: Good to meet you, $c. We have traps all along the pass to help us catch mantid that might be sneaking through, but their numbers have been so great that most of the traps have already been triggered.$B$BTaoshi said you might be able to reset some of them while you're out there. Can you help?

objectiveDetails.description: 重新布置影踪派尖刺陷阱

text.title: 疲惫不堪
text.objectives: 将换岗命令传达给斥候魏庆、斥候龙凡、斥候盈盈和斥候贾肯。
text.description: 有人告诉我说，浅足小径那边的斥候已经连续值了两天两夜的勤了。难怪螳螂妖会溜了进来。即便是最认真的斥候，在那种情况下也会走神。$B$B我希望你前往那里传达我的命令，让他们立刻撤回到阵内养精蓄锐。我会安排新的人员轮班站岗的。

english.title: The Restless Watch
english.objectives: Deliver return orders to Scout Wei-Chin, Scout Long, Scout Ying, and Scout Jai-Gan.
english.description: I'm being told that our scouts have been on duty in Shallowstep Pass for more than 2 days straight, no rest. No wonder mantid are slipping through. Even the most dedicated scouts would slip with those kinds of shifts.$B$BI want you to go out there and deliver orders to the scouts that they are to return to the battlefront immediately for rest and rations. I'll arrange for a new shift to be posted.

text.title: 解毒良药
text.objectives: 收集10棵紫色香橼。
text.description: 新来的！很高兴见到你。我叫赛菩提，我负责保证影踪派的战斗力。$B$B螳螂妖具有一种能够蚀肉腐血的剧毒。若不医治，中毒的人就会慢慢地痛苦而死。$B$B我需要紫色香橼的花粉。你可以在前线北边的润泥藏身处附近找到它们，那是最近的地方了。如果你正好要去那边的话，能帮我带一些回来吗？

english.title: Treatment for the Troops
english.objectives: Collect 10 Violet Citron.
english.description: A new face! Pleasure to meet you. I'm Septi. I keep the Shado-Pan fighting.$B$BThe mantid have poison that chews through the skin and infects the blood. It makes for a slow, excruciating death when not treated.$B$BI need pollen from the violet citron flowers. The nearest place to find them is around Dampsoil Burrow just north of the battlefront. If you happen to go in that direction, could you bring some back for me?

text.title: 救死扶伤
text.objectives: 治愈8个受伤的高家军黑衣卫。
text.description: $n，我可能需要你的帮助。我们的战士在前线的南侧长期坚守，和敌人战斗到精疲力尽，很多人都受到螳螂妖的毒素感染。$B$B我们需要更多的人手照顾伤员。我用你带来的草药做了一些绷带，但如果你有一些治疗技能，可以起到更好的疗效。$B$B请你帮帮忙，$n，帮我们的人重新站起来，以便他们能够安然无恙地返回这里。

english.title: Back on Their Feet
english.objectives: Heal 8 Injured Gao-Ran Blackguards.
english.description: $n, I could use your help. With their long shifts, our warriors down at the southern front of the battlefront are fighting to the point of exhaustion, and many of them have been exposed to the mantid poison.$B$BWe need more people to tend to the wounded. I've prepared some bandages with the herbs you brought me, but if you have some healing skills, those might work even better.$B$BPlease, $n, get our men back on their feet so that they can get back here to safety.

objectiveDetails.description: 治疗受伤的高家军黑衣卫

text.title: 无尽的螳螂妖
text.objectives: 在高岚阵击败12个科里克提克攻击者。
text.description: 南部前线的高家军需要支援。如果你想帮助影踪派的话，就应该去那里一展拳脚。

english.title: The Endless Swarm
english.objectives: Kill 12 Krik'thik attackers at the Gao-Ran Battlefront.
english.description: Gao-ran's men need help down on the southern front. If you want to stand by the Shado-Pan, that's where you should do it.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败科里克提克攻击者

text.title: 搜查遗体
text.objectives: 找回20块科里克提克虫钳武器。
text.description: 我的确有另一个任务要交给你，$n，这个任务非常艰巨。我需要彻底研究这种螳螂妖的毒素，但为了进行研究，我需要更多来自毒素携带者的一手情报。$B$B在你前往南方战场的时候，能否为我带回一些螳螂妖的武器，以便我检查他们的完整毒腺。

english.title: Rummaging Through the Remains
english.objectives: Recover 20 Krik'thik Limbs.
english.description: I do have another task for you, $n, though it's a might grim. I really need to get to the bottom of this mantid poison, but to do that, I need more information directly from the source.$B$BWhile you're down on the southern battlefield, could you bring me back some mantid limbs so that I can examine their intact poison glands.

text.title: 临时弹药
text.objectives: 在琥珀泽收集16颗不稳定的恐惧宝珠。
text.description: 我为你准备了一项新任务。$B$B我们赖以击退螳螂妖重重包围的龙息火炮目前正面临着弹药不足的窘境。营地里的炮手发明了一种临时弹药，它要用西面山脊里的球形种子制成。$B$B几小时前，他们派遣了一队新兵去采集种子，但至今杳无音信。我想派一名得力干将来确保完成这个任务。$B$B$g小伙子:小姑娘;，你能胜任这个任务吗？

english.title: Improvised Ammunition
english.objectives: Recover 16 Volatile Dread Orbs from the Ambermarsh.
english.description: I've got another job for you.$B$BThe dragon cannons we depend on to keep the thicker swathes of mantid back are running low on ammo. The camp's cannoneers developed an improvised explosive that's made from the globe seeds down the western ridge.$B$BThey dispatched a couple initiates to bring some back hours ago, but have heard nothing from them. I want to send someone a bit more capable to make sure that this gets taken care of.$B$BAre you my $gman:woman; for this?

text.title: 小偷和捣蛋鬼
text.objectives: 击败10只躁动的荨皮精怪。
text.description: 我不想在这种小东西身上浪费时间。$B$B杀死抓到的所有这种东西。看好你的财物，他们会趁你不注意偷走各种东西。

english.title: Thieves and Troublemakers
english.objectives: Kill 10 Agitated Nettleskins.
english.description: I can't catch the little buggers for the life of me.$B$BKill any you can get your hands on. And keep a close eye on your valuables, they like to steal anything that isn't tied down.

text.title: 所托非人
text.objectives: 找回新丁小赵的剑。
text.description: 听我说……呃……这还真叫人尴尬。我去采集球形种子的时候，刚把剑放在地上不到一秒钟，不知从哪儿突然蹦出来一个大林精，拿起我的宝剑就跑进西面的峡谷里不见了。$B$B没了剑我可怎么回营地啊。丢失武器一定会被影踪派除名的，剑在人在。$B$B求求你，能帮我找到那个大林精并夺回宝剑吗？它对我实在太重要了。

english.title: In the Wrong Hands
english.objectives: Recover Initiate Chao's Sword.
english.description: Look... um... this is really embarrassing. I set down my sword for like ONE SECOND to gather some orbs, and a big sprite sprung out of nowhere, snatched it, and bounded off down the western gap.$B$BI can't go back to camp without it. Losing your weapon is a sure way to get kicked out of the Shado-Pan. It's sacred.$B$BPlease, can you try to find this big sprite and get my sword back? It would mean a lot to me.

text.title: 削减虫群
text.objectives: 使用龙息火炮击败50只蜂拥而至的螳螂妖。
text.description: 自从你去了裂谷后，螳螂妖的数量又增加了。你收集的这些球形种子现在要派上用场了。$B$B快到前线去操控一台大炮。不要让任何一只螳螂妖通过。

english.title: Cutting the Swarm
english.objectives: Use a Dragon Launcher to kill 50 swarming mantid.
english.description: The mantid numbers have been increasing since you left for the cleft. Let's put these orbs you gathered to use.$B$BGet down on the battlefront and man one of the cannons. Let none through.
